records.title: Accident claim
records.text: Had an accident claim that keiron champion and his team helped deal with it took a long time to get finished but covid didn’t help with that. But him and the team kept me informed all the way through the process and where very quick to deal with call and emails would recommend and would use again thanks

records.title: Excellent service!
records.text: Jenniffer Brunt & Sue Baldwin made a difficult time so straight forward. Emails were always responded to promptly and the whole process was seamless.Providing me with a fixed-fee price was also a bonus knowing that no additional costs would be involved.I would recommend the service provided to me at Slater & Gordon to anyone needing advice for family law or documentation completing, high level of professionalism whilst maintaining simplicity.Thanks again for all your help.

records.title: That they are professional and trustworthy with your case
records.text: Hi, I would just like to that Adil Saeed the solicited that dealt with my case was very helpful, professional, and polite. Adil always kept me on the right path in what would happen next and explained everything out to me in english which helped me tremendously. My case is now closed after 2 years and 2 month later which I am glad is over at last . Thank you very much Mr Adil Saeed for all your help it wouldn’t of happened if not for you Cathie Lees

records.title: Robyn Eaton has been amazing and so…
records.text: Robyn Eaton has been amazing and so professional great asset to the business xx

records.title: Targeted Service
records.text: I am very thankful for the support received from Slater and Gordon and specifically from Karen Murray. Karen has been very professional and she understood (and offered) exactly the kind of support I needed. I will definitely contact her again if I’ll need help with a legal matter. So 5 star to Karen! The reason why I have given 4 star to the overall experience, is that my details where registered incorrectly in their database and I had to chase the support team few times to rectify it. If I hadn’t done so, my case would have been forgotten.

records.title: Straightforward
records.text: Natasha Todd was very helpful in keeping me informed and the whole process was pretty straightforward, ending in a favourable result.

records.title: Thank you Mr Ryan Ellis
records.text: This eventually came to an end. Thanks to Mr Ryan Ellis.This case has been ongoing since February 2019, when I was involved in a road traffic accident. A low-loader collided with the rear of my car while itI was stationary at a traffic light. I thought it would be a straight case which would end within 18 months, but it dragged on until a few weeks ago. Solicitors were changed several times, and emails were not responded to. I was the one chasing the firm, until Mr Ryan Ellis took over my case and came to the rescue a few weeks ago. He introduced himself with a comprehensive breakdown of the issue, and hit the ground running, updating me as he went. If the other solicitors were like Mr Ellis, or if he had handled my case from the start, it would not have dragged on for more than 18 months.Mr Ellis was so professional, giving a detailed explanation of the case as we went.I will use Slater and Gordon again if the likes of Mr Ellis would be the one to handle my case. It would have been a full five stars for Mr Ellis, but for the problems I went through chasing the previous solicitors (at least five of them). Thank you Mr Ryan Ellis.

records.title: I would recommend the solicitors
records.text: I would recommend the solicitors & the only downfall was it took a long time to sort my case. Laura Frizzel was very helpful in everyway & answered all my questions.

records.title: Accident Claim
records.text: I had an accident on the 13/02/2021After going through several departments and staff who really didn't know what rhey were doingI was appointed a new solicitor in Louise Hurley who was very open and honest with me and took charge of my case and we moved forward very quicklyLouise was very thorough and explained everything, was available to take calls and returned calls if missed and responded to every email normally on the same day I was very impressed with the way she advised and looked after me through the process even though we dis-agreed on several points, we got their in the end until conclusion I would 100% recommend Louise Hurley to any one and definitely have no problems using her in the future being the professional that she isShe has my blessings in moving forward in her careerJeff  Khan

records.title: My claim was inherited by 3 or more…
records.text: My claim was inherited by 3 or more people during the process. This was due to people leaving & at first I did not feel like It was being taken care of properly, in fact one lady from Slater and Gordon tried to talk me out of it by saying my case was going to lose.Luckily however, Priyesh took over my case & things felt hopeful again. Priyesh kept me up to date with any changes & handled the communication really well, despite the challenges that the opposition threw at us.I give 5 stars to Priyesh & 3 stars to the folk who handled it previously. Priyesh managed to smooth everything out which is what matters.

records.title: What good fortune it was to get Mark…
records.text: What good fortune it was to get Mark Luxton as the Soliciter in charge of my Mesolithioma case. This case was resolved in a few months not years as other legal advisors had told us.Mark kept us totally informed every step of the way to a very satisfactory conclusion. Thnk you very much Mr. Luxton.

records.title: I am pleased with the outcome of claim for underpayment of wages.
records.text: I am pleased with the outcome of my case. It took a lot of work and my Lawyer was able to negotiate a fair settlement for me.I was informed both verbally and written throughout the process and I would recommend this company to anyone fighting a claim.

records.title: I highly recommend Andrew Hostler at…
records.text: I highly recommend Andrew Hostler at Slater and Gordon (Cambridge). It's been 6 years since my family and I signed up to be represented by Slater and Gordon, after being in a car accident whilst on holiday in the UK. Andrew Hostler took over our case 6 months ago and has managed to get my settlement to the finish line. He's easy to deal with, a great communicator and does what he say's he's going to do in a timely manner.

records.title: Slater and Gordon was abit up and down…
records.text: Slater and Gordon was abit up and down at first with my case, very slow replying to me and not very good communication at first. However, it did improve massively once Gulderen Salih took over my case she was absolutely amazing! Kept in contact regular. Never missed an email and got things moving very quickly and i got given the best out come. Gulderen salih i would personally give 5*. Thank you 😊

records.title: Professional and supportive …
records.text: Solicitor was very friendly as well as supportive and professional. She was great at giving advice with a full explanation. She never gave up when other party tried to delay and always kept me up to date.

records.title: Megan Whittaker was extremely supportive
records.text: Megan Whittaker was extremely supportive over a 2 year period involving 4 claims. Megan helped me to managed 3 minor claims with different claim handlers and was happy to act as a SPOC due to the complexity of the case. I was very grateful to have been assigned her despite the outcome of the case being a disappointing one.

records.title: Good advice and straight to the point.
records.text: I found the advice given by the solicitor very useful. The discussion with the clarified some important points and helped me to ponder and decide which action I should take next.

records.title: Waited a while but they settled my…
records.text: Waited a while but they settled my claim very well. Email updates came regularly and received a very professional service

records.title: Although my claim has taken longer to…
records.text: Although my claim has taken longer to conclude than I thought it would slater & Gordon have been professional throughout . The only negative was my adviser left halfway through and I wasn’t informed of this and was still emailing him but getting no reply .

records.title: As soon as Laura and her team took over…
records.text: As soon as Laura and her team took over my case things started to move forward which finally resulted in my claim being finalised.  I was regularly kept up to date regarding how the case was proceeding.I would like to thank all those involved

records.title: Room For Improvement
records.text: Was well supported on the whole, but via   phone, mainly email. No meet and greet which was disappointing. My paralegal although very nice could not advise me on whether to take an offer or fight my corner for a higher offer. I am still under medical supervision so this made a decision difficult.

records.title: David Cunningham from Edinburgh
records.text: David from Edinburgh dealt with my claim. David was fab, took a little longer than anticipated due to insurance not paying out within time frames and David handled me getting impatient well. Thanks for your help dealing with my claim.

records.title: My claim experience
records.text: Eason tan , the aftercase handler was amazing and did everything in his power and ability to chase payments and keep me informed.My claim handler patrycja was equally as good and I can’t thank them enough.

records.title: Mr Peter Meadows saves the day
records.text: At the start of the process i was messed around lots and if it hadn't been for Mr Peter Meadows taking over the claim i would be giving a 1 star score, he has been brilliant from taking over. Always answering questions and very informative. He deserves 5 stars but i only gave 3 as its a company rating, he certainly saved me and my daughter from any worries he is caring and just simply brilliant at his job.

records.title: Thank you Megan
records.text: The rating is very generous. Only because of the lovely Megan Whittaker.  She has only taken my case over from the previous solicitor and she went above and beyond and concluded this in 2 months. My case has been opened since May 2021 and the experience wasn’t at my expectations for the first 2 years until Megan stepped in. Thank you MW

records.title: Successful cycling accident claim
records.text: Like- My claim was handled swiftly.- Any errors were remedied quickly.- The funding process was transparent.Dislike- I did not feel like there was sufficient transparency in respect of the settlement process in that I was not told the value of any offer(s) made by the Defendant unless I chased this myself. - Communication was at times difficult, I was unable to reach my legal representative on the phone number I was given and did not receive a response to emails for several days.

records.title: I feel like my case took far too long…
records.text: I feel like my case took far too long to complete. Took almost a year to get medical information. Never made any progress in the 2 years Michelle Buck was doing my claim.   I wouldnt recommend this company as I feel very let down by them.

records.title: During my 2 years battle
records.text: During my 2 years,  3 different people dealt with my claim . This made the process harder as I had to re explain the situation to each individual , an correct miscalculated numbers due to confusion with passing from one to another . The time overall felt longer than neccesary . the company I claimed against was the main reason for this , but I feel if you give someone a date to respond , to then change that date another 5 times to recieve response seems abit pointless . Why provide a date at all if it can be pushed back weeks to months to suit someone refusing to respond ?  Apart from that I have finally had a settlement with 25% cost . Glad to be over with it , didnt feel I got as much as deserved but somethin is better than nothin . Cant complain about the overall politeness of operators . Deflated from 2 years battle , but grateful

records.title: This Thank you Megan Whittaker review is not all negative
records.text: This review is not all negative, it ends on a positive note.I had a few hick ups along the way I had about five different advisors which was stressful. And none of them seemed to get my claim rolling. October 2023 will have been three years I waited for my claim to be resolved. Along came another adviser,  Megan Whittaker. Within a few weeks of communicating with her my case has been sorted, and I am so happy. If I had Megan Whittaker first, I would have given a score of 5. Megan Whittaker was professional and had Excellent Communication Skills.Thank you, Megan Whittaker.Yours,Georgina.

records.title: Initial process was very efficient but…
records.text: Initial process was very efficient but now that the case is underway there appears to be no way to contact S&G to check in on how the claim is progressing. The numbers on the correspondence don’t work.

records.title: Wanted more time to read documents…
records.text: Wanted more time to read documents before signing really. Had one of two problems. But hopefully remedy came today on the phone. Thanks

records.title: Had to chase them for updates during…
records.text: Had to chase them for updates during claim which took a long time, I feel the offer they gave me was also kind of low but given the circumstances of my finances kinda had to take the offer.

records.title: On one occasion I felt I received a…
records.text: On one occasion I felt I received a telling off, it wasn't presented to me well and when I challenged it I felt I was being patronised.  I also had to wait a little longer as my certificate of insurance wasn't given to me at the start of the case so I had to wait a further 14 days cooling off period at the end of the case.

records.title: very long process over the phone
records.text: very long process over the phone - it took quite a while to complete the documents.I would have preferred to have had more time to read the documents sent to me before signing

records.title: I found that I had to chase…
records.text: I found that I had to chase information. ie medical records from my GP has I was being told still waiting for my medical records when I asked at my GP they had not been asked for the information it was only then that they contacted premex who then sent the signed release papers to my GP who then sent the information.I feel relevant information from specialist had not been received before conclusion of case.

records.title: Accident case August 2019 - October 2023
records.text: I have concluded a case with slater and Gordon Lawyers.  This was a car accident case that commenced in 2019 and has just been concluded finally.  My experience with this company has been a very frustrating one because of poor communication from the case handlers that were allocated to me.  So far to date I had five case handlers allocated to this case.  Everytime they left no one updated me.  I only found out when my emails where not being answered by calling the customer services. This happened throughout the case.  Finally I was allocated Lucy Boardman who improved our communication and managed to concluded the case in a timely manner.  Without her expertise this case would still be open and my frustration endless.  For that am extremely grateful to Lucy for all her assistance.On the positive, Slater and Gordon have a very efficient Customer Service team who without their assistance this would have been a contined painful experience.  For that reason I have given the company a three star rating otherwise it could have been a different story.So thanks Lucy Boardman and the Customer Service team for all your assistance and support truly appreciated.

records.title: Sorry,but I can't give an opinion…
records.text: Sorry,but I can't give an opinion because I don't have a completed case from 2021 and I don't have any information about it after the update.

records.title: After deleting a negative review I…
records.text: After deleting a negative review I managed to send email to enquiries@slatergordonThey hopefully will pass my instructions to the relevant department. Still think the lack of human interaction should be addressed.

records.title: Friendly, helpful staff seem keen to please.
records.text: I am using Slater and Gordon on my Insurance company's advice following a RTA and so far they seem to be doing ok.Everything is moving along quickly and smoothly and will hopefully come to a favourable conclusion.My only criticism is that it would be better if you had just one person dealing with your case so you have continuity of service which I would find preferable.

records.title: I had to chase extensively to get…
records.text: I had to chase extensively to get answers and the physio you recommended wasn't very good and seemed more interested in just asking money.

records.title: Disliked how many times in a working…
records.text: Disliked how many times in a working day you constantly called, I then ring back to arrange a convenient time to call outside of my working hours fir that call not to happen which then resulted in numerous calls again during office hours,

records.title: Very slow to respond
records.text: Very slow to respond,  and was very confused as to who was the person that was dealing with my issue!

records.title: Is in the case that is involved thousands of people, you’ll not get a good representation from Slater Gordon
records.text: I know that they’ve taken a very large case and won.They were so busy that I have sent an additional documents regarding my car and the effect I believe it had Due to interference with the emission chip. They did not respond to any of the letters, only automated email to Say It’s been received.Out of the blue moon I’ve got a check for £1700. Usually a solicitor firm will let you know it has been settled and it’s come to an end and you’ll be receiving set an amount of money. They i’ve not give me any such email or letter.When I complained the responseed by sending me the contract that I’ve Signed in the beginning

records.title: Slater and Gordon do not show their…
records.text: Slater and Gordon do not show their clients the care and compassion they deserve. To big of a company to care about the small people. Will not recommend to anyone

records.title: Disappointed outcome and the firm, feel let down and treated unfairly
records.text: Was part of VW claim and received £300 for the claim that lasted a couple of years. S&G decided in final moments to settle (which was against common sense from claimants perspective) and receive millions from VW as law firm for doing that. They were also awarded £193M to distribute to all claimants (around £1500 per claimant), but S&G decided (their committee) to distribute only percentage of that amount (still waiting for the calculations/logic used). Looking at their reported profits, I can only assume how the money was distributed. Complained about that all, but was told I signed up to them deciding on settlement, etc. They are now trying the same tactic with mis-sold finance. I will be avoiding them at all costs!

records.title: Bad Experience
records.text: My Experience is not good at all. It has been more than one year but nothing conclusive yet. I have never been updated about progress of my case although received emails after whiles for documents. Case worker has been changed many times. Communication gap between Client and case worker.Never been informed where we’re standing and how long will this take. Overall not good experience at all.

records.title: No personal touch I had 4 different…
records.text: No personal touch I had 4 different people looking after my case and I never met one of them.

records.title: Poor response times.
records.text: Poor response times, emails not replied to for over a month. Live chat doesn’t work.  I’ve emailed twice now about timeframe for my compensation payout, this is after I signed forms in Sept agreeing to the compensation amounts. Just want a genuine answer.

records.title: No communication
records.text: Submitted my claim when it first happened in November last year.Everything was going smoothly and fast. Up until around February when contact slowed and I had to continually reach out to them for updates. Now they have closed their small claims department and opted to switch to their sister company, they have given no timeframe on when this will happen.Can’t get through to them by phone or email either and my last case handler no longer works for the company anymore!I need some updates!

records.title: To be honest at first I thought the…
records.text: To be honest at first I thought the initial contact was superb. But then after that it all went downhill. Within 2& half years I had at least 5 different legal advisors. I found out that my second had left the company & had an automated response saying so! I’ve constantly had to chase & this has left me over the years so stressed out. My final contact was Natasha & to be fair was better than the previous, but I have to say I feel really let down by Slater & Gordon. The company failed me with the online portal system blaming the other side, then Chantel admitted you were at fault! (I have e mails to prove) it was me constantly pushing to get response. Chantelle kept saying to me she had over 200 cases to deal with. This made me feel I was not a priority. My case got delisted because of your shortfalls & had to be relisted not my fault. I only accepted the offer because your company caused me so much stress & I wanted an end to it after nearly 3 years. You were recommended to me by Irwin & Mitchell, but I will never recommend you to anyone. The stress you have caused me as a company is insane. You should be the ones paying me compensation & I will be goi g to the ombudsman with all my evidence

records.title: I’ve been waiting for weeks to receive my VW claim payment
records.text: I’ve been waiting for weeks to receive the payment for my VW claim, I receive a message from the to say cheques were being sent out but no sign of it yet. They ignore emails and fail to give updates and why a cheque when they have my bank details. I understand they received £11,000,000  from VW I’m sure that’s accruing interest in their bank not mine.

records.title: I’d definitely go elsewhere
records.text: As much as I can respect covid slowing things down a little, my claim started in 2017 it has taken 6 years to end my claim and personally majority of the time I didn’t feel the company was very professional. I had multiple people take over my case, and all but the very last person were inadequate. I was for ever chasing them and they never really progressed much. 6 years later the last person took over my case and progressed more in a few months than anyone did in the 6 years. A 25% cut for themselves is a hefty amount for the little they did. (Minus the last person, she was actually really good). I’d never use them again though and wouldn’t recommend them.

records.title: Unhappy customer
records.text: I cannot believe that after over a year Slater and Gordon decided to pass on the Small Claim section to another solicitors’ firm ( including mine).Totally disappointed as I had to deal with more stress and still waiting to be paid.

description:
Travel without stopping on European Motorways
Worried about tolls in France, Spain and Portugal? Emovis Tag UK can provide UK customers with a tag for automatic payment of motorway tolls. UK Call Centre based in Harrogate.

records.title: The ideal companion
records.text: I have used Emovis Tags for several years now and they have saved me so much time at tolls that I lost count. Super easy to set up, slow down when approaching the barrier and there you go. The tag usage is reported flawlessly with every detail needed to remember the journey. I will miss them and will repeat when the opportunity arises.

records.title: The ease of use.
records.text: There doesn't beat the experience of just continuing your trip through France when you come up against the pay stations.  Click and it's  done, the green cross points  your way ahead everytime.   Being a widower my window was on the other side when approaching the barrier so at 78 that became an awkward situation to be in, my wive would do that job in the past, but now being a Lone traveller in France I have found the tag invaluable.  I'm  now going to France via flights to keep my yearly visits going as I have decided to be able to keep my independence i must stop putting myself a risk in long journeys.

records.title: So far so good
records.text: So far so good. Very straightforward process and tag arrived just a few days later. Looking forward to seeing how we fair at the various tolls in France!

records.title: Replacement clip holder needed
records.text: Needed a replacement clip holder as we have changed cars and the clip holder could not be removed. Went online, clicked the 'order new clip holder' box, and got an immediate response and despatch the same day. Outstanding service. Like all of the other reviews, this is a brilliant piece of kit and allows stress free motoring on the autoroutes.

records.title: Very good service and a very useful…
records.text: Very good service and a very useful product allowing us fast entrance and exit from the French motorway toll system. Very easy to instal and the monthly billing was clear and accurate. My only regret is that whilst they cover France, Spain and Portugal, they do not cover Italy.

records.title: Needed replacement clip holders
records.text: Needed replacement clip holders ordered just after Christmas and arrived the next day. Excellent service

records.title: We have been so pleased to have been…
records.text: We have been so pleased to have been able to use our what used to be called a SANEF Tag. Once you’ve driven up to your first toll station, it’s so marvellous to hear the little device in your car chirp into life, then the barrier magically lifts up to let you through. It’s so much quicker than queuing up with everyone else and importantly far better for my wife who struggled to reach the ticket machine on her side of the car. It was great value for money but sadly, we’ve had to cancel due to the end of our foreign touring holidays.

records.title: Accepts payments from UK banks
records.text: Very easy application process and very speedy delivery of tag, less than 48 hours. Also accepts payments from UK banks unlike some other tags.

records.title: the clip and the tag arrived very quickly
records.text: .not used it yet but the clip and the tag arrived  ahead of time The website is an easy system.Will be using it next year

records.title: Compliments all round
records.text: I have been using Emovis tags for three or four years visiting France and Spain six or seven times.So far the system has been absolutely faultless. It works a treat. Just drive up to the barrier and was through without stopping.My contact with the office staff has always been unfailingly great, which is why I have taken the time to send in a review.

records.title: Delivery response and rectification
records.text: I paid for next day delivery, admittedly this was on Christmas eve, but obviously wasn't expecting it to be delivered on Christmas day!! Received an email stating it would be delivered on 28th before 1.00pm. subsequently by 6.00pm still no sign of it. I'd left security gates open all day (I was, out but my wife was in) to allow delivery, as it is a required sign on delivery. I paid for this service and they didn't honour their promise, I now expect a full re fund for delivery charge.....poor service!!!I received a phone call from Emovis on 30/12/24 and sincerely apologised for the non delivery of my item at the stated date. They cannot explain why the courier hadn’t delivered it, at it was at the depot ready. They have rectified the issue and made good their end of the agreement. I am now pleased and impressed with the professional attitude of their team.

records.title: Never received my toll tag in post
records.text: I emailed my issue and they replied within a couple of hours with a solution. As with other organizations I thought I wouldn't hear for a few days. Good service to date

records.title: Buy a new tag before leaving the UK if you have any doubts about your current one.
records.text: Once connected to Customer Services my experience could not have been better. Using the chat facility not so good.  I had problem in France (travelling alone in the car from north to south) with faulty tag. Had no joy with ‘Emma’ on Chat. I’m an experienced tag user and not in a new car. However CS advised me my grey tag was faulty (despite the battery coming up as ok) and needed replacing. They were most helpful with addressing my subsequent queries. Fortunately I am flying home for a few days and can pick up new tag. They don’t despatch to France.

records.title: Positive chat but poor database function
records.text: Just had a positive chat with customer services. Your adviser gets 5 stars for courtesy and accuracy. But, your system could only recognise me as a customer by my full three part name. You couldn’t find me on your database via my post code, address, mobile number or surname alone. You need to rethink how you identify your customers. Just saying..,

records.title: Very efficient and prompt service
records.text: Very efficient and prompt service. One brief telephone conversation answered the couple of queries I had. Looking forward to hassle free tolls when we head back into France very shortly.

records.title: Ok but could have been better…
records.text: Well done for offering to exchange Tag which was one of those where there has been problems with battery reliabilityIt would have been better if you'd made it clear that this was free of charge and if you'd provided a Freepost address for the return of the old Tag to save me have to pay postage

records.title: Emovis Customer Service
records.text: I had a difficult experience trying to close my account because I couldn’t work out how to do it easily. However, having an office in the UK really helped, Customer Service got in touch and explained everything I needed to do and how the deposit refund worked and the final bill. I used Emovis Tag for several years and it’s absolutely brilliant racing through the barriers.

records.title: Great help for Autoroutes
records.text: Very fast service, ordered a new tag and it arrived the next day.  These tags are really useful for the motorways, it would be better still if they could be used in Italy too.  A bit disappointed though that on being told my tag might have a battery problem, it was essential to pay a new tag deposit.  I assume I will get the deposit back on the old one, but so much easier if it had been a straight swap.

records.title: Overall a good service however…
records.text: Overall a good service however replacement of tags is a clumsy process and could be more efficient. Also disputes re incorrect toll payments is not particularly efficient and could be quicker/more streamlined. Am only handing my tag in as I now live in France ans there are cheaper providers available here.

records.title: Previous tag expired during Covid…
records.text: Previous tag expired during Covid inactivity.  Love the device, but wonder why I pay £20 again to join the club. Is it refundable - I was not clear on if so or how… Too keen to get the marvellous little gizmo and zoom past the queues - unless  they’ve all got one now!

records.title: Absolutely essential for driving in France
records.text: Absolutely essential for driving in France in my opinion, the site works well, although the billinglog could be a little easier to follow i think - just ordered my first replacement tag due to a battery warning, so will see how that goes... thanks!

records.title: Beware product recalls
records.text: Updated (in light of receiving customer service after posting).Generally great experience in using the Emovis tag in France - beating queues at tolls (and not having to climb across passenger side of right-hand drive car to waive credit card), generally clear pricing structure and simple billing.Just a cautionary note about responding to automated product recall emails and using the chat function on their site to resolve any queries. I got an email asking me to order a new tag and return my old one (a product recall). I chatted with customer support to confirm this was really required (as mine was quite new) and was told it was and that the usual postal fee would be waived. I got a new one but was charged the postal fee. I complained, but they said it was my error and that despite the email and confirmation, my tag was actually from an unaffected batch. I ‘returned to sender’ the unwanted tag in mail without opening it. I am out of pocket postal fee, refundable deposit, and the exchange fees from euro to gbp. (Update below ##)On the plus side, just returned from trip and my old tag worked fine.## I have subsequently been offered notional postal fee (€5) back, although not sure exactly how that will work with the currency exchange fees. Nonetheless I appreciate the gesture, am retaining my subscription and look forward to travelling with Emovis tag again.

records.title: Renewing tags
records.text: I have used French and Portugal tags and they make motorway travel so much easier. It is not absolutely clear, with the online system, what actions you have asked for. (I amazingly asked for three new tags for my one car by mistake - AND they all arrived!!) the web-site desperately needs a summary status/history page so you can check you've made the right choices. I DID phone and lthe lady I spoke to made everything easy.

records.title: service needs streamlining.
records.text: I have had great service for all the years I have been with Emovis and their forerunners.  However I am not sure that they are now the cheapest company which allows UK membership.  The process of ordering a new tag when the battery is time expired and returning the old is annoying and needs to be streamlined.

records.title: I have had both Tags for a few years…
records.text: I have had both Tags for a few years now, and service has always been great! Someone needs to simplify their website, so sending a Tag back and obtaining a refund is confusing to say the least! I had to call them and the lady explained what to do.

records.title: Great call handling staff
records.text: Staff both incredibly helpful despite the constrictions of the Emovis company throttling of simple tasks.5 stars to the staff 2 stars to the company because of the inflexibility of their systems.

records.title: Italian anomaly
records.text: I always received excellent service from this company but reluctantly had to return my tag, which they acknowledged immediately, as they don't cover Italy where we are holidaying this summer. I have had to replace the tag through Bip and Go who cover France,Portugal,Spain and Italy but are less easy to deal with as their office is in France, plus of course the hassle of changing companies. I don't really understand this anomaly as they both use the same technology. !!??

records.title: While I found the process relatively…
records.text: While I found the process relatively easy it was delayed as my address could not be verified despite the post code and drop down box show my address. It is a minor thing that delayed things a day. A small issue or bug? Happy with the service overall.

records.title: Does The Left Hand know What The Right Hand Is Doing
records.text: I give this company 4*.The reason is I am still waiting for my clips to be delivered. I returned the clips with a note explaining that the did not fit my Tag. Excellent response informing me that the Tag I have no clips are available and should exchange my Tag to a Black one.This I did and again excellent responses My new Tag arrived next day with the matching clip. Great! But I need a clip for my wife’s car. £4.23 has not been credited to my account for thr original clips which I returned. I was expecting them with my new Tag. I mush emphasis the customer relations was excellent

records.title: The request for the tag was easy to do
records.text: The request for the tag was easy to do, I asked the chat bot for advice on the tag, was given the advice to go to the correct site. From there, very easy to fill in the request and that was it, submit the request and within 2 hours, email advice that the tag had been processed and dispatched to me.

records.title: Disappointed with the tag
records.text: Having used our Emovis tag on a number of occasions in France, we checked the status of the tag before leaving on holiday, the tag and battery status both showed ok. After using the tag twice in France it went wrong and couldn't be used for the rest of the journey. I contacted Emovis, all they said is the tag and battery status are just indications and the tag is 4 years old so presumably has gone wrong. Surely it is then pointless to have any type of status! The tag doesn't work and the staus still says everything is fine. Not impressed, if you have a status it should at least be accurate, thus i could have changed it before leaving England

records.title: Stupid system of returning  the tag…
records.text: Stupid system of returning  the tag because the battery is faulty.  But instead of issuing a replacement they want you to order another.Update 28 MayNow sorted after a phone call from Emovis. Credited for the postage to return the faulty tag and no postage on the new one, together with a new windscreen bracket.

records.title: problems with website
records.text: Had real problems with website and could not complete transaction in about 5 attempts. 4 pm in afternoon so support team had gone home and live chat not working. Finally completed process and tag dispatched following day. Will review again when I actually start to use the tag but not the best of starts

records.title: Tag cancelled and not used yet payments being taken
records.text: UPDATE - The issue was subsequently resolved after I called the company to discuss the situation.I decided not to use the Tag and contacted the company to confirm that I wanted it deactivated. I received confirmation that this had happened. When travelling in France all Tolls were paid by debit card - The Tag was not used yet payments have been taken from my account.I subsequently returned the Tag and have confirmation that it was received.Why is money being taken on the direct debit?

records.title: Just got my replacement emovis tag…
records.text: Just got my replacement emovis tag replacement for the old one after the battery has gone past it's life expectancy. It took a while to find out how to get the new one on the internet. Now it's not clear if I need to send the old one back to reclaim the deposit - no instructions with the new one. I think Emovis could be a lot clearer about this.

records.title: Mixed feelings!
records.text: Very efficient company. Having a tag is a massive bonus - only reason for three stars is I seem to have been charged the yearly fee on two tags as I recently ordered a new one and returned the old - fee was charged on the old one (which my account said had expired) while it was in the post on it's way back!!

records.title: Tag works well and saves paying out…
records.text: Tag works well and saves paying out when travelling. Customer service however, not great! We set up a new account as I just couldn't log into my account, emailed them and all they said was reset password, which still didnt work. I sent the old tags for that account back and put a letter inside asking for the refund of the deposit for 2 tags back to my bank and this was ignored.I received an email confirming they had received them and the deposit will be in next month's invoice.I already asked them to close the account and I am still waiting for a reply now as to why it hasn't been paid back to me, especially as we have paid €40 for new tags in my husband name.

records.title: Customer details not kept secure
records.text: ***Edit to add: received a phone call from Emovis today (18/10/23) and they have taken onboard all the concerns and are looking into making the experience better for the client and hopefully for this not to happen again. Adjusted my rating to 3 stars to be neutral as such***Sadly have found the customer service experience severely lacking and even worse I could hear another operator confirming another customers details inc full name, address and bank account details. Not really GDPR compliant. When I flagged this to the person I was speaking to they just laughed and said she was a loud person… Now just hoping someone didn’t hear all my details

records.title: Great product but when my battery…
records.text: Great product but when my battery expired I paid for next day delivery for a replacement two weeks ago prior to going to France.The delivery did not turn up next day or has it some two weeks later and post my trip to France.

records.title: Five stars for how useful, BUT…
records.text: I found it very hard to find how to return a tag. I received numerous emails saying the battery was nearly finished. So, I ordered a new one. Surely, if I already have a tag, I should be sent return details for the old one?Overall the Emovis tag was the best thing I did - travelling solo on French motorways - it saved the scramble across the van to use my card. Welll worth the small amount for the lease.

records.title: The website is not great.
records.text: The website is not great.I get that I need to return the tag with an expired battery, but it fails to recognise that I have already ordered a new tag.Your site should join together, return tag due to battery, AND at the same time, supply a new one.

records.title: Recycling fail, so far…
records.text: I have used the tag for travelling in France. It got me through motorway tolls with grace and speed!! No scrambling to the opposite side of the vehicle to get my card in the slot…BUT my present tag’s battery has run out. Emovis will send a new one and take the old one for recycling. I still have not found how to recycle the old one, the website is flawed in that department. 😥

records.title: This is usually a great firm but it’s a…
records.text: This is usually a great firm but it’s a shame they don’t listen to customer requests. Ordered a new screen attachment and could I get them to send it to any address other than the account one….. No!

records.title: Also mixed feelings I ordered a new TAG…
records.text: Also mixed feelings I ordered a new TAG for France and two extra clips .I received the TAG ok and clips  but the clips were for a Spanish TAG which were not compatible .Evidently it was my fault for ordering the wrong ones ,really?.

records.title: EMOVIS TAG FAILURE
records.text: I'VE PAID FOR THE TAG  TWO WEEKS AGO BUT HAVE RECEIVED ONLY THE CLIPS BUT NOT THE TAG ITSELF.TRAVELLING IN SIX DAYS TIME Now resolved They said I hadn't ordered the tag only the clips.

records.title: Company cant accept its mistakes
records.text: This tag is great if you are travelling through France. Simply pull up, wait for the beep and carryon enjoying your journey. Just remember that it is more expensive then paying each toll.The problem is the customer service or lack of. I payed extra for guaranteed next day delivery, but it was not sent next day. I contacted customer service and was given loads of excuses, trying to blame me saying that there system had not registered the tag, even though I had verified it 24 hours before. They still took payment for next day. When will companies learn that computers are not perfect and a simple apology goes a long way instead of trying to shift the blame to the customer.Reply to Emovis Tag. I stated paying extra for each toll because you charge a fee. If you paid each toll at the toll booth, the journey would be cheaper. I did not say that the charge was more. My toll cost on my journey was 41.40 euros, however by the time i paid 12 euros for an annual fee (which i understand), an application fee of 12 euros (which I understand), the cost of the tag 20 euros, (which I agree), a monthly fee (why you have a monthly fee and an annual fee I dont know, but i knew this before), and the 12 euros for the guaranteed next day delivery that takes 3 days, my total cost is over double at £108.34 euros. If people understand that the convenience cost more then its a good service. Shame the customer service is bad.With regard to the rest of your answer, you have just proved my point. As I stated in my review, I clicked the link. It was your system that did not register it, but again instead of admitting this, you decided to put it down to me, the customer. No offer of refunding the money for the trouble or even an appology, just excuses. As my title states "Company cant accept its mistakes"

records.title: AVOID if using a Motorbike
records.text: The tag works well in a car but is really unreliable on a motorbike.Sometimes it lets you into the motorway but then fails to function properly when exiting necessitating a time delay and call to the helpline.All whilst patient travellers are backing up behind you .Also there have been problems with toll adjustments when the toll classes the motorbike as a car then declines a toll adjustment even though the previous tolls and following tolls were on a motorbike. All this is enhanced by very average customer service in the UK.

records.title: Jac and ger
records.text: Getting the Tag was easy and quick. Using the Tag absolutely fabulous. However as this was a one off trip with family we won't be driving in France again( we are now nearly 80) we returned the Tag as requested for our refund. We have proof of postage but the Tag was not delivered so they say! A first time ever for us! So we did not get our refund but we did get a very quick response when I cancelled the direct debit! Not impressed with the after care service.

records.title: Works about 60% of the time.
records.text: Used on a motorcycle trip. Worked about 60% of the time. Had to reverse out of some toll booths, tailgate trucks through and read all the numbers to an assistant over crappy intercom. Bit of a nightmare at times as the French drivers love tailgating and leave no room for you to manoeuvre when things don't work. .

records.title: Failed after 1 journey
records.text: The tag failed after 1 journey through France. For that 1 journey it was excellent hence 2 stars rather than 1. Customer service was poor: the only thing I got in response was them questioning where I had positioned the tag on windscreen. When I returned the tag they admitted it had failed but did not offer either an apology or refund.I believe the failure rate is low but I wish I hadn't bothered.

records.title: Emovis exchange rate makes it very expensive!
records.text: The tag itself works fine, although if you want to travel in Spain and Portugal you need another tag, so that’s the cost of 2 tags and still it doesn’t cover Italy!However that’s not the worst of it. Emovis charge you in £s and their exchange rate is atrocious! You can’t pay in euros, making this tag way more expensive than normal tolls or any of the other tag providers….

records.title: Battery replacement is a pain
records.text: Really like having the tag but it's telling my my battery has expired and on the website I'm expected to pay for a replacement tag because of this.Such a waste of resources and postage when they could have had a slide-in CR2032 battery that you could replace yourself.

records.title: Ordered an extra clip for my second…
records.text: Ordered an extra clip for my second car. Immediately emailed Customer Services to cancel if it went to my 'other' location. Ignoring that request, they dispatched the item the next day informing me ONLY then that, the order can't be cancelled. It's quite an expensive service for the convenience and for such a nominal costing item, I was surprised. It seems, every penny counts. Needless to say, I wont see the item but will be charged. Yes, I shouldn't have checked beforehand but, equally, I gave plenty of notice!!

records.title: Delivery charges are a bit much
records.text: Used the tags for years but get a little miffed in having to pay £5 to deliver a French tag and £5 to deliver a Spanish tag when ordered to replace at the same time. Surely there should be a way of ordering both tags and paying 1 delivery charge for people that use both tags.

records.title: New tag came to replace old one with…
records.text: New tag came to replace old one with it's battery expired but with zero information on how to get the €20 deposit back on the old tag. Seems like a a con to extract an extra €20 out of you.

records.title: My name is Greg McAllen
records.text: My name is Greg McAllen. I am the proprietor, along with my Wife, of a small business based in Rutland. We have been continuously trading since 1981.Now I know this is a long review, and long reviews can be boring, but before using this company, you should be aware of how they can behave if things don't go their way and their client upsets them. In December 2023, my wife and myself viewed a property for sale and agreed with the owner to purchase. It was a straight forward sale with no loans or mortgage. Part funding was to come from the sale of one of our three industrial units, one of which is solely owned, and used by us privately. The remaining balance to come from our Barclays savings account. I had sold the industrial unit, freehold, to the owner of another neighbouring business on our industrial estate. It was a straight forward sale without involving the services of a solicitor or estate agent. There was a wait on our buyers part, due to a Land Registry issue, our buyers funds coming to us from the Halifax. In the meantime, I looked to engage the services of a conveyancer as our deal was done and just waiting for the funds to land in our account. Normally, I would use my usual solicitor, who is not local, which meant travelling the A1, in the middle of winter, just to sign a few documents. We did not want to do this. We therefore decided to use the services of Hegartys, local to us in Oakham. Additionally, my Daughter has friends working for their Stamford office. Having obtained a quotation of £1650, which I thought reasonable, we made a trip to their office in Oakham. All went well until, on being asked where the funds for a cash property purchased had come from, and I informed them they were from the sale of an industrial unit. They asked the solicitors name who dealt with this, and the name of the estate agent. When we informed them we had not engaged the services of either, their attitude changed, along with the facial expressions. It was not nice at all. I was faced with accusations of money laundering, which where thrown at us on many occasions over the following weeks. Now, I understand solicitors have to cover themselves, but we were dealing through Barclays Bank and electronic transfers, all of which have a paper trail. The Bank have their own policies to prevent money laundering and if the money was not from a legitimate source, it would not be in there. We both felt the solicitor and case handler were unhelpful, bordering obstructive. It was like we were being treated as criminals, and paying for the privilege. Finally, having formed a distrust of this Lady, I agreed with the seller to pay him directly. I did not feel I should transfer our savings to Hegartys and trust this solicitor with control of our lives. We had a very bad feeling this solicitor may delay the purchase, possibly losing us the property. The payment was made to the seller, via CHAPS transfer from our Barclays account. Oddly, we received an email from them, telling us we cannot do this, not advising us against it, or giving reason why we shouldn't, just telling us we could not. Not once did we receive any communication from this Lady that could be construed as advice. Therefore on the 22nd April, with the sellers agreement, we transferred the funds, both signed a document stating what the money was for and the terms we had agreed between us, and in two days we moved into the property. Result. This just left formal completion. At this point I advised Hegartys of the situation, via email, and asked them to continue to completion and transfer. I finally received a reply yesterday saying they were no longer working for us. I had already learnt this, receiving a phone call from the seller, saying HIS solicitor had been contacted by Hegartys to be told they no longer worked for us. Additionally, Hegartys contacted the estate agent and informed them that myself and my wife were laundering money. Now that is one hell of an accusation, based on a unfounded suspicion without evidence. But to relay a suspicion to an estate agent in the form of an accusation, not even one of their own profession, is very naughty indeed and indicates to us we were correct in not placing trust, and our funds, with this solicitor. This action was just vindictive and unprofessional attempting to cause trouble and halt the sale even though POST-stating they no longer working for us. We have not received any further communication. My advice to others considering using Hegartys is be careful as this particular solicitor cannot be trusted if scorned. Certainly do not divulge any sensitive information or information you wish to remain private as she may use it to support her own stance, additionally making up stories as she goes along to fill in the gaps, particularly if you do not do as you are told! MAD!

records.title: Conveyancing Neglect Warning
records.text: WARNING – Do not use this company for conveyancing if you are buying a property with someone and you are putting down a bigger deposit than your partner, they are not thorough in personally explaining the financial pitfalls of joint ownership.  I bought a house with my partner in 2015, I paid £101k deposit (46.5%), my partner paid a zero deposit. I naively signed to buy the house as 50/50 Joint Tenants thinking that was owned jointly in name only, not realising it meant I was handing over £50,500 to him at the point of purchase!!! I had to leave my home 3 years ago taking our two children with me due to him being abusive. I am now renting for the 3 of us which is expensive. He won’t move out or sell the house, and we can’t live with him. I can’t afford to sell it anyway because I’d have to give him half of my deposit plus growth, plus equity on top of that!!! Even though I have already paid for 46.5% of the house, he is trying to make me pay half the remaining mortgage. I can’t even get him to pay rent on my half of the property he is living in.  There’s still 17 years on the mortgage and I’m going to have to wait all those years to get my money back out of the house, while he gets the privilege of living in it and earning money on it.  When I questioned Hegarty about my situation and how they could not have personally discussed the deposit situation to make me realise what I was doing, and advise me properly, their response was that our relationship was OK when we bought it and a split was not anticipated. What sort of response is that?! That’s exactly why they should have help protect me!!!! Now I have nothing and am on my own with two kids trying to make ends meet.  All the money I worked for over the years that I put into that deposit is just benefitting my abusive ex-partner.  This has ruined my life and furthermore, I even paid for the privilege as I paid the conveyancing myself! Now I have questioned this with people I know who have bought houses with unequal deposits, the solicitors they used, personally sat them down to discuss this and worked out the percentage share. If they had done that with me, and protected me properly, they should have advised me to buy at around 73/27 share in my favour and I could take him to court to force him to agree to sell it.  It’s shocking how they missed this, it’s ruined mine and my children’s lives for the last 3 years, we don’t have money to even go on holiday due to my high rent and my all my savings tied up in that house. Buying a house with someone and using Hegarty is the worst mistake I have ever made, and I will pay for it for years.  Please don’t end up in my awful situation.  Use someone else, and make sure you properly discuss this with your conveyancer.

records.title: Bad advice given!
records.text: Below is the email that I sent to the solicitor that was supposed to take on my case.The response I got back from him was:'That's not a problem'I'm quite frankly disgusted and will never use or recommend this solicitor to anyone! When I first contacted you on Tuesday, you asked me to send over the paperwork relating to my redundancy offer and you said that you would contact me that afternoon, once you’d read it,  to discuss further.I sent you the paperwork as requested and heard nothing more from you that day.  I then called you at 12 noon the following day just to make sure that you had received my email and was disappointed that the impression I got, was your memory had to be jogged into even remembering who I was. You appear to be a very busy man and I understand that completely. We then had, what I can only describe as a very rushed conversation, in which you advised that I should accept the offer that was given but I felt that you had no time to hear my whole story.My other colleagues, that are also being made redundant and also had to seek legal advice, were all given appointments where they could discuss face to face their situation with their solicitors and I wasn’t even offered this option. My colleagues also told me that some of the wording on the settlement agreement should be changed and this is not something that you advised me??I know that I am nobody to you, merely a potential client, but this is a very upsetting time for me. I’m the sole ‘bread winner’ in my household with bills etc that have to be paid and I’m now losing my job which is affecting my already declining mental health.I want to be able to speak to someone who at the very least is able to be a little sympathetic to my situation and make me feel that they are on my side so to speak. Your email this morning, see below, in which you even forgot to attach your advisors certificate and only discussed to whom you should send your invoice,  has not instilled me with any more confidence. With the above in mind, I think that it would be best if I take my business elsewhere.

records.title: Not impressed with services for Immigration
records.text: All this is bearing in mind the current restrictions with COVID.A few issues in my own personnel experience for services of applying for my wifes UK Spouse Visa. 2021After receiving an email reply on how to proceed with meeting with a solicitor specializing in visa/immigration, we made the payment of £240 for a phone call meeting. First of all the payment was missed and had to follow up two days in a row. Wasn't till two phone calls and a poignant email was sent did we get somewhere. Once they realized we had made the payment and selected our appointment time. Which was then 30 minutes late, (she did apologize).The most frustrating of all was the fact we had paid this amount where the solicitor we spoke to seemed to have very little knowledge of our circumstances. Everyone's circumstances are different I am aware. We learned one thing from this expensive, short meeting, which I strongly feel  was genuinely not worth it. Now bear in mind this was only a 30 minute phone call which I feel deeply angered by at the whole thing from start to finish. Where on earth can you get away with charging the public that rate for someone who does not know what they are fully talking about and I am trying to apply for my wifes visa which is of a serious nature. I want to be assured by a solicitor this is the way and that is the way. Not hesitant or unsure. I am sorry but this was a wake up for us. We continued on from here without any further services and will not in future either.Thank you for the prompt reply. Interesting that within 17 hours of my review and you have researched the meeting with my wife, from over 4 weeks ago and have replied.If only the same amount of effort was put into a little research prior to my wifes meeting. Really felt there was a lack of knowledge on the subject. The information given was all found online and was not up to date with some aspects. When I am dealing with a Solicitor at your rates I expect to be fully satisfied with the services rendered leaving the call with far more clarity on the issues brought forward. Which on this particular occasion I most regrettably did not.The only reason the call was pleasant as your employee describes, I am just simply giving an honest review. Lastly I did not take this further at that time due to the fact I simply had enough other concerns at hand having moved back to the UK. If I was to dispute the meeting I was undoubtingly in for a another ride. I will take my losses instead and wrote this review. I have no issues paying for services at all. But as they say you get what you pay for, well I feel not in this case.Thank you and have a good day

records.title: I would not recommend this company even…
records.text: I would not recommend this company even though the outcome was positive for an ILR spouse visa, many mistakes where made during the process these being as follows.1) issuing a Partially Complete application form despite raising this with them and sending them a response from Sopria Steria. This was only corrected the afternoon before the appointment at 08:30 the next day when they finally sent the completed form and check list.  They kept insisting the partially complete form was correct,it was not.2) The cover letter they issued had part way through got a different applicants name on.3) The letter said the application was for naturalisation which its not its settlement.4) The application was for a spouse ILR visa and the 180 days per year does not apply it applies to PBS only. They did not know this. 5) They sent an email instructing us to send all the documents to them so they could send them on to the Home Office. As the system is now online this option does not exist they should have known this.The above significant issues can only lead to the conclusion they had never used the new online system before.

records.title: They will not honour their own words!
records.text: I was very happy with Jemima who handles my case and she did a wonderful job and always kept me in the loop, however, I have very clearly agreed them with the pricing, they have sent me detailed pricing details that too on the contract and I have explained them on numerous occasion that you have provided me with your fee on the email and you can not charge me extra once we agreed,  I can understand due to some issues they have to work extra and I have already paid them for that extra work that we have agreed however they are very reluctant to charge nearly 3k extra as the fee, I was under the impression that Davidson is a very professional company and they don't do such things but I was wrong and even after showing them all the proof about the agreed payment, they have refused to honour their own words. So if you are looking for a fair price commitment, They are Big - NO NO If you don't care about paying extra without any commitment then, of course, you can choose themOverall I am very happy with Jemima work, who works as a solicitor in this firm but I am disappointed with Davidson Morris due to lack of moral and ethical standards!Update 25th Aug 2020:Davidson replied to my review stating that they have provided the Terms of business to me which states about the fee, However they have very conveniently missed the part where I have asked them multiple times to give me a break down of the fee on the contract and also on the email. which they did and they have clear knowledge about my work so they are happy to charge the unfair, unethical, and unprofessional version of their fee which breaks their own contract and their own words.Thank you for the wonderful and professional way of making people feel good about how they can be exploited by your firm!

records.text: We instructed New Homes Law to act for us in the sale of my partner’s shared ownership flat and in the purchase of our new home. Taylor Mynard was our conveyancer and overall we were really happy with the service provided. Taylor was extremely responsive over email and also spoke with us on the phone on a few occasions at the outset when it looked like there were a few complications with the sale. We know that common complaints about conveyancers are that they can be hard to get a hold of, but Taylor usually responded substantively within a couple of hours (and often within a couple of minutes) and it felt as if he was proactively moving things forward for us and helped us to complete on time.The main reason we would not give NHL 5 stars is that there were a few times when we noticed typos in the paperwork (ie in our names) and one occasion when the written advice provided referred to details that weren’t relevant for our transaction, so we assume that meant a precedent had been used and not properly updated. These little errors may be understandable given number of transactions NHL probably processing at same time and weren’t really material, but would suggest anyone using them does carefully review documents they are asked to review to make sure everything checks out. All in all though we would definitely recommend Taylor and NHL for very good services, priced very competitively. Thank you again!

records.title: Good service, delay on land registry

We did come across an issue with registering the property which has now been resolved.As New Homes Law are dealing with many first time buyers, I think it would be prudent to ensure clients are better informed post-completion of any issues or delays. However, I'm pleased to say when the issue was discovered, it was dealt with quickly.

records.title: Poor service from NH Law (review updated)
records.text: Initial problem for which I raised a negative review:I bought my flat directly from Bellway in Nov 2018, and they recommended NH Law. Fastforward July 2020, and the land registry still did not have my details updated. Was the problem solved?Yes. Problem solved within roughly 3 weeks of the initial escalation.Jessica from NH Law was extremely helpful, and managed to get everything over the line. I am updating the star rating from 1 to 3. Jessica handled it in a 5 star manner from the time she got involved, however, the company should still be held accountable for the entire process.As lay people who make the biggest investment of their lives in a home, we depend on, and have absolute faith on the solicitors to get the job done. It's critical that the team involved do not drop the ball on any of the clients processes. There should be justifiable excuse for an 18 month delay in registration. It meant that for 18 months after paying up, I was not the legal owner of my property, in the eyes of the land registry.Given how many of us bought from the same new development faced different kinds of issues due to NH Law, I hope they take this feedback in the right spirit, and come out with new processes to ensure their future customers do not face the same issues.

records.title: Fast conveyancing of new home but long delay with registering
records.text: I bought my new build home in February 2021 and was recommended New Homes Law by the developers, who offered an incentive to use them.  My original convenancer was a good communicator and enabled my purchase to go ahead on time (I was also selling an older house with another law firm).Unfortunately, through mishandling and mistakes with several different conveyancers involved, I have had to contact the Land Registry several times for them to chase New Homes Law.  They said the first application they received was in July 2022 and was incorrectly filed.  I had been advised that the application would go in shortly after I'd completed in February 2021. This caused yet more delays and no apparent urgency on the part of New Homes Law, who didn't contact me about this mistake and the delay.  I have now received copies of the Land Registry register and Transfer by email from New Homes Law, nearly 3 years after I bought my house!  I am still waiting for my NHBC Certificate to be sent to me.

records.title: We have recently completed on the sale…
records.text: We have recently completed on the sale of our property and purchase of our new home and dealt with Aysha from start to finish throughout this process.I did not feel reassured or informed by Aysha and would quite often make contact myself for updates rather than being updated. During these calls Aysha’s attitude always made me feel as though I was an inconvenience and shouldn’t have made contact. I appreciate she deals with this day in day out, but I don’t and found it to be a stressful process and I never felt any better for contacting New Homes Law. Having said that, aside from being spoken to with a poor attitude every time I called,  and having to constantly chase, the sale and purchase was completed within 3-4 months despite there being some complications so that was a positive.

records.title: Awful experience with Taylor
records.text: I disliked dealing with them. Not a company I’d use again. The Hoowla doesn’t get filled in, and has IT problems so you can’t track things accurately by checking that. To sum up the experience in one episode - I emailed Taylor  30 Aug 23 querying the reason for a charge of £250 on the conveyancing statement he wrote, called “service charge”, as my service charge was in credit £130? Completion happened 31 AugHe replied 4 Sept that if I’m in credit I need to ask the landlord for it. But I want to know why NHL paid£250 on my behalf. Actually it turned out weeks later, Taylor mislabelled it fee, it wasn’t a service charge. This kind of muddling is standard. If they don’t think it’s worth their time, they give disingenuous, off kilter answers that don’t satisfy the question.I’m disabled and not going to make my difficult life even more difficult dealing with these gummy bears by doing a complaint. I complained I wasn’t getting updates and replies to enquiries, they decided to ask an office manager email me DAILY saying there was no update. Even when there were actual updates. I asked them not to. There’s no pleasing some people, right? What would have pleased me would be actual replies and updates, but I’d have had to undertake a written complaint process to even begin to convince them of that. I’ve put my complaints to them in writing, if they want to act on them (they won’t) they can. You can see the attitude come through on their responses here. What is legally compliant work, and what is reasonable customer service is a wide gap that these people occupy and they will defend it for ever and ever, just as long as they don’t do what you ask. If you like being in the wrong at all times and seen as unreasonable, talk to New Homes Law.

records.title: Poor customer service until I changed conveyancers
records.text: To their credit, when I changed to a new conveyancers, they issued me a full refund and swiftly transferred over all files to the new conveyancers, who were significantly better. This is the only reason this review is not 1 star.So some of what I ended up with over my frustrating time with New Homes Law:- Outstanding tasks being left for over a week with no explanation- I have a record of correspondences where I emailed, waited 48 hours for a response, got none and then had to call them- Most times the response from my call would be that someone would get back to me by the end of the day, that rarely happened- Emails not being forwarded to me to allow me to take immediate action- No out of office statuses being set for people on holiday and no one else taking up their tasks whilst on holiday or ill- Changes of staff dealing with my case with no explanation as to why (later found out they’d left the company)- Twice claiming not to have received a hard copy of a document that was sent and not accepting a soft copy despite the issuing party informing them a soft copy was fineI did initially just ask to be re-assigned to another solicitor but they couldn’t do this as there was no one else - I think perhaps they’re just overworked and understaffed, but they don’t mention that to you. It just ends up with poor customer service.

records.title: Slow, not responsive service that I have to chase after
records.text: I was using this company because Peabody recommended it for the completion. They changed my solicitor 3 times, delayed my completion for 3 months (I've been chasing nonstop), never returned email in time and if I call, the solicitor was forever in the meeting, miscalculated my stamp duty tax, missing ground rent payment etc..  Overall a very stressful experience for completing my apartment purchase.

records.title: Will not use again but negative feedback has been addressed by NHL
records.text: Although my initial experience with NHL when buying the flat was positive, my experience selling via them up until when Taylor (who was friendly and responsive) took over my case was poor and did not meet the standards NHL say they stand for on their website and on their phone holding message. The sale of the flat was close to falling through but was completed in the end. Below is what I understand happened.- Documents requested from Buyer's solicitor on 23rd January were not requested via Land Registry until 13 March 2023 and when requested was not done properly (using individual signature instead of NHL signature). This caused a major delay which was not resolved until mid May. -The Management pack for the company that is responsible for our Ground Rent, Mainstay, was not initially requested despite, I understand, being obviously required and despite NHL stating on 13 March 2023 ‘I can confirm management pack has been received and has been sent across to the buyers Solicitors’. We then understand only the management pack for Firstport, service charge, was requested and Mainstay’s one may have only been requested in early April (though I can’t confirm this because I didn't get a response).  Further investigation from me after receiving an email from Mainstay on 12 April 2023 led me to understand that Mainstay needed to receive a Leasehold Certificate from me so they could produce the Landlord Certificate (none of which NHL had flagged to me). For this I needed to get a document from Land Registry for which I had to pay £7.00 by cheque only to find out from the Estate Agent (not NHL) that NHL already had this document which my Estate Agent then emailed to me. I then contacted Mainstay to expedite the process. UPDATE: Having followed the official complaints process I have amended my review, and have left points that are still valid but have been addressed by NHL.

records.title: Got the job done, but would definitely go elsewhere next time.
records.text: I am not interested in a name and shame so will keep names out of it, but I was not happy with my contact with NHL.She would never offer information without me having to chase and I felt as though she would have happily ignored me the entire process had I not been asking for updates every week or so.  Being a first time buyer this process is extremely intimidating and when I asked questions or asked for clarification on things I was made to feel like a nuisance and a bother.My address listed on their systems was wrong and my post ended up going through the wrong door on occasion which is a huge GDPR breach - even after I told them this and gave them the right address it was still written wrong on my post. The contract itself only came through my door by pure luck as I had a parcel that day and the postman recognised my name. There were typos in my contract (including my name being spelt wrong which I had to cross out and correct). I explained early in the process my deposit money would take minimum 3 working days to be withdrawn and was not even told when an exchange date suddenly appeared on my portal (per chance I happened to check and noticed it) and I suddenly needed 10% of my deposit within 2 working days in order to continue.On the day of completion (no less than 10 minutes before I was due to leave to go and pick up the keys to my new house) I received an email stating the contract had not been signed correctly by myself despite them having received it 5 weeks prior to this date and this had not been mentioned before.  In December, I was told by my NHL contact not to give notice to my landlord until we had a solid exchange date in sight - I moved into my house on the 1st Feb and am yet to receive word that I should give my old Landlord notice that I was moving house so it's just as well I did not continue waiting blindly on my NHL contact to advise. When you are paying upwards £1000 for a service you do expect some level of respect and working in customer service myself I was very conscious to avoid being a 'demanding' customer and was always polite when asking for information that should have been given to me rather than me needing to chase. I appreciate it is easy to become jaded in such a position, but I think its worth taking into consideration how intimidating this process is for someone such as myself and NHL certainly did not help with the stress that comes with buying a house.
