description:
At Jackson Boyd, we specialise in dealing with contentious litigation in the areas of personal injury, employment law and dispute resolution. 

For those who have suffered negligence, abuse or injury, Jackson Boyd offers the highest level of legal expertise delivered in a caring and compassionate way. We pursue just compensation for our clients’ genuine grievances, providing a service that is tailored to each individual’s needs and ensures we deliver the best possible results. In the last year alone, we have assisted over 12,000 people and secured millions of pounds in compensation. We cover all types of accidents, from whiplash damage to life-threatening catastrophic injuries. For all personal injury work, we provide a no-win, no-fee service.

Our Dispute Resolution team handles a wide range of legal disputes, from professional negligence to disputes between landlords and tenants. We take great pride in our personal yet professional approach to each and every legal case we deal with. We understand that for you, your business or personal reputation may be at stake, and so too may be your vested interests in a project or business transaction.

Our Employment Law team has expertise in all areas of employment law, and can assist you with your employment law concerns. The law relating to employment is a very wide area, and covers everything from offers of employment to termination of employment and everything in between. You may be an employer who has an issue to resolve regarding a contract, or an employee who has a dispute about unfair dismissal or whistleblowing. Jackson Boyd is well placed to help you regardless of the circumstances, and we pride ourselves on our excellent client care and legal knowledge.

To get you the best possible outcome, our dedicated teams will provide a compassionate, personal service that will focus on your particular circumstances and needs. We will take the time, care and effort needed to find the best solution to your problem, meaning that you are safe in the knowledge that your issue is in safe, experienced and professional hands.

records.title: You might have ‘legal expenses’ cover…
records.text: You might have ‘legal expenses’ cover with your home or other insurance, if so read on. Jackson Boyd are the panel solicitors for at least one of these insurers, and while this might contain some insurance element, it is primarily a method for channelling business to Jackson Boyd. Jackson Boyd, at least for the legal expense insurance side of their business, is a glorified claims management company. Their primary source of income in these cases seems to be the judicial expenses which they recover from the other side, and these are a relatively paltry amount. Consequently you may get an unqualified claims handler or paralegal handling your case. They might even under settle your claim. One of the Partners, Mr David McKinney, tried to ‘strong-arm’ me into settling a claim for an amount which another firm has labelled ‘derisory’. He even did so by misrepresenting the legal position around the personal injury ‘qualified one way cost shifting’ protocol.  My injuries turned out to be serious and life altering. I have now moved to a ‘proper’ law firm that are genuinely fighting for my interests. The success fee they will take is worth every penny. In summary, if you are seriously injured go to a firm where your case will be handled by an experienced qualified solicitor and they will get a barrister on board early. Digby Brown, Thompsons and Balfour & Manson are a good starting point. Someone accredited as a personal injury specialist with the Law Society of Scotland or Association of Personal Injury Lawyers is a decent indicator of quality.

description:
PLS is a modern and progressive property law firm, putting our customers at the heart of everything we do.PLS has offices in Manchester and central London. With around 150 employees, we are one of the leading conveyancing firms in the country by volume. We are experienced in all types of conveyancing including Help to Buy.

Here at PLS, we value every single one of our customers and we love hearing about your positive experiences. However, we do recognise that sometimes things do not go as smoothly as we would like. Like many property business, the past year has been particularly hard – from the impact of the pandemic to the extra strain brought about by the introduction of the stamp duty holiday - so, it has not always been possible to achieve those Five Star reviews. 

Excellence in customer service is extremely important to us and if you have any concerns with our service, please do get in touch with your conveyancer, or you can direct message us on Facebook! If you need to, please also use our complaints procedure, details of which you will find in the first letter we sent to you and also from a search on our website.

This platform is for our clients only and we monitor all feedback for service improvement and also content accuracy.

records.title: Excellent experience under tight time constraints
records.text: Recommended by Persimmon Homes when we were part-exchanging our old property and buying a new build. We only had 6 weeks between starting the process and completing. Team were fantastic and kept us up to date at all times making sure we knew what was going on. Anything we needed help with they were on hand to help with straight away and liaise with the other solicitors. Everything completed on time just before Christmas, with PLS helping to take away any unnecessary stress from us at an already stressful time.

records.title: Outstanding service!
records.text: Outstanding service!Can’t thank this company enough as they have been fantastic from the first day until the completion day.Would recommend this company to anyone us looking for a fantastic customer service!Exactly what you want when you’re buying  your first house.

records.title: Spot on from exchange to completion
records.text: From exchange to completion PLS were fantastic. Loved the app so I could see the progress. The communication was spot on, everything went smoothly and if I had a query it was answered promptly. Would 100% recommend this company

records.title: First time Buyers
records.text: My mortgage broker put me through to PLS and Sean Hibbert handled our case. It was our first time buying our home and Sean was patient and understanding. He was there when we had questions and answered them all and helped us on our behalf. He put us at ease and guided us through the paperwork. Myself and my mother are satisfied and grateful to him and his team. I will definitely recommend using PLS for an exceptional experience. Thank you!

records.title: Best conveyancing team
records.text: Lucy and her team were the absolute best, fantastic communication, updating me along the way! The portal is so easy to use, uploading documents is simple and tracking your case all the way to the very end, thanks for all the support, 100% would use PLS again

records.title: PLS were amazing for us
records.text: PLS were amazing for us, a hassle free purchase of our new home. They were extremely helpful and very informative, just the service you need during a house move transition. We highly recommend them. (596477)

records.title: Very helpful and efficient
records.text: Very helpful and efficient. Brilliant to work with everything went smoothly and everyone was haply to help at anytime!

records.title: PLS did a thorough job
records.text: PLS did a thorough job, and Shahrukh and Jackson were on hand and helpful throughout the process and made it a smooth transaction for all parties.

records.title: Straightforward and stress free process
records.text: PLS were on hand from the beginning of our home buying journey to answer any questions and kept us in the loop along the way. The portal was very easy to use and update and created a stress free experience when buying our first home and thank Nick Anderson and team for their assistance through this. Many thanks Cameron & Emily

records.title: 640606 - A very seamless experience for our first time purchase.
records.text: 640606PLS Solicitors were recommended by the property developer to us for our first time purchase. Peter Shell and Sophie Lowther handled our file. I must say that we had a very seamless experience throughout the process. Their turnaround time was quick and updates were provided throughout. We got paperwork posted with clear instructions on how to complete. All queries were duly responded with. We could also check for updates on their portal. Had a very positive and hassle-free experience. Thanks, Peter & Sophie.

records.title: Efficient and reliable
records.text: They handled our case really well to say it was quite last minute. They did need a couple of things that our mortgage advisor said were unusual, such as requiring us to have our legal marriage certificate notorised by a solicitor. This was an extra thing we didn't expect.

records.title: Good experience on sale
records.text: I had a good experience with Liam from start to finish with what I believe was a very difficult transaction. No fault of Liam’s but the landlord. Liam always provided up to date advice and got used to my rhythm and placed a weekly call with me to provide me an update. Pleased to say we have now exchanged with a completion set for Jan 2025.

records.title: PLS Solicitors helped me to buy my…
records.text: PLS Solicitors helped me to buy my first home. Ellie Hammer team handled my file and they did a fine job. Lucy and Isabelle always answered my questions on time. Please note, it is better to call them and ask your doubts as it will be quicker. Emails might take a bit longer. I am giving 4 stars because improvements needed in the quote team. Quote team needs to give the initial quote based on analysing the circumstances of the client rather than just a quote without any considerations. Apart from that everything went well. Thanks PLS and special thanks to Lucy :)

records.title: Positive experience
records.text: Overall we’ve had a very good experience with PLS. It felt we were kept up to date on a regular basis and Caroline was quick to respond and always helpful. It was good to have the portal as a quick and easy way to access information and know which stage we were at.

records.title: PLS helped me with my first home
records.text: PLS helped me with my first home. They were always happy to answer any questions I had and in a timely manner too. I would definitely recommend them to anyone especially if you're a first time buyer and have limited knowledge on first homes and everything involved.

records.title: Overall Good Experience
records.text: On the whole, the process was relatively straightforward. My partner and I felt on certain occasions we were trying to chase them rather than PLS getting in touch to provide details. We also found that they had numerous members of staff working on our case meaning key information was either misplaced or forgotten about however this was quickly resolved. Towards the end of our moving process they were clear, precise and aided us through the final stages of our completion. So overall, we would recommend using them and thank them for their support and service with our house move.

records.title: PLS are a professional conveyancing solicitors
records.text: PLS dealt with the sale of my property. There were a number of issues that had to be overcome to enable our sale to move to completion. The PLS team were extremely professional and worked diligently to ensure all requirements were met to achieve our sale. The hole team were involved at done stage but one person in particular was our main contact who kept us updated at every stage throughout the process. I can’t thank them enough for their efforts and professionalism and would recommend PLS to anyone who requires an excellent conveyancing solicitor.

records.title: I have a mixed experience with PLS
records.text: I have a mixed experience with PLS.  One of my cases was not dealt as expected however, the other case, dealt by Simran was outstanding.  Simran was very proactive, communicative and most of all, she cared.  To me, PLS should strive to bring all members to the same level, to the same standards.I will go back to PLS again, but I would choose use the same case handler again.

records.title: Great Service Fabulous team
records.text: Fabulous customer service from the Altrincham / Amy Atkinson Team.Gemma especially we felt went above and beyond to complete my Mums case on time, buying a shared ownership property.The PLS portal was easy to use.Customer service staff always talked me through anything we did not understand.Communication was great always happy to help .Gave us a competive price.Great service from the PLS team.Thankyou again.Alison and Bernice.

records.title: Got the job done quick
records.text: I recently used PLS to purchase a leasehold flat and was assigned Alex Spragg. They managed to get the transaction completed in six weeks. I found the app really useful in terms of tracking progress and reading reports and correspondence. Whilst my case handlers were not the most proactive in terms of communication (I had to call them for updates), when I did call/email I got a response to my query very quickly. I would use them again if I needed to.

records.title: Just exchanged
records.text: Just exchanged, Sam Burton did a superb job but a little up and down before he took over. One thing I would say is that communication needs to be improved but other than that would recommend PLS.

records.title: A long process but got there in the end!!
records.text: My whole remortgage process has been a laborious process to say the least, taking a whopping 15months to complete from start to finish. But having said that, since being assigned my own case handler (Simran) @ PLS the process did seem to run a lot smoother towards the end. Thank you Simran & the team...

records.title: Fast paced service
records.text: PLS portal was very helpful to track the progress & access documents without having to wait for the post to review key information or sign important documents. Portal is very helpful, but would recommend to first time buyers or those that prefer contact to question possibilities of more telephone contact. Helpful team that kept almost daily contact via email. We would not have completed as fast as we did without their work.

records.title: PLS gave us the best quote for what we…
records.text: PLS gave us the best quote for what we needed even better than our local solicitors. The attention to detail was second to none and Caroline always kept us informed with where we were at and what we were waiting for making sure we understood everything sent to us and if we didn't she gave an explanation. The app they use so you can keep track of your case and provide documentation is brilliant and you can track your progress. Caroline was such an integral part in our adventure as first time buyers keeping us up to date and at ease. She was an absolute pleasure to speak too.

records.title: Good solicitors, first time buyers
records.text: Good solicitors. Got everything done promptly and smoothly. We were able to track progress on the portal which was useful and check back. Slightly variable communication one team was great, the other less contactable/didn’t always call back hence the 4/5 stars but overall very happy and good value for money. Took one stress out of the buying process and got everything through quickly for a fast pre-Christmas completion. Would definitely recommend. Thanks!

records.title: My experience for purchasing a property
records.text: I choose PLS solicitors for the purchasing of my new build, I experienced much for the team’s effectiveness. The team’s work made the whole transaction to be more simply and more easy to follow. The online portal is excellent and let me know the progress of the transactions directly. However, their responses by call and email seem to be a little bit slow and do not let me have the instant reply. Overall, I appreciated much for their professional and effectiveness.

records.title: PLS solicitors have been amazing…
records.text: PLS solicitors have been amazing throughout, they all made the purchase of our first home so stress free. We were recommended through keep moat homes and were so glad we did. Communication was brilliant throughout and all the staff were really helpful. Special shout out to Arshad, Tom and Charlotte B. Thanks so much!

records.title: Simran - Remortgage team 4
records.text: Simran working on Remortgage team 4, has been a reliable key player in our remortgage process. She has dealt with our case in a timely and professional manner at all times. All queries well dealt with efficiently and we would happily use PLS again. Thank You Simran.

records.title: Thank you for the hard work
records.text: Once the sellers Solicitors set up a correct contract - the team at PLS exchanged and completed within 7 working days. This was not a straightforward sale as there were a number of complications the team had to explain  deal with. I was not overly impressed with the App - its OK to pass things to PLS but I had no real view of what was outstanding..Thanks Rhianne Caroline and team

records.title: Efficient service
records.text: Many thanks to PLS Solicitors! James and his team provided excellent service from the moment PLS agreed to act on our behalf up to the time the contract was exchanged. It was great talking to James, Grace, Sam and Lydia over the phone or by email throughout the whole process. They were all superb and are indeed a tremendous team to work with. No problems throughout the process- it was all smooth with clear explanations provided to clarify any issues of concern or where we needed more understanding. We are in no doubt this great team will continue to guide us until the purchase is complete. We are truly grateful.

records.title: Not the best for first time buyers
records.text: As first time buyers we asked to be kept in the loop and to be shared details of the process. We regularly said it was our first time but were left in the dark during most of the process and felt a bit ignored, which caused extra anxiety! Updates /actions from our solicitor felt quite last minute and weren’t explained clearly causing extra confusion.Luckily the sale has just gone through so thanks to the PLS team for getting it over the line.

records.title: I'm putting 3 stars because of Oliver
records.text: I'm putting 3 stars because of Oliver: he's been absolutely brilliant, and I'm so sorry for him because it felt like he was the only person who really cared about us.This service could be way better if only they would improve their communication skills. They have been a little more constant in replying to the emails only in the last month (out of 4 months), as we had a strict deadline, so they were forced to communicate with us. We had to chase them over the phone to have updates, since they didn't update the platform and therefore it was difficult to understand how the entire process was going. They were very nice, but communication is key, so I really hope they work on this for future clients. Also, the online platform is very easy to understand and use, but it needs to be updated step by step!! Buying a house is very stressful, so it doesn't make sense to make things harder!

records.title: Really efficient
records.text: Really quick, and no huge hiccups. Only issues were 1) can't get anyone on the phone if you ring. They're very responsive via email though 2) They got my completion statement wrong - 2 X charges for acting on behalf of lender 3) I'd asked for an environment report which they initially forgot to do.Honestly, given how fast new build exchanges have to be, and the builder's solicitor being slow, they were pretty on the ball.

records.title: Could not recommend
records.text: Could not recommend.  They are giving quote for less money and afterwards ended up with double of the quotation. They charged me for the NHBC registration as well without informing me. Not recommend any more.

records.title: Professionalism and Proactive Updates
records.text: Technical detailing of paper work w.r.t. transfer is good, Approvals of Paper work is good, There are some manuals cuts and cross on handwritten text on some legal papers is not good and shows lack of professionalism and compliance checks.The frustrating part is customers have to call and ask PLS team about these instead it should come from their end being proactive on the communication and also progress updates of the transfer process.

records.title: OK. Not very friendly when asked queries
records.text: Used them when buying my house about 4 years ago. They kept saying they had added documents to the portal when they hadn't. Recently contacted them to ask about land and borders to property. A gentleman gave a shirty response saying they had already sent this information when they hadn't

records.title: Extremely slow to answer pressing…
records.text: Extremely slow to answer pressing queries when it comes to a house move. Had to do a lot of the chasing for information myself and there is no acknowledgement that my emails to them have been received and are being acted upon. Multiple times I've had to chase my own email

records.title: Only good thing to say is girls are…
records.text: 3 star as issues resolved as promised... But sadly stress caused through mistakes has knocked off two stars... Girls are polite and worked hard, starting work as early as 5am to get deadline

records.title: Very easy to get hold of and prompt in…
records.text: Very easy to get hold of and prompt in replying.The language (written) was often difficult to comprehend and the thirdfort app was only good at providing initial documentation. Post that, it lost a number of personal documents.

records.title: 3.5-4 Stars
records.text: 3.5-4 Stars We used PLS as they came recommended by the Developer that our property was built by.Innitialy we received a lot of help in the form of videos and phone calls that made the whole home buying process less daunting . Buying our flat happened very suddenly so it was good to know that we had the guidance . Legal terms were explained well, Videos showed us the process and things we had to remember . Whereas we originally mainly dealt with James, we ended up talking to a variety of people , one of them being Connor who was very prompt with his replies . Having several people working on your case though sometimes made communication tricky as not every person was familiar with our case details . This became especially visible when it came to exchanging contracts as the paperwork sent two us had mistakes in them twice despite repeatedly emailing them about the specific things that needed fixing . We understand that the solicitors are not able to change contracts send to them by the developers solicitors but it was clear that PLS still went ahead with sending us the incorrect paperwork via post  rather than raising it with the other solicitors. This constant back and forth added additional stress to the already stressful time, also as numbers such as in relation to deposit amount , legal fees etc didn’t add up and had to be corrected by us . Luckily thanks to Connor pushing for an asap exchange of contracts , all this didn’t affect our completion date which we are awaiting this Friday . We appreciated a phone call today asking us genuinely about our experience ,taking on board criticism in a very understanding way .We are hopeful for a smooth completion day☺️

records.title: Reasonably quick and efficient to use, mostly, they were prompt in their follow up. Saheb, was very professional and helpful at the point of completion, when my 1st contact was away on leave.
records.text: Once I got used to using their online system it was a fairly easy process, However, I still would have preferred more confirmations of the critical information sent in the post as well.

records.title: Can't really recommend. Got the job done...
records.text: Used them because they were recommended by home builder for a newbuild with a cash incentive. If you are paying full price - don't bother. Seem to be faceless. A mission to get hold of relevant people -different departments, lot's of generic email replies, hard to chase up if you actually have an issue. Communication throughout was email that would take days to get a response. Couple of instances of erroneous info given. Told by house builder company that they are inexperienced conveyancers, not "real solicitors" so ignore them.... now after completion have hassled for a few days via phone to get feedback (when so hard to get hold of during the process) I am a property investor with a portfolio so dealt with many solicitors, these were the worst.

records.title: Remortgage Team 4 we’re very helpful…
records.text: Remortgage Team 4 we’re very helpful and had great availability over the phone and provided clear guidance throughout the process. Although the overall service was good the online portal was quite poor and not updated sufficiently, also the phone connection often seemed quite poor.

records.title: Decent enough Solicitors
records.text: Decent enough Solicitors, tend to be quite slow to respond to correspondence and made a few minor mistakes over a stressful period, however they got the job done in the end, 3/5.

records.title: Mediocre services
records.text: My husband and I bought a house with PLS Solicitors.The communication was VERY bad, my questions remained unanswered most of the times and documents requested in the beginning of the process got lost along the way, requested again in the day of completion and not even downloaded after they were requested urgently (even after the completion was done, which has actually triggered this 3 stars rating).

records.title: Slow progress
records.text: Slow progress, poor communication a the beginning, multiple errors in the final bill. After 7 months of dealing with solicitors at the end they managed to fail complete all reports on time before Mortgage offer expired.Yes, we managed to finish everything on the end with luck after mortgage expired but with a lot of unnecessary stress.

records.title: Long process until Zoe took over
records.text: I started on beginning of April 2021 and should finish on middle of July 2021 very long process ...on beginning was replying every time different person which is quite annoying to not have just one person to deal with your case for sure if Zoe was there all time the process wasn't so long. Was keeping me updated with all off my queries and I'm sorry if i did bring stress, I'm very happy on how the case was going on the end with Zoe.3* for the process that was so long 5* for Zoe and many thanks for your involvement on the end.

records.title: Not the best experience
records.text: They have been good overall. Everything down Online could have be great if they was a phone catch up to explain to us the evolution. The down side for me was they never called us when there was something not clear which needed more clarification but also needed to chase them up for everything. We had to remind them several time about key factors until it got done. Sending documents with wrong name wasn’t ideal as well.

records.title: House keys at last
records.text: We found it very difficult to communicate with anyone , we were put on hold continually, but when we did get through to Kirsty she was very helpful . We were accused by one of the senior team partners that we never send through our all our paperwork and told we could loose the house . Which was completely wrong and was assured after contacting PLS that all the paperwork was defiantly there . However after a long stressful process , we have finally got our keys . Thank you Kirsty .John and Marilyn Findlay

records.title: Completed on time but had to chase a lot for answers
records.text: The house sale was completed on time so I can’t complain too much but it was very stressful. I feel if I didn’t call twice a day and email a few times a week to get things in writing, then it would have definitely taken an extra 4-6 weeks to complete. The communication and attention to detail was poor and can definitely be improved. Anyway, PLS still got the sale completed on the day we wanted them to so I’d like to thank Daniel and PX Team 3 for all of their hard work to get things done on time. We are now proud home owners!

records.title: Pros: I ended up with a house
records.text: Cons: I would receive no communication for days or weeks at a time, I had to chase them several times to get a document updated because they had my National Insurance Number wrong, which they STILL haven't updated a month AFTER my completion.As a first time buyer, I was getting a lot of documents thrown at me, and was given not as much guidance as I would have liked.The final cost of the Solicitors was almost DOUBLE what I was quoted, and I quite understand that they cant make a quote that includes every possible fee, and there will be other fees but that seems excessive to me, especially since it didn't include items like the LISA Fee, which I had told them that I would be using a LISA.Also, they added an extra fee for going with a "Special Lender" which I was never told about before the invoice came in.I went with PLS due to the recommendation of Persimmon, I have no other experience of Solicitors, but I think this should not be who they are recommending.Also, the portal would not work on the app for me, I had to open it on browser, just a note.

records.title: Slow response
records.text: Poor communication. Slow response.We asked questions to the sellers and to solicitor.  The solicitor replied emails only after several attempts and did not help much on the transaction. The transaction eventually fell through (not the solicitor's fault though) and I had to look for another property, but not PLS again.

records.title: Hidden charges/ not a personal service
records.text: The original quote for conveyancing was cheaper than other solicitors but on completion there were other charges that I was not made aware of in the beginning. Had to speak to too many people during the process who were not aware of my case.I also feel they did not send out necessary documents for me to sign effectively and on time. Could have saved myself a lot in postage if they had sent documents out together. I had to do a lot of the chasing up to progress my case.If I was buying again I would not use an online firm. The process was not personal and as a 1st time buyer you need to feel your solicitor is dealing with you personally for reassurance.

records.title: Never use again
records.text: Amazed at other reviews. Their communication has been horrendous. They had my email address wrong, kept on changing their mind on additional document's needed for a simple remortgage ( there should be a simple list of document's needed) and case manager was very rude. Struggled to ever reach them on the phone.  Never less than 10 min hold time, before getting cut off. Boils down to them mostly working from home, so no good internal face to face  communications with colleagues

records.title: Did job but I felt like an annoyance
records.text: They were ok. I always found they were pretty short with me when I asked them to send me some documentation they had apparently already sent to me, but I never received. Did the job, I guess, but always felt like I was annoying them by asking them to do stuff I was paying for (house purchase)

records.title: Awful experience and rude 'solicitors'…
records.text: Awful experience and rude 'solicitors' (if you can call them that)I used PLS to purchase a shared ownership property in 2020. Although it was admittedly in between lockdowns they were slow and uncommunicative as to what was happening. Then when I came to sell said property in 2024 they had missed out some key elements of the purchase and the title was also not registered with the land registry. The post completions department are not trained enough to deal with post completion issues and use incorrect legal terminology which is embarrassing.They are unprofessional, rude and have questionable practices generally

records.title: Unfortunately I wouldn’t recommend PLS
records.text: Unfortunately I wouldn’t recommend PLS. From start to finish proactivity and communication was poor and we had to constantly chase for progress and updates. If you don’t follow up a month can go by with no action. Having completed two weeks ago we are still trying to clarify a couple of issues that were missed by PLS and are being ignored by Beth despite numerous calls and emails. Our original solicitor Deenah left the firm half way through our case, of which we weren’t informed and no official handover was done which made everything even slower. As first time buyers the whole process was stressful and chaotic and we wish we had chosen a different conveyancing firm. To end a bad experience we had hidden mortgage fees applied to our final bill despite PLS being aware that we had a mortgage with NatWest from the very beginning. When asked they were unable to provide a clear breakdown of the costs. Best to go elsewhere.

records.title: Your not their client, the developers is.
records.text: Used them on recommendation of Bellway homes, but I found most of the time they were representing Bellway not me. It was near impossible to speak to the solicitor and coms ended up in long email threads with often different people replying. Any questions I asked I was referred back to their docs on the portal, and at one point I was told ‘just sign it’ when questioning a boundary title document.Just before completion I had an issue with the build quality but they didn’t want to confront my builders solicitors, I’m now still trying to resolve this 6+ months later.The icing on the cake was they sneaked in three extra charges that weren’t on the original quote, these were:   Anti Fraud Fee £80+vat; Maintaining Archive Fee £40+vat; Activation of New Build Warranty £95+vat- warranty.

records.title: Not best experience
records.text: - Purchase successful, but it took long time since process started- I had to chaise for everything via emails and many times by phone, as as mention in some comments here, many times promised to be called back with no response, email replied just before office close so there is no possibility to get reply same day- few mistakes in doxuments, I had to highlight before completion and appears again after month, like amount of property for mortgage, simple but annoying - poor quality searches - I don’t understand  and how as some of my friend get very nice search packs from external companies as well using PLS and paid same for it, but my has not provide as mane useful and detail information, - additional costs which i don’t have energy to follow up more, as buying a house is enough stressful process I use this service as my friends were happy to buy a flat in Liverpool but I would not recommend this experience with PLS to my friends.

records.title: Funds not paid
records.text: I have found pls difficult to communicate with from the start. There is often lack of clarity with their requests.My mortgage did complete on time however the surplus funds upon completion were not remitted to me on the completion date as they should have been. I received no responses to emails the day after completion so called them. On the call I was assured funds would be in my account by the end of the day. Ths has not happened and am now left unable to make payments that these funds were allocated for. I expect better and more ethical behaviour from a firm of solicitors. It's my money not yours and should have been issued to me on the day of completion.After chasing again today the funds have been received but are less than I was quoted yesterday with an explanation that they have overpaid my redemption and I now have to wait for my previous lender to refund these monies to me. Absolute farce to deal with.

description:
20+ years of conveyancing experience

Available 8am until 8pm – we work around your lifestyle

Get real-time updates online to track your sale/purchase

Join over 2 million people who have completed their transactions with Enact

Receive a fast, reliable and stress-free conveyancing service



Established in 2000, Enact Conveyancing has been at the forefront of the conveyancing market, working with over 2 million customers since launch. Our focus is on delivering high-quality, efficient, and innovative property and conveyancing services.

Our experienced conveyancers are passionate about the work they do and pride themselves on providing you with an outstanding, personalised service from start to finish. 

Moving house can be a stressful and complex process, that is why our conveyancing team is on hand from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm Monday to Friday to help you every step of the way. 

We also provide you with access to our market-leading online case tracker, allowing you to view vital information, complete paperwork, and contact your dedicated case handler through secure messaging at a time convenient to you. 

Visit our website to find out how we can help you, or to get an instant conveyancing quote.

 Visit our website 
 Contact us

records.title: Everyone I spoke to or sent a message…
records.text: Everyone I spoke to or sent a message to was absolutely brilliant, answered any questions or concerns I had quickly and efficiently, explained everything to me about how our mortgage was progressing and kept me updated. Thank you Enact. I will definitely recommend you to friends and family.

records.title: Simple interface, all went smoothly
records.text: Their simple web interface was just fine for my straightforward remortgage, and the few questions that came up were answered quickly and clearly.

records.title: Good Service by Enact
records.text: We dealt with Enact  in respect of our recent mortgage application.Their online portal was very easy to use and kept us regularly updated and showed clearly how we were progressing with the applicationIt was a very good service and would definitely recommend using them.

records.title: great service
records.text: Enact were instructed to deal with the conveyancing side of my morgage application by Santandar.Enact provide access to an online portal which provides live-time updates regarding the progress of the morgage application. Furthermore the portal enables most of the document signing to be done electronically (e-signatures). It takes a couple of visits to learn how to navigate the portal but it is genuinely useful. There is a good  telephone support service alongside the portal. Overall a very efficient and hassle free service.

records.title: Excellent Service
records.text: The Enact team and their online portal allowed us to closely track our re-mortgage progress which without question saw this complete very quickly. We understood each step as to where we were, what was required of the various parties, as well as being updated by text and email when anything more was required or a step completed. We would highly recommend.

records.title: Thank you all as a team for your…
records.text: Thank you all as a team for your excellent service and professionalism good communication and I'm really happy from start to finish how your staff handled issues and always ready to help .

records.title: On-line mortgage application
records.text: Easy to deal with once you get your head around the portal, even the on-line chat was useful.Anything that you could not understand through the portal or web-chat, you could easily speak with a human being.

records.title: It was a very smooth and quick and I…
records.text: It was a very smooth and quick and I didn’t have any issues along the way. I am really pleased with their service and Donna was really quick to respond to all my queries.

records.title: Exceptional Service
records.text: Everything from initial appointment to completion on both properties was nothing but excellent. Communication via the online tracker is so easy making the process easier than your standard conveyance. This is the second time using Enact and I would not use anyone else.

records.title: Highly Recommended!
records.text: This is the 2nd time I have used enact for a re-mortgage and they are always friendly, efficient and knowledgeable. They made sure that the completion happened on time despite some delays from our end with some of the paperwork and dealt with a transfer of equity for us.  I would highly recommend their services..

records.title: Our experience with enact was good…
records.text: Our experience with enact was good overall. However, reading other reviews, I found out about the online portal. The online portal link provided to us expired after a couple of days because of which we were unable to communicate via the portal. We received multiple calls throughout the process which we appreciated but the online portal was never discussed which i am a little disappointed about. Overall experience with our remortgage was good.

records.title: Increase staff
records.text: I gave them 4star reason for not giving 5 star is taking to much time . start with them for remortgage 16 October request them as soon as possible bank said to be by 1st of November in 2 weeks its been completed but its take 7 weeks and completed on 28 november as I am in tracker so paying high interest rate and loosing money Rest of everything they are helpfull and gone smoothly Only request is to increase staff so work can done quickly

records.title: The tracker was a very useful tool so…
records.text: The tracker was a very useful tool so that you could check the progress, upload documents and download documents. I did find it a little confusing at times but all in all a good tool

records.title: Quick and helpful
records.text: So I’m a first time buyer and because we bought through auction we had 56 days to complete. Matthew and his team made me feel very confident and educated me throughout the process. Emails were replied to quickly and calls also answered promptly or returned if not. Would definitely recommend if first time buyers or buying through auction thanks again to enact conveyancing.

records.title: Stress free & so helpful
records.text: Recently used enact for my re Morgatage and they were great. Kept up to date regularly with what was happening and it was all very clear & understanding when I did need to speak to someone. Will be using them again for sure and would recommend  them too.

records.title: Enact came with as "free legals" with…
records.text: Enact came with as "free legals" with the lender on 2 remortgages.  We completed on time and on the whole a very good experience.  There were occasions when the portal didn't work & also the portal was not always 100% up to date eg still showed outstanding tasks even though they were completed.  However,  the phone pick up is quick with helpful staff  and the case handler did respond when needed to.

records.title: Efficient and painless
records.text: It was a painless transaction where Enact's tracking system kept me up to date letting me know when I needed to fulfil my obligations. The whole transaction took shorter than originally anticipated.  At the beginning they called me to set me on my way. I am only giving 4 stars as this wasn't a very complex transaction, staying within the same provider but needed conveyancing due to product type change.

records.title: Enact were quick and easy to use for a…
records.text: Enact were quick and easy to use for a remortgage and transfer of equity. The system is relatively simple to use and it’s pretty what you need to do at each stage which makes it easy. If you want to speak with them on the phone it can sometimes be difficult and doesn’t appear there is just one person assigned to your case. But for simple conveyancing I would recommend.

records.title: Great experience, could have been better had I read my emails
records.text: Process was pretty smooth no issues or problems, completed on time, great job. The only area for improvement I can suggest that the period to opt in to an online experience could be extended. Unfortunately I was on holiday and missed the email and deadline to opt in to an online process. Instead I defaulted to having to share and receive documentation by snail mail post which did concern me, could delay things ?. It didn’t all was good, but it did add a little bit of stress that without having Online portal to check progress a that nothing was waiting on me would have reduced. But in the end it wasn’t an issue and all was good.

records.title: Conveyancing for BTL flat
records.text: The conveyancing for our BTL flat went very smoothly and overall our experience of working with Enact was great. The online dashboard gave us 24/7 progress updates, messaging worked well and it was easy to upload and download  documents using our account. We experienced one minor glitch at the end when co.pletion didn't go through on the expected date and we incurred a variable interest rate charge from our previous lender.

records.title: Great service for remortgage
records.text: Great service provided by enact for my remortgage. All questions and queries were quickly dealt with and overall a good experience.

records.title: Good quick process easy online portal,
records.text: Good quick process easy online process, only issue was that the completion date was set but we had no idea what it was as it wasn’t displayed on the portal. Supposed to get the money into our account when we did but smooth process

records.title: Never Received Clarity about Fees-Very Expensive
records.text: I found them very expensive. I asked several times about the expected fees, but no one provided detailed information.When received the completion statement then given a standard explanation about terms and conditions and clauses here and there.The process is flawless but I have been charged twice compared to other conveyancing.I am not sure about recommending them to friends and relatives.

records.title: Enact has made my mortgage move so easy…
records.text: Enact has made my mortgage move so easy and during the process i was give all the updates on the spot. Sometimes i was busy and couldn't notice the updates but in those cases they rang me over phone and updated. Thanks enact.

records.title: Smooth and easy process…
records.text: Enact made my re-mortgage experience very smooth and easy to complete due to their online portal facility that kept me up to date with progress and outstanding tasks.

records.title: It was easy to keep updated with the…
records.text: It was easy to keep updated with the progress and or any tasks I needed to do. My phone contacts were particularly helpful and staff were able to assist or point me in the right direction. I will consider using them again.

records.title: After an appalling experience with my…
records.text: After an appalling experience with my long term bank HSBC we switched to Halifax, supported by Enact. It was a simple and efficient experience. Everything was dealt with promptly, the on line portal worked well and if need be there was always a person to talk to who could access our file immediately and answer the query. I wanted to put 5 stars but for some reason it wouldn't let me!

records.title: I was allocated a case handler
records.text: I was allocated a case handler, who made the process of property purchase more personal and he was quick and efficient . When I did phone them with queries they were polite and helpful . Occasionally I didn’t understand why information was being requested and perhaps they could have provided better and more detailed explanations or phoned me to explain . Generally a very good service

records.title: Enact Review -030123
records.text: The enact team were always easy to communicate with. Going through the process over the Christmas break had some minor hiccups but as to be expected. I would recommend staff to not use abbreviated terms when referencing forms, as many who remortgage are not familiar with the abbreviations as we don't use these forms day to day.

records.title: Enact Conveyancing for remortgaging
records.text: Enact Conveyancing was chosen by the bank with whom I remortgaged, I was very happy with the service I received.The main contact used was message and emails so completing forms and uploading documents was easy and straight forward.I’m happy to recommend them and would even look to using their service in the future.A+

records.title: Efficient
records.text: Hello, I have written some feedback to you directly about some areas of improvement. Particularly in relation to the customer interface with your technology.It would also be great if you would appreciate that sending one request for a trust pilot was sufficient. Keep sending me reminders is above annoying. Perhaps my silence tells you something.On the whole you were efficient at doing the conveyancing.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: I'm only leaving this review to try and stop the relentless emails and phonecall's for feedback.  Portal was easy to use and phone was always picked up (not always the case with other conveyancers).  Inbox is not monitored well - I was being chased for paperwork that I emailed back.  Even though i initiated the remortgage process months in advance to avoid stress i don't understand why certain forms are sent in the final week... which caused problems as i was sick with flu and had to try and go out to print and scan documents that I could have sent long before.  Overall i would still recommend.

records.title: Unimpressed so far.
records.text: Things started really well in the remortgaging of my two Buy-to-Let properties, but things are now dragging on. I'm not appreciative of phone calls during my working hours, and equally not appreciative of the repetitive auto generated replies on the Case Tracker. For one property, I've had weeks and weeks of the onus being put on me to sort an issue out, without telling me how to, and now Enact are claiming that they can deal with it.... a lot of time wasted.

records.title: uncaring service
records.text: uncaring service with no attention to detail constantly dragging their feet. During the whole process, I received very few short emails or updates from them, making the whole experience more stressful than it needed to be. I'm sure there are people at this firm working their hardest, but overall the company needs better staffing and communication.

records.title: Overall the Conveyancing went well and…
records.text: Overall the Conveyancing went well and satisfactory..But they constantly chase me to do more reviews , even though I completed their satisfaction review .. therefore a service that was received to a satisfactory standard becomes one that ruins the whole experience..

records.title: Overall the team were pretty fast and…
records.text: Overall the team were pretty fast and efficient, however;- they lost documents which we submitted and then asked for secondary copies- they then requested copies of documents which in fact they had already confirmed as being received- it was unclear on the case tracking whether the case was 'on target' or not to complete by the 'old' mortgage expiry date.Ultimately the case was completed smoothly and by the required deadline. But communication of progress could be improved.

records.title: The service was good but
records.text: The service was good. They assist whenever I needed.Only disappointment is i didnt receive the funds on time. I received completion statement yesterday but havnt received the funds yet.

records.title: Problem eventually resolved
records.text: I was asked to transfer money to them rather than my existing lender (that would have no cost associated). I asked if there was any charge or penalty and received a reply stating there was none. Only to then find that charged me for sending them my own cash. Not apologetic, just told “ it’s in the T’s and C’s” After leaving my review was contacted and they resolved, but should have happened in the beginning.

records.title: Okay but not great
records.text: Communication needed to be prompted along with asking for necessary documents. Nearly missed the deadline had we not prompted and now the incorrect surplus funds have been sent after pointing out previously what the correct amount should have been. Used Enact for our previous remortgage and it was the same then.

records.title: Easy to use portal and reactive
records.text: Easy to use portal and reactiveOnly problem which was an important one for me, with their payment policy, they can only accept payments from a UK Bank Account.

records.title: On line application disjointed
records.text: On line application disjointed, not really flexible enough, had to go old school with a pen

records.title: Slow to respond to messages on the…
records.text: Slow to respond to messages on the portal. Didn't respond to questions asked.Its easier to phone them rather than message or 'chat' online.

records.title: The online chat facility was great
records.text: The online chat facility was great.  Trying to contact my case handler for updates on my mortgage not so much!

records.title: Overall was ok. Would use again.
records.text: Company was used as part of First Direct mortgage transfer. Service was overall ok, but process was slow and time scales on transfer longer than quoted. Also was quoted price, then queried by phone when it looked wrong, was advised all ok so paid and then called for more due to their mistakes!

records.title: So on the whole our experience was ok
records.text: So on the whole our experience was ok, but our advisor Chloe was clearly inexperienced and messed up the payment dates and when the first payment quoted by Barclays was clearly incorrect left us to it… it took me a number of phone calls to sort without any support from a very below average conveyancer..

records.title: Not enough contact at the outset…
records.text: Not enough contact at the outset detailing what information is required, on the positives the final payment and conclusion with my transaction was very smooth.

records.title: From 0 to hero
records.text: I am editing my original 1-star review, which I have left at the bottom for the background.  Since then, as promised, this was escalated and I have to say it was like dealing with a totally different company.  I can't fault them since I complained and I'd go as far as to say, they exceed my (and my broker's) expectations.  The case did carry significant stress as our earlier experience was genuinely bad and at one point I wondered if we'd ever get there.  It was a shame it took me to complain in a public forum to get things moving, but they certainly did and they pulled off a very speedy completion after that.  Genuinely super grateful to Jo and Amber who did an amazing job.  If my review was just on the last two weeks I would be rating 5 stars.Original review of 18 Nov 22:I am basically using TrustPilot as a way to get my case dealt with properly as this is becoming a nightmare, costing us hundreds of pounds a month, threatening a subsequent house move and our ability to get our kids' school places.  We need a certificate of compliance from the management company for our remortgage to complete.  This has been going on for 8 weeks.  5 weeks of that was mostly me doing all the chasing until I identified that Enact mistakenly thought it was FirstPort.  It was actually E&M, who told me Enact should know better as they deal with them all the time.  After finding out for Enact what to do and sending the payment, I was told on the 4th that everything had been sent to E&M and we will await their timescales to send back the certificate.  Today, E&M tell me that Enact haven't actually sent them what they need, or the payment.  I called Enact today who say there's something not right with the file, the transactional team dealt with this part and they haven't put any notes on the system.  The case handler is confused by what they're seeing and needs to get it checked.  I can't afford to wait days just for Enact to figure out their mistake just to have to wait another two weeks to find out that E&M still haven't received anything.  PLEASE, this is ruining our lives and costing us £hundreds extra per month as we're sat on a variable mortgage until you get this complete for us.  8 weeks to get a certificate, I just can't believe it.  PLEASE HELP.

records.title: Mixed experience - keep chasing to get the service you deserve!
records.text: I've just used Enact for my remortgage with Royal Bank of Scotland using the free option funded by the bank.  The process was really straightforward and took 5 weeks from returned paperwork but you do need to chase them.I requested a form.  This was not sent until I chased a second time a week later.Once all paperwork is returned Enact suggests a 10 day turnaround.  I'd still not heard anything by day 15 so had to chase again.I have to say the agents manning the telephone lines are very professional and did help chase up my completion.

records.title: Unclear communication and instructions
records.text: Unclear communication about what is need and how it is to be provided. E.g. I was asked multiple times to return a document, which I eventually realise I was never sent. Then I asked if I could upload something to the case tracker, but later found out they wanted a hard copy etc etc . A bit frustrating and would be easier all round if they were clear about what they wanted and how I should provide it.

records.title: Enact were effective in getting my…
records.text: Enact were effective in getting my remortgage sorted for the exact date that it was needed for. They only contact you when it is necessary, although they do not often reply to specific messages to them in their online portal. It is best to call them, as their staff are very helpful on the phone.

records.title: Honest Review -Final Episode yet to come
records.text: Honest Review -Final Episode yet to comeI’m not sure what to comment at this stage, but I will update with the final outcome, hopefully very soon.Straightforward BTL Purchase.Ongoing process for nearly four months.Lack of communication and poor response.No real progress apart from updates on the Online Tracker. (Hardly move).I should have used local ones—at least they would be visible and accessible.I feel completely in the dark and not even sure where things stand at this point.While not directly their fault with the delays, I’ve already lost a 5 figures as I had to move other investments to prove my funding for this purchase.I wouldn’t recommend them at all, but I’ll wait to see how things turn out.Truly frustrating experience, leaving me far from at peace.An absolute nightmare—full of regret.

records.title: If you're in a hurry, avoid
records.text: I am currently separating from my wife and in the process of a remortgage to buy her out so that she can buy her own property. Although not 100% enact's fault, their communication is diabolical. There has been a restriction by the council that needs to be removed before progress can be made. Enact sent an email and didn't receive a reply. Instead of chasing it up they asked if I could find the contact details for them. A quick Google search later I had got the details and forwarded them. Unfortunately that is only the beginning. I have now asked 3 times if they have had a reply and I still don't know if they have or not because the case handler hasn't replied. The live chat agent ended the chat with me on Tuesday when I was trying to get an update and although I have been told my case has been updated to urgent, they said it can take up to 4 working days to process an action. In my eyes that is not urgent. I was asked to send my marriage certificate as part of the process and it took a week for them to reply to say it needed to be a full scan. I have heard nothing else about that since last week either. All I can say is that the communication is an utter shambles and I wish I had used a local solicitor.

records.title: Lack of urgency
records.text: The processes in place make the journey of remortgaging straight forward. However in my case, there was an issue that has not been addressed nor resolved due to Enact not following up with the mortgage lender promptly and regularly.  This has impacted the case and resulted in the mortgage not completing before the required deadline. To say I'm disappointed is an understatement.

records.title: Poor customer service means financial hit
records.text: I will be rolling off my mortgage at the end of the month onto a very unfavourable rate due to delays in my remortgage. Whilst the platform that Enact uses is good, the customer service is have received has been poor. My case manager did not respond to my messages on the platform until a prompt from me through my broker. I have responded to almost all requests on the same day, yet will not be completing on time. I have been asked for documents repeatedly that I have already uploaded. Despite being 3 working days from my mortgage ending, I did not receive any contact for 4 working days until i phoned. It has not been made clear to me 1) when completion is expected 2) what is holding it up 3) what the cost of the remortgage will be. It is a shame as the financial impact is on me.

records.title: Currently, a dreadful situation.
records.text: Enact have been acting for me on 2 x Buy-to-Let remortgages. On the first, I was going to leave a 5-Star review. The second I was holding off reviewing until completion, however I can hold off no more. Still uncompleted over a week after the first, and now an email from them to say ‘I have arrears on my old mortgage’ and that ‘I should keep up the monthly payments’ until completion’ (whenever that is going to be !). Having continued with the monthly payments and knowing I had no arrears, I find that the mortgage company (I have been with for 25 years) have slapped an ‘Agents Visit’ fee on my account, preparing to send an agent to my home to investigate why my now expired mortgage hasn’t been paid off… something I brought to Enacts attention a month ago, and they chose not to act on. All in all 50/50. First remortgage, good. Second remortgage dire.

records.title: A honest review
records.text: A honest review. Enact was definitely too confusing to follow straightforwardly. The process was all over the place, they were contacting on different formats, through online chat, e-mails, text messages etc and things were easily missed because of this. Also my case workers were slow to reply and/or just ignored messages and seemed very understanding. Sadly I wouldn’t recommend using them as processes definitely could be simplified and they cost me money with all the delays to my remortgage process (if somehow I could have stopped the process and asked for compensation I would have done), I did raise these concerns at the time and seemed to get boohooed. If I had another chance I would not use them if it could be helped.

records.title: Not the best "service"
records.text: As a mortgage broker, any free solicitor services that come with the mortgage that I have recommended have a heavy weighing on how the customer completes and also reflects on the service that I offer. I'm sorry to say, i am just let down time and time again and it's slightly embarrassing that i now how to caveat the recommendation that my clients may run into trouble.. Which they inevitably do.

records.title: Appalling communication
records.text: They handled our remortgage. They managed to do it quickly, which was appreciated as we were a bit late going into the process. However, their communication was appalling: for some reason they only emailed my husband, even though I was clearly the one answering back. When I asked them to email me as well, they added me in a few emails, but a couple of days later went back to emailing my husband only again. Content of emails was unclear and confusing. In addition, they made a mistake in recording my name, and were inflexible in the resolution of this issue, which meant I had to send them a certified copy of my ID, further delaying the process. Wouldn’t use again, made process unnecessarily stressful.

records.title: A poor experience from start to finish.
records.text: A poor experience from start to finish.I wish I had read these reviews prior to instructing this company.I won't bore you with the details but in summary- the security questions they ask on the phone go into so much detail that if you haven't memorised every detail of the previous mortgage you have no chance of answering away from home. It was suggested I should keep my mortgage details with me at all times!- The computer interface, which they insist you use, is useless.  There is no proper login, just a password screen. So trying to access is impossible if your cache clears and you need your username (there isn't anywhere to enter it!). - The chat/message facility which they religiously chase if you haven't replied immediately, allows you to enter your own message/question but they never answer it.

records.title: They have sat on my application with…
records.text: They have sat on my application with First direct for months, then give no notice to make a payment, I sent the payment the same day and they they asked for more money. They use pushy tactics as well.Myself and my mortgage provider have filed complaints.

description:
For all your future planning needs from professional Will writing, Lasting Power Attorney and Trusts. 
UK-wide Will writers available at a time convenient to you will guide you through the whole will writing process.

records.title: Very good and made everything perfectly…
records.text: Very good and made everything perfectly clear ! Nadia was very professional at her advice and we can now rest knowing our wishes are clear !!! Many thanks!!!

records.title: Good customer service
records.text: Easy to book an appointment. Very professional service with clear and understandable information. Informed me of legal things I never thought of. Great peace of mind to know my affairs are legal and in safe hands.

records.title: Nadia provided a professional service…
records.text: Nadia provided a professional service with all of the information easy to understand.She informed us of all of the options available.We would recommend sovereign for all of your estate planning needs.

records.title: A detailed discussion on important matters. Friendly and compassionate advice.
records.text: A timely call. Enough time to go into detail. Professional advice by Nadia Miles.

records.title: Nadia Miles was very polite courteous
records.text: Nadia Miles was very polite courteous, and very helpful and good sense of humour thank you Nadia.

records.title: Claire was very considerate and…
records.text: Claire was very considerate and helpful, taking time to listen and explain everything to me. Thank you

records.title: Claire Furguson absolutely fabulous…
records.text: Claire Furguson absolutely fabulous with knowledge and service thankyou very much Michele Scott

records.title: I had the phone call with Neil Harrison…
records.text: I had the phone call with Neil Harrison very good. Very professional went through everything. The only downside is there is added extras which we were not told about when we booked the appointment however that’s not Neil’s fault so that’s more the company not being as transparent as it could be. Thank you Neil.

records.title: FULLY EXPLAINED PROCESS
records.text: Relatively easy process helped along by the will writer every step of the way. Explanations were clear and precise and my questions fully answered. The person conducting the call is the will writer - Neil Harrison.

records.title: This company is excellent!
records.text: This company is excellent!! Especially Nadia who was very professional,knowledgeable, patient and thorough. She made this very important task an easy one for me and my husband to complete. I would give her and this company 10 Stars if I could. Would highly recommend to anyone!! Thank You ☺️

records.title: Our planner Nadia was excellent
records.text: Our planner Nadia was excellent. She was well informed, and very good at explaining the product to my husband and myself. She covered all our questions and more.We did feel Sovereign Planning was a little “crafty”. Luring customers in with a low price then while we were warned there would be extra costs for add on’s, we were very surprised at how much more, those extras would cost.

records.title: Sovereign will experience
records.text: I was very conscious about signing up with sovereign planning as I have been scammed before but I was reasured by Lorraine by email confrontation n activation code for monies  paid.  Found the percidure a bit fast but was also talked through the actual will and papers attached by Claire. I have looked at the will n will signing it today.  Thanks everyone

records.title: Nadia was a wonderful lady
records.text: Nadia was a wonderful lady, who did our will's. She spent an hour on the phone with my wife and myself filling out our details. This lady knows her job, nothing was too much for Nadia to handle. She didn't push us to spend more money than we needed and explained everything in plain English. Thank you Nadia, much appreciated. Jim & Ann

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great price, clear instructions, numerous reminders prior to call, excellent friendly & knowledgeable lady who explained everything clearly and advised on all aspects.  Reason I didn't give 5* was there were a couple of questions which I'd have liked to have known about beforehand so I could give deeper thought.  However once raised, I had time to think things through and have my questions answered, which was good.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Joanne was really nice to talk to. She explained things well & didn't push too hard with the extras I could have paid for, she respected my decision not to buy further policies etc. My will was relatively easy to arrange & the whole process only took 25 minutes.

records.title: My experience with Sovereign Planning…
records.text: My experience with Sovereign Planning was good. Joanne explained everything to me and I could easily understand what was happening regarding the main part of my will writing.My only criticism was I felt a little pressured to buy the extras. Even though I said I couldn’t afford the extra £400 I was still told that i really should get the power of attorney, I again said I couldn’t afford it. I was then told I could put 20% deposit down then pay the rest later. I again said I couldn’t afford that. It was then I also said I didn’t want the extra ‘gift’ form that cost £24 but was told to get it as I may have something later down the line to ‘gift’ and that I could alter the form at anytime without further cost. I still didn’t need it but felt pressured to pay for it. Just be aware there are ‘extras’ that they try to sell you. All in all the service I received from Joanne was good. She was very friendly and professional in the general will writing.

records.title: Jenny was friendly and helpful
records.text: Jenny was friendly and helpful as well as professional throughout our appointment.We feel like she covered off all our requirements and concerns.

records.title: Straightforward will preparation
records.text: We received a telephone call at our appointment time from an exoerienced will writer who took us through each stage of the process. We completed the will within an hour.

records.title: Very thorough and friendly
records.text: Very thorough and friendly, but worked out very expensive by the time they put on power of attorney and memorandum of wishes

records.title: Clarity
records.text: Such a good experience we had doing our willsPut us at ease

records.title: Nadia Miles whom conducted the…
records.text: Nadia Miles whom conducted the telephone conversation was both friendly, helpful and professional. I haven't given 5 stars purely because I was offered a special price for taking out the will but then find out its very limited and Nadia then has to try and sell add-on's or extra's. I know this is the way lots of how business appears to be run these days but it doesn't impress me.

records.title: Hidden expense should be transparent
records.text: Hidden expense, Writing and payments for the Will, is one thing but then they are legal procedures which are helpful but are not  Divuged when you sign up for the Will,  should be made Transparent,  I paid for 2 legal papers which was just over £180 pound each.So Will doesn't go through Probate process etc

records.title: Being austic and adhd I struggle with…
records.text: Being austic and adhd I struggle with these things but after a very patient chat on the phone things were all sorted .

records.title: Neil Harrison
records.text: Neil, the advisor was very knowledgeable and made the whole experience very easy and quick he answered all my questions and was very professional.

records.title: Just do it.
records.text: Claire talked me through the will making process making everything easy and understandable I wish I had done it sooner.

records.title: Sraight forward and receptive
records.text: It was fairly straight forward operation between the two parties. Jo was receptive to my thoughts and took on board the ideas that i had prepared. The process wa well explained. The cost of the POA hit me a bit as it was the frist time that it had been mentioned and I felt a bit under pressure but that wa the sytem and not reflective of Jo.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. Nicola was our advisor and very thorough, took the time to explain everything to us with simple terminology and no jargon.

records.title: Not too bad
records.text: Phone about a will for a set price I did ask 5 times if there was any hidden extras was told. No 5 times on the day of the phone call found out we needed something else £700 more seemed very professional polite

records.title: Clear and helpful Will writing service
records.text: Our Will writer Nicola Astin was very clear and concise, with a friendly and professional approach. She answered allour questions thoroughly to ensure full understanding.  If Sovereign could consider  including information regarding ‘property protection trusts’ in their guidance document issued before telephone appointments, we would have found this useful.

records.title: All went as explained no problems nice…
records.text: All went as explained no problems nice easy  experience. A bit of upsell is tried but not pushed.drop one star as we believed £24. Was for a presentation pack which turned out one sheet of computer generated paper for memorandum of wishes I called to query this saying was expecting folder etc to store documents in the lady refunded £24 overall good efficient service at reasonable price

records.title: I was told of the initial charge only
records.text: I was told of the initial charge only! Then on the prearranged phone call I was told of a second charge, not very professional ! But as I needed to make a will, I decided to carry on! No apologies for misleading me!

records.title: Initially disappointed.
records.text: I was disappointed initially after being told I could get my will written for £59 which I paid in advance. But when it came to it I had to pay an extra £150 on top. After that I was dealt with by Nadia who was very understanding and considerate.

records.title: Much discussion to build a will.
records.text: Although the agent was very efficient, yet made me feel uncomfortable during the giving of information to build my will.  I knew what I wanted in my will and it was very basic.  Information  given was very correct and was towards building a safe and definitive will.  However we did settle on the format of my will.I wait to receive the first draft.

records.title: Easy and quick service
records.text: Easy and quick service. Neil Harrison was very professional and helpful throughout the call. Would recommend to others

records.title: Valerie was very very knowledgeable
records.text: Valerie was very very knowledgeable, answered all our questions only criticism  last 10 minutes of 45 minute call she was trying to cross sell POA , another policy to protect the deeds & quite pushy! We did say no twice but each time she replied you do have a cooling off period which we again said no due to cost of living at moment we only want our will, if we wanted additional services which cost over 4 figures we would ask for them

records.title: I was charged £59 for initial setting up the…
records.text: I was charged £59 for setting up the Last Will and Testament I understood I would have to pay an extra £5 for an extra grandchild over and about the the limit of 4. Totaling £15. Then I found out I would be charged and extra £24 for what they call Memorandum of Wishes. A bit of a con. Second cost was a total of £39 + £59 the whole experience cost £98 paid in advance. My first will in 2012 cost me £365 through a high street solicitor a bit of a difference. I saved £267 doing. It through Sovereign Planning.

records.title: I disliked the fact on the first phone…
records.text: I disliked the fact on the first phone call we were told the price would be £39 no mention of any other payment neededThe phone appointment went very well Becky explained every thing but we're shocked when we had to pay more but went along with writing the will as we needed one

records.title: Surprise cost
records.text: After thinking I was going to get a will for £99, other items meant I need to spend another £1600 a bit of a shock. Possible cost need to be more transparent before you can make an informed choice

records.title: Valerie was very informative and…
records.text: Valerie was very informative and explained everything In detail however, I found it all a little overwhelming to absorb so much information in a short space of time.Would have preferred more time to digest advice before committing.  Although I do have a cooling off period

records.title: The lady I spoke with was knowledgeable…
records.text: The lady I spoke with was knowledgeable and very goodHowever there should be clear tranparency about additional changes prior to first call It becomes a bit like dealing with a double glazing firm eg you need to sign up now for discounts If a husband wants a right to reside for a wife until death if passing to children on her  if a additional £400It’s just a paragraph with straightforward language nothing complicated but you are heavenly chargedA simple will at £59 is good value but check extras before you startMemorandum of gifts £20Right to reside for partner until death £400Power of attorney £480 for both welfare and financial if you think exssevive look at AI THERE AKREADY THERE

records.title: Draft will
records.text: As I am not the best with online, I am finding it difficult to register 🥴so am not able to view draft willSent email but as yet not had reply

records.title: Hoping things get better ?r first experience has been good our…
records.text: Our first experience has been good our Wills were quickly produced , the problems come trying to make contact to proceed  ! We have tried e-mails and phone calls are impossible , could someone contact us so can complete .

records.title: Unhappy
