records.text: I need to remove my previous review as after receiving their will and POA, I have found that they have charged me an extremely high fee. I have been looking around various Companies and found many where the fees were much much less for POA. The fee for the will was comparable but the POA was excessive. I could have done these with Government for free.

records.title: During my appointment to write my will …
records.text: During my appointment to write my will  on 2nd November 2023 Susan was very knowledgable but I was not ready for some of the questions and needed some time to investigate, I feel that the hard sell at this point without further discussion with my loved ones was a little brash.Belinda Collins

records.title: Disappointed…expensive with add-ons
records.text: Friendly service but very disappointed with added costs which were never mentioned when pre-appointment calls were made etc. A lot more expensive than elsewhere/other companies. Cheaper to go to an actual solicitor by the time the add-ons were paid.Very disappointed with the selling if this service.

records.title: Wendy Birdsall - Sovereign Planning
records.text: The consultant, Wendy was very good: everything was explained slowly, clearly and logically - full points to her! However, we found that the initial contact was ‘economical with the truth’ about costs. Yes - a will done for £99 was explained, agreed and paid up front….but we did not know we would need 4 x Powers of Attorney at £160 each to ensure ease of all ‘end of life’ arrangements. We did not really expect that and we should have been told on first contact! Minus 3 points for that!

records.title: I really liked it being done very…
records.text: I really liked it being done very quickly and over the phone. The price was very reasonable too. The man who did the will was very professional and thorough. When I was sent the draft to look through I sent a message to say one of the names were spelt wrong,  I had a message back to say the amendments were corrected.  Over a month went by and I hadn't received the documents, I emailed and got a really quick response that my documents were sent out a couple of weeks ago and as I hadn't received them they would send them again.  I then received them a couple of days later, however the amendment of the wrongly spelt name wasn't made.

records.title: Jenny Collins was very informative and…
records.text: Jenny Collins was very informative and explained the process clearly I was given the time to think of my options, ask questions and clarification. My only issue is at the initial interview it was not explained that the will would cost more due to the number of beneficiaries and because they’re not my children but my grandchildren. This is not a fault of Jenny’s but does need addressing at the first phone call, the appointment setter would surely know that the price quoted could differ depending on the will context. I did specifically ask if there were any hidden/other costs and was told no. Is this another saga of mis-selling???!After several phone calls a positive outcome was achieved, thank you.

records.title: Very happy with the will writing…
records.text: Very happy with the will writing process not too happy with the hard sell to have themdo the power  of attorney with” it’s a one off offer tonight” and if we didn’t take offer it would double next time we contacted For that reason alone would not recommend Valerie

records.title: Expensive
records.text: Be honest it's not cheap if you want people omitted from your will its expensive,my last will I had no  extra charge for this service yet you  charge £150 disgusting

records.title: Not very well informed. Online not covered.
records.text: Handled over the 'phone. So mentioned memorandum to will to enable updates to bequests without changing main will. Cost for that. Then fund for grandchildren, which was very expensive and no options to shop elsewhere. After the fact found Co-Op Finance do will funds for set fee, £200 less than Sovereign. Also, person didn't think the inheritance of passing property onto step children counted at the higher rate. Yet government's own website states this is the case. So not very informed & professional. Also, how to cover my online presence and accounts NOT covered. I'll have to sort this myself via the memorandum. Not good.

records.title: Big sell for add-ons
records.text: Beware they will try to sell you a whole lot of add-ons.  Make sure you check it's not cheaper elsewhere first - it will be so go ask them to price match and they will still try to add on other things.

records.title: A cheap will but just a ruse to sell expensive extras.
records.text: We are pensioners seeking a basic joint will costing £99.00 It would appear that if you just want a will written all they want to do is sell you extras for over £1,000. But first you must pay for the will up front. On the plus side we were talking to a pleasant lady called Sherry and she took the time to go through everything. When she said we needed these extras we said we were just looking for a basic will and would need time to think about it. She then said that she would call us back on a mutually agreed time and date. This didn't happen, so after 2 days I contacted Sovereign Planning and explained why I was calling, the person then said Sherry was sick. I asked why I hadn't been notified to this her tone changed to very abrupt and all she kept saying she was sick and said don't I understand the meaning of sick and no one else could take the case. She said she would arrange another call in a week, how does she know Sherry would be better by then. Her attitude was abysmal. I said the service wasn't what I expected from a professional company and wished to cancel the will, after a bit of humming and arring she agreed to refund the payment.  Case closed

records.title: Payments taken without any Invoice. Service only partly provid
records.text: I have made two payments through my bank - one of £59 for Will writing and second of £335.00 both to Sovereign Planning. However, I have neither received any itemised Invoice for the second payment nor I have been provided with promised service ( presumably for a draft power of attorney.)

records.title: Lack of communication
records.text: Lack of communication Spoke to Rebecca on 01/12 phone call had been arranged to discuss both my husbands and my own Wills. (Payment was taken straight away at the end of the phone call).06/12 Draft Wills were emailed to us! There was an error with my DOB so I sent an amendment email back on 07/12 and received automated reply saying I would be advised when amended re-draft was ready ‘we aim to respond within 48hrs’, it is now 13/12 and we have had no further contact from Sovereign Planning.

records.title: First impressions I cannot fault, but….
records.text: First impressions I cannot fault. Polite and curious and very efficient in my request. Post telephone consultations appalling. Chase chase chase. No response. Emails to rate on here without a complete package signed off. Where do I go now that this company has taken my money, signed me up for power of attorney? Is there some kind of ombudsman I need to contact to report. You have text me to review MY document but actually have not sent them. I understand Christmas but someone must be on email?please

records.title: Will Writing
records.text: Professional,  personable lady. However, I was taken aback by the service as I was asked to pay near to £1k for including a Right to Reside and Powers of Attorney. This would be my choice but it seemed a little cynical to transform a value for money service into something costing over 20 times as much. It seemed like a strategy for expensive upselling. I will purchase these other services eventually but not now and through another company where I have been given the chance to explore and compare service and costs

records.title: Be prepared to be offered other products.
records.text: Didn't like or expect the "selling" aspect of the telephone appointment. Told we could buy suggested product on the day at discount price or pay more later. Should have been allowed time to think and decide without the threat of discount or no discount.

records.title: Not impressed so far.
records.text: Not impressed so far.What started as a £99.00 service became a a £260 .00 bill for simple exclusions. A further option was discussed for lasting power of attorney at £650, no mention of this being if you have mental health issues only.We had a mirrored will which required amendments which were sent, and acknowledged, but they are still saying they are waiting for them. Drafts sent to my email went into spam, I was given the option to recover them, and they disappeared into spam.So all in all, not a good experience, certainly not working for me in keeping costs down. I paid £47.00 for the last will with similar requests, no hassal at all.

records.title: Hidden costs
records.text: Interaction with the company good and efficient as was the promotional price of £59. However, as I required an exclusion clause in the will, I was asked to pay an extra £150. Given that I had to dictate the clause as well I thought a 300% increase in price totally unacceptable. If I had known upfront I wouldn't have proceeded. Granted I was offered a refund on the £59In your response you mention a full refund was offered which is incorrect. You offered a refund of £59 dependent on me altering my original deposition to Trustpilot which I was not prepared to do as I regarded it as a payment for a "non disclosure agreement" which I found unacceptable.

description:
Here at PCS Legal we are committed to ensuring all clients receive the highest possible standard of advice and service. 

Buying and selling property is one of the biggest and most stressful things you can do and we therefore aim to take the stress and inconvenience away from you, making your property our priority. 

Our staff are dedicated and highly trained in dealing with all aspects of your proposed transaction whatever the circumstances may be. Our welcoming, cooperative and fully qualified staff are always on hand to answer any questions you may have regarding your transaction. 

We provide a fast and efficient service with a free, no obligation quotation at your request.

We have offices based in Basildon, Ongar, Wickford, Rayleigh, London and Harlow. 

 Get An Estimate 
 Contact Us 
 Make A Will

records.title: Good experience
records.text: Jasmine was very kind and professional. She took her time to explain things I did not understand and made my home buying process seamless and quick. Will definitely use this company again for any future property purchases.

records.title: Clear and professional - thank you
records.text: Sophie and Miles were very helpful during our first ever home buying experience. Communication was thorough without being overwhelming, and Sophie in particular took the time to speak to us at length on the phone several times and talk through options/advice when we experienced delays from our developer. We would definitely use PCS again in the future.

records.title: Tommy Clarke
records.text: Tommy has been very professional and helpful to guide me through my flat purchase over the last few months. He patiently answered all my questions and provided me with detailed explanations. My purchase is completed today. Thank you so much Tommy!

records.title: Charlotte was great
records.text: Charlotte was great. Kept me up to date during the process and was on the ball. Quick responses to emails and always answered the phone. Was communicating with me Christmas even and completed on my remortgage before midday on the 2nd of Jan. very happy and sets the standard.

records.title: Amazing service from Julia
records.text: Julia Fuioaga was our solicitor throughout my first home purchase with my partner - and she was amazing!  She helped us throughout the way, answered any questions we had being first time buyers and explained the whole process throughout the journey. I couldn’t have an easier experience and wish everybody’s home journeys were as easy as she made it for us. She also worked with our ideal time frame and her availability was amazing as we had weird working schedules also. Can’t thank her enough!♥️

records.title: Apartment purchasing made easy
records.text: I am grateful to Jasmine at PCS Legal Team with helping me to navigate the process of purchasing my very first apartment. The team made it very easy and had been helpful at every step. Without the professional help I would be too overwhelmed with all the paperwork.

records.title: Megan and Lauren at PCS have been so…
records.text: Megan and Lauren at PCS have been so helpful and professional throughout a most difficult property sale. They both worked very hard to achieve a resolution which was better than expected. I would have no hesitation recommending PCS to anyone in the future.

records.title: Efficient & Professional
records.text: I ve used PCS a few times now and I always found the team members efficient and professional. Recently, I ve had delays with a leasehold property where by Amy Kelly and Sophie Cornish have been  on the case and sorted out the issue promptly. Enabling things to move forward. They were both helpful

records.title: Molly Hiron at PCS is a real life saver
records.text: Molly Hiron at PCS is a real life saverThank you to Molly who helped us to complete our Purchase and related remortgage in readiness for the Christmas break. Molly worked tirelessly (literally all hours) to ensure this completed in line with what our Sellers wanted. A real asset to the team

records.title: I have received a really good service…
records.text: I have received a really good service from this firm to purchase a property.PCS Legal is really expensive, but I think the price can be justified with the quality of service, if you are looking for smooth process, within the deadlines and to have peace of mind. They also have an excellent availability for clients, and quick turn around time in the queries.

records.title: Moved in before Christmas
records.text: Successfully completed just before Christmas, and I’m grateful to Molly Hiron and her team for their hard work on completion day to make it all happen. The process took longer than I initially expected, but I suppose that's how it is.

records.title: Exchange of contracts on time
records.text: Exchange of contracts on time. Buyers solicitors were very awkward on the last day demanding more information.  My solicitors got the deal done. Will use again

records.title: Excellent solicitor, technology could improve
records.text: From start to the end, I thoroughly enjoyed the services of PCS legal - specifically of Liam who was my solicitor in house purchase. He had extremely rapid responses - taking no longer than 24 hours to response - and always manages to resolve my concerns and queries which were many. The entire process of house purchasing ended up extremely smooth, despite being a chained property in which Liam managed it spectacularly. He was also very patient and the updates he provided were timely and comprehensive in all cases.I stopped short of a 5 star because I think the IT system/portal of PCS could be improved with my initial onboarding being a confusing with some mixed messaging on the portal - all the human elements such as Liam himself deserved a full 5 star

records.title: Good service
records.text: We are a South African family buying a house for the 1st time in the UK. It was a bit daunting for us, with what seemed like reams of paperwork and regulations. Damon Singh of PCS Legal was extremely patient with my myriad of questions and he explained everything carefully and clearly. His team were fairly prompt on their email responses. We are pleased the process is now complete, thanks to Damon and his team, we are now enjoying our new home.

records.title: Good job
records.text: I can't give them a five, because at times I didn't understand what was going on and what I should do next, but overall the solicitors did a pretty good job, but most importantly they did it quickly and managed to do everything on time. So I can recommend their office to everyone.

records.title: PCS Rayleigh, Megan & team
records.text: Megan and her team were always on hand for any queries and concerns we had. They were proactive in chasing down the chain solicitors to resolve a lengthy chain. They assisted greatly when we lost our buyer around 8 weeks into the process by arranging already collated information to be passed to relevant solicitors. Not that I want to move again, but would not hesitate in using PCS Rayleigh should the need ever arise. Thanks to Megan, Ronnie & Angel.

records.title: Professional, Effective - but lacked personal interaction
records.text: The whole process took around 4 months to complete - and throughout we never met the conveyancing solicitor (Natalie) in person. The only real 1-2-1 contact we had was via telephone during the last 3 weeks, when everything seemed to speed up considerably. I can't say whether the lack of face-to-face interaction was was a good or bad thing - but, personally I like to meet the people that I am dealing with, even if it is only via TEAMS or ZOOM etc.That said, Natalie was very professional and we were pleased that everything went through without any real problems.

records.title: Use PCS Legal first time for purchase…
records.text: Use PCS Legal first time for purchase our first home. Sarah J team supportive and explain all terms and answer releavant questions. Very pleased with this team's service through out.It can be improved by reponding any queries bit more time effectively.Thank you so much!!!

records.title: Efficient service and clear charges
records.text: I found the service very efficient and thorough. They answered questions succinctly and their charges were clear without any unexpected additions.Sometimes a little chasing was needed thus not a full 5-star rating however I would recommend PCS and I would use them again.

records.title: Friendly and understanding
records.text: We really can't fault PCS Legal when buying our new build. The team were efficient, sympathetic and friendly; unlike the builder! We always felt like they understood and had our best interests in mind. The high Street solicitor was much more expensive and PCS turned out to be cost effective alternative. Thank you.

records.title: Positive experience
records.text: I recently sold my shared ownership property with Megan Hunt's team. I was very impressed with the team's efficiency and professionalism - the sale went through smoothly and quickly. I was given regular updates and any queries were answered swiftly.

records.title: Overall experience was good
records.text: Overall experience was good. Being OAPs and not very conversant with computers and mobiles we were a little unsure at times with what was required. Unsure too at times whether to send details by email or letter. Very good at the end with letting us know our emails had been received.

records.title: Good and bad
records.text: When I first got given Louis everything was going well until she went on Mat leave, and then I was given diamond team who was next to useless, never responded to my emails or phone calls. I was then finally given Adam H, who has been so helpful and without him I wouldn’t have completed and exchanged on my flat today. I am so happy with the help and support from him.

records.title: Team Nikita
records.text: Team Nikita was great. Katie & Jenna were knowledgeable. Kept me informed on every step.They could done better on pricing as what was initially quoted was increased when actually invoice came.Happy with service.

records.title: A difficult task.
records.text: The team dealt with my mothers property swiftly however when it came to my sale there were hold ups and delays.Mine was a leasehold property and there were things that could be avoided to help things run smoothly.Overall i`d rate it a 4 service for that reason but staff always polite and friendly it was a difficult set of circumstances to navigate.

records.title: Overall a good experience but the team…
records.text: Overall a good experience but the team was initially slow to respond to emails (compared to my previous conveyancers) which I found a little unnerving. This is their way of working so be prepared. Always had good and informative communication with Molly when I was able to get through to her directly. Fees were as initially agreed so overall good.

records.title: Unfair to pass comments
records.text: Hey, regarding last review from Chloe, I am the buyer!!I have think there is a bit of `covering` up by the other (Chloe`s) Solicitors here!  Who has the mindset to say that, on day of intended completion, Friday, I will leave the office early and its company policy NOT to exchange on a friday afternoon! ? I ask you!?I have to say that the `team` at ABW, Shay and Sydney and Alex, were all very polite and efficient with me! So, I can say `thank you` !

records.title: Would use again!
records.text: Molly and her team were prompt, responsive, friendly, and patient with my first time buyers neurosis! They completed my auction purchase in 28 days, no issues. Aside from a little confusion at the beginning, it was an issue free experience. They are a great value, and I would use them again.

records.title: a really good experience with PCS legal…
records.text: a really good experience with PCS legal a few challenges with communication at the beginning, but overall a really good service. Even when the sale looked like it was not gonna go through I’ve got fantastic support from all the team.

records.title: Very quick! 3 week completion!
records.text: The team was very good and we completed the purchase of our apartment in a record time of three weeks!!!The beginnings were a bit shaky - we were sent document requests one after another, there was a bit of a duplication to what is needed by email and through the apps. We also got documents to sign which were not for our intended purchase. At no point we had an introductory call running us through the process.When Carley took over, we saw much more interaction. She would email and follow up with a phone call. She deserves five stars!I’d like for a little more intro, a walk through and cohesion in the initial requests but overall a great success.

records.title: Millennium Legal direct me to the…
records.text: Recently my solicitor is really high efficient, my case have lot of progress in this week.

records.title: Very slow process
records.text: Very slow process, even on chasing responses are slow, 12 weeks in and it feels like we are never going to get to exchange and completion any time soon, tried calling for an update but did not really get one just felt fobbed off.  Hoping to see light at the end of the tunnel soon!!

records.title: Poor service at the start, but did improve after change in case worker
records.text: Our apartment purchase took 6 months to go through when it really shouldn't have. We were first time buyers and the sellers were not on a chain. The delay in the end seemed to be primarily from the sellers solicitor but our early experience with PCS Legal no doubt slowed the process down (the conveyance team from July-Septembe). However when Nikita King's team took over our case in September, things did improve in terms of efficiency. We were still a bit frustrated though with having to constantly chase up and get a quicker response to emails sent.

records.title: Not a great start
records.text: Initial information was sent over only for PCS to request this again almost 2 weeks later. Got to the stage where we were supposedly just waiting for one last enquiry from the seller's solicitors, which the estate agents then confirmed was provided the next morning. Since this point PCS have gone silent, haven't heard anything back from them in a week with both sides chasing. When I called this morning I was told that PCS are still waiting for enquiries. I feel at this stage I'm going to be forced to chase up both sides daily to get any action, which I'll be doing from now on.My overall impression with PCS isn't great at all. Some simple updates would be nice, especially when multiple people have emailed. This type of behaviour at my job would lead to a disciplinary hence my frustrationEDIT: I was contacted an hour or so after leaving this and have now been informed what's happening

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: I had a mixed experience. Following instruction, I had to chase the para-legal team on every step. No response to emails. I have to admit that they were however very polite on the phone. After the case was passed to the conveyancer, the process was smooth with improved communication.

records.title: Really quick process!
records.text: Whilst the process was really quick I found it frustrating in the early stages that phone calls were not answered and I had to rely on emails, and wait for replies.Also, as I was between properties, my laptop and printer were in storage. Luckily the local library staff were able to print and copy documents for me, but it did cost me a fair amount.

records.title: could be worse
records.text: could be worse, could be better. A bunch of positives, but also some negatives which made the process painful at times.Pros:from start to finish it was complete in 3 months. Price was very competitive.Negatives:Mainly communication, they give themselves 72 hours to respond to any queries, which i feel personally is a day too long. Sometimes when sending a response to a query i wouldnt receive any acknowledgement, so would have to send an email asking if all was now good, then wait 72 hours for a response to my request for a response lol.It felt like that had too many cases to be honest, and the overworked staff were trying to juggle a lot of plates.Nothing personal agaisnt the staff i dealt with as they were all decent when dealt with directly, just felt like a proper conveyancing mill.There were no major issues during the transaction

records.title: Communication, communication....
records.text: There was a lack of communication. This may be something you do every day, but for me it's once every 20 years.  Buyers need a lot more considered responses.  When we moved to our third assistant on the case, Maria, things moved much more smoothly and were all well explained.

records.title: Okay
records.text: Got the job done for competitive price compared to other firms however communication wasn’t great and they were quite slow from their end which delayed the process.

records.title: Update
records.text: Updated review

records.title: PCS Legal handled the sale and purchase…
records.text: PCS Legal handled the sale and purchase of properties, for both my Mum and I. They were recommended to us by our estate agent.Overall our experience was a mixed bag.The first person assigned to our case was never available. She would never return emails or phone calls. We were just pushed to use an online portal.We were then assigned Adam Hennessy. This was a better experience. Mum and I had no issue with Adam. He was friendly and helpful, and was mostly available for calls.My main issue with PCS was communication. There seemed to be days with no update on progress. This may well have been going on behind the scenes, but we didn’t hear anything regularly, unless we asked.Towards the end my sale became quite stressful, and I did feel PCS didn’t really provide much support during this time. I engaged more with my estate agent on this.Personally I feel, for important matters like this, a weekly ten minute phone call, with a quick update would be beneficial, rather than being directed to a portal.We also experienced a few requests for the same paperwork, from different people, when Adam was away, so there didn’t feel like there was much continuity. I also spoke to someone else in the office, a couple of times, who whilst very pleasant, did not call me back after she said she would.I have given a three star rating, as I definitely think there could be improvements here. Mainly around communication

records.title: Molly Hiron
records.text: She delived did the review i asked quick But then wont give any advice for free. which is fair i think but at the same time i payed 1k come one was one question... Anyway, She is ok i guess

records.title: Not a bad experience overall, but there were unnecessary and avoidable delays.
records.text: Overall Molly was helpful and knowledgable, and while my sale went through in 14 weeks there were definitely delays that could have been avoided had more attention been paid to the details. There was a 3 week delay at the outset waiting for me to complete ID checks, which had already been done; I had to apply for a retrospective regulation on some windows which the buyers solicitor pointed out, and I could have had it done weeks before if PCS had read my documentation and advised me of it; I was being asked for my bank details after completion despite having sent them with my initial paperwork at the outset, and was asked for bank statements the week we were exchanging despite having sent them 2 weeks earlier. All those things were avoidable had more attention been paid and we could have completed a lot sooner.

records.title: House purchase
records.text: To start with the process of PCS Legal was slow, and there was a lack of communication on their behalf which was worrying. We were hesitant that we had made the right decision to use them. However, our case handler got  changed and we cannot thank Shahriar Ahsan for turning it round for us and making the purchase of our new home run smoothly and non stressful in the end. He was very responsive, friendly and helpful.

records.title: Mixed experience
records.text: After about a month into our sale, we had a very frustrating couple of months when we found it near impossible to contact PCS.  At the suggestion of our purchasers, we were about to cut our losses and engage another solicitor.  However after we made a complaint, PCS upped their game, and with the help of Rachel Smith, one of their solicitor's assistants, they were very helpful and things progressed smoothly to completion.

records.title: Sometimes tricky to get anybody to call…
records.text: Sometimes tricky to get anybody to call you back and there’s nobody in the office between 1-2pm, which can delay any queries being answered. However, once we started getting towards the end of our sale/purchase, we dealt more with Jeanette and things moved along a lot more quickly and she always got back to us on the same day.

records.title: I have mixed feelings about PCS Legal
records.text: I have mixed feelings about PCS Legal. I was a first time buyer and i wish i had a face to face meeting instead of doing everything over the telephone, Things moved slower than i anticipated but we got there in the end. Charges should have been clearer and not leave it until you are ready to complete to find out the extra charges.

records.title: Moved on 5th October 2018
records.text: Moved on 5th October 2018Hard to contact anyone after initial sign up Billing very poor no breakdown of cost on completion. Was overcharged by  £ 600.00 plus. Had to contact them to get reimbursed not always easy. They did pay up in the end.OK they did the job we moved house but I think  they could have eased the stress by being easier to contact.

records.title: generall OK until the release of money.
records.text: Although the sale of our house generally went well with PCS Legal, they are unacceptably slow in releasing monies. Our house was completed 11 days ago and still no balancing cheque. We were told it was in the post 5days ago, but even our post isn’t that slow, so we suspect this was incorrect.I’m still waiting by Diana Ross, could have been written about PCS Legal.

records.title: PCS Legal were overall average
records.text: PCS Legal were overall average. Their costing was clearly explained and correct the whole way through the process. They turned emails and enquiries raised around reasonably quickly. I was disappointed when I found our solicitor had gone on annual leave for a month and our file was not handed over to anyone even though we were literally at exchanging point. We got there in the end though.

records.title: Cheapest solicitor... for a good reason. Wouldn't use again
records.text: I needed a solicitor for a remortgage and this was one of the cheapest options (it became apparent why). We had used a great solicitor for our house purchase but unfortunately their remortgage fee was too expensive so we opted for Pcs legal. Began alright with their portal being fairly easy to use. They sent one of the ID checks out wrong and we struggled to complete this correctly. Then the day our mortgage offer was issued it all went quiet. After a week of emailing and calling as we needed the mortgage deed for signing and getting no response I finally copied in one of the senior partners to my email, and unsurprisingly got a response from the solicitor within 3 minutes. Apparently no one covered her cases during annual leave and out of office responses don't appear to exist either. For a company this size you would expect at least the very basic business management and service levels, not such unprofessionalism or responses like "oh i think they didn't check my cases while i was on holiday". Finally got the job done, which is the only reason I've upgraded the rating to 2 stars. Working in the new build industry for years I've worked with a lot of bad solicitors but this really was a next level. Will definitely think twice before using a cheap solicitor again!

records.title: A law unto themselves?
records.text: A law unto themselves?I write this review as a  third party working with the purchaser of my leasehold flat to conclude the sale. PCS Legal fell down on the job from the word go, failing to deal in a timely manner or at all with documentation emailed to them. Information sent to them for the third time was eventually acted upon but they were then late in raising Enquiries and fundamentally mis-understood the position on ground rental. A transaction that should have completed in early November 2024 as per the Memorandum of Sale cannot even be exchanged upon yet, because PCS Legal reckon they did not have local searches returned (whereas the council local land charges unit confirmed that the search results had already been obtained in person by their search agent some time previously ) and because the lease was allegedly defective and onerous on ground rental, which it is not with a low annual ground rental and 25 year rental review periods under the retail m prices index.Beware of this firm. The SRA website shows that across the five offices there is only ONE qualified solicitor on Roll, the rest of the staff being paralegal conveyancers. This firm has cost its buyer client and me as seller a small fortune in failing to deliver a competent outcome in a timely manner. We might just exchange contracts by mid-January of their senior conveyancer can get his act together.

records.title: I do wonder how genuine the 5* reviews…
records.text: I do wonder how genuine the 5* reviews are....if you look back at the negative reviews you will notice a common thread.....poor communication!!  That has certainly been my experience.   Countless times I have called and nobody answered the phone.  Many times I left a message asking them to contact me and nobody did....and even when I did manage to speak to someone, my conveyancer more often than not wasn't available.Very very poor communication!!!   They make what is already a difficult process, that much more stressful.

records.title: Firstly I believe the staff work…
records.text: Firstly I believe the staff work incredibly hard but just have too much workload. Hence the issues. Communication is awful. We had to constantly chase. Promised emails and call backs which rarely happened. Constantly holding to get through to reception, then holding to speak to case handlers which was a challenge.The “portal” doesn’t get read or updated so has no value. The Holding message does not reflect the service(except the bit about holding is frustrating)A boundary issue was pointed out at the start of the conveyancing but not looked into too late.If James Fellows is part of this he was brilliant.Mollie tried her hardest.It’s clear the two opposite legalteams rarely phone each other which slows the process. We will use a local Solicitor next time.Management. Look at workloads of your valuable staff

records.title: Poor service
records.text: I purchased a property end of 2023 and although the purchase is completed and property shows as being in my name, the lease for the property has still not been transferred on my name. I have emailed them several times, call them several times, but no one replies to the email or answers the phone or voice mail.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: The job was eventually done however I did not feel particularly well supported whilst working with PCS Legal. Any time I had a question or doubt, I struggled to reach out due to constant miscommunication and lack of clarification. Often I struggled to contact the office as well via phone and was not sure what was happening during waiting times as it was not communicated well. I was also treated as if I had known the whole legal process and steps of buying a property while as a first time buyer I had no particular insight or understanding of basic things and this made me feel uncomfortable and uncertain most of the times. Happy that it is over.

records.title: Horrid communication
records.text: Horrid communication, 'lost' emails, sometimes took weeks to reply. They directly delayed my purchase by several months.Their internal complaints procedure is little better.

records.title: The employees who deal with your case…
records.text: The employees who deal with your case are constantly changing. As a result, quality suffers. They don’t keep the promises they made, for example, they said that a monthly report on the status of the case would be provided, but in the end I had to knock it out of them every month. When requesting documents related to the case, they do not send them and avoid this topic in every possible way. In fact, I got the impression that their specialists have too much workload, and therefore very little time will be allocated to your case

records.title: Cheap - You get what you pay for.
records.text: PCS was the cheapest option we could find which is why we went with them and they did get the job done, but not without issues. When speaking to the actual solicitor, Leonie, things were usually good and any issues were worked through, however when speaking to one of the assistants it became difficult as they didn't seem to know what was going on. PCS also raised new queries on the day the contracts were to be exchanged which seems crazy to me, especially when they are the ones that agreed the completion date. Why would they agree a completion date if they still had queries. I also asked them multiple times if they were missing any information from myself and was always told nothing was outstanding, but when we went through compliance multiple things were missing, which almost delayed the deal by 2 weeks.

records.title: Misleading "no completion, no fee" claim
records.text: Their claim of "no completion, no legal fee" is misleading.In September 18, we instructed Fletcher Longstaff on the sale of our home and the purchase of another property. Sadly, this fell through in December 18 after it transpired that our buyers did not have a mortgage. Out of the initial £350 that we paid to Fletcher Longstaff, only £111.18 was reimbursed to us, and the rest was kept by Fletcher Longstaff as "non-refundable fees for searches and disbursements". Shame they did **not** find out whether our buyers had any funds, as I had to eventually talk to the buyers **myself** to find that out.Altogether, this leaves us £238.82 out of pocket and with a rather negative experience of that company.

records.text: I now have a Will, something I have been meaning to do for a longtime. The process obtaining one with FreeWills was simple and I did not have to speak to anyone and a cost was very little when compared to what the Solicitor wanted.

records.title: Fantastic Service
records.text: Great experience & free. However you will get lots of emails asking for reviews & if you would like to purchase extras but that's absolutely fine.

records.title: Excellent site for simple wills
records.text: This is an excellent site for people who have a little knowledge and want simple and straightforward wills. Anything more complicated incurs extra costs.

records.title: A helping hand
records.text: My Will was a bit complicated but was helped by very constructive advice and suggestions. I very much appreciated the input. I did not expect a personal touch but was very grateful for it! Thank you.

records.title: Easy to use
records.text: Easy to follow instructions to create/edit.Ideal for a simple will.If you keep putting off making a will then use this as an interim measure so at least youe estate doesn't fall under intestate.

records.title: Great Free and Quick Service
records.text: This is a great free and quick service if you want a low complexity will, and there is an opportunity to tip if you wish to do so. Feedback: It would be helpful if you could save the will as draft, rather than it automatically being submitted for review when saved. This would save time for both parties. One of my will versions sent for checking was nonsense but still passed the review so checks seem to relate purely to spelling/grammar rather than logic.

records.title: Great reviews and information
records.text: Great reviews and information. A little slow on reviewing the draft will, but nothing major. The best thing it’s free for anyone who requires a basic will.

records.title: Straightforward, no fuss and no fee.
records.text: Second time I have used this service. My will is quite straightforward but I needed to make some minor changes. It really is free although you do have to resist buying the financial products you are offered throughout the process - unless of course you want them. Clear instructions on the information required and quick production of finished will to download.

records.title: A simple process to creating a free WILL…
records.text: A simple process to creating a WILL with plenty of easy to follow guidance.  Apparently, once the WILL has been generated it is examined by an expert to verify it's legality before the final version is sent/e-mailed.  If this is correct and a level of trust is required here, then I cannot see any problems.   I would say for a simple WILL this is probably fine but for a more involved one I cannot say, that is down to personal judgement.

records.title: Free wills here for sure - also options to spend :)
records.text: Get a free will - sure thing - can't beat the value provided here - could save your family time, stress and money when the time comes - as it surely does.You will get quite a few options to spend money during the process (and emails about the same afterwards) - I guess that is how they fund the system, however annoying it might be - after all, nothing, at least in this world, is truly free.Thanks to freewills.co.uk for providing an essential service!

records.title: Quick and easy
records.text: I needed to make a simple Will at short notice and found freewills.co.uk randomly among others on a Google search. Having misunderstood the wording on their website I mentioned this and they made it easier to understand which was much appreciated.

records.title: Simple and easy instructions to follow
records.text: Simple and easy instructions to follow, good support and review process, reasonable extra prices, but slow delivery

records.title: Helped us when a friend fell suddenly ill
records.text: This helped us when a friend fell suddenly ill and had no current will. (It would be helpful if there could be an explanation that sometimes there needs to be a review by a human before the will can be finished since that alters the time of completion).

records.title: I've known for a long while that I…
records.text: I've known for a long while that I could make my own will, but this site takes you through it with confidence to be able to do it right. It is genuinely free but donations are welcome and any other help at an affordable ptice.

records.title: Easy to use
records.text: Easy to use and ability to save, review and make changes before finalising the document

records.title: Sent a draft never recieved final copy…
records.text: Sent a draft never recieved final copy could be a scam but not sureUpdate final copy recieved not sure what the issue was. Didnt go to junk/spam but arived after review

records.title: A very easy site for a basic will.
records.text: A very easy site for a basic will only took me minutes to complete a very easy process the bond copy did take a little longer than expected but not an issue the only downside to this site is regular emails almost daily.

records.title: Easy Will Writing
records.text: Makes will writing easy to understand. The whole process, including altering the will, is very simply and easy to navigate.

records.title: Free will was delivered
records.text: The will went into my spam folder overall long winded experience but a free will was sent to my email

records.title: Very easy to follow plan
records.text: Very easy to follow plan. Excellent that it’s free! Quick & efficient service

records.title: It wMore optionsould be really good if there was…
records.text: It would be really good if there was more options in the questions, for example I have already paid for my funeral, this is not one of the options.

records.title: easy to use
records.text: clear and concise, easy to use and comprehend, would recommend, only reason i didn't give 5 stars is because  they do send quite a few emails after use i don't mind one email but not multiple but other than that its a good service

records.title: It was simple but too simple
records.text: It was simple but too simple. Doesn’t allow items to be listed and designated to individuals. Just deals with percentages of total value. Not how i want my estate shared out

records.title: Basic will which is what you get for a…
records.text: Basic will which is what you get for a free will. However just because it’s free does not mean that one shouldn’t receive a decent service or there be  transparency in the add on services which one pays for!I received my will pretty promptly and also paid for the binding service. The binding service for the price is a rip off given that I paid for a flimsy film to the front, a single staple and 1 eyelet. Something I could have got my granddaughter to do for free and probably cost me £1 if even that. Had there been a clearer description of the binding service I wouldn’t have bothered. I’ve had professional wills in the past and the quality of this paid binding is quite shocking and given that it’s not free there is no excuse for this sub standard product The will itself was clearly printed on a printer that was running out of ink as some of the font on the pages is faded and has lines running through the lettering I work for a national company providing health that is free to the customer. We do not do things half heartedly because we are offering a free service! But it seems that the same can’t be said for this company. I understand that it is free and it’s not going to be in depth like a paid for service, but don’t offer a free service if you are not going to offer a service that is worthy of your advertised service I emailed Free Wills the day I received my bound!! will with pictures of the font and my displeasure at the quality of the binding for the price on the 17th May and to date I have received no response ( I’ve checked my junk mail, nada)You do get a mails offering further paid services but you can unsubscribe to these which is what I did

records.title: Completely happy with the service…
records.text: Completely happy with the service except for the offers at the final stage to pay for speedy approval of your will. It said you could otherwise wait 3-5days. I didn't buy the service and my will was approved in 24 hours probably because it was really, really simple will.. Needs to qualify the offer to say helpful for more complex wills.offer to

records.title: Unable to get updates despite edits submitted
records.text: Initially my experience was 5* - a very straightforward online service, however, since I tried to edit some sections all updated versions have been sent unchanged. Additionally, the will doesn’t mention distinction between joint owners and tenants in common, so after all turns out my will is not valid in the one point that I most cared about.

records.title: I did not want to leave a percentage…
records.text: I did not want to leave a percentage but an amount when my estate had been sold and the money split between the people i had specified in my will

records.title: When you chase it up the email reply…
records.text: When you chase it up the email reply you get is often a bit snotty. No need really.

records.title: Editing problemse Freewills site was easy to use
records.text: The Freewills site was easy to use and edit until I realised an error with the executors and tried to correct it.  Finished article showed one executor entered twice and I couldn't change it ( I thought this might invalidate my will), then it said I had already inserted details of 2nd one but it was deleted ?  I changed some details later on but received bound copy of first edit which was wrong before 2nd one received unbound.

records.title: Refers to my husband as my wife
records.text: Refers to my husband as my wife, I have changed the preference to 'Male' twice and still reverts back to 'Wife', looks and feels like a bit of homophobia, and I see I'm not the first to mention this. Disappointing in 2021I have changed to a 3* as they connected me very quickly and rectified the issue, but it still shouldn't take a negative review to have these features working, this isn't the first time it has been mentioned in a review and still not rectified.

records.title: Not applicable.
records.text: Was not the product for me, so neutral rating.Asked to be removed from flow of emails that came in giving legal reasons.They did stop but this is the second survey I have been sent for something I did not purchase.

records.title: Just ONE issue wth this
records.text: This was a very good service with ONE exception. I gave my title as "Mr" and specified that I am married, and wanted the beneficiary to be my spouse, so the final print said that I left everything to my "wife". The problem is that I am married to another man, and the beneficiary should be my husband. I managed to find a way round this, but it is a bit outdated and could be simply be remedied by using a non-gender-specific term such as "spouse" which would cover all eventualities.

records.title: Will writing programme
records.text: The will writing programme asked very basic questions therefore didn't fully give the proper will solution. I understand that this is just a precursor to the user then contacting your Company to take it to the next step but that is not what I want on this occasion. Thank you for your assistance.

records.title: Organisation and structure of the input…
records.text: Organisation and structure of the input data was OK but was a little disappointed in the formatting of the will itself.  It was not easy to make subsequent changes. I had to rewrite/cut and paste the whole document to achieve the output I was seeking.

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: The will service is free. I can attest to this as I have mine and the process was quick and straight forward. The only downside was that after I had submitted all my details I was asked if I wanted one of their solicitors to check it for me (£50 fee). I said no. Then I was asked if I was interested in power of attorney (extra fee). Again I said no.Then I was asked if I wanted them to print my will for me (£20 extra). I said no and was then instructed to download my will as a pdf file.Now I get emails on a daily basis from freewills advertising their services and I have to ignore or delete them.The will part is good but the pestering afterwards is annoying

records.title: I found making the Will with freewills a real mixed bag.
records.text: I found filling out the questionnaire straightforward which was a relief, nothing complicated. I did need to ask separately how to give a proportionate amount to charities, which meant saying ‘no’ to ‘do you want to leave an amount to charity’. It was not obvious and I neatly left and went elsewhere but I found my way. I really don’t like the finished will, I know the wording needs to be legal speak but it makes me want to find a template and do it myself. Very glad I didn’t pay for a paper copy. I also don’t like it being sent in pdf form, I really want it in document form on my computer. Having it wafting in the cloud does not feel like it’s mine.

records.title: Easy to follow
records.text: It’s easy to use and follow for a simple Will . I’m still however waiting for my copy to be checked , bonded and sent to me after 5 working days . So will rate them properly once I receive this .

records.title: Was charge £15 for a hard copy of my…
records.text: Was charge £15 for a hard copy of my will which I thought was not worth it, it was done on the cheapest paper with a plastic page to the front not worth £15.

records.title: The service is good and easy to use
records.text: The service is good and easy to use, BUT as soon as you use it you start getting emails about services that you don't want and they just keep coming!

records.title: This service is well-meaning
records.text: This service is well-meaning, easy to use and free, and I wish I could give it more stars.  But the will that it produced was old-fashioned and needed "plain-Englishing" (in fairness, most solicitors-devised wills have the same problem).  Phrases such as "I give, devise and bequeath all my estate" need to be simplified because it's not clear what they mean - why "devise and bequeath"?It also doesn't allow for beneficiaries who die before, or at the same time, as you.  I've got 3 adult children; what happens if one of them dies in the same accident as me?  If they have children of their own at the time then I'd want the grandkids to inherit but if they were still childless then my remaining children should share everything equally.I read the 9-page free will with interest but will make only minor adjustments to the single-page document I'd devised myself.

records.title: I haven’t sent a good review
records.text: I haven’t sent a good review, because I was told that you would send my a copy of the will I ordered, which I haven’t received yet.

records.title: A Bit Slow
records.text: Perhaps they should have sent the Will before asking for a review.It arrived quickly after I posted my first review.

records.title: Rude staff
records.text: Having a free will is good but the customer service is appalling. I dealt with Amanda George and I found her to be very rude and unprofessional. I wouldn't recommend this company on the that experience alone.

records.title: Will complete but Amanda is rude and unprofessional
records.text: 2 stars is for the online Will but Amanda is rude and abrupt which looses 3 stars. Im not the only review who has stated Amanda is rude. But other than that it,s good to make a Will online. I paid £30 in the end with a refund of £19 for an additional service I didn,t require but she emailed on requesting "this has been done" no opening or ending to a customer email. Unprofessional. They are also demanding Trustpilot review my opinion

records.title: Great idea, not well executed.
records.text: Since you can’t see all the questions without making sequential choices, you might need to go back and change a previous answer. I couldn’t find a way to easily do it. Because it needs to be simple, there are lots of things it doesn’t cover.It uses one unfamiliar term for which it’s hard to find a definition - and even if you could find the definition, it doesn’t allow you to use caveats or change the scenario.I would give it no-star or one-star if I were paying for it. I’ve put two on the basis it’s free and I guess in the absolute simplest of circumstances, it may be useful to someone. Meantime I’ll need to sort out a will elsewhere

records.title: A bit too basic for my requirements
records.text: I know it’s a free service but the questions are so limited that the resulting will is not adequate. I don’t know if it’s possible to add in more scenarios but it certainly wasn’t obvious to me. So, leaving estate to be divided equally amongst children is fine but if one doesn’t survive me I would want everything to go to my surviving child if the other had surviving children. To me, this seems a fairly basic clause to a will.

records.title: I did not like the encripted aspects of…
records.text: I did not like the encripted aspects of the form and found it difficult to make edits. You claim to be a free service but you were asking for tips in the form of money and possibly charging for actions at a later stage, I found these to be unacceptable and have not gone forward with this will. On the other hand the questions asked were useful and a guide to think outdie the box.

records.title: dubious claims
records.text: Website ok but the company claims will is checked by a solicitor but isn't registered with the Solicitor Regulation Authority and wouldn't tell me who the solicitor was. Seems very dodgy. Had it checked by a real solicitor who said it was badly drafted.

records.title: didny carry out my instructions or phone to discuss
records.text: I ,made a will which included a provision about my shared property which i wanted to make a specific provision.  as i wanted to exclude my father from the inheritance and as agreed with my parents the share should pass to my mother. your company chose not to include it in the willmany thanksnic

records.title: Filled in online when I could see copy…
records.text: Filled in online when I could see copy I was concerned with wording so sent message (no reply) left voicemail no reply then received an email saying my payment failed for purchase of bound copy although has gone out of my bank. Received today but has been done incorrect.

records.title: Really basic willIssue in software - not useful
records.text: Really basic will, with issue in soft ware - tried several times to leave different percentage of estate to listed personnel but "programme" kept changing my input to equal % across all beneficiaries. Gave up in the end and am reverting to traditional method - going to a solicitor.

records.title: Went to Free Wills website and…
records.text: Went to Free Wills website and completed my will, no problems. I did not however, appreciate the numerous e-mails soliciting their services which were charged for. If I had wanted the services I would have purchased them whilst compl

description:
Our expert lawyers are located nationwide and work with a central support team based in our head office in Guildford. Because we use technology to enable our lawyers to work flexibly – in many cases from their homes or clients’ offices – we are able to keep overheads low and pass on those savings to our clients. 

Our unique way of working also ensures our clients deal only with their consultant lawyer – they won’t find themselves handed off to a junior team member who can’t offer the expert advice or personal support they deserve. 

And because our lawyers don’t have billing targets, they are able to focus on the right number of clients and ensure each and every one gets a dedicated service. 

We can offer advice on a broad range of legal matters including residential property, employment, family law, commercial property, corporate and commercial matters, and personal injury and clinical negligence cases.

records.title: Hannah Brace
records.text: Hannah Brace, our solicitor did an excellent job when we bought our first home. She is very positive, understood our difficulties, stress and very professional. Her service is outstanding while other solicitors did not show this kind of positive attitude she did and she believed that the case is possible to be done on time! She kept her words and delivered the promised service much quicker as we expected. One month and a half was enough for her to sort out all the legal paper work. Thank you so much, Hannah! God Bless You! Eva and Stefan from Letchworth.

records.title: Was recommended this solicitors
records.text: Was recommended this solicitors, in particular Divya by the estate agent and she was great. Very responsive and sensitive to my first time buyer status. She helpfully guided me through the process and was always available at the end of the phone. Would definitely recommend.

records.title: Jeffrey Gilbert is fantastic
records.text: Jeffrey Gilbert is fantastic. From the moment we instructed him we knew we were in safe hands. He is reliable, efficient and very friendly.

records.title: Setfords Review
records.text: We couldn’t recommend Tom enough! He was fabulous and made the whole process run smoothly. Tom was proactive, professional and above all else, kind.We would recommend Setfords to anyone buying a property.

records.title: They are excellent
records.text: They are excellent. Amazing people, very professional and dedicated. They are always there to answer all your questions and concerns. As a non-UK resident, I had some problems finding a solicitor who dealt with non-residents, I feel very fortunate to have contacted Setfords Solicitors. Everyone I got in touch with from their office was nice and helpful. My deepest gratitude to Gemma, Carla and Jo.

records.title: Mrs Turner was friendly
records.text: Mrs Turner was friendly, kind and knowledgeable. She helped me, and sorted out my problems very quickly and I would highly recommend her. From S. Marzbani

records.title: Kirsty handled our mortgage case from…
records.text: Kirsty handled our mortgage case from start to finish, she's very reliable and very responsive to emails and calls promptly. My hubby and I have recommended her to family and friends. With our full chest we highly give our recommendation. Choose Setfords and thank us later. Abiola & Olu ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

records.title: 10 out of 10
records.text: We wanted to take a moment to acknowledge Florence Oyebola for the excellent work she provided with closing the sale of our home. She acted in the most professional and calm manner, providing great service and always having our best interests in mind. Although we had some bumps on the road, we felt confident after talking to Florence that everything was going to be alright.  It was a pleasure working with Florence and we wish her all the best in her career.

records.title: House purchase
records.text: I used Setfords to purchase my new home. My solicitor, Evette and her team were amazing. They always replied to my enquiries promptly and kept me updated about the progress of my purchase. They answered all my queries clearly and competently. My purchase also had some complications which Evette and her team worked hard to resolve on my behalf, working collaboratively with the seller’s solicitors to get everything required for the sale to complete. I would definitely use Setfords again and would recommend them to friends and family.

records.title: Good experience with Setfords
records.text: Our experience with Setfords was good. Sarah Thomson who did the conveyancing to buy our new house was very helpful from start to finish . Made everything simple and she was approachable  if we had an issue we didn’t understand . Very prompt at replying to emails and phone calls . We would definitely recommend Setfords .

records.title: Zoe always answered my questions…
records.text: Zoe always answered my questions quickly and came back to me on the occasions when she had to make further enquiries. Overall my experience in buying the property was slower than I anticipated apparently due to external influences whilst selling my property went fairly smoothly.

records.title: This was my first experience buying a…
records.text: This was my first experience buying a property and I needed support with the process. Rebecca was great at communication and returned my calls and emails promptly (which wasn't the case with the first solicitor I had been recommended, whom I had to change because of that).There were quite a few issues/delays from both parties for various reasons and Rebecca was really patient with all my queries and provided helpful and timely answers.She was also really empathetic (I was going through a divorce at the time and was a bit of a mess) and  went above and beyond explaining 50 pages of legal speak to me in one of the docs I needed to review.In terms of where my customer needs weren't 100% met, I would have liked more attention to detail (e.g., spelling of my legal name, wrong address used in contracts a few times). Also, more transparency in regards to costs (granted, not the actual solicitor costs but the ones relating to the management company fees) as the amount took my by surprise on the day of completion and I had to borrow the money to be able to do the transaction.All in all, and having heard the experiences of my other friends with their solicitors, I think I received good service and would recommend Rebecca to others as well as would use her services again in the future.

records.title: Great with 'complex' purchase
records.text: We had a bit of a complicated purchase scenario.  Sarah and team were great in getting it all underway and through to completion without a hitch. Couldn't be happier with the service - particularly after 2 firms told us we were stupid to proceed with the scenario.Bizarrely it was our very standard sale, where communication didn't quite go as smoothly.  Somehow/somewhere there were some misunderstandings and last minute panics.  But the team worked through it and we got over the line.

records.title: Sold flat with tenant in situ
records.text: We sold a leasehold flat with a tenant in situ.  The conveyancing proved to be quite challenging and our solicitor David Morse worked hard to ensure completion took place ASAP.  He often answered emails very early in the morning!The Setfords App and Esigning did work well. Their fee was very reasonable for the amount of work involved.

records.title: Friendly and helpful
records.text: Graham Peebles was a friendly and helpful solicitor for our recent house sale.  He dealt with some unexpected problems (not of his making) calmly and pretty efficiently and (as we found ourselves saying to each other) we got there in the end!

records.title: Wills update
records.text: We had been recommended to Setfords by a friend for having our wills updated. Sarah was very kind, helpful and explained legal  terminology very well indeed and the completed wills were easy to understand. The secretary was very helpful several times in helping us deal with physical disabilities on visits there. We were surprised at how expensive they were though and the payment system was not simple.

records.title: Overall positive
records.text: Overall, the experience of selling and buying a property with Setfords has been a positive one. There were a few miscommunications along the way however, which did cause some stress, such as a document being missed which was needed for the sale of one property and solicitor fees being taken from the deposit of the property being purchased without prior knowledge. Setfords did deal with both of these problems though and thankfully everything went to plan in the end.

records.title: As close to 5* as it gets!
records.text: Dealing with Setfords was as close to a 5* rating as it gets. Only a couple of small comm's issues (possibly impacted by 3rd party conduct tbh) prevented it being 5*. It's the 2nd time we've dealt with Evette Abbey specifically and it won't be the last = she is super-efficient. Nice work Setfords!

records.title: Our solicitor was very helpful and…
records.text: Our solicitor was very helpful and guided us through the difficult process of selling. There was an issue with Setfords suffering from the hack which took place across the industry. I think this could've been handled better by giving customers more information and telling us how much of our data was compromised.

records.title: Flat sale completed efficiently although had to chase for updates.
records.text: Flat sale completed successfully and on time. Explained the process very well. The only issue was we had to chase for progress updates more than we expected to.

records.title: A good experience.
records.text: Jordan was very professional, very quick, very helpful and knowlegeable. He went to great lengths to answer my questions and queries. All in all a good experience. Were I to look seriously at another property, I would certainly engage him once more.

records.title: Good experience with Setfords
records.text: Good experience with Setfords. Always responded to us in a timely manner and sent all the required documents. Great with answering questions. It was apparent that they are well experienced and great at what they do. I was able to trust them fully with our home moving process.

records.title: Good but some issues.
records.text: Good but some issues.We bought and sold with Setfords acting for us and the process was smooth. We did not use the portal because we were unable to use it.Communication was good and our solicitor supported us well with the whole process.We also arranged for new wills and Power of Attorney and again quite smooth with good communication.There were issues:-A response from a trustee was not passed on from head office; this also happened when we sent back a document to head office regarding our sale.

records.title: Professional knowledge with passive solicitor services
records.text: Setfords's solicitor have adequate legal knowledge to help their clients to solve all the queries. Due to the solicitor is introduce by the developer, seems they are more intend to stay on developer side. But at some critical issue, they will help the buyer to fight for their legal benefit (rights). This is an excellent points. If the solicitor can active to provide more points on buyers view will be perfect. Final this is worth to recommend solicitor's firm.

records.title: Great Setfords Experience
records.text: Sarah was very helpful throughout our process. It ended up being a drawn out affair due to the solicitors on the other side of the transaction, but Sarah sorted what she could promptly. She also acted in our best interests throughout. Thank you very much Sarah!

records.title: Carol was great at staying in touch and…
records.text: Carol was great at staying in touch and flexible with contact options eg setting up a zoom call. Our sale process was complex and took a long time. She was patient and consistent. I'd recommend Carol.

records.title: Quick, thorough and fairly priced
records.text: Our Solicitor Lucy has handled two purchases and a sale for us now all of which were completed quickly and effectively for a fair price. Lucy is professional and their advice was sound we will use her for a third time when we move again. The only reason I have given 4/5 and not 5/5 is that some times Lucy and her team can be hard to contact by telephone, emails however are always awnsered promptly.

records.title: A very straight forward transaction…
records.text: A very straight forward transaction assisted by Sonal and her team. Papers turned around quickly. The only delays were at the hands of the buyers conveyancers who left a great deal to be desired.Happy to recommend Sonal in the future.

records.title: Would definitely recommend
records.text: Kristel was very helpful and thoroughly professional in her approach. We had a tough time in moving to the new property due to the delay in the chain but Kristel was very supportive and made sure that everything was done on time. I would definitely recommend Kristel to all my friends who are keen to climb up the property ladder.

records.title: Expensive for the service
records.text: Purchase went smoothly but expensive for the service they provide. They basically just sent us things to read and sign and we sent them back.

records.title: Deal completed but disappointed about uncommunicated additional charges
records.text: We used Setfords for our property purchase and the deals was done successfully. One thing I am disappointed is, while we were committed all charges are confirmed at the beginning, we were later on charged additionally for GBP200 for a declaration for right of way in the final statement which we are not been informed anytime before. I consulted others which the right of way declaration is quite obvious for my case and should be included in the overall conveyance fee

records.title: Communication wasn't good
records.text: Setting up the account was easy enough, but we found communication was lacking.Felt like there was no hurry to get completed and had to chase up the mortgage company myself in the end.On completion heard from the estate agent of the house sold and lady who sold the house buying before hearing from Setfords.  Still not had any actual official confirmation of completion after 10 days of completing!

records.title: Mistakes made on settlement figures…
records.text: Mistakes made on settlement figures including trying to charge stamp duty on a 122k property. Told them the figures for completion was wrong as we was part repaying a mortgage. So early settlement figure was wrong. We had been told we’d need to claim it back ourselves???  Completion date was a complete farce. A very simple chain to sort left my wife completely stressed and upset. Communication was poor. No upfront details of searches etc which would be needed an additional 1k of fees charged. Overall what should have been simple chain to sort turned out to be a very stressful experience. Communication between solicitors always seems to be an issue.

records.title: Great customer service let down by escalation of costs and overchargements on completion statement
records.text: Fantastic experience and my solicitor Gemma Lloyd was always on hand to guide me through the process of selling my apartment. Professional, very approachable and great service. Thanks for making this as smooth as possible. Would definitely recommend. UPDATE 9TH May Unfortunately it later came to light that there had been a number of over charges on my completion statement. First my estate agent and secondly my originally quoted fees

records.title: Action was a bit lethargic
records.text: Action was a bit lethargic. On COMPLETION DAY we were not advised that money had arrived from our sale, even though 2 messages were left by us enquiring about developments. EXTREMELY ANNOYED to receive letter from the REVENUE demanding payment of our Stamp Duty with  added penalty interest.

records.title: The overall experience left me with…
records.text: The overall experience left me with mixed feelings. I am glad that we completed but it was a bumpy journey. As a first time buyer I would have liked to be more informed in the process. Most of the times I had no clue what was going on, and I had to constantly ask for updates. My solicitor was quick in responding to my emails, but responses were usually monolectic which was not helpful. I would have preferred more communication and less of feeling guilt in seeking it. Also, the process took a lot longer than expected (5 months for leasehold property not in a chain). I was very stressed with a mortgage expiration approaching and a deadline to vacate my rental accommodation. I didn’t feel fully supported by my solicitor during these difficult times. At the end we managed to complete a week after vacating my rental accommodation, which meant that we had to stay in a hotel that added to our expenses.
