records.title: Chris Morgan is an unethical solicitor
records.text: Chris Morgan has acted unethically in contacting me directly on several occasions, in the knowledge that I have a solicitor acting for me in a case of contentious probate. His tone in early communications was threatening and disrespectful, and in the text he made unwarranted personal remarks as to my character. Latterly, I agreed that he could act on behalf of myself and my siblings in applying for Letters of Administration, and in the distribution of funds, while retaining my own solicitor. Mr Morgan has made an interim distribution to my siblings without gaining my instructions as a joint administrator of my brother's estate. My wish was to wait until accounts have been agreed and for there to be a single distribution. He has not supplied these accounts, and gave me a few hours to telephone him with my bank details before disappearing for the Christmas break. I was not prepared to contact him directly, and shall be complaining to the law society about his conduct.

records.title: OK service
records.text: OK service. Anthony tends to use 10 words when 5 or less would do. Had to correct the Sale Price on multiple occasions. Late completion cost me an extra £11k in SDLT.  I am not blaming the late completion on Setfords, but the mistakes and consequential delays were certainly a contributing factor

records.title: We used Setfords solicitors to purchase…
records.text: We used Setfords solicitors to purchase a flat in London. Initial conversations went well, and the process started smoothly. However, over time, communication became much less efficient, and the solicitor made little effort to resolve outstanding issues with the seller. Whenever we asked for an update, they simply repeated the same email without providing any detailed information on the current status of the process.After working with us for four(!) months and presumably processing the documents, we were abruptly informed that, due to changes in the company’s insurance policy, they were dropping our case and would no longer represent us. We had to quickly find another solicitor, pay extra for urgency, transfer all the documents, and explain the delays to the seller, which were caused by Setfords’ actions. Regardless of the policy change, they should have checked this at the beginning, not after four months.As a result, we wasted months with Setfords, incurred unnecessary fees, and delayed the purchase, which nearly caused the chain to collapse.

records.title: Service was good, but now demanding more money.
records.text: The service was good, but suddenly after 3 months we were told we owed another £1700 after being told we had paid enough. We are still waiting for court documents and feel this is being kept back until we pay.  In total the bill will be over £5000 for production of court papers and 1 family court appearance. Seems far too much.

records.title: An average service
records.text: The overall job was done properly and was fine.At the start of the process we received very little communication and on multiple occasions when we phoned and could not speak to the right person we did not receive a call back or email. I personally did not feel very supported over a process that we needed help and support and some understanding with. Communication only got better after I emailed the team every day to ensure our case was being worked on. This should not be the case but it seems to be with most property solicitors. The job however was completed to a thorough standard.

records.title: Not Happy
records.text: While the team is approachable and responsive to emails and phone calls, I encountered significant challenges during the process of selling my house, which was a chain-free transaction. The process extended over four and a half months and was notably slow. Additionally, there were errors with my paperwork that led to an unnecessary duplicate payment for a house survey, with no offer of compensation for this issue. Over the course of nearly five months, I frequently had to follow up to ensure that necessary tasks were completed. Without my proactive involvement, the process could have been even more delayed. Based on my experience, I would not recommend their services.

records.title: Very poor communication throughout
records.text: Very poor communication throughout. Didn’t receive regular updates on the purchase status and when asking for updates had slow and unhelpful responses. Very expensive. Definitely wouldn’t recommend and would advise at taking your business elsewhere.

description:
CEL Solicitors is a nationwide, family-run law firm with a strong reputation for excellence in civil litigation. Our mission is to provide expert legal services that are accessible to everyone on a no-win, no-fee basis. We are proud to have helped thousands of clients across the UK secure the justice they deserve.
Our Areas of Expertise
At CEL Solicitors, we specialise in a wide range of services, including:
Fraud and Scam Claims
We are dedicated to helping victims of fraud and scams recover their losses. Our team has extensive experience in handling cases involving online scams, investment fraud, and more.
Learn More
Housing Disrepair Claims
We fight for tenants' rights to live in safe and habitable conditions. If your landlord has neglected essential repairs, we can help you hold them accountable.

Tenancy Deposit Claims
If your landlord hasfailed to protect it in a government-approved scheme, our team can assist you in making a claim.

Personal Injury Claims
Whether you've been injured at work, in a public place, or due to a defective product, we can help you seek compensation. Our personal injury expertise includes workplace accidents, slips, trips, falls, road traffic accidents, and product liability claims.
Learn More
Professional Negligence Claims
We hold professionals accountable when their negligence results in harm. Whether you've suffered due to poor advice, misconduct, or other professional failures, we are here to advocate for you.
Learn More
Medical Negligence Claims
If you have suffered harm due to medical malpractice, our dedicated team can help you pursue a claim. We understand the complexities of medical negligence cases and will work tirelessly to secure the compensation you deserve.

Japanese Knotweed Claims

Life and Critical Illness Claim Appeals

Commercial Litigation
Our team has a wealth of experience in resolving commercial disputes, from contract issues to partnership disputes, ensuring that your business interests are protected.

Our Commitment to Clients
At CEL Solicitors, we understand that legal issues can be stressful and overwhelming. That's why we are committed to making the legal process as straightforward and accessible as possible. We believe in providing clear, honest advice and will keep you informed at every stage of your case.
Where possible, we operate on a no-win, no-fee basis, ensuring that everyone has access to the legal support they need. This approach means you can pursue your claim with confidence, knowing that you won’t be out of pocket if your case is unsuccessful.

Nationwide Reach: We serve clients across the UK, bringing our expertise to people in need of legal assistance, no matter where they are located.

Get in Touch

I was also told that i could then choose whether to pay CEL, or not to do so, since they had a Fiduciary Duty to act in my best interests and inform me that my bank may well refund me, thus saving me having to pay CEL their 25% fee.This, in these terms, did NOT happen. I challenged CEL but they dug their heels in and insisted that they had achieved the result and were due the fee that I had contracted to pay. I took legal advice from Which?, who said that I had a strong case and should go through the Legal Ombudsman service. We were about to leave on a 3-week holiday and I did not want this dragging on. I was offered a very small reduction in the fee and agreed to settle, just to stop the acrimonious email exchanges.Bottom Line - ALWAYS speak to your bank FIRST, if no joy, then engage a service such as CEL

records.title: Slow start
records.text: So far not really up to standard yet. I opened a fraud case 2 months ago but its been a slow process. I don't get replies that quick and I have to force them to call me. I hope if they can recover my money I can push there ratings up.

records.title: Thank you Paul Carson for talking to me…
records.text: Thank you Paul Carson for talking to me yesterday .Feel better such a helpful and understand the situationhoping for positive result

records.title: I like the way cel solicitor response…
records.text: I like the way cel solicitor response to their clients and how they handle cases,it's a big up

records.title: Advance fee scam
records.text: Has anyone had any success with a advance fee scam at all?

records.title: Paul
records.text: Found Paul to be very helpful and gave a positive understanding of my situation.

records.title: False information from employee
records.text: I was told by an employee that the fees charged would be charged to the bank and not come out of the money I get back. However I have received the money and been charged all of the fees.Got some money back which is great just got a total that was less then expected due to the wrong information from an employee

records.title: Asking for a review after one call….
records.text: I initially spoke to Joe who treated me with respect, compassion and detailed the process in an easy to understand way. Was told I’d be speaking to an individual case handler within 24 hours. However that’s not happened yet and when I called back, the clock has reset to 48 hours now. Frustrated that they’re collecting 5 star reviews based on one call and nothing to do with the actual legal side of the work. If thing progress in a positive way, I’ll edit this to a higher rating.

records.title: Not Great at all
records.text: Unfortunately I felt this law firm wasn't the right fit for me despite its glowing reviews. I never spoke to a lawyer once, it was always Paralegals and alot of unprofessionalism I had to get my case transferred over to another Paralegal who was better. Response times wwre very poor,  management was very poor. Personally I would not recommend this law firm.

records.title: Overall poor impression
records.text: Spoke at length with a customer advisor, who seemed very knoweledgable and sympathetic. sent E mail with all my details, then nothing for a week. received call after call then wanting a repeat of all that I had spoken about in my previous call. Asked the question what the fee would be if they won my case, again nothing for a few days, then the calls started asking again for a repeat of the information already disclosed. I accept everyone is busy, but there seems to be a lack of communication internal and a lack of care. I have been left with a very poor impression of what is advertised as a very proffesional company,

records.title: Everything started off so promising…
records.text: Everything started off so promising nearly 18 months ago, had assurances that the way i was scammed wasn't to be embarrassed about. After a few months my case was rejected by Halifax, so after talking to CEL we appealed to the financial ombudsmen, this was unsuccessful i was told. The next step was to go back to them, this was some six months ago and i haven't had no contact back since....

records.title: I spoke with Joe yesterday and informed…
records.text: I spoke with Joe yesterday and informed him that I had been scammed. He was so  helpful and being a good listener he went on to explain how CEL could help with a possible claim against the Barclays Bank. He was professional and explained everything in a concise and clear manner.

records.title: Not a big help, still I had to pay
records.text: I paid a fee for something that I've done on my own. I've got the chargeback of my credit card because I have personally requested it, whereas the letter that Cel solicitor sent to my bank for a refund of my main bank account has been declined.I'm quite disappointed as they ensured me that we would have won the case. I have been naive because I let the solicitor know that I got the refund of the credit card that I have personally requested! If I wouldn't have said anything the solicitor wouldn't have known and I wouldn't have paid the fee. So I would suggest to people: if the bank contact you personally don't say anything.

records.title: Very poor at receiving information.
records.text: Their terms are that we must keep in touch otherwise the full fee will be payable.  But they are very poor at receiving information and communicating themselves. This was off putting to the extent I terminated the agreement with them.

records.title: Wish to get back close to totality of scam not lose quarter plus interest!!
records.text: It's bad being scammed once but for the recovery agency to charge at least a quarter of what is lost is the second biggest scam

records.title: Unsuccessful
records.text: So far so good. I feel hopeful. Now they are going to do their magic. I will come back and let you know if they were successful in getting my money back.VERDICT : NO they were not successful in getting me even a penny back

description:
Why choose us


Tailored to youWe’ll find out what’s important to you and what’s unique about your move, so we can match you with the conveyancing firm that suits your needs

Trusted by our customersThe Simplify family are all rated Excellent on TrustPilot, so rest assured you'll only ever receive the best service

No move, no legal fee
Our no move, no legal fee guarantee means that you will not pay us any legal fees if your move falls through.

Your time matters to usUsing the right combination of tech and people, at the right points in your journey, helps to fast track the process and keep you in control
Get an instant quote
Alternatively, If you would like to discuss a quotation over the phone please call 0333 234 4425

eWayOur innovative online case management system, eWay, allows you to keep track of your progress, make payments and complete documentation 24/7 via a smartphone, PC or tablet. Or you can download our iOS and Android app.

records.title: From the moment I rang the company…
records.text: From the moment I rang the company everything was explained in thorough detail, everything moved as they said it would and even quicker which was excellent for us. They are always there at the end of the phone, can not fault them at all!

records.title: Great experience again
records.text: Getting close to exchange and completion and Connor has been brilliant throughout. Answering any questions that I have and making sure everything goes smoothly. Great experience again.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. Found me a very competitively priced surveyor.

records.title: Dan in particular has been extremely…
records.text: Dan in particular has been extremely helpful when answering my questions. As a first time buyer, he reassured me that no question was silly and made the onboarding process very smooth. I look forward to the next steps in the process in the hope that it continues smoothly and efficiently.

records.title: Impressed
records.text: Having seemn reviews  I decided to ask  for  a quote.I was phoned by Ryan who talked me through the process and answered all questions.Ryan went the extra mile and  I was after some thinking quite happy to sign up.Many thanks for your help and  reassurance.I would definitely recommend .

records.title: My first house move in decades
records.text: A lot has changed since my last home move in the days long before the internet was an every day tool.My case was initially handled by Ryan. He was very helpful clearly explaining the process I was about to embark on. Within a few minutes of the call an email arrived with a link to the convayencer who would be dealing with my case.The saying goes "You don't get a second chance of a first impression".And so far that first impression has given me confidence that the rest of the process should be relatively smoothe.

records.title: Very helpful
records.text: Despite the fact that my iPad was displaying data fields that could not be completed fully, I was talked through some options to try and overcome these glitches by a very patient and understanding young lady who answered my call promptly.

records.title: Sean Donald-Deacon has been fantastic…
records.text: Sean Donald-Deacon has been fantastic to work with. Regarding my sales quote, he assured me that a senior member would be assigned to handle my case, which gave me great confidence. He has been extremely helpful both over the phone and via chat. I highly recommend Sean for his professionalism and excellent service in resolving any issues.

records.title: Incredibly Helpful!
records.text: I am a first time buyer with little experience in purchasing a property. Thomas with My Home Move Conveyancing is very friendly, lightning quick to answer any queries I have had and gave me an extremely fair quote. After finding a house my partner and I liked we instructed the Solicitor and paid a initial fees. However, the house fell through and we thought we had lost the money we had paid. After contacting Thomas again he alleviated me about the search guarantee and that I'd meet the criteria meaning I wouldn't lose any of the money. We are currently in the process of buying a new house with My Home Move Conveyancing thanks to the incredibly helpful Thomas.

records.title: straighward job done brilliantly
records.text: Was very straighward, the only place gave me a reasonable quotation. Very delighted with the service I received. Thank you very much!!

records.title: Only just signed up with you experience…
records.text: Only just signed up with you experience up to now has been good. Look forward to this carrying on until completion of my home.

records.title: Fairly straightforward.
records.text: Fairly straightforward.I would have liked to have been told about the stamp duty situation rather than being alerted by someone else.Everything should be clearly set out from the start.Thanks and regards, Annie

records.title: It could have been quicker but overall satisfying
records.text: I have mended my orginal review as subsequently I received an adequate support and I have to say that tubings progressed well and smoothly.It’s a shame I had to chase through trustpilot, but at the end things went well. So I am happy overall for the service received.Below my original review:I’m growing frustrated with my case.It is now over 2 months since we started the process for a remortgage. (Which for their own admission it should be straightforward and quick).I don’t get response from my assigned conveyancer to my emails and when I call her on the phone she doesn’t pick up and doesn’t return my call despite me leaving a voicemail.I am at risk of jeopardising the whole transaction as the expiration date of the mortgage offer and other papers is approaching. Adding additional stress.I have given 2 stars as I hope this is going to get resolved before it’s too late.Happy to upgrade it if sorted or to downgrade it if not.

records.title: Early Days
records.text: So far it’s early days, but I’ve not come across any problems, questions have been answered promptly, forms are relatively easy to complete…

records.title: Reassured on quality of service
records.text: Having had issues with my house sale with another conveyancing service I was keen to assure myself that the problems I had would not be repeated.  Dan Atkins provided the information I required so my concerns have been answered.

records.title: We’ve just signed up with eWay for the…
records.text: We’ve just signed up with eWay for the sale of our home and future purchase. I’m a returning customer and Bens service has been great.  We look forward to receiving a professional and timely Service of everyone else involved going forward.

records.title: The website is clear and easy to use
records.text: The website is clear and easy to use. Queries are answered swiftly and process moving smoothly

records.title: So far so good
records.text: So far so good - working with Premier Property Lawyers - It seems early days so far to comment in detail. So I'll try to update this as it goes.

records.title: Responsive and helpful
records.text: Very impressed with our conveyancer Charlie Ford, who made sure that we were well-informed throughout what ended up being a lengthy and complex legal process. Adam Jones, who helped on completion week, was also brilliant. Both could be reached easily by phone and were very responsive and helpful. Only reason this isn't a 5 star review is because the initial process of being put in touch with our conveyancer/getting an initial appointment felt more complicated than it needed to be, and we were confused about our best point of contact for the first month of so of the buying process. Once we were in direct contact with our conveyancer, things became much more simple. On balance, would really recommend them.

records.title: Feedback
records.text: The people I have spoken too are all friendly and helpful, however your AI system needs a little work on. I have completed a number of tasks and saved them yet it keeps telling me I haven't, I do save each document, examples include;I successfully completed the Mitek ID check yesterday and it was all ticked off, yet today I have received an email at 11.55 asking me to do.Last week I phoned up Adam Chance and booked an initial Appointment Call for next Thursday 13.00. Yet I keep getting reminders to book an appointment.

records.title: Good Experiences
records.text: I used MyHomeMove Conveyancing twice and both experiences were good. Although there are recent staff changes, they work as a team so I feel there are always someone to help, work, follow up and respond in a timely manner. The workflow system, eWay, let me feel the process is transparent, organized, and secured. Thanks, Rani! I would not hesitate to use MyHomeMove Conveyancing again :)

records.title: Effective and smooth online conveyancing
records.text: The online portal made it really easy to exchange documents and find information as well as see the progress of my purchase and sale. It was really easy to contact my conveyancer (Sheila Akoto, and before that Leena Shah) by email or phone and she dealt with all phone enquiries quickly and efficiently, particularly as we neared the completion and exchange part of the process.

records.title: Overall good experience.
records.text: I recently used my home conveyancing for purchasing a property from my father. There was no chain so the process was quite simple. There were a few occasions where I needed to chase for updates but the few enquiries that held us up were out of my conveyancers hands. I thought the portal was very user and friendly. My Overall experience was good and Ria my conveyancer was friendly and always willing to help where needed.

records.title: Good experience working with “My home move convenyancing”
records.text: Good experience working with “My home move conveyancing” Always responsive to our questions in a timely manner. Just happens once in the whole process when it tooks a bit longer to recive their reply but overall always very good and quick. The online portal is very good as you can access and upload all the required documents at any time and easily.

records.title: I sold my leasehold flat through My…
records.text: I sold my leasehold flat through My Home Convencying and Thomas Spowage was very patient, helpful and responsive. Being Leasehold things were not straight forward but Thomas help me navigate my way through it. The price was highly competitive and the online portal was easy to use. I would recommend Thomas and the company.

records.title: Over all the service the team provided…
records.text: Over all the service the team provided was great. It all started off well, and then my conveyancer changed a couple of times, which was frustrating because couldn't get hold of anyone when I needed to speak to someome over the phone. However, once Paula took over my case she bought it on track and it was easy sailing.

records.title: Sean
records.text: Sean, has been an excellent representative.He called me after sending a quote out, (which is a very clear format I might add)We accepted the quote initially but eventually went with an another one purely because they were local to us.I informed Sean of my decision and he was very understanding and wished us all the best.

records.title: Overall good experience but customer service needs to be improved
records.text: Overall good experience, but my conveyancer Nicolle was bit rude sometimes, her customer skills were shocking. As a customer it's my right to get an update time to time which didn't happen, when called to speak to Nicolle, on few occasions it felt she has attitude problems,perhaps she need to be trained how to treat customers. You should not treat customer's as a number.Anyway the sale has completed now.Thanks

records.title: Paula was always really helpful and…
records.text: Paula was always really helpful and upfront with the entire process for our first house purchase. It was sometimes difficult to get in touch but we can imagine she is in very high demand and when we did get in touch it was very straight forward and we were able to solve any queries directly.

records.title: Very efficient
records.text: Much more efficient using a dedicated, predominantly online conveyancer as opposed to dealing with a high street / generalist firm. Everyone else in the chain really slowed us down using normal solicitors. Very easy to contact on the telephone or by email any time. The online portal (eWay) is a great way of keeping on top of the whole process.Charge extra costs for things that they shouldn't but that's all conveyancing solicitors. The amount paid was still less than other quotes we received.

records.title: We have only just begun our journey…
records.text: We have only just begun our journey through conveyancing for sale and purchase with My Home Move. So far all seems simple and easy with guided steps and help via the online portal for information to be uploaded. We have an extensive set of documentation for building work and electric work through the years and readily to hand in files so found it easy to scan and upload documents required. I advise users to get all the paperwork ready before going through the portal questionaires and scanning every document you have ready to upload and naming everything so you can find it easily, this will save a lot of time when completing. I also suggest though when completing any of the online forms that the save button is used before uploading any document as if not the form upto that point will reset after upload and you then have to go through abd re-comllete. It is also not shown that you have uploaded a document to the relevant question/area when you revisit those forms again, i can imagine some may find this confusing. Building particulars may seem a bit long winded and odd with the question, but we saw this as a good thing to cover all possible queries at a later date.

records.title: I like the portal and the way it guides…
records.text: I like the portal and the way it guides you through the process.  We have found it difficult to make contact with our conveyancer, she did not turn up for the initial call, with no notice of cancellation or message left.

records.title: Waiting in all day for a telephone call…
records.text: Waiting in all day for a telephone call which never happened. Tried to call on hold for 20 minutes and nobody even answered to transfer me through to my contact.

records.title: Good but some hidden charges
records.text: I left my review after the purchase is completed (although still waiting for the Registration of Title yet completed). The conveyancer did a great job, they review my case very thoroughly and raised necessary enquiries to the vendor and management company, and they response to my enquiries very quickly too. Although I would recommend to chase them more often if you think the process is stagnant, as they might miss out something and waiting for nothing.The only disappointed thing is the charges. There is a  £904+VAT "cost" after I paid the standard "Professional Fees" of £704+VAT (excluding some add-on specifically for my purchase). The quotation they sent me at the beginning was only included the "Professional Fees", and there is no breakdown of this "cost" and what is it for. I believe this is their fee for providing service, but they should have listed it out at the beginning.

records.title: THINK ONLINE CONVEYANCING...THINK DELAYS AND PROBLEMS
records.text: I am sorry to say I would not recommend online conveyancing when buying a property. I recently purchased a flat via an online solicitor and it took nearly 5 months.Everything in life does not always come in BLACK OR WHITE but the Internet doesn't recognise 'grey' areas. Evan after I had exchanged I was receiving texts from the company telling me "I had 23 issues to complete online" .

records.title: More training required for the conveyancer
records.text: I think the conveyancer needs to get her act together. She asked payment from me the seller that was required from the buyer. She sat on the information that was required by the buyer’s solicitor but said that she hadn’t received it even though it was sent ages ago by the Management Company.The good points: she would respond to my emails and phone calls.

records.title: Too many conveyancers
records.text: We went through so manyconveyancers with no explanation to what they kept changing. The process took many more weeks longer than it should have done.Eventually we were given Brody who worked wonders and was able to get our completion through, but initially the first 3 months of the process was painful.

records.title: I have just started the conveyancing
records.text: I have just started the conveyancing, literally instructed them 2 days ago. So I can’t really give a proper full review as there’s not much to review on. Hench the middle and safe 3 stars given.At this early stage there’s 2 issues I would highlight:1/. You should not ask a new client to give a review within a day or two of instruction.2/. Secondly you should not allocate a conveyancer who’s going to be on annual leave for a whole week and uncontactable and therefore not responsive to initial queries. As you can imagine, there be many initial queries to address etc.Both the above two points do not leave good first impressions so far. Let’s see how this all plays out.

records.title: Hard wired online system
records.text: I did  not have good experience with their online website,  hoping the actual conveyancing will be successful 1st day

records.title: The communication with myhomemove has…
records.text: The communication with myhomemove has been good so far. But the eWay system is not reliable at all. it always shows errors when logging in .

records.title: Online portal is very good
records.text: We love the online portal and the ability to upload documents. You can see the progress of your move along the way. Communication started off well then it was difficult towards the end. Promised exchange dates passed and ended up exchanging and completing on the same day. This was very stressful. Having removals and waiting around for everything to go through, not knowing that it would. Previously had good experiences with this company but not sure we would use them again.

records.title: Mixed
records.text: I find eway easy to use and the notifications helpful.With regards to the conveyancing itself, I have had some mixed experience. My conveyancer is slow to review any uploads and often informs me that I still need to upload more documents weeks after the initial upload. Which is frustrating as it appears that I am back to square one. I would prefer an early review of documents so that we can get things moving more quickly. Not sure if this is due to workload? Or part-time working, or a bit of both.

records.title: Conveyancer was great - Quote team did not honour original quote
records.text: Paula my conveyancer was great , answered calls and emails , knew her stuff and was a delight to work with on my case i would definatly recommend her and her team .......... sadly the quote team did not honour the original quote and then failed to reply to my complaint sent by email , a real let down was the quote team .

records.title: Good but could be very good or fantastic…
records.text: When you got started it worked ok  but at times the response was slow. Because you have an excellent portal we could see the purchasers solicitor had emailed but there was no response from yourselves.  I also think the hand over between you and purple bricks was lacking in that they didn't communicate with you but you hadn't chased them, you knew we had sold but I had to ring to get you started. You were on the purple bricks portal as acting but had done nothing to start the process until I nudged you.  It's really just all about communication.

records.title: I liked conveyancin the phone calls and the firm…
records.text: I liked the phone calls and the firm and us were fed up with people pulling out and then okay when we got the last offer . So all good in the end reasonable price for the conveyancing and getting the house sale to the probate team

records.title: The lawyers were fine
records.text: The lawyers were fine, fairly quick and responsive.What has bothered me since however are the dozen or more text messages every 1-2 weeks pestering me for a 5* review.I'm really curious as to whether this review will cause them to cease.

records.title: Competitively priced but let down by…
records.text: Competitively priced but let down by some of their systems. They use a robotic online identity system Hooyu which is very persistent and continues to hassle even after a problem has been allegedly sorted directly with the solicitor or after they’ve told us things were acceptable. We found this very stressful and can’t fully recommend the service because of this.

records.title: Not bad but Comms could be better
records.text: There are some very good aspects to the service: our assigned conveyancer was very efficient, courteous, knowledgable and helpful when I spoke to her, the eWay portal is a nice way of wrapping everything together. Communication though is not great; it is very difficult to get hold of someone (anyone at times) when you need to and despite requests for more regular updates in the week or two leading up to Completion I struggled to get a clear picture of what was happening. I understand our Estate Agent and Buyer's solicitor had similar issues.They need a team that are much more readily available to sit above the conveyancers, handling routine comms, setting expectations, explaining next steps etc

records.title: Not quite sure yet.
records.text: At the moment it's to early to tell.At this moment in time I'm not sure, have some slight reservations,  cannot recommend to anyone yet

records.title: Overall got my purchase completed the…
records.text: Overall got my purchase completed the eway is good but unfortunately the communication is very poor. Multiple times I attempted to contact my conveyancer to be told they are out, they are off. In this current climate a lot of law firms work from home on some days so the lack of communication is the reason for my poor review.

records.title: A very poor start
records.text: A very poor start. Your submission portal to accept the your quote was not working, so I had to contact your office and Daniel had to submit it manually. Then I was told I would get an email from E Way which never arrived. Instead, I got another email from My Home Move to remind me to log into E Way using an access button in that email, and it took me to a bad webpage which said that "application failed". I had to contact Sean to send me a new link. So far, I have spent my time on phone calls to your office to fix links to your portals and I am still waiting to get started with a conveyancer. I was told that I would have a direct contact number to a conveyancer and yet I have been told to do everything by internet links that don't work. I am now waiting for a new set of emails to arrive from Sean. Both of your customer services representatives have tried to be helpful to fix these errors, but you need to fix all your links to your portal. This leaves me with little confidence in the service offered by My Home Move.

records.title: Unsuitable for properties purchased at auction, despite specifying this up front
records.text: Unfortunately their quote process can't cope with house purchases that aren't bog-standard. Even after a phone call to specify I was buying through Modern Method of Action with a 56 day completion timeframe, the quotes provided were for solicitors who stated minimum turnaround times of 12-13 weeks), or who doubled their quotes when told about the buying method. They may be great for other people, but it was frustrating that they wasted my time despite my clear communication up front. An additional note on the solicitor they referred me to (PM Legal). Despite the quote being obtained in my name (female), with my contact details (female), the solicitors have begun addressing correspondance to my husband. A great example of everyday sexism, and not acceptable in this day and age. Do better!

records.title: I had four differant Conveyancers
records.text: I had four differant Conveyancers,  none from start to finish .Kept sending irrelevant documents correspondence that could only mean something to Lawyers and a lawyers job is to put things into plain English for the client which wasn't often. Plus of course you get a call centre/ switch board who want to know everything before being passed onto another person who wants all the information again.

records.title: Less review emails, just one response would be good!
records.text: If the same effort could be applied to answering desperate emails from clients as in promoting reviews I could be happier!  Day 3 and nothing from my appointed conveyancer, being out of UK maybe this has been the wrong choice for us.  Certainly, the amount of work involved in completing the online system makes it clear why the prices are so much lower than a land based service.

records.title: Could do better
records.text: Most of the tasks I was set I managed correctly. However to upload and print the signed declaration forms was Impossible. All my printer would print was just one blank page. The id requirement was equally dumbfounding. There was good information about the various forms of ID they require. But there was no prompts or method for actually completing the task

records.title: Charges going up already
records.text: Recommended via the co-op. Not overly impressed so far. After 1 week and I’ve already received a notification that charges have gone up. Not sure if I’ll continue with them or not

records.title: Lack of communication and updates.
records.text: Lack of communication and updates, particularly when nearing exchanging contracts. Requested documents from us various times, when we had already sent these. Requested ID documents from us which could have been arranged months prior, as opposed to the week before we were due to complete. Due to this incompetence, we were then asked to pay an additional expenditure fee as we exchanged and completed within 3 days of one another, despite us being ready to exchange for weeks prior to this. Very unimpressed with the service we received.

records.title: Whole process took way too long
records.text: If it had been one property I might have let it go, but I was selling 2, both took 8 months to move anywhere, consequently one fell through due to length time to sell. There was no urgency to move purchase forward until deadlines crept up then it was too late. The on line website was frankly a waste of time, documents had to be duplicated many times and you are unable to view many  documents once uploaded.

records.title: The solicitor is overwhelmed and missed some details
records.text: Their quote is cheaper than others.However, the solicitor is just overwhelmed. It is really difficult to reach them by phone and they reply very slowly by email.The solicitor also didn’t missed some details from seller’s solicitor, which dragged the process and made the seller really frustrated.

records.title: Don’t recommend
records.text: It was close to impossible to get in touch with my solicitors on a daily basis and many times they’ve missed the appointment. They have also taken ages to review the paperwork and I ended up in a loss because of their late replies and realisation of proper steps. A simple no-chain, no-chain transaction ended being a 6-month long one. Even now, after the completion date, I still have revised enquiries with them that they can’t be asked to answer. I don’t recommend their services and they bring more stress than help.

description:
First Migration, established in 2007, has helped over 19,000 clients secure their UK Visa and British Citizenship approvals worldwide. During this time, we have maintained probably the best online reputation worldwide for always providing our clients with a 5-Star+ service. How have we been able to do this? It is quite simple, as you will only work directly with the business owners and have a dedicated two-person expert team to work with you (Dean & Aga). You must have secured no less than 5,000 UK Visa approvals to work with clients directly at First Migration. This ensures that our clients only ever receive truly expert advice, and we solely secure UK Visa approvals. After signing up for our service, you will be provided with a dedicated number to call if you need to reach us (by phone or text message), and you will receive replies to your emails within 24 hours. For your convenience, we are a fully digital UK immigration consultancy, and all meetings are conducted via Zoom webcam. That way, we can offer you a personal service wherever you are in the world, as nothing beats seeing your UK Visa Expert when working closely with them. The UK Visa application process is also fully digital, with an online application form being submitted and all PDF supporting documents uploaded to a website. This enables us to assist you remotely, as you will provide PDF copies of all your documents to us via a DropBox/Google Drive. If you are not confident using computers, we will guide you through from start to finish to ensure the process is stress-free. As we pride ourselves on solely securing UK Visa approvals, you can rest assured your application will be approved the first time as our client. Should you want us to work with you to guarantee your UK Visa or British Citizenship approval after reading our reviews, visit our website at FirstMigration.com and submit a Callback Request. Alternatively, you can always email Dean or Aga directly at contact@firstmigration.com, explaining your current situation and which category of UK Visa you are looking to apply for. Like the clients that have left reviews here, we hope you will place your faith in us and become a part of our ongoing success story. We look forward to hearing from you shortly and feel free to get in touch at any time.

records.title: Dean and Aga are absolute superstars

records.title: Extremely knowledgeable and professional
records.text: The service and support I got once I had handed over my documentation was excellent a I had the up most confidence in my adviser. Having the person with me on the day of the visa was very comforting as well. I know that I wouldn't have gotten my visa without their assistance. The only thing that I was surprised about was the level of support before I had submitted my documentation. I wasn't contacted at all until a few days before my appointment. I thought that for the money that I would get more support from them regarding making sure I could get and had gotten all the correct documentation.  Once they did get in contact they were great but there was some issues with my documentation which would have been better if I had of had more support earlier.

records.title: Professional service - Tier 1 extension and ILR for Contrators
records.text: From my experience First Migration is a professional company  and provides first class advice on immigration. I used their service twice, first to extend my Tier-1 visa and then for ILR. Being a contractor, my paper work was a bit complex for me to maintain and hence approached First Migration for their service. Also the immigration rules changed like the weather in the UK. Both Dean and Aga are very knowledgeable on immigration topics and were very helpful indeed. My advice to others using their service is to book short appointments:1. First appointment to check your case, clarify your questions, plan, payment, receive templates for accountant, employer etc. 2. Second appointment once the draft letters and other paper works are ready. You can use this time to let them verify your paper work or ask further questions. 3.  Submit completed document. You really do not need an appointment as the completed papers can be send by post or can be delivered in person at their reception. Offices are in good location (Holborn) which can be easily accessed by London Underground.  My ratings are 5 stars for Tier-1 extension and 4 stars for ILR.

Perhaps if I had taken matters into my own hands I could have dealt with it faster. Also, when I contacted the office requesting to speak to my consultant who was handling my case, the woman answering the call was quite rude and rather patronising telling me  'do you not know the problems with the UKBA?' yes, actually I am well informed but I want to know if there is anything else that can be done to expedite my case as I needed my documents and, bottom line, I wanted to speak to my consultant.  She didnt have to tell me things I already knew. All in all, I feel that I might have managed it better myself rather than paying yourselves to handle my application.

records.title: Not Happy ..will not recommend
records.text: I approached First Migration by a reference and was given a huge assurance of a same day service date within the next working week. Beware they take the payment right away. After a couple fo days they came up with some story that the home office has moved the goal post ..blah blah and did not give me a date until  after abot 40 days since I originally contacted them. by this time you cant back off as you haven paid all teh money upfront and they would give a penny back. I would have applied thorugh post and got the visa!!!. Just a waste of time and also costed me a fortune. Unknowingly I dragged my freind as well and he got even worse experience. They also offer you a referral bonus which you only get after chasing them a hundered times. Would not recommend any one who has all paper work in place. Go direct..or by Post

records.title: Not worth the money. Rude and not professional.
records.text: I received an email from first migration asking me to review them on Trust Pilot about 6 months after I used them for my visa application. I had a very bad experience with them but wasn't planning to review them because I had nothing good to say about them. When I received their email though, I wrongly thought that they are truly looking for constructive criticism to improve their services. I wrote a review reflecting the experience I had only to receive an email a few days later with a reply that is full of lies and unprofessional accusations. I was truly shocked at how unprofessional they were dealing with my review, given that they were the ones asking for it in the first place. I have then added a comment to their very poor reply because trustPilot interface doesn't have a REPLY feature to business replies. Below is my first review, you can then read their reply underneath and my comment on their reply by clicking on (COMMENTS) under this post. Thank you.--------------------------------------------------- I have used First Migration twice. The first time round there was  an acceptable level of service at a reasonable fee. I have even recommended them to some friends and got them business. The second time however after 2 years I was hugely disappointed at the service and the attitude. After I made the payment I kept emailing and calling to arrange for meetings but the response was too slow despite the fact that my appointment was coming closer. I had initially arranged for a meeting with the person managing my case to meet in 2 weeks time but then was surprised that he just "went on holiday". I was instructed to call the office to arrange for a meeting with someone else and kept getting voice mail. When the person finally appeared and came back from the holiday, he handled the case very poorly, and extremely rudely. I ended up with a hurried and hostile meeting in the corridors of the office, looking through a number of mistakes that they have done to my application and correcting them one by one. I honestly would have been better off handling the paper work myself and not having to pay a considerable fee (£800) for such a service. I got my visa accepted because of my hard work and attention to detail, but I am sorry to say that Fitst Migration had no credit in this. I was planning to recommend them again to 2 of my friends who had appointments a month after me but after what I have seen, I advised my friends to look for another service providers. They did and got a much better application for only £600 and also got their visas approved but without having to waste their time correcting mistakes and being treated rudely.

records.title: BIG WARNING BiG WARNING
records.text: BIG WARNING! BIG WARNING! BIG WARNING!First Migration are not solicitors. I totally admit I was a fool to believe they were solicitors. In my case, First Migration let a third party, get involved in my matter by letting this person, the partner of the father "request conditions" in order to get the father to give his signature, his consent, to his own child becoming a British citizen. The father had looked after his son all his life.First Migration then delivers this ”conditions” to me which was a person who should not have been involved. Who else could be involved in my matter, I wondered? A solicitor wouldnt allow such thing. A solicitor works for you, as you are the person who is paying. My child didn't want to see his father conditioned, not by him, but by the third party, the partner, who First Migration communicated with on my expense. I found that upsetting, that anyone, a third party, can request conditions about my sons future. There were no way my son wanted to see his father and get a signature under this woman conditions, what could they be? Anything. We didn't get any signature from the father as my son refused to see them under this conditions of "requests".I withdrew my request for advice in this matter and my childs. After hard negotiations I got my part back but lost all the prepaid fee for my child. The reply below by Mr Morgan says its all; Someone who can't admit he made an mistake talking to a third party; like "you decided to email your former partner and upset him so much that his new partner felt obliged to call First Migration on his behalf as he was so angry he could not speak to us personally." This is not true at all. It was his partner who demanded power over the case. If First Migration haven't let her, it could all have been fine. The email was not upsetting. I have proof. I mailed the father to ask and remind him again in a friendly way, to sign his own sons application. It was a simple question. Instead the wife who has damaged the relationship between the father and his son interfered.  She had no right to do so and if First Migration were solicitors they wouldn't have let her. Again I was a fool to believe they were. Listen to what I say. This agency are taking advantage of your frail situation and do not care about you, as a solicitor would do who follows the law.Hire a solicitor who cares for you and knows the law. It is the same price. First Migration claims I have lied and they are accusing me of false accusations. It is bizarre.  ALSO First Migration asked for an extreme amount of documents, which I spend DAYS to collect, which I found out later through a solicitor, was not at all needed. First Migration didn't even begin my Childs application, nor mine to the home office. But kept half of the fee. For nothing. Get a real solicitor for your case!

description:
Bishopsgate Law is a firm of solicitors with offices in London, Hertfordshire and Northampton, and a national client base.


  We started in 2016 and aim to provide cost-effective, high-quality services while managing to be thoughtful and attentive. 

 We are proud to have more than seventy qualified lawyers and over one hundred and fifty talented staff working in three main areas: 


  • Property Law – including residential conveyancing, commercial property, lease extensions, enfranchisement, property disputes, construction and more. 


  • Wills & Probate  – providing executor services, bespoke wills, lasting power of attorney, estate planning, and more. 


   • Business & Employment  – working with employers or employees, advising on and drafting settlement agreements, working on disputes between businesses, and more. 


 We are regulated by the SRA and have achieved the Law Society's Conveyancing Quality Scheme accreditation. While we take feedback very seriously, we will only be moved to act by fair and accurate criticism or praise. We take pride in giving a great service and genuinely care about the lives of our clients.

records.title: Experience started off really well with…
records.text: Experience started off really well with the first property we were looking to purchase, prompt responses, kept well informed and overall great service. This property fell through. The next property, which we completed on, was not a great experience. Having to chase for updates, communication had significantly dropped compared to the first property. My reasoning for the 3 star is that we were advised our property did not qualify for the HTB ISA bonus and that we needed to seek around £3000 of funds elsewhere. Lucky that I pushed back on this as it was due to human error keying the request for the bonus on our solicitors side and we were in fact eligible for the bonus. There was a stressful few days where we didn't know if we were going to have the funds to complete and if we hadn't of pushed back we would of lost out in almost £3000. I appreciate human error happens but I should not have been misinformed before the matter was looked in to properly, rather than just presuming we don't qualify. If a website gives you an error message or doesn't complete the action you shouldn't presume and then give your customers incorrect advice off the back of that without giving some care or thought. Once feedback was raised they were very quick to reach out and apologise for the errors. Appreciate the quick response.

records.title: Honest feedback
records.text: Thanks to the team at Bishopsgate for helping us navigate our first property purchase. James and Jayden were very communicative and responsive, which is not always the case with solicitors, so this was greatly appreciated and made us feel heard throughout the process. Our initial point of contact did however go on maternity leave without notifying us, which was unhelpful and caused a slight delay in overall comms. I would say that the report that we received concerning the property did leave a fair bit to be desired, feeling pretty generic and not specific enough to our property to be of significant value. It did also take a very long time to receive any information back, as they were waiting to receive all information before passing any on. We would have preferred to receive things as they were available - rather than hundreds of pages at once, in no structured order. There could be improvements to the process and we would have appreciated more advice as it did feel like Bishopsgate were the messengers and we had to decipher everything and flag concerns ourselves, rather than them spotting and providing this. Overall, we definitely really appreciate all the swift responses to all our correspondence, as I’ve had friends who have been ignored via email and phone and have had to resort to going to solicitors offices - therefore the value of prompt responses cannot be understated.  I would use Bishopsgate again because they do get things done, but would do so in the knowledge that I need to be thorough and meticulous.

records.title: The team were knowledgeable and very…
records.text: The team were knowledgeable and very helpful. Explained and answered all my queries and kept me updated at each stage.

records.text: I had a good experience with Claire and Yana as a first-time buyer.
