records.text: Shanice was great however I never received a call back on the time slot from the solicitors eventhough I had that I had evidence to make a strong claim. I later had a phone call and have been advised to complain to the hospital before taking legal action

records.title: Emily was very nice and understanding…
records.text: Emily was very nice and understanding on the phone however forgot to mention when passing me to a solicitor there was a £400 fee for medical records to be assessed, which was disappointing. Sadly feel as if I wasted 30 minutes.

records.title: Meh wouldn’t use for smaller claims
records.text: Had good hopes but just like their adverts their frustrating, Quick enough to call but quick enough to hang up when your claim isn’t going to make them enough money. Speak 100MPH on the phone to rush through to get their numbers up.

records.title: A very good idea
records.text: A very good idea, and full points for innovation, but it is not really as effective and as helpful as they hoped that it would have worked

records.title: Standard call and customer service as…
records.text: Standard call and customer service as it should be. The person I spoke to respond accordingly.

records.title: The advisor said that I had a case
records.text: The advisor said that I had a case, they passed me to a solicitor and she said that I did not have a claim.Waste of time

records.title: Felt comfortable talking to the caller…
records.text: Felt comfortable talking to the caller and there was good communication and she was very helpful.

records.title: Call about a fall I had
records.text: She was patient as it wasn't easy to explain. She had a problem about where my fall happened. It was right on the edge of the road where the road meets the pavement.

records.title: As a whole what I have been passed over to
records.text: True solicitors can't fault them. The solicitors scott rees. Sent document through to sign. Whilst I was in the process of getting document together. They called and stated that they can't do the claim. I am being forwarded on for operation and operational proceedures, I have had one last month, recieved a appointment for another unexpectedly next month during this short process and awaiting for another from a appointment at the end of last week. Don't seem to have the patience or compassion needed.

records.title: Just beware these are a broker and I…
records.text: Just beware these are a broker and I wasn't aware the solicitor they put me onto had really poor reviews online so I have opted to go else where. Although the adviser was helpful they didn't really put me onto 'the best' solicitors.

records.title: Mrs Shelley J Hodges
records.text: Hello I found Florence very helpful, however the follow up has been quite unsatisfactory, as I said that I finished work at 4pm and I was called two minutes passed which was fine, but I work in hospitality so may not necessarily finish on time, then left me text messages, to which I can't respond, also the net work my phone is with, will not let me phone the number I have been given.

records.title: ok but not the best
records.text: it was easy to do but they asked for a time to call and then called 10 minutes after i had filled in the form. why ask for the best time to call and then call anyway.the lady was very abrupt on the phone not what i expected. i was not impressed.

records.title: I left home on Saturday at around 1pm…
records.text: I left home on Saturday at around 1pm meeting with my daughter in Lewisham. I had only gotten to Lewisham College just down from my house when I tripped over a paving stone that was raised about an inch and a half  I went down on the left side of my head  as you can see in the pictures attached. I damaged my spectacles when I fell (my favourites no less) which I have had to put in the Optician to the cost of  £192:98receipt enclosed  I've also fractured my right thumb  and damaged my front tooth (right) I go to  get my thumb plastered on the 8th June 2022 I have complained to Lewisham Council in the past when I tripped before but they only repair just the paving stones that caused the fall 5

records.title: Initially the call taker was brilliant…
records.text: Initially the call taker was brilliant and told us that she thought we had a claim , however no one from the firm they sent our details to contacted us . We have tried to ring them but there is no answer . We are only searching solicitor as we don’t know where else to turn to , my father is very poorly and no one is helping us to find out what’s wrong

records.title: I was told i would get a further call…
records.text: I was told i would get a further call following my second call, but it wasn't received,(and I didn't have any miss calls), then I receive a letter in the post, that seemed to confirm information that would have been received in the third phone call that I didn't receive! I feel I should have received the service that Michael said would happen, but he was polite on the phone.

records.title: Lauren was very helpful please take and…
records.text: Lauren was very helpful pleasant  and polite, couldn’t fault anything straight to the point and tried and went to the right people to chase up. After recognising I was just left. Only person who offered me a drink in 3 hours of being there after being told I would be left by half 2 by a sales man James.

records.title: I found Faye polite and friendly
records.text: I found Faye polite and friendly, however I found it difficult to interrupt her on many occasions to ask her to slow down with her speech and information. In the end I had to pass the phone to my daughter to try to gain some control over the conversation. My daughter had to be very firm in asking Faye to slow down and listen.Thank you for your kind attention.

records.title: Caring and compassionate.
records.text: Caring and compassionate.Fantastic service throughout initial contact and was absolutely impressed. I was fully briefed on how my case would progress and Margaret listened and noted all my concerns . A solicitor was nominated and a solicitor contacted me by text to say they would be in contact 'very soon'. However, although my initial contact was beyond reproach this all occurred on the 16th December 2019.....and I'm still waiting for the solicitor to actually contact me!

records.title: This is just a lead generation service…
records.text: This is just a lead generation service don't be fooled by the 5 star reviews. People are just rating the well spoken telephone agent at First4Lawyers. I was transferred to another solicitor with subpar reviews.

records.title: Don't do landlord disputes yet website shows that they do
records.text: Website shows that they do landlord disputes, but after receiving a confirmation text and then a call and then being on hold for some time in hopeful anticipation that I can finally get support, they concluded that they couldn't help.

records.title: Pointless at the point it matters
records.text: First4lawyers themselves:Friendly, empathic, fast service. Enquiry dealt with by agent extremely compassionately.However, the legal firm (and in particular the solicitor) they sourced to, was dire - completely the opposite to F4L’s warm approach. NOT a positive experience - not empathic, cold, uninterested and unprofessional.

records.title: Called concerning  G.P medical…
records.text: Called concerning  G.P medical negligence.  Explained situation to first4lawyers, also explained  I have no other way of sending documents other than post. " don't worry there's  a link you can press to access  postal info, also our solicitors will be in touch within the next 24 hrs" ....NO LINK ON EMAIL CONTAINING POSTAL ADDRESS, NO CALL BACK FROM ANYONE.......DOESN'T  BODE WELL. , NOR MUCH FAITH......UPDATE! FIRST4LAWYERS say they got in touch that same day, as I'm virtually  housebound I can say without doubt THEY HAVE NOT CONTACTED ME AT ALL IN ANYWAY SHAPE OR FORM .

records.title: This is a review for First4lawyers.
records.text: Edited - I was asked to leave a review after talking to the First4lawyers front line who answer the phone, which I did, and left a 5 start for the person who took the call and was very helpful and professional. However, it seems that First4lawyers use that as a review for their work.I did eventually get a call back from them and they couldn't take my case because they recovered compensation would be too small.

records.title: First Encounter
records.text: People were very friendly and they speak with excellent understandable accent.  However, something needs improvement is that I told the first person all my details but then I had to repeat them again to the second person.  Also, I had to repeat the focal point that I liked my claim to be emphasized on.

records.title: Abit disappointed
records.text: Woman from this company first 4 lawyers was nice and stated i would get the help. Days later Stephensons who they passed me to states they can't help me due to the amount of money it would be worth, "they wont benefit from the little commission they would receive (too low) So all about money which is no surprise. And this problem which was caused could of lost my baby. So im very disappointed

records.title: I spent a lot of time describing my…
records.text: I spent a lot of time describing my complaint to Jacob. He told me that I would be telephoned that day or the following orning by a solicitor. A female solicitor telephoned the following day at 10 a.m., wishing to taalk. It was agreed she would phone back at 4 p.m.. She did not do this and I have heard nothing since. It is hard to see that this firm would offer a professional efficient service.

records.title: Efficient and professional service lawyers let it down
records.text: I was really happy with the service provided. The assistant was very helpful knowledgable and tactful in her questioning. Her actions were prompt and she knew exactly what she was doing.😳😱😡shockingly the lawyers have never bothered ringing back. So I had to reduced my Rating from 5 stars to 2. Shame on the lawyers after such hard work by the clerk!!!!

records.title: Wouldn't recommend
records.text: Was told I have a claim but when put through to one of their solicitors they told me the wrong dates that they was passed on and didn't have a claim. If their staff took the original information correctly and passed it on correctly then maybe would of saved everyone's time. Maybe they do and I just had the small percentage of wrongly passed info. In the future it be more efficient to find a lawyer myself then going through agents.

description:
Optima Legal
We are a specialist property law firm. For 30 years, we’ve worked in partnership with the UK’s financial services sector, enabling them to support over 4 million customers through a comprehensive range of legal services including remortgage services and later life lending.

records.title: Optima made everything easy,fantastic…
records.text: Optima made everything easy,fantastic communication at every stage.They were extremely efficient and a very fast service about 1 month from start to finish a very refreshing change to the way things seem to be these days I would recommend them to anybody.Thank youNigel and Mandy Shelley

records.title: Great service from start to finish
records.text: From start to finish the service was exceptional. All communication was clearly laid out and I was able to completely self service from start to finish. I completed when I wanted to and there were no unnecessary delays. I would highly recommend them.

records.title: Highly recommended
records.text: From start to finish Optima Legal have communicated brilliant, through calls, emails, text and the online tracker. It’s been the right amount to point us in the right direction and re assure that they have everything under control for our remortgage process.

records.title: Amazing from start to finish
records.text: Amazing from start to finish, easy to use website and great communication. Took all the stress of my partner and I. Everything went smoothly, couldn’t be happier with the outcome and service, 10000% recommend!

records.title: Thank you!!!!!
records.text: The team are very patient and tried several times to reach me to update me on what actions required immediate response. I was update regularly to advise me on what to do. I was reassured that the completion would be done at the time my current mortgage expires which was what I worried about. I cannot remember the date but this was my experience throughout the process.

records.title: Best Service
records.text: I would like to thank Optima Legal and its management for the best support while remortgaging our property.  Your staff are the best advisors and keep it up the good job. I will definitely recommend Optima Legal, Happy New Year in advace

records.title: Professional and efficient
records.text: They were very efficient and professional. They made the process easy without the need to visit any office. From the commodity of your home, they made everything possible, quick and easy.

records.title: A Great Experience
records.text: It was a great experience. Everything went well, from being informed at every stage of my remortgage to its completion. Thank you for a seamless service.

records.title: Straightforward and efficient remortgage
records.text: Optima legal handled my remortgage swiftly and efficiently. The online portal was easy to use and communication was excellent. I would use them again.

records.title: Customer service at Christmas I have to say really excellent service…
records.text: I have to say really excellent service and I was really surprised that 2 people took the time to call me on Christmas Eve and pushed my completion date through to the end of the year. I would definitely recommend

records.title: Helpful staff if you call
records.text: Very helpful staff if you called never email as you don't get a response. If no one available to talk to I did get a call back a few days later. I even had a call on 23rd December to confirm completion. Helpful over the phone to explain anything I didn't understand. Did take 2 months to complete remortgage however it took a few weeks to realise redemption statement needed to be partners name, as system just does things automatically. Once that was sorted everything went through fast. They are a busy online solicitors and there are lots of bad reviews but I found them good

records.title: Quick, simple and easy!We found the process quick and…
records.text: We found the process quick and efficient. The online portal meant we didn’t have to deal with anyone personally which I know for some is essential but for us it worked perfectly. My husband is a shift worker so being able to do everything online was a requirement. Thank you Optima! The whole process was a breeze.

records.title: re mortgage with equity transfer
records.text: It was pretty easy to get through my re-mortgage with equity transfer. I won't give 5 stars just because sometimes it was a bit fiddly to upload some documents which were not on the standard list. Apart from that everything was great, recommend their services.

records.title: Very good experience
records.text: My personal experience of Optima Legal was very good. Dan, in particular, kept in touch and updated me on my case. I was very grateful. Thanks

records.title: Fast in processing the mortgage but all…
records.text: Fast in processing the mortgage but all seems automated. I asked questions on the portal, didn't get a reply until the process was almost over and still didn't get an answer to my question

records.title: Over all a very good service and the…
records.text: Over all a very good service and the portal was very easy to use. The only down fall was when I received 2 separate phone calls from a random number from unknown members of staff expecting me to give personal details and answer security questions over the phone when I had no idea who they were, they they seemed to get annoyed when I was reluctant to give my personal details..as to me they could have been anyone. That didn’t sit right with me. Apart from that no complaints and all was transferred very smoothly.

records.title: My re-mortgage
records.text: My re-mortgage was complete very smoothly without any issue. The only issue i came across is that is very difficult to get them on the phone unless you are very patient. Apart from that very good, well done!

records.title: Overall was good enough but could if…
records.text: Overall was good enough but could if been better. Would of been nice to be able to speak to someone rather than emails and messages on the portal. Also identifying a telephone to return calls would of been really useful.Overall the mortgage went through and that is all that matters

records.title: Optical  Legal
records.text: Optical  Legal.  Is sometimes  very straight forward and easy to Update your portal .  But I found it  difficult to get through to anyone on the phone which would have made things so much better and easier.Unfortunately on one of my mortgages  I gave up and decided not to proceed with the mortgage with  optical Legal,  as it became to complicated to awnser the questions without speaking to a person. Next time I will  try to find a local broker rather than doing everything online .

records.title: Overall Good Experience
records.text: Overall they were very good, except the one time we had to call and it literally took the whole morning just to get through to someone.

records.title: Your agents were really helpful and…
records.text: Your agents were really helpful and talked me through with uploading to the portal - lovely helpful polite staff What was not good was me having to ring and chase up about six times as the relationship between the Nat west offset team and yourselves was not effective,  getting the redemption statement t sent too early thus we had to do this a few times,   So the technicalities were disjointed and lengthy. But your agents were really lovely.   I will recommend you

records.title: They were great with remortgage
records.text: They were great with remortgage. Easy website and swift communication.Phone line has an issue where the automated system would not understand the postcode to verify yourself, but stick to it and it will eventually transfer you to an agent

records.title: In general not too bad
records.text: In general not too bad experience. My bank got my address wrong so this had to be sorted, plus I feel like there was not enough support regarding attaching required documents. But once I managed to get in touch, everything went smoothly. Lots of updates by email and sms messages.

records.title: All sorted
records.text: Mortgage broker initially done the first contact then after that virtually every thing was online , but did have to get broker to phone solicitor a few times to confirm issues , also our old mortgage deal amount was requested to early thus they wanted to charge us for leaving old contract early .Then we got charged £14 a day for delaying our new mortgage until the date out old one finished .

records.title: Optima Legal we're very good
records.text: Optima Legal we're very good. Once I had got to grips with using the Portal, things moved along at a steady pace.Whenever I spoke with my Case Manager or other members of staff they were extremely helpful and professional, answering all my questions, providing help and guidance throughout.Thankyou.Best Regards John Bouskill

records.title: Everything has been done and remortgage…
records.text: Everything has been done and remortgage completed. Portal system works well. Seemed to get asked for the same stuff by different people so could probably be more efficient. At the end of the day what do I know about conveyancing ? Nothing, and optima legal have completed our remortgage entirely online from our perspective.

records.title: A very easy to use online service with…
records.text: A very easy to use online service with an easy to navigate account portal. My remortgage went smoothly with no issues at all.One comment for improvement, the online email proforma system is a little tricky and could do with some finessing. Just having the ability to send a plain email rather than selecting a template which sends without any content being added would be useful.

records.title: Really not as bad as made out.
records.text: Saw a lot of negative reviews when HSBC made me use Optima but honestly, it wasn't bad at all. The online portal is honestly, such an obvious thing that not many solicitors do. Made seeing what I needed to do a lot easier. The communication wasn't great. I'd send a message through the portal but never actually hear back so had to ring quite a few times but the person on the phone was always helpful. It took a bit longer than expected but I think that was more down to the bank than Optima themselves though they did seem to forget to pass messages on or ring back when they said they would. All in all, if I had to use them again, I wouldn't mind.

records.title: Online system that works
records.text: The service is designed to keep the client updated at all times with prompts to action when any task needs doing. Room for improvements in uploading document process which, atleast in my case, did not always go smoothly.

records.title: Our mortgage provider selected Optima
records.text: Our mortgage provider selected Optima, but if I had a choice I'd have no problem using them again. Overall everything went smoothly and it was pretty easy to use the online portal etc.

records.title: Not the worst but not the best
records.text: Portal pretty good and easy to use. Process stalled with no explanation around two weeks before my current mortgage was due to expire. Financial advisor chased but was told he’d receive a call back within 48 hours which never came. He then had to chase again until eventually we got a call back with less than a week to go and things started moving again. Caused unnecessary anxiety considering I started the process 4 months in advance. Overall okay.

records.title: Really dislike the online system
records.text: Really dislike the online system, its difficult was hard to navigate and you get no instruction. I’m a young intelligent woman and the whole process left me anxious not knowing if things were correct & no guidance. The telephone team helped but I had no set solicitor to contact and discuss my re mortgage, it was always a different person. This is my 3rd time going through this sort of process and I will revert back to my original solicitors in the future.

records.title: Fair service
records.text: There were few issuesBut took 5 and half month for remortgage That is too long .I paid variable rate for 5 months.Because of some delay to check the provided documents. After calling they were checking.

records.title: The service was slow.
records.text: The service was slow. It took longer than I expected to complete the remortgage process.It is difficult to get through to  the solicitors on phone.I never received any communication directly  from my named solicitor not even an introduction email.

records.title: Good until you need to speak to someone.
records.text: Great until you have questions. I needed to speak to someone. The phone system is painful to navigate. You then end up speaking to someone who call themselves a receptionist. Useless. They have no access to your account but insist on asking lots of questions but have no info to help. They then direct you back to the website. Only after complaining did they concede they could put me through to someone. That involved going back into the automated security clearance. Also painful. Eventually the help was given, and it was good, but I had to fight to get it.

records.title: Portal not great, telephone team saves the day
records.text: There's no real communication via the portal, and you have to phone in for any queries, which isn't always convenient (phone team was great though :) Other portals have a messaging centre where you can at least drop a text message and later on read the response (e.g. evenings after work). Also there was some broken functionality on the portal (sorry, can't remember exactly what).

records.title: Optima legal is a mixed bag
records.text: Optima legal is a mixed bag. Scores highly for getting the job underway but pray that your case doesn't have to be looked at by a senior team member because will take 2 weeks. The other irritating aspect is that I had to email three times before receiving answers on two separate occasions.

records.title: Slow
records.text: Difficult to discuss anything over the phone. Online portal is ok till you have an issue. They delayed the completion, coting me 18 days of high mortgage rates.

records.title: Adequate
records.text: The building society paid so can’t complain about the cost.But you will not be able to speak to someone working on the case (at least I couldn’t) and so you rely on the message portal which is slow and a conversation would make things a lot quicker. The phone people are ok but don’t know details.Also asking for totally unachievable dates for redemption statements is just a basic process flaw. Again it adds time (and interest cost for a remortgage). The time to check a repayment shortfall was unreal.

records.title: Difficult to get in touch
records.text: I found it very difficult to get through to someone, with long waits of 30-60 minutes to speak to someone, I also found mixed responses in how helpful the people that I spoke to were.

records.title: Dificult to connect to portal due to web security issues
records.text: My internet provider TalkTalk would not allow connection to the portal. The only way I could gain access was to turn off all internet securiity. This is very worrying when dealing with large sums of money while re-mortgaging.There is also no facility to be able to talk to a person if your question does not fit there standard answers or if you cannot supply a document

records.title: At points I would have given them 0.
records.text: At points I would have given them 0.By the end I would have given them 100 because of getting the mortgage completion done on time and the relief I felt (I'm doing this remortgage for the first time and on my own so the panic was real)There was a lot of time in between actions on the tracker that nothing was happening...every time I ticked one thing off the tracker on the portal, something else popped up and it felt like it was never going to complete on time. If all those things need to be completed, then have EVERYTHING up from the start.I kept emailing them (they tell you to email for the important stuff only - this is over £100,000 we are talking about. IT'S IMPORTANT.) and their replies were a bit vague, not reassuring really and took days to get a reply.However, the mortgage did complete on time and everything was ok but whilst I was waiting, it felt like eternity. I went from a Natwest mortgage to a Halifax one but it looks like many banks use them.Keep the faith but this is a lot of money so please keep contacting them if you feel you need to.

records.title: Dreadful customer service. Taking our money.
records.text: Pleased to say that Optima Legal changed the completion date since posting this - thank you. Original post is below--------We returned all of our documentation on 9th January and requested a completion date of 1st February. They asked us to complete in January but we said no due to early exit fees. We have just been informed today that we won't be completing until 2nd February and we need to pay £300 in daily interest fees. We've complained and are awaiting a call back but there seems to be no urgency or attempt from them to resolve this swiftly or fairly. Very disappointed.

records.title: Everything was going well until a…
records.text: Everything was going well until a request was made for Redemption Statement. The request was never followed up by Optima from my existing lenders. The only times they did was when I called. This delayed my completion date by two weeks, costing me extra charges from my existing lenders because I was on SVR.

records.title: Mortgage completion process was clunky…
records.text: Mortgage completion process was clunky in places and felt close to falling apart at times due to a lack of dedicated person dealing with our case. Every day costing us more during cost of living crisis. BUT got us over the line with a helping hand in the end 'ie hours of phone calls etc'. HSBC - not your finest moment.

records.title: Not user friendly
records.text: They asked for lots of documents they already had and at one point tried to get us to do an unneccesary and costly change of ownership with the land registry. The portal is only useful if the exact process you need to do is there. Uploading documents they have requested that are not on the drop down menu means they get misfiled and optima assume they dont have them. The only good things about the process were Abi and Rebecca who were both super helpful and untangled the mess made by their colleagues and the portal.

records.title: Average service.
records.text: They are a high volume service - they’ll do it in their own time. Although I did find picking the phone and speaking to someone not too painful. They were actually polite and helpful, couldn’t really help with time frames to complete but were never rude.They missed that a shortfall was on the account and it delayed the remortgage after they received the initial application some 5 months ago. Let’s just hope their diligence is better for more complicated situations.

records.title: Clever portal system but they are slow…
records.text: Clever portal system but they are slow to respond to queried and struggled with anything out of the ordinary for which there was no standardised process. They can only be used for the most straight forward of transactions.

records.title: Mixed feelings due to a specific process differences with lender
records.text: Overall I found the online portal useful. However, they did have a different process with our old lender and I found that some employees were not well trained for it. It required a lot of pushing on my end. Once the process was following the standard steps the experience was good.

records.title: A bit frustrating but a good service overall
records.text: If it wasn’t for them being very pedantic about requiring certain information without being clear as to why then I would have given a higher rating. This led to some last minute stress and frustration. However the online portal is very good and works well. Plus they did keep me informed along the way.

records.title: Poor interaction
records.text: Good online portal. Terrible at listening, terrible at customer service. Sent a message setting the completion date and they kept replying with different dates. I replied to each message. I reiterated the date we wanted and asked if they understand. They kept replying with a different date. Either they didn’t read my messages, or their message system doesn’t work or they are incompetent. A terrible service. Likewise to other reviews, I did not appoint them for my remortgage. Lesson firmly learnt and in future, I will check which legal company the mortgage lender uses and I will be highly unlikely to use any lender that uses Optima Legal.

records.title: Poor communication
records.text: Poor communication, took weeks to get main people to review anything.Did their job but at their complete leisure.

records.title: Awful customer service!
records.text: Awful customer service!! When they claim they try to call either of us as soon as we answer even on one ring they put the phone down. Getting through to them is ridiculously bad waiting 20 minutes at times but then having to give up. Was supposed to have sent important documents in the post twice that never turned up, the one time i did speakto somebody about the post something they actually had to ask another person if they would be allowed to send something by recorded delivery to ensure if arrived, which obviously they couldn't as it never turned up. If you posted something online you couldn't upload more than one document at once you had to do them separately and never once got confirmation of being received at the time. If I was ever asked if Optima were helpful I would say definitely not! I gave them 2 as eventually the remortgage got done!!

records.title: Long wait times, slow response times
records.text: Long wait times, when submitting forms through their very fancy portal, for someone to review and action what was submitted.  Also impossible to get telephone support after long wait times and never getting through to someone who can actually help

records.title: Portal isn't up to standard as it…
records.text: Portal isn't up to standard as it doesn't have sections to be able to upload the information.Although we uploaded the right information there were delays due to incorrect filing of information.Although I did chase the problems nothing was done until I asked my broker to find out why it was delayed.I ended up losing a couple of investment deals due to the wait of the money.

records.title: Be prepared to do a lot of chasing!
records.text: Be prepared to do a lot of chasing!Dates given for paperwork needed were incorrect, no proactive call backs to myself, spent hours on the phone ensuring I didn’t get additional charges. Two stars as Pippa and James were great and did ensure deadline was met.

records.title: Slow from start to finish
records.text: Slow processCase opened in July, mortgage expires end of October and then takes to mid December to complete- - - -Slowness has now been underlined given thier response to my review over 28 days ago.I will also add that their reply referenced a complex case; yet I was receiving letters about early repayment charges mid November when it already expired perhaps examples like this add to their own complexity - poor!

records.title: Delayed process
records.text: There was some gap between the lender and Optima which delayed the process over a month and I had to keep chasing for an update multiple times over the calls/emails etc., Surely this situation could have been handled in a better way rather than the customer chasing them indefinitely. Ofcourse the process was completed just on time after chasing multiple times but it could have been completed much earlier.

records.title: Optima Legal too much relaince on an automated service…
records.text: Optima Legal rely too much on autogenerated tasks and answers. They ignore time critical emails and answers in emails do not answer the questions raised. Miraculously my remortgage went through on the correct day but their failure to confirm receipt of funds I had sent them and the portal still showing that they were needed made me wonder if I would have to pay the money twice in order for the mortgage to complete on time.

records.title: Far to long for Transfer of equity
records.text: Simple transfer of equity which is staking far too long. Documents sent on the 10/06 from my solicitors. Optima have acknowledged that this has breached there SLAs Ignoring my emails and escalations. So frustrated - I just need a an estimated completion date!

description:
Graysons is a Sheffield, Hathersage & Chesterfield based solicitors specialising in wills & lifetime planning, probate & estate administration, property, family, personal injury, occupational illness and medical negligence.

Based in Sheffield since 1925, Graysons Solicitors is one of South Yorkshire’s most established and respected Solicitors. Through its vibrant and progressive team of dedicated legal professionals—including six highly experienced partners—the law firm has built a reputation for providing expertly tailored legal advice. The firm’s Lexcel accreditation—the Law Society’s quality mark—is testimony to its excellent standards of management and quality of service.

Graysons is recommended in the Legal 500 2023 for its work in the areas of family, personal injury, private client and medical negligence.
We are here to help you with a range of high quality legal services, including:

Personal injury
Medical negligence
Occupational illness and injury
Property matters
Divorce and separation
Children matters
Domestic violence
Wills, trusts & inheritance tax planning
Probate and administration of estates
Powers of attorney
