Grayson's representative (Will writer) came to the house, and was professional and polite.The fee was not the cheapest but it's all about how well a Will is written that is of paramount importance.Many thanks to all.I would highly recommend this company (Grayson's) rather than an online Will writing company.

records.title: Graysons (Sheffield office)
records.text: It has been a very difficult year for our family losing both of our parents to Covid. Graysons helped us to navigate the probate process and the sale of our late parents' house. For this we are very grateful to Ellie (Probate) and Lacey (Conveyancing) for persevering, though all of the Covid-related challenges and seeing the jobs done. Thank you both very much. Alan D. (Sheffield)

records.title: Process a little slow
records.text: The process involved a sale only, on a deceased estate, no chain. The process of five months seemed excessively long to completion. There were no great issues that would have delayed the process to my knowledge. Most of the process, contact and form filling done online. The enquiries form appeared to have issues with uploading more than one document in any one section, or accept it may have been user error (me). Additional instructions might have helped. Towards end of completion it felt comforting to finally communicate by speaking with someone, who was helpful and well informed.

records.title: I got the house!
records.text: Well I bought my house so the outcome was positive! Just felt like the customer touch was lost -emails would be very prompt when they needed me, but some emails and phone messages from me went unanswered. Can’t imagine it’s a very different service to any other conveyancer.

records.title: A very professional approach
records.text: A very professional approach, Shona Gore was well briefed and able to answer all the relevant questions and provide good advice.My one criticism is the cost, £500 for a half hour meeting and a very small change to two wills seems excessive.

records.title: Overall my experience with Greysons…
records.text: Overall my experience with Greysons solicitors has been brilliant. Everyone I dealt with was extremely professional, knowledgeable and understanding. Some correspondence was delayed for various reasons and I did have to do a lot of chasing for results, but everything was explained fully, with reasons as to why there were delays, Jess was amazing for, start to finish, and I am extremely grateful for all her help along the way. I would recommend Greysons to anyone in the future. And know that if I need it I will be using them again for legal services.

records.title: Review
records.text: Very good service but would have been better if could have weekend appointments so we do not have to take time off work. Also thought staff could be more professionally dressed at times

records.title: Darren Purdham
records.text: I had a work accident just over a year ago and Joshua Davies took on my claim. Over the past year he has been very helpful always there if I needed to speak to him very professional and I would recommend graysons solicitor's to anyone who needs help.

records.title: They delt with me very well and very…
records.text: They delt with me very well and very fairly helped me through my case especially Robert Burton who took on my case from my work injury I suffered from. Love the support and advice I had from him this is a very good solicitor firm I recommend Anyone only downfall I have is the percentage they take after you win a case but it is what it is apart from that would use these guys again

records.title: We placed our house sale and purchase with Graysons….…
records.text: We placed our house sale and purchase in the hands of Graysons. They completed the process and in the main did a professional job. There were occasions when communication might have been better but in the main our experience was positive.

records.title: Injury claim
records.text: I found my experience of Graysons Solicitors to be very good overall . The time scale of my claim wasn't helped by the Covid situation , a lot of staff were working from home , or out of office for whatever reason , but was resolved in the end !

records.title: Carol and Laura was lovely to deal with…
records.text: Carol and Laura was lovely to deal with , kept me well informed of every step , made sure all searches was completed and every detail found,  would recommend to family and friends

records.title: Claire Chapman is an absolute delight…
records.text: Claire Chapman is an absolute delight to work with. Meriet knows her stuff. As a team, they have consistently delivered a great service to my company.

records.title: Good services at Graysons
records.text: We worked with Caroline and Robyn and the service from Graysons was good, they were knowledgeable, highly professional, and tactful in their operations. We would have appreciated more frequent updates and feedback, during the lengthy process of completing our purchase. We would recommend their services.

records.title: There when I needed them and always…
records.text: There when I needed them and always happy to talk me through the progress made even through the Covid restrictions. Happy with the service but a little expensive but you pay for what you get they say.

records.title: Graysonn's provided an excellent…
records.text: Graysonn's provided an excellent service even though I'm not presently in the country. Their method of communication was explicit and made it convenient to get all paperwork signed and submitted. Thank you especially to Bridie and Philippa for their continuous efforts.

records.title: The experience was fine
records.text: The experience was fine. Our only complaint was the misspelling of my husband's name on documents more than once!!

records.title: Frustrating lack of response to emails and increasingly urgent enquiries
records.text: Graysons did the conveyancing for my house purchase.The most disappointing and frustrating thing was that they simply never, never answered an email. I wanted to respect their time by not picking up the phone so sent them clear, short email messages close to the expected completion window asking them to set up a client account so that I could transfer the whole purchase price to them in instalments (my banking app limits the amount I can transfer in one day). I nevertheless ended up making frantic phone calls to my bank, transferring what I could, and then driving out to a branch the day before completion to get the money over. I'm still waiting for the final documents (to be prepared by the seller's solicitor on completion and then sent to me by Graysons) and it's now three weeks after completion (tbf, Christmas and New Year have been during that period)

records.title: Good, and not so good
records.text: In terms of amending my will, Graysons have been very good - efficient, good communication.In terms of managing the process of dealing with my late wife's estate, less so. This has gone on for months, and feels like it's taking too long. Communication on progress is infrequent, I am having to chase for updates.

records.title: I chose a solicitor with a Sheffield…
records.text: I chose a solicitor with a Sheffield office because wanted to be able to see someone face to face . I never did and things were done by e mail. There wasn't a lot of explanation by phone about advice and choices to be made. This increased anxiety over process. Process was professional but could have been more proactive and friendly.

records.title: A couple of minor quibbles
records.text: Getting our signatures on a form and later saying "There will be an additional charge for ..." was clumsy.The solicitor who took the case over was polite, patient, gracious. I will stick with Graysons.Asking for this feedback the day I paid, rather than when we get an outcome (albeit in 2024) lacks customer focus.

records.title: Fair - no major issues but communication could be better
records.text: Had no problems with the conveyancing work completed. More reasonably priced than some others and they got the job done. Seem like a reliable firm.Found communication quite poor: although my calls were always answered, I believe I managed to speak to my solicitor just once, possibly twice over the phone over 4 months, which was challenging given that I really needed someone to explain the process. Also seemed to take ages and constant hassling to get information on what was happening, with answers only forthcoming when the estate agents also contacted them. When I had issues after completion (on picking up keys) noone would help, they'd already washed their hands of it. The app was pointless as noone ever responded to messages. Would also have been better to have hard copies of documents alongside emails.Overall fair - no major issues but probably would go elsewhere next time

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: Felt the appointment was a bit rushed and sometimes found it hard to fully understand what was being said as I didn't feel it was explained very clearly.  Also the person whom I spoke with was VERY casually dressed and did not look at all "professional" like most legal professionals usually do!  Also think the charges for services like a will re-write when only very small changes are required is too high.

records.title: Graysons dealt with two issues, excellent and disappointing.
records.text: Graysons dealt with two issues for me:Equity Transfer - Brilliant service, person dealing with this had excellent communication etc..Conveyancing - This let them down, anxious time for home buyers, I always had to chase for updates, when I advised that I was disappointed with communication got a terse response. I would liked to have given them top marks for both experiences and would have if judged on Equity Transfer.

records.title: My account was passed through 4…
records.text: My account was passed through 4 solicitors who each gave the same promise towards customer service. Each solicitor was really good at what they do but I just didn’t see the deal with being transferred.

records.title: Lack of communication, but exceptionally quick completion!
records.text: Lack of communication! During the process of our sale and purchase there was a lack of communication from our advisor, especially in the first 2/3 months. It’s like Graysons forgot how to communicate verbally, the only form of communication was through the app or email (thank goodness I am only 26 and can use technology!). When you did try and speak to the advisor over the phone the receptionist said they were busy or on lunch, on the very few occasions that I did get through I was made to feel stupid for asking for an update. Despite a lack of communication, Graysons  speed to get the process complete was exceptionally quick. The professionalism in the email trail was also exceptional, it will certainly help if we do ever plan to move again.

records.title: Lack of responses
records.text: Lack of responses, don’t give out useful information needed - don’t share when they’re on holiday even when it clashes with completion

records.title: I found all individuals assisting us in…
records.text: I found all individuals assisting us in the process to be very friendly. I did however have a serious disengagement with the delays in communication and response rate. My phone calls were seldom answered, and my emails frequently not replied to. My solicitor was on annual leave several times throughout the process at points where time was of the essence, and I wouldn't find out until receiving an out of office reply. If repeating the process, I'd be grateful as a client for more transparency, as I was often left scratching my head as to what was happening. The use of terminology and legal terms often gave me the significant impression that it was being done to avoid me understanding things, giving more leeway for my solicitor to deal with things on their timescale, not mine.

records.title: I used Grayson to buy a house
records.text: I used Grayson to buy a house. My solicitor was competent and helpful. But went under the radar for 10 days in the end which delayed the takeover by 10 days.

records.title: WASNT really worth putting a claim in
records.text: Just isn’t worth the mither got a hidden £205 charge

records.title: Communication was an issue
records.text: We were disappointed with the communication.  We seemed to experience breakdown between us contacting you by email and then not hearing anything for several days.  Right at the beginning of the process we had difficulty with attachments not coming through correctly and we had to use snail mail.  I appreciate that the Covid restrictions caused difficulties, but I think your responses could have been more timely.

records.title: Overall they got the job done however…
records.text: Overall they got the job done however messages left to ring me back not always answered emails not replied to not just to me but also to the estate agents dealing with the sale and purchase of the property. It took my estate agents to let me know mostly what was going on. I understand that the current pandemic situation has made things difficult so this may have been the reason but it really was frustrating when you don’t know what’s going on.

records.title: Didn't find your conveyance department…
records.text: Didn't find your conveyance department very communicative, nothing really explained, forever chasing with no responses for days/weeks in some instances. They never read my case also as it became apparent they wasn't aware of timesscales/deadlines due to the financial order. Nicola was very helpful and professional throughout.

records.title: just average really but ok
records.text: friendly and easy to get hold of but just giving average points as they were just ‘normal or average’ because they were. Office is very hot no air con and on the day of completion felt I had to chase for contact in an ongoing way.hours passed, before then the estate agent took over the chasing for money. I got worried re keys and felt nobody was bothered part from selling agent.pretty corporate and conveyer belt

records.title: Ok, but frustrating
records.text: Whilst the completion activity did get done. It was a month later than agreed. It appears the agent dealing was working to a different timeline. Also struggled to get any sort of response to emails or calls throughout the process. Not sure I’d recommend using Graysons again.

records.title: My solicitor at Graysons was very thorough.
records.text: My solicitor at Graysons was very thorough however at the completion stage there was problems that could have been avoided if she’d have been on the ball with things.  After saying that I completed in time for Christmas and all went smoothly on completion day.  I would use Graysons again.

records.title: Straight forward liability admit claim…
records.text: Straight forward liability admit claim took over 2 years to settle and would have gone on much longer had I not ultimately accepted less than the claim is worth (at time of writing this review I still haven’t received the settlement money).

records.title: Very poor experience
records.text: The service I received while buying a house was really poor. Nobody explained the process to me. I was constantly having to chase every little thing. Emails and voicemails went unanswered. On several occasions the vendors solicitor and estate agents where asking me if I was still going ahead with the purchase as it was taking so long. I was given time scales that were not followed. I was told "sh!ts hit the fan" and called "doll" which I found very unprofessional. The only reason why it is not one star was because other members of staff resolved the issues over time. I had a really bad experience and will not be using this company again.

records.title: I found it difficult to talk to the…
records.text: I found it difficult to talk to the solicitor dealing with the case. She didn’t reply to emails or phone calls. I spent time chasing her. I asked for explanations as I didn’t understand what was asked. No reply I actually spoke to another solicitor in the end. Terrible service. Never use your company again. Im aware of others saying the same. 🥲

records.title: ‘Will review’ warning
records.text: ‘Will review’ warning If you think you’re going for a will review, do your homework beforehand as this is probably an opportunity to sell  POA and since you’re at their office, there’s no cooling off period. I went with my elderly father who was expecting to look at the will (he’s hard of hearing and would have agreed to anything on the phone when the solicitor called him). Probably a good reason to have a POA but would have liked to think about it for a few days first. £562 for one POA.

records.title: Poor communication!
records.text: Unfortunately our experience with this solicitors was not of a high standard. Communication from our designated solicitor was lacking, leaving us confused as first time buyers. There was large delays in the process due to this lack of communication not only between our solicitor and ourselves but also between our solicitor and other parties such as our mortgage providor and the seller's solicitors.

records.title: Good service but less good at…
records.text: Good service but less good at communication, especially in responding to email queries

records.title: We felt that the length of time from…
records.text: We felt that the length of time from start to finish of over 14 weeks was very ,very extended. Bearing in mind 1 letter to the lease holders took over 5 weeks before a follow up was sent. Our feelings along with the estate agents was that it appeared Graysons were over stretched with work and we, unfortunately suffered extreme delay.

records.title: Communication was vague
records.text: Communication was vague, only via letter which would be fine if followed up by a call to explain next stages. When discussed via phone all seemed good and then if we had not contacted and asked all of a sudden things needed to be done so as a supportive advisory company I personally was not overly impressed. Would I recommend? On my experience! No!

records.title: Did not meet expectations that they set…
records.text: Did not meet expectations that they set out in their contract to us. Did not respond to emails. Avoidable delays and things done out of sequence. Communication could be vastly improved (brief email update would offset rising tension and avoid phone calls asking for progress) Gemma however was helpful and followed through. Would not use again, they seem to have lost sight of the fact that moving house is stressful enough and they are providing a service to the customer, not doing them a favour...

records.title: Poor service
records.text: Solicitor takes a long time to get back to your enquiries leaving you days at a time without any correspondence really poor service overall wouldn’t use them again and would not recommend them at all left very disappointed with the overall experience

records.title: Bad service
records.text: I required services for transfer of equity, I sent Grayson solicitors my ORGINAL property plan and twice requested the original plan back once my work was completed and they kept sending me a photocopy! They sent the wrong form to hm land registry which delayed the work. The communication was poor to.

description:
Swiitch is the new name for Shoosmiths’ conveyancing services.

About us 

We recognise that every client is unique, and every conveyancing transaction is different.  Whether you are taking your first steps on the property ladder, buying your dream home, upsizing, downsizing, selling or re-mortgaging, we are here to make the legal side of the conveyancing process as quick, efficient and as hassle-free as possible. 

Award winning 

We won National Conveyancing Firm of the Year and Residential Property Team of the Year at the British Conveyancing Awards 2023.

Client service 

We strive to provide exceptional client service by being: 

• Easy to communicate with: direct dial phone numbers give you straightforward access to us and we offer advice in plain English, taking time to explain the conveyancing process to you
• Approachable: we are open seven days a week and weekday evenings for your convenience
• Personal: you will have a dedicated Conveyancer and assistant, who will be your first point of contact
• Transparent: we offer fixed fees wherever possible, only requiring payment on successful completion of a transaction
• Secure: we provide secure, online access to view progress in your transaction, and you can transfer documents and information quickly, easily and safely. 
Free quote 

Use the free conveyancing calculator on our website to find out how much your move is likely to cost. 

Contact us 

Call or email us to discuss your next move

records.title: Our Recent Sale and Purchase
records.text: We worked with Craig Hinks for our recent sale and purchase.  I've honestly never been so pleasantly surprised by someone's knowledge, work ethic and support in this process.  I've always had a fairly negative view of the people involved in a house move (fair or not) but Craig really went above and beyond expectations during our work together.  I honestly can't recommend him enough or Swiitch.  Thank you so much for your support throughout the process.

records.title: Successful purchase
records.text: Worked hard and managed to get everything through on time even though everything went to the wire. Able to talk to them quite easily when needed and explained everything clearly to us. Beth's service was excellent throughout the process.

records.title: New Build Completion
records.text: I completed on our home 25/11/2024. I found Swiitch (shoosmiths) efficient and always available to help with any questions.Special mention for Muna Oriaku who did not stop working until we completed especially considering the developers solicitors were rubbish!

records.title: Responsive service
records.text: Swiitch was recommended to us by the estate agent we used to sell our late mother's property. At first I was a bit sceptical about what it would be like dealing with a firm that was not local to us but I have to say that everything progressed smoothly. When our buyers asked for a completion date before Christmas at short notice, our paralegal Beth Wheeler did everything to make it happen and was always prompt to respond to emails or calls. I would have no hesitation in using again.

records.title: First Time Buyers
records.text: We are first time buyers, the whole process seemed very daunting from the start… but honestly it couldn’t have gone much smoother thanks to Lauren Elliot and Megan Kelly at Swiitch! They were always there to answer any questions, and worked their hardest to get the contracts exchanged as quickly as possible. We couldn’t be happier and so excited to get into our new home! Thanks to everyone involved in getting this done for us, we’re so grateful.

records.title: I wound recommend Switch highly…
records.text: I could not recommend Switch highly enough, Craig Hinks and the team kept me informed all the way through the sale of my house. One of the things that was particularly refreshing was that the phone was always picked up, if Craig was unavailable one of the team would pick and pass on any messages which were always responded to. All in all they made a stressful process (due to the other side) bearable and I would be more than happy to use their services again should the need arise.Thanks once again for all your help CraigBill Danes

records.title: Switch definitely recommend for selling your property
records.text: I’m so glad i picked Switch as my solicitors, I was so impressed with Tom Love he made me feel so relaxed at a very stressful time when selling a property. Tom kept me up to date as soon as things progress on the phone and by email.I would definitely recommend Switch to sell a property, personally I myself would ask for Tom Love, with his knowledge and experience you won’t go wrong. Thanks again Tom for all your help. Steve Harrison.

records.title: The best conveyancing experience ever
records.text: I used Swiitch for both my sale and purchase.  Both Craig Hinks and Holly Mongan made the process smooth and easy.  All delays were due to third parties. I could always speak directly to them when I phoned and emails were usually responded to within 30 minutes.I would not hesitate to describe my experience of Swiitch, especially Craig and Holly, as the best of any conveyancer I have used.

records.title: Exemplary Service
records.text: Swiitch have been excellent with helping me purchase my first home. I cannot speak highly enough of Gemma Clarke and Sarah Stead. They were available to contact regularly and I always felt like they cared for my best interests during each step of the journey. Both are so easy to communicate with and I felt so comfortable through a very stressful period. Thank you to both of you.

records.title: Thank you to Swiitch and Tom Love for…
records.text: Thank you to Swiitch and Tom Love for helping and supporting us in our purchase of our new home. They gave us good advice and update us with all the relevant information for us to get the best deal. We very much appreciate all your patience and support. You guys are the best.

records.title: Conveyancing for house sale
records.text: We used this company for conveyancing when selling a property. The platform used made it easy to upload any necessary documentation and to see what we still needed to do. We were assigned a contact at the company, Beth Rebhan, who would send us emails with any queries and most of the time answer our queries promptly. The only issue I found was when Beth Rebhan had days off, then nobody appeared to pick up our emails and we then resent our emails when Beth was back.

records.title: Hannah and Nicole
records.text: For most people moving home is one of the most stressful events in their lifetime. What I never thought about was that this stress can emanate through to the solicitors but multiplied many times from their various customers. Hannah and Nicole were the perfect buffer to defuse the anxiety for Hazel and I, along with managing our sale and house move to Moonflower Place in Biggleswade.  Brilliant and well done to the pair of them and would highly recommend Switch to any potential house buyers. Best regards and Happy Christmas to all at Switch and the only reason I didn’t give a 5 star rating was the problem that arose with their phone system.

records.title: Many thanks go to Beth Rebhan and Megan…
records.text: Many thanks go to Beth Rebhan and Megan Kelly for all they did during our recent house sale and purchase. They did a great job and were very supportive to us during this time.

records.title: Excellent conveyancers
records.text: This is the second time I have used Swiitch and again they were very professional in dealing with the conveyance this time as an executor. All matters dealt with swiftly and kept me well informed of developments to exchange.

records.title: (Almost) smooth saleing
records.text: Zara Sharples handled a house sale swiftly and efficiently for me and my sister, and was unfailingly polite and generous with her time on the phone. Would have rated Swiitch 5 stars but for one small issue. We were looking for a quick sale and were not informed Zara would be taking almost two weeks’ annual leave not long after starting work. A colleague stepped in, but they had to be urged to push things forward as it was not their case. All worked out fine in the end, but there’s a chance you’ll find you are dealing with a team as much as you are with an individual.

records.title: Swiitch made moving house pretty simple…
records.text: Swiitch made moving house pretty simple and straight forward. The website was easy and secure to access with the moving steps set out in a straight forward manner and simple to follow. Leanne worked her socks off during the days we moved and was particularly patient when answering technical questions. Leanne always responded in a timely manner with precise information that was clear and written in as much non jargon speak as possible. Thankyou Swiitch and Leanne for the service!

records.title: beth rebhan is very good at her job
records.text: beth rebhan is very good at her job she is very pleasant to talk to and is very happy to help with any questions you have we think she is the best solicitor we ever had and we wish her well in the future many thanks beth

records.title: Helpful, clear and prompt
records.text: Swiitch were helpful, clear and prompt in our 5 month journey with them to completing our new home purchase. Some of the time was tricky, to be expected, as it was over Christmas and New Years - but as soon as the year started up again work was done to get us to completion. We really appreciate having Swiitch on our sides, having the option to do most things electronically, and getting the answers we needed as we went with this being our first time buy. Thank you Olivia, Rachael and Emma!

records.title: residential purchase
records.text: I recently worked with Isha Mistry and Carrie Sutton, on ax extremely time pressured residential purchase. The team were great as communication was clear and timely and they ensured that my requirements were considered throughout the process. Thank you for your support to get across the line! Would recommend their services.

records.title: Great service, helpful and friendly
records.text: Nicole Edwards has been with us all the way. We have had no end of problems with this move but Nicole has helped us throughout the process. She has been sympathetic, helpful and explained the processes involved with a move, a lot of which we were not familiar with.

records.title: Professional solicitors
records.text: Staff seemed friendly and professional. Did manage to complete under time restraints and worked with us to get the completion on time. I have only marked a 4 as when advised by connells to use this solicitors i was told would be quick responses but did feel communication process was hard. Also our orignally quotes for sale and purchase were both more than what was quoted. I apprieciate they were only estimated but a 1000 more than quoted seems extreme when we had cheaper quotes from other companies. Which we will keep in mind if need a solicitors in future.

records.title: We had a good experience with Swiitch
records.text: We had a good experience with Swiitch. Isha Mistry and Tracey Russel was fantastic always helping with everything answering all my call and emails. A Big Thanks to everyone who made our dream come true and really appreciate it.

records.title: Sam Maloney was helpful and the process…
records.text: Sam Maloney was helpful and the process went smoothly. Sam kept us well informed at each step allong the way. I would have liked to get tax advice relevant to my property sale but that is not offered by swiitch.

records.title: Swiitch were quick and efficient
records.text: Swiitch were able to come and support us with our conveyancy situation on short notice, when a previous firm had let us down.Business was conducted with minimal fuss and we were kept informed of the processes the whole through.

records.title: Thank you
records.text: Ryan Blake was really responsive and helpful with getting the sale of my property completed and as smooth as possible. He was always available when I called and was willing to provide updates whenever asked. Thanks Ryan - really appreciate it! You made a stressful time as easy as it could have been.

records.title: Company made the process very smooth…
records.text: Company made the process very smooth and answered our questions quickly and expansively.James G and Lorna were very helpful and helped us navigate the process as first time buyers.

records.title: Beth Wheeler took over the account
records.text: Beth Wheeler took over the account, transforming our experience with the company, from poor to brilliant.Beth and her team, made it happen and guided us through the final stage.Now look forward to buying a house with Beth and team handling it.

records.title: Lydia Dowsett and Conor were very good…
records.text: Lydia Dowsett and Conor were very good in sorting everything out as there were a few problems on the way. We were informed of them during the sale and generally they were sorted quickly and efficiently.The sale did not take too long and was  a very reasonable cost . So all in all I was very pleased with the whole experience.

records.title: Sale and Purchase
records.text: Swiitch, previously Shoosmiths, was recommended to us by our Estate Agents to deal with our sale and, for ease, we also decided to use them for our purchase. Having Lydia Dowsett, Paralegal, as our point of contact for both transactions has been brilliant! Lydia has kept us up to date on proceedings and has been easily available via email or telephone, answering our queries quickly and efficiently when, at times, we were feeling unsure of the current position. Thank you.

records.title: Thank you to Beth Rebhan
records.text: Beth Rebhan has always been very efficient on each occasion that I have contacted Swiitch and has promptly responded to any enquiries and kept me updated where possible. I also used Swiitch when selling my family home last year and Beth was always very helpful and professional

records.title: Flat 2 Squirrels Green/3 Surrey Place Sale/Purchase
records.text: It is very difficult for anyone who does not work in conveyancing to understand all the documentation and specifically the wording contained within - it would be extremely helpful if the covering emails could give some indication/help points to aid the completer along with a list of the documentation included and what they are.  I think this would have made the whole experience less stressful and aid a quicker turnaround time of documentation.However I will mention the work that Craig Hinks personally delivered ensuring in the final weeks that I was updated on progress, especially the final two weeks which were a rollercoaster of activity.  I know how hard Craig worked in the final weeks. Co-ordinating three parties is no mean feat I can imagine but with his perseverance we exchanged before completion which was as it was promised and for which I am extremely grateful. Thank You Craig.

records.title: Sale of house
records.text: Relatively inexpensive, and in the end, did everything that was needed.  Comms weren't as good as i've experienced with other solicitors, and a propensity to simply 'bat on' queries from the other side.  In other words, you need to actively manage you ascribed solicitor.

records.title: House Sale process
records.text: General comments:Pros - towards the end of the process Olivia Eades did a professional job during the closing process, communication was good.Cons / points to improve - the dots somehow didn't always seem to be joined up at Shoosmiths, eg I was asked for information that had already been submitted and received by the company, my account was apparently closed at one juncture when a sale fell through essentially without advising, causing confusion again when it was "reopened."The proof of ID requirement was a joke and inconsistently applied, I still can't understand why the process for ID proof was acceptable for the closing of the first sale of the property but not the second (when the initial sale failed at the buyer's end).I didn't have full confidence in security systems as Shoosmiths don't have a secure drop box. Although they couldn't provide me with their bank details via email in order for me to make a payment (due to "security concerns") there wasn't the same concern emailing customer details as attachments (eg full bank account details and statements, passport and driving license copies etc) back and forth. Security is important and Shoosmiths really need a secure drop box for document transfer.It may not just be a Shoosmiths issue but a docusign type process rather than regular mail / DHL etc would improve efficiency... particularly when mail going back and forth internationally takes up to a month.

records.title: In my opinion
records.text: In my opinion, the process took longer than expected to complete on a property where there was no chain. I did not feel I was regularly kept up to date and had to chase to get a response. Unfortunately, I did not feel that the principal associate working on my behalf on the purchase of the property was communicative in the way I would have expected during this stressful time.Fortunately, towards the end Hannah Locke and Maria Khalil were extremely helpful and once they became more involved, I felt the levels of communication were much improved.

records.title: Case delay
records.text: As far as I was aware, my case was delayed for a further two weeks, because the person dealing with it was on sick leave, and I presume the company was waiting for her return before it was passed to her colleague, I addressed this before hand via an email, enquiring as to, should something not be in place regarding absences, did not receive a reply to date.My application from when I submitted my offer, took 12 weeks from the date I made my offer to the estate agent, they did not waste anytime their end.

records.title: Will not accept electronically signed documents
records.text: As a law firm they seem fine, but it is very frustrating post pandemic to be unable to sign documents electronically - Adobe Sign or Docusign for instance provide very easy ways to digitally sign documents, and this is all supported by law and technology. Having to print out sign and scan forms seems very 2001.[on reply below, happy to be in contact but I can't see a way to contact through Trustpilot right now (link for more details has expired)]

records.title: Efficient but not perfectly informed
records.text: Though three different people dealt with the sale from time to time, the hand-overs generally seemed to be smooth. We had expected that Shoosmiths would know about the (slightly unusual) tenure arrangments in the town where the property was being sold, but in practice the staff most concerned with the sale did not appear to do so; they also had not immediately grasped the full implications of those arrangements for establishing title. Having said which, this was perhaps not a typical residential conveyancing case.

records.title: Overall very helpful and friendly
records.text: Overall very helpful and friendly.  I would say that their admin charges seem extremely high for what it is they provide.  I was annoyed at the end of the transaction, we needed a Declaration of Trust form which they drafted and provided to us (1 page of A4 paper).  At no point was we told that we would have to pay £234 for this.  It wasnt until the day before our sale that we were told we would have to pay this.  Had they told me that it was going to be this much, I would have gone and got quotes for lower prices (money being extremely tight at the moment).  Given we could not complete without paying this, I had very little option but to do so.

records.title: It worked out in the end
records.text: Started off a bit rocky - too many advisors with a lack of consistency and constant chasing. The first few advisors dealing with my case never called when they said they would and I was left in the dark too long. As a first time buyer, I felt unsupported. This changed when Maurice Muchinda took over my case. He was professional and friendly but above all, he took the time to keep me informed and answer all my questions. Even though the process took far longer than expected, this was out of Maurice and Shoosmith’s hands. I would rate Shoosmith average and their fees are excessive (particularly having to pay to be able to use their website - its 2019!) but Maurice was brilliant.

records.title: First time of selling a house and I…
records.text: First time of selling a house and I felt that I was chasing all the time, Connor always got back to me quickly and tried to answer any questions I had.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Excellent service up to the day of completion. No call or letter of confirmation that the sale had gone through.

records.title: Better communication please
records.text: We went with Swiitch as we were advised by William H Brown that using their ‘internal’ solicitors would make the house buying process easier and smoother.We had to chase on a regular basis for updates and at times our emails would go unanswered. Considering we were paying for a service, the communication and customer service elements need improving.Despite this both Abi Atkinson and Kelly Stubbs did eventually get us over the line, and in the days leading up to completion they were in regular contact and provided advice and support.It’s just a shame that the process took 8 months and there were times when we were left not knowing what was going on, which just added to the stress of the situation.

records.title: Communication…
records.text: Swiitch are managing the sale of a house to which I am an executor. The process has been nothing but miserable and painful. Dire communication and when there is any it's one line with no information and no questions answered. I have to keep reminding myself that they are representing us and we are paying for this service.Really disappointing after the estate agent recommended them but I guess there's a reason for that.

records.title: House sale
records.text: Difficult to contact by phone. Very demanding when they wanted information. Very slow to give any feed back when asked specific questions. Having to make a second appointment with a Notaire in France due to unclear initial request was expensive and time consuming.

records.title: Emma was great, other than that not a great experience
records.text: Emma was great at keeping us updated at the end with our exchange and completion.But unfortunately before this we had not had a great experience. We constantly had to call them to chase the buyer, and even then that didn't always happen resulting in us having to call the estate agent to chase the buyer and their solicitor. Communication wasn't the best, we would email for updates and would take days to hear back and sometimes wouldn't hear back at all until we called. If we called and our solicitor was there we asked for a call back which often didn't receive. We sold our property in December 2022 but didn't actually start the process till around April 2023 due to the buyer not being chased properly.

records.title: We found Shoosmiths to be slow and not particularly knowledgable
records.text: We found Shoosmiths to be incredibly slow most of the time and not particularly knowledgable in the areas we needed help with. It was very difficult to get hold of anyone. We had to get various documents drawn up several times because of various mistakes. There have also been several issues with the seller which Shoosmiths haven’t been able to help us resolve. We felt like we had to do a lot of the work that we were expecting the solicitors to do. In addition, unfortunately, Shoosmiths lost our instruction to engage the Surveyor and to have Wills drawn up; it took weeks of us chasing to get to the bottom of what had happened. However, towards the end they became very responsive and more helpful.

records.title: I wouldn't bother if I were you
records.text: This company is very slow and lack knowledge. Offer a very robotic customer service approach and when you challenge their urgency and professionalism they become very sarcastic, the developers who we brought from have even said they will not deal with them again due to their incompetency, we had to constantly chase and work full time to communicate for them to other parties involved. We used HTB and I asked for an update from HTB and they said that they had been sent someone else's forms and asked "can you ask your solicitors to concentrate when they are filling them out". Overall a very stressful experience, wouldn't recommend. An extra star is because we eventually got our house.

records.title: Lacking attention to detail and a personal touch
records.text: Thought it would be wise to save writing this review 3 months after the purchase of our home to avoid inviting any delays or unforeseen complications such has been the case during the entire conveyancing saga.On one hand Shoosmiths LLP were very helpful in helping us sell our first property however the purchase of the other was frustrating with changes in personnel handling our case and quite frankly shutting us down with template legal responses to our queries without any human factor or any understanding of our situation.   Be warned!   If you pay for a "home buyer survey" Shoosmiths LLP will NOT read it therefore are unable to comprehend the context of a report based on a short summary section they only acknowledge.We also discovered they were writing letters and questions to the vendor we already knew the answers to but had not checked nor allowed us the scope to intervene and correct the correspondence,   for me this was embarrassing. Adding fuel to the fire they incorrectly calculated our final statement,  whereby on completion we had to desperately find additional money to complete within a matter of days.  Overall it took 6 months to buy a house which had no onward chain,  says it all.If it wasn't for the estate agent and sympathy of the vendor I'm not sure how we would have completed,  as much as I would like to name and shame the individuals involved - it is clear working part time hours and being chewed up in a system of churning out conveyancing case work is taking it's toll.

records.title: Ooh dear where to start.
records.text: Ooh dear where do we start.Slow. Documents not proof read before being sent out.Being told all documents are completed, then 4 days later new ones turn up. Additional policies added without consultation. Expressions of dissatisfaction not being taken seriously. Emails not answered or if they are answered 3 days later. Still waiting to exchange. More excuses about chasing others in the chain  There's a tiktok video about emailing everyday for 5 months  to get an answer. That's the reality. Go on surprise me and make the exchange happen before the first time buyers in the chain retire. Update we finally exchanged 3 weeks later after I threatened to pull out of the sale. Communication on the actual day was bang on!Ref US M-00994398

records.title: My opininon of this solicitor is that…
records.text: My opininon of this solicitor is that they don't treat you as a customer like they should. You are considered as a part of a transaction where the bank who provides the mortgage is the customer and they are the only ones who count even though you are the ones who are paying the bill. In our case there was a poor level of communication, a complete lack of regard to my instructions and a general lack of empathy to our situation. Our transaction took a lot longer than necessary due to the lack of listening and communication involved. Despite these great reviews they are getting here, i am aware that i am not the only one who has not had great service lately.

records.title: I am in the slow process of selling a flat in London
records.text: I am in the process of selling a property and using Swiitch to represent me on the recommendation of my sales agent (Brinkleys Putney). To say that they have been inefficient is a massive understatement. A straight sale to a willing buyer from a willing seller and 6 months later they still cannot give me an indication of when exchange is likely to take place.The solicitor I was given, Amna Khan, will often take a week to reply to emails from the buyer's solicitor. Will often not reply to my emails at all and generally speaking, appears to not be concerned whether the sale goes through or not.If you are looking for a painful, drawn out time wasting exercise then Swiitch is your solicitor to sell your property. If you enjoy emails and concerns going unanswered then ask for Amna. However if you have an interest in actually selling your property then I suggest finding another solicitor.No doubt a representative will reply to this message and make excuses as to why it's not them that's holding up the sale. For anyone who wants further reviews on Swiitch, there's plenty of other sites that give a clearer summary of how this company operates.

records.title: Added stress of poor communication
records.text: Anyone going through the naturalisation process with a lawyer is understandably anxious in some way. Your future depends on the people guiding you through the process and you’re paying a lot of money. IAS ultimately took me all the way through that process but it wasn’t without additional anxiety added. I experienced oftentimes very poor communication with my various lawyers there, one in particular didn’t respond to an urgent question I emailed them for *two whole weeks*. Some lawyers’ communication styles were also vague and unspecific and had I not been an English speaker or able to use the internet I would’ve had a much harder time. I got partial answers, vague answers, I mostly had to tease information out of them the whole way. Abdul M was my final lawyer who helped me with my naturalisation application. He was competent and communicated with me better than my previous ILR lawyer, R, whom I am apparently not permitted by TrustPilot to name, and whom I would not recommend for any reason. This lawyer disappeared several times for unknown reasons and I felt left high and dry by her. When I complained to supervisor Houri Zahedi I was given a new lawyer, but the process was much more stressful than it should’ve been. IAS is so prominent in this field in the UK it’s hard to find alternatives to help one with visa applications. I would counsel anyone embarking on this process to shop around, consult your council legal aid help service first.

records.title: Okay, but not worth the price

records.title: Poor customer experience for the money I paid
records.text: I expected better customer service for the money we paid. More exactly, I was disappointed that the communication via email was poor, highly delayed, and inconsistent. For example, I would ask three questions in an email and I would get the answer to one. This caused me anxiety and an overall feeling of dissatisfaction with the services provided. The highlight of this collaboration with Ms. Kurshida Begum was that I received a positive response within only two months and she was clearly knowledgeable of all the steps and documents needed for my visa application.

records.title: UK Spouse Visa
records.text: I reached out to IAS in Nov 2022 for my UK Spouse Visa Application. On 15 Feb 2023, I received my visa. IAS is a great company full of expert lawyers that one can easily trust. I was quite happy with the services they provided but would have been a bit more appreciative if my casework had told me about the timeline of the process before I paid the full amount. I found the expertise a bit expensive and wish I was kept more in the loop about certain things. At times I even felt like I was being favored or was pestering the team for asking basic questions. Maybe the team can be a bit more sensitive and understanding towards their clients as it is very hard to be on the other side and have your future totally dependent on an application. Rest everything was great - they are all quick, efficient and professional. Would definitely recommend IAS.

records.title: Would shop around for other immigration services in the future
records.text: Overall we are satisfied that our UK Spouse Visa was accepted and my partner is now living in the UK. However, we were not completely satisfied with the overall service from IAS, with the reasons below:- Email response times to questions are slow (if you get a response). SLA is 5-10 days for those who don’t know- Lack of communication from IAS both before and after visa submission left us feeling uneasy about the process and decision- After sales support does not that align with their pre-sales urgency - Lack of professionalism in places, for example:    - documents shared via personal cloud storage devices, rather than a secured alternative from IAS     - Creditcard details shared over Teams meeting during visa submission    - Incorrect documents shared to usI had made these feelings clear to the Supervising Manager as well as the Client Relationship Manager (who was nonexistent throughout) but neither provided any support and failed to fulfil their promise of a meeting to discuss my concerns. Too busy for an unsatisfied customer or don’t care?In future, I would shop around for immigration specialist services. When paying a significant fee for the full package, I expected a much more attentive and professional service.

records.title: Good peace of mind, but disorganised.

Also by being more organised. Between the original consultation and talking to Abdul for the first time, I was very confused, frustrated and worried. I was asked twice, by two different people, to prove that I made payment to them. I was introduced to several people who I didn't have anything to do with. The person who did my original advice session recommended timelines to me, then I had to chase for next steps over the following weeks, putting me in jeopardy of missing those timelines.

records.title: Zara Ali. Negative into a positive experience
records.text: We began our relationship with IAS in 2019, we needed help with a ILR application. And what started off has a positive relationship with our case worker soon turned anything but. With communication none existent, constant chasing from our side, no updates or follow ups. Having then discovered our application had been closed by the HO, information only discovered from our chasing the HO. Zara Ali took over our case and turned a very anxious and concerning situation into a positive result, with the HO providing their response within weeks. Thank you Zara and Iza For your support and help in getting us through this stressful time. You were very open and transparent with all communications from the HO so we were in the loop at all times.  Turning a very terrible experience with IAS into a positive one.  Just wish Zara was our case worker from the start. I believe this would have saved us a lot of anxiety and sleepless nights.  Only leaving 3 stars due to how we were treated at the start of our immigration journey with IAS. I would recommend Zara Ali to anyone who is seeking help with their applications.  We are still awaiting the outcome from their internal investigation into what went wrong with our case. Perhaps this never took place? Pity if we were only told this to appease rather than it actually being done. As I would not wish what we went through with the initial case worker to happen to anyone else.

records.title: They gave me information about what I…
records.text: They gave me information about what I could do to help my current situation.

records.title: Terrible Service
records.text: Used this company back in April 2024 for my wife Spouse Visa, the experience wasn’t very great, constantly have to chase them for a update, charge you ridiculous amounts of fees just for basic requests and don’t give you full documentation if your application was successful. I received no IHS number, receipt or anything (which is important if they decide to work for healthcare to receive a refund back). Poor service, to me all it felt that they care about your money than providing you an professional service and i will definitely won’t recommend their services to anyone other than avoid.

records.title: Not worth
records.text: Not worth. I only needed renewal of spouse visa. Through experience we knew all papers needed. Personally wasn’t great, every time a new person talk to you. They made mistake of wasting my time travel all the way for an appointment which was cancelled. They did not request to get my original passport back. Now 10 month passing and I still don’t have my original passport. No one answers back to any email or contact. No communications at all.

records.title: Bad experience, could have done ourselves
records.text: Paid for both spouse visa and partner visa, was appointed to an intern named 'S' to deal with the case. No suggestions on how to write the document and after sending the documents to her, there is no feedback!  Take ages to schedule a meeting, wouldn't reply until several emails or call. At the meeting, there is a crying baby constantly interrupting. It was a great concern for the company to handle our visa application. Thank god that the visa is guaranteed and the intern quit. Then we were assigned to her tutor 'D', who is much better at the response. But it feels like it's a pure business and she doesn't have to be friendly. The whole experience for us is that they don't care about customers at all maybe they have too many.

records.title: I paid for citizenship advice and was…
records.text: I paid for citizenship advice and was provided with the information at the time following a conversation with a Lawyer (I will not name) a few months ago. We took the legal advice offered as given. One month ago I contacted the Home Office to get advice from them and it contradicts what I was advised. I have written to said Lawyer 4 times, the first time having had a response to send through the case document they provided for them to review. I have had zero response. I have since escalated it to their Casework Performance managed on the 29th July (out of office until the 31st July). I still have had no response back from anyone. When they wanted my money, they responded quickly; now that I'm questioning their advice, they disappear. I will continue contacting them until I receive an answer and will update the review should this change.

records.title: Waste of money
records.text: I was grateful to receive a discounted price to speak to a lawyer for 1hour. But unfortunately it felt like a complete waste of money. The lawyer rang me at 10:36 and my appointment was at 10:15 I completely understand that delays happen but unfortunately she attempted to end the call at 11:14 meaning I didn’t have my full hour I paid for. I asked further questions so we ended at 11:20, and still didn’t get the full hour I paid for. The lawyer did state I’ll be able to send questions to her as I have 3 days after this call but it’s the principle. I then was requesting for advice as one do and the lawyer spoke mostly about fees regarding her services which was really disappointing as I understand if I asked but I didn’t. Most of the information given to me I found on the internet. She was discouraging the attempt for me to submit the application as she listed reason it might fail without using their services. She proceeded to ask me how much I earn then stated later on in the conversation when I said I could not offer the fees. I could save up for it knowing I am alone and have no one else, i unfortunately have extensive bills and one might say but information was helpful but i felt like it was demeaning. As I explained my situation and she proceeded to mention this, its by no means, mean I will give up on this as this is my life and immgration is very important, but I could’ve saved the money instead of booking this like she suggested

records.title: Better options available, would avoid.
records.text: Smooth sales, awful service. Getting a firm answer from lawyer was like getting blood from a stone. On more than one occasion I would call repeatedly only to be told that the lawyer was out of office or on leave - these email alerts can be set up and would have saved me a great deal of stress and time, unprofessional. Yes, my visa eventually came through but reviewing documentation took significantly longer than it should have. When reviewing financial requirement documents, the lawyer even had the nerve to tell me I didn’t meet it, even though I did AND had included a document to break this down and make it clear for them and the home office. Went with this service as it was cheaper than some of the other options and would make the process less stressful and faster, this was not the case at all, and given the level of service I received, I would think twice before using them again. Two stars because I did receive my visa after months of exasperation and a complete lack of communication.

records.title: Not worth the appointment

records.title: Thanks to Trustpilot

records.title: Not that knowledgeable
records.text: Not that knowledgeable I paid £150 for advice relating to a spousal visa application and was initially given the incorrect advice during the virtual meeting.This was however corrected when the written advice was sent to me.At £150 for a 30m session, I would have expected the caseworker/solicitor to have the correct information on hand for me based of the summary of the situation I sent through beforehand and their supposedly expert knowledge of immigration laws in the UK.This leaves me unable to recommend their service or to use their application preperation service.

records.title: Disappointing customer experience
records.text: As someone who recently utilised the services of IAS for my Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) application, I must express my profound disappointment with the overall experience. While the application itself was successful, the journey with them was frustrating. From the beginning, I encountered conflicting information from their advisors, which only exacerbated my anxieties about the process. When I sought clarity on timelines, the advisor’s response was shockingly unprofessional, essentially telling me to cease my inquiries and accept their pace of work. It was disheartening to realize that my £1000 investment in their services only served to amplify my anxiety and frustration, rather than alleviate it. Furthermore, any attempt to raise valid concerns was met with defensiveness from the advisor. While the successful outcome of my ILR application is appreciated, it does not overshadow the regrettable customer journey that preceded it. For anyone considering utilising their services, I urge recommend exploring alternative options that prioritise professionalism, transparency, and genuine customer care.

description:
At Simpler Law we believe that Wills, Trusts, Lasting Powers of Attorney, and other forms of Estate Planning should be accessible and affordable for everyone. Families work hard for what they achieve and this should be protected and passed on to future generations.

We do not subcontract out our Will Writing requirements and all the Wills we write are legally binding and prepared with each unique individual and their requirements in mind. 

We have written in excess of 200,000 Wills, hold a £2M indemnity insurance, and manage £500M in Trusts for our clients. We have a robust and industry leading Customer Care Charter in place to protect our clients, which can be found here.

records.title: Save money; use chatgpt.
records.text: My wife was stopped in a supermarket.We needed to look into wills so she paid up. Obviously the appointment was after the 14 day cooling off period...They were polite and professional. But honestly all data gathered in the appointment was a fishing expedition for more work. To sort out everything we really need was going to be 2 grand for trusts and estate planning etc. You don't get much for the fee you pay in the supermarket.So save your money, use chat gpt to make yourself two mirror wills. You can give it the names of your kids, who you want your executors to be etc. Then you can store it yourself (to have simpler wills store it is extra... bet they didn't tell you that in the shop)Then buy a book from amazon about estate planning. Having said all that, if you only want a very basic will then I expect these guys will be cheaper than your local solicitor, but you wont get anything more than a page and a half of typed A4 in a binder.

records.title: Had initial appointment but then heard…
records.text: Had initial appointment but then heard nothing for 2 months. Emailed them only to receive documents with half of what we discussed missing and names spelt wrong. They charge a monthly fee to "hold" the Will and 6 months later I still have mine, not been requested, still charging me and so for what they're charging me if they don't have my signed Will, not sure. Overall experience cost alot, accomplished nothing, still no completed, correct Will so just cancelled debit order, cut my losses and went and had one done for free somewhere else. I was very disappointed because the lady I dealt with was very sweet.
