records.title: Misleading advert
records.text: Misleading advert. Thought I was getting a good deal but if things are too good to be true then they usually are. Had to wait a long time to get an appointment but understood as think everyone saw the ITV advert but I didn't mind waiting for the price. Will and LPA for £179, great! Went through it all. LPA was only one of them so needed to pay another £179 for the health one. Thought its expensive but if they deal with it all and register it for me then fine, at least it is done. Well no, the fee is just for them to complete the free form that anyone can do online and then you have to pay an extra ££ per LPA to register once it is recieved in the post after 28 days. So ends up the cheap deal was actually £179 and ended up being over £500.00. Fortuantely they refunded me for both LPA's once I realised but most people wouldn't have asked if they register it as she didn't even explain that bit and just said follow instructions when you get it. Felt a bit mislead and ended up re-doing my will which I didn't need to do and was doing it more for the LPA. Disappointed.

records.title: I am disappointed with the provided…
records.text: I am disappointed with the provided service. it took 3 trials to book a meeting. i chose to buy the aftercare plan which i paid for but up till now i have not received the Will.no one answers the phone

records.title: Agent was friendly and answered all my…
records.text: Agent was friendly and answered all my questions. Everything was explained. Unfortunately there are several sweeping statements that are made by all agents, during the calls, that are inaccurate and can be misleading. Examples: Simpler Law are more qualified and better at Will writing then Solicitors: If your Will is damaged or you need to make additions or changes, you will have to Pay for a new Will. They are obviously following a script, as a sales pitch and do not really understand what they are saying. Simpler Law, are not Solicitors or Paralegals and are therefore not Covered by the same Legislation as Legal Professionals.The original advertisement was for a Simple Will for under £100.00. Lasting Power Of Attorneys were also offered at a very reasonable cost. At the end of my Consultation the Bill was just over £850.00. This does still sound reasonable for a Will and 2 LPAS, but is far in excess of what they advertise. They also offer a storage facility for your will with "additional benefits" and offer to register The LPAS both for an extra cost. A Will is a very important document. After taking some time to think about it. I was unhappy to continue with my purchase and have asked for a full refund.I will be using a Solicitor to draft my Will and register my LPASMy advice would be to take time to go through everything after your consultation. Then decide if it is the right service for you.

records.title: I was taken quickly to lasting power of…
records.text: I was taken quickly to lasting power of attorney.  Which is £650 more than just writing the will. Incomplete details were taken. My wife's children were not considered.  I phoned later that day to advise them of this. sent an email. 4 days later I made another phone call. Today have received a call when I was unable to answer. that is a week after the query but the money forms came through quickly. thankfully a 14 day cooling off period. Charlotte was charming though.

records.title: Had a call with a consultant and needed…
records.text: Had a call with a consultant and needed to call back to amend something - waited 30 mins on an answering call machine before I gave up so getting through to getting support is very difficult.  The consultant did follow up a few days later, however, and due to the price being reasonable, I have decided to continue with the service.

description:
Our fresh approach to conveyancing combines our unique technology with well-trained staff and a commitment to brilliant service.

We’re transparent
We charge a flat rate on transactions whether they are sale, purchase, leasehold, freehold, cash, or mortgage.

Fully supported staff 
We only employ full-time lawyers and assistants who focus purely on property giving us the ability to move transactions through more quickly and therefore, with a much higher success rate.

The Latest Technology
Technology underpins our business. Our custom built system gives everyone immediate access to case details. This is key to our unsurpassed responsiveness & accuracy.

With our unique approach to availability and accountability, both our clients and referrers avoid the stresses normally associated with property transactions.

records.title: We had a fantastic experience!
records.text: We had a fantastic experience with Shannon and Jade. They kept us informed and answered all of our queries promptly. The online portal is also a big bonus that gave us a sense of control over the process.

records.title: Excellent people & efficient easy portal
records.text: Excellent people and the portal gave great visibility over the process, tasks and updates.  This was the most efficient process I have ever had in selling a property.  I cannot recommend The Partnership enough.

records.title: The best Solicitor ever!
records.text: The best Solicitor ever! The partnership in Guildford help us on our house purchase. Rishi our solicitor was amazing. He was so professional and he replied to every question we had straight away. I always got an answer within 10 min. We completed in 8 weeks and managed to move in before Christmas thanks to them. We would highly recommend them to anyone and surely we will use their services again. The Partnership is the best solicitor company we ever dealt with! Thank you, Iren & Michael

records.title: Great experience
records.text: Jade and Shannon really pulled it out the bag to have me moved in before Christmas. They’re very professional, quick to respond, and managed my expectations of everything very well. I also think the partnerships portal is brilliant, you can log in and see all the appropriate docs there in one place - much better than other solicitors I’ve worked with (hundreds of emails, print outs and PDF’s).

records.title: Jade and Shannon showed such patience…
records.text: Jade and Shannon showed such patience in dealing with a far from straightforward process, and their responsiveness was first class.

records.title: Visual pie charts to keep us updated
records.text: Absolutely brilliant from start to finish.It wasn’t an easy transaction and Michaela & team handled it in a smooth and stress free manor.The online portal, summary of the progress pie chart and weekly update calmed our nerves. So much easier having everything in one place rather than over emails that could get lost.I have already recommended them to friends and family who are now moving home and will look to use them again if we move again!Thanks team!

records.title: Highly professional
records.text: I have found this company to be very friendly, approachable and highly professional.  Their response to any communication I put to them, was swift and efficient.

records.title: Thanks for a really professional…
records.text: Thanks for a really professional service.  All queries were answered quickly and issues dealt with effectively.I would recommend the Partnership. Particular thanks go to Rishi and Ryan for getting our sale to exchange.

records.title: Monica & Rishabh
records.text: Monica Gill and Rishabh were a great help in helping us understand the legal side of purchasing the property. They were always there to help us at any point we didn't understand. Thank you so much for your support and services.

records.title: The best!!!
records.text: Very smooth buying process. No stress! We were kept updated throughout the whole process. Communicating through the app made the process easier and we felt like we were in control too. I would recommend them to anyone:)))

records.title: Excellent  service and helpful  every…
records.text: Excellent  service and helpful  every step if the way, Monica and Rishab  were happy  walk us through the process  and would recommend  Partnership solicitors to anyone  buying a house

records.title: Property sale process
records.text: The fact that the company has the workflow to communicate with the client makes a significant difference.The only reason why I have not rated The Partnership with 5***** is only due to the fact that our sale took much longer than expected. We (sellers) were not in a chain and neither were the buyers.

records.title: Very good and very professional
records.text: Very good and very professional. I would rate highly. Website was clear and informative and felt very secure. One star dropped because I felt it would have been nice if sometimes there had been more personal interaction rather than relying on the tech but I am old!

records.title: Overall a really great service
records.text: Overall a really great service. I would have preferred a more direct (telephone) approach rather than so much reliance on the web systems but I cannot fault their hard work and dedication of the team.

records.title: they’re busy but they’re good
records.text: Catherine and Sahar were always there on the other end of the phone when I needed. They guided me through my first purchase with kindness. The portal was clear and organised, however best to call if you want a quick response and to ensure everyone was on the same page.

records.title: Very professional service
records.text: Very professional service. Always returned calls, responded to emails and provided information in a timely manner. The staff seemed to understand their brief, knew what they were doing and were well co-ordinated as a team.Will certainly recommend tou and will use you if ever the need arises.Thank you once again.

records.title: Good weekly update on the process
records.text: Good weekly update on the process. Kind and helpful staff

records.title: Very good service
records.text: Very very good service, prompt and efficient, and fairly priced.The only reason it’s not 5 stars (I would have picked 4.5 if could) is our appointed solicitor didn’t respond directly to our messages on their portal, choosing instead to raise enquiries which we then had to wade through to find answers. This was a v minor issue however and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend The Partnership.

records.title: Enthusiastically Recommend!
records.text: So quick! Never had to chase them, and the portal makes everything super clear. They really helped us understand everything as it was happening - especially over the phone. Some of their emails assumed a level of understanding from us that we didn't have as first time buyers - but they were always happy to clarify. They were easy to reach when needed. Some of the costs accrued in the process weren't laid out in our original quote. But overall, we'd absolutely recommend - such a better experience than anyone else we know has had with other solicitors.

records.title: Online portal is great but costs…
records.text: Online portal is great but costs greatly exceeded initial quote. Communication through the portal was super and made it really clear to see progress on the purchase. However the difference between the initial quote for the legal work and the final cost was almost 25% higher. I recognise all legitimate costs but the sales team should be more open to the likelihood of such a significant increase in cost. Overall though the Partnership were easy to communicate with and our purchase completed satisfactorily.

records.title: A Long Journey
records.text: The initial contact from TP was very professional. Then lawyers on our account were changed and no effort was made to  introduce themselves.Overall during teh sale and purchase communications on updates were sometimes not clear and some language used in messages confusing to mere members of the public.Good to  know that whenever we rang there was a human being and calls were always returned.We did have to chase on a couple of ocasions.The final steps were excellent.Overall TP got the job done but some improvements in communication would have been helpful.

records.title: The process & referencing got confusing…
records.text: The process & referencing got confusing for someone who is not very computer literate and sending documentation through the portal a nightmare!  Prab & Vaishali were very responsive even if sometimes I felt out of the loop. Fortunately my seller & I struck up a good relationship so we sorted a lot of it out between us. Thank the lord its all over now - never again!!

records.title: Selling our property
records.text: The Partnership was very helpful during the process of selling our property. The portal worked very efficiently. There were a few times when we wished for more detailed feedback about what steps had been taken to contact the buyer’s solicitors who seemed elusive. But overall we were very pleased with the service.

records.title: Reliable and good customer service
records.text: The client portal system is very easy to use and keeps you informed about the progress. We always received quick responses to our questions from the team. We did feel that some outstanding enquiries could have been chased earlier/ some of the communication with the sellers could have been clearer, as we ended up missing our target completion date by one day. Overall a good experience though and we felt that the work they were doing was thorough with attention to detail.

records.title: We got there!
records.text: Communication was amazing, every question was answered and dealt with a good level of care. However it did take what felt like an eternity to get to completion. I know that things do crop up and after covid and brexit, but for a big chunk of time we felt like it would never complete. However, Mandeep got us over the finish line and was professional and helpful.

records.title: Sale of house
records.text: My experience wasn’t great because I am not very good with technology. I found the portal hard to get used to. However all the staff were extremely patient and helped me through. They were very professional and double checked detail. It was useful that I could phone to talk to someone. They were persistent with the buyers solicitors. Who were frustratingly slow at responding to requests.

records.title: House Purchase No.2 with the Partnership.
records.text: Experience no.2 purchasing a property using The Partnership and excellent experience once again. From start to finish the team were on point, worked within agreed timescales and looked after our interests all the way through the process. Highly recommend the team and will use again in the future.

records.title: Management Pack Advice
records.text: I am extremely happy with the performance of The Partnership, this is the fourth time I have used their services to sell some of my portfolio of properties. One thing I would highlight to reduce the time to complete, would be to pre order the Management Packs that are required in order to sell flats. This would have reduced my selling time by up to four weeks.

records.title: I thought that the service was good for…
records.text: I thought that the service was good for the price I paid - I got quoted far more elsewhere, and my representative was always polite and professional.They seem to have done a thorough job - I know some people have bought in the same block as me, and didn't receive the amount of information I have, for instance on nearby planning applications.Only reason I'm not giving a 5, was for a while there was a lack of proactive chasing - I was told on a couple of occasions by an assistant that we just need to wait the right amount of time before chasing...which was weeks.  In the end, I was evicted from my current property, and once I received notice of this, things seemed to get some urgency on their side, thankfully.Would use again.

records.title: Efficient and Professional Experience
records.text: The portal is so easy to use and such an efficient way to keep track of your property sale at all stages.  You get a prompt that there is a new message or action required, so there are not the usual delays in moving things forward. The whole experience was really efficient and professional. I would definitely recommend and would not hesitate to use the Partnership again in the future.

records.title: Would look elsewhere next time
records.text: Okay so this was a tough one to rate. On the one hand, we did complete on both our sale and our purchase, so hence no lower than three stars. We have used the partnership twice before and found them to be really efficient and detail driven with great communication. This time around our biggest issue was around a lack of a sense of urgency and really quite poor communication. The number of times I asked for a call back that never arrived and how rare it was I actually managed to get through to the solicitor on my case made for a frustrating experience at times. The partnership also communicated very poorly with the estate agents on both sides, this led to me being the only port of call for communication and made the whole process much more stressful than it needed to be, which considering the thousands of pounds in fees you are paying, really is quite disappointing.The issue with the partnership is that it is a fairly large organization so it is dependent on which solicitor/team you end up with. Also they have different departments dealing with different stages like a separate sales team, completion team and also a paralegal support. This has its benefits but also means it is quite difficult to actually speak to the key solicitor working on your case. I would likely look for a smaller solicitor with better communication skills going forward and this view was shared by both my seller and buyer's solicitors.

records.title: Just ok
records.text: Working almost entirely via an online portal was frustrating. When I had questions, often they went unexplained/not replied. Previous property sales I have had direct contact with legal which makes the process much more seamless. TP we're ok but I wouldn't use them again.

records.title: Uber professional, human touch needed
records.text: The Partnership portal was very well organized. It was easy to locate documents and to know where in the process we were with regard to our property purchase. However the solicitor we worked with was professional to the point of lacking, dare we say, a human element. She would respond exactly as you would expect a solicitor to. At various points we felt told off. Go with this company if you're happy with stone cold business. If you'd prefer someone warmer, I'd choose a smaller firm.

records.title: OK but could have been better
records.text: It was a simple transaction and most of it was smooth. There were still last minute exchange issues despite advance notice that I would be abroad with only email access. They also shredded documents that they had promised to return.

records.title: We felt there were large delays
records.text: We felt there were large delays, few updates. It took the sellers team to get in touch with me personally to ask what was happening. We had been told it was the seller delaying matters.Once past this hiccough things improved markedly. The contract small print, leasehold conditions and what one should be aware are difficult for laypeople to decipher so guidance in these areas would have been appreciated.Thank you

records.title: Improvement of services
records.text: It took 20 weeks to complete the property purchase. It is quite a long time. This totally affect my plan. It would be better that the solicitor could have a video conference to explain the details of the purchase and any points that need to pay attention. As a layman, we do not total understand what all the legal documents are refer to and what should be pay attention.

records.title: Distinctly average & lacks a personal touch
records.text: There is nothing inherently bad about or wrong with The Partnership, they are just (in my view) distinctly average conveyancers.  The online portal that they use as the main point of communication can sometimes be used to keep you at arms' length, so the whole experience lacks a personal touch.They also do not advise on anything related to the Building Safety Act, so would not recommend them to act for you on the sale or purchase of a long leasehold flat which is affected by this legislation.  Also, whilst they claim to be aware of the difficulties of dealing with third party management companies and leaseholders, they are not timely and efficient in sending enquiries to those parties, which can lead to delays.Ultimately, they get the job done, but there are other service providers out there who do it better.

records.title: It came together in the end for which I…
records.text: It came together in the end for which I am grateful but most of the first couple of months were a struggle, as emails were not answered, weekly updates were thin and vague, the whole process took around 6 months to complete. Possibly due too many clients taken on at once

records.title: Achieved result but with some anxiety along the  way
records.text: Everything went well and we were able to do it without delays on the Partnership's side. They were very helpful in answering any questions I had and the response time I got when I asked a question was very quick. However, there were occasions where a deadline was approaching and days went by without an update on how things are going, which I found unsettling, as I had no indication whether we were going to be able to hit the deadline or not. This could be a personal thing, but for me the more information and the more updates - the better.

records.title: The service was adequate but…
records.text: The service was adequate but communication was poor. We were recommended the partnership as we are overseas but continually got phone calls in the middle of the night! The replies were slow and we never felt like our own circumstances were understood.

records.title: So so…
records.text: Seemed a little reactive rather than proactive. Lots of last minute delays and surprises which could have been dealt with earlier.

records.title: It is done, but......
records.text: The overall experience was rather stressful. The interest of the client was not placed at the highest and it took them 5 weeks to get a response and I have to get my previous solicitor to help them. The Portal was not the easiest to use.

records.title: Not especially impressed
records.text: Ok. More expensive that other quotes I got but I don’t know if the service was worth it. Lacked info on additional fees that were added. Not sure I would recommend.

records.title: Fine in the end
records.text: It was very much a ‘cut and paste’ rather than a personalised approach through the portal but all went through fine in the end.

records.title: OK service, nothing spectacular.
records.text: For achieving the intended result, The Partnership did fine. We purchased a property, and all legal requirements were clearly completed, and mostly in a timely manner. Their portal service which they use for clients is a nice feature and helps keep all useful information together in one place. However we felt their customer service was not the best. We were asked for certain documents repeatedly, even though we'd submitted them already. During the money laundering checks I had to remind them of documents we'd already sent the week or so prior. Then, we noticed they were simply copy pasting responses to us that they were clearly writing to someone else. Their message to us, their actual clients, would begin; "We've informed our clients ..." These weren't important messages, but it was not a good look that they couldn't even be bothered to write a message from scratch to us; or at least review what they were sending. Finally, response times were not great - except when it came to them receiving money. Typically we'd wait 24 hours for a response to an enquiry, which was fine ... except when they were requesting money, and then their responses would be within the hour. I could not reach our main solicitor on the phone except during such a time. Fortunately the legal assistant was available on the phone to deal with my non-money related enquiries. Overall it gave the impression that The Partnership were ok to do the bare minimum for us, but no further than that. In my opinion, when it comes to such a huge decision & cost involved in purchasing a property, you'd like to know your solicitor is doing their utmost to meet your needs.

records.title: Average
records.text: I had high expectations from an award winning firm which I assumed would be client focused, but it didn't meet my expectations. I'm happy with their conveyancing work and efficiency, but I'd give a rating of average for overall service satisfaction as a result of not that high standard customer service. My main point is they were not proactive and do not have the client focus mindset. The attitude I felt is to complete box ticking and wait, that is it. The experiences I'd quote (1) a weekly update at a critical stage was outdated. When the update becomes a formality, what is the value. Plus, when I called to challenge that, I didn't even receive an apology over the phone for their internal break of communication, despite I asked for it directly. (2) My various 'small' questions via the portal, because they were not 'important' I guess, never got answered. When only a single line could have won a happy client, what a waste of opportunity (3) I sold my property but didn't receive the proceeds on the day of completion as I was promised. I got told it had been due to an error in the agent's system, which apparently had easily been identified and resolved afterwards - following my complaints. I had no idea why this was not identified and resolved on the day, I could only guess that they had not done enough. I'd expect all efforts to be made on a completion day to ensure it goes smoothly, chasing then sitting there waiting, risking it not be completed on a completion day was not acceptable to me. But that's what happened. I regretted trusting their words that the money would be in that day and waited till end of the day to query about that, that is - I queried myself, no one cared to warn me even at that point I wouldn't get the money as I had been assured. I blamed myself, if I had chased them earlier, it could have been resolved in time. But this shouldn't be my job. Overall, the service was delivered - I was told they were performing in line with their service standard - but I did expect more and it could have been better. It is professional service we are talking about after all. Another general comment. I think phone call and email communications shouldn't be entirely replaced by the secured portal when dealing with clients. There are times when the portal is not as convenient or efficient, not to mention the operational risk as seen from the recent cyber incident in the legal sector.

records.title: Didn’t receive paper copy’s of sale as I ask for
records.text: Not a lot of communication unless you ring them up

records.title: A very stressful time spent to get the…
records.text: A very stressful time spent to get the process done. A day before exchange of key i got an email from HTB that there was a problem on the papers submitted by my lawyers. I had a flight to catch that i changed last week due to late work done by the team handling my case. But im glad there was this gentleman Name Oscar. He got this work done on the last day. I must say he did a great job since it was very difficult situation for me because it was not convenient for me to miss my family wedding and change the tickets again by paying 2000£ extra

records.title: Sadly not as I expected
records.text: I had previously used the partnership for sale of my house and found it very efficient and professional. This time it was different. My portal was not updated and old info was left at the top of the messages list. Information was not forthcoming when I asked for it and it was avery confusing process. I had to complain once about delays in responding to my requests.

records.title: Was professional but very painful…
records.text: Was professional but very painful having to deal with how you communicate messages

records.title: Incredibly slow
records.text: Incredibly slow, with minimal information in their updates.  Would not  recommend them at all.

records.title: Exceptionally frustrating process and lack of up-dates, would not recommend
records.text: We used this very review pilot to source the best Solicitor team to sell our flat.   Super disappointed with the process.  We started in May and spent days loading on all the required documentation onto the portal.  No idea why as every time the team required copies they asked us again, and again.  This may however have been because we had 3 sets of Solicitors with zero continuity between then, hugely frustrating.   The 'weekly up-dates' are just holding statements, so I spent most of my time chasing up the team and actually having to personally manage discussions with some of the leasing companies and building management teams to expedite the process.  Maybe we were simply unlucky, but I would certainly not recommend using The Partnership.

records.title: Never answer what you ask
records.text: Never answer what you ask. Do things at the last minutes just not like professional.

records.title: Lacking in proactivity
records.text: The responsiveness was incredibly slow, our move date got pushed back several times due to actions not being completed.  We were waiting weeks for documents to be provided by the council when you could just go and get them online, which my wife ended up doing.  In fact we ended up tackling more queries that our solicitors.  If I could have held back some of our fee I would have done, tackling these queries took hours of our time when this is what we paid the partnership to do.The portal feature was useful but in general the lack of proactivity would mean I would not recommend the partnership or use them again

records.title: Is there anybody there?…
records.text: We sent multiple messages and frequently got no response or  replies to questions or concerns. Weeks went by without any proper contact

records.title: Michaela and Atena were lovely and…
records.text: Michaela and Atena were lovely and helpful. Two things were not great, I was asked when I was thinking of completing and I stated that end of September as my tenancy was ending. Then I was not informed that the searches were completed and therefore I felt we stalled in the moving date. When I questioned how much longer the searches would take, I found that they were complete and suddenly that day I received many forms to read and complete. Secondly I had to chase Fred and ask what was happening as I had not received any messages from him, it is easy to forget that we as the general public do not do this very often and therefore need communication to know what to do next. I should not have to chase you for information.

records.title: A lot of work needed
records.text: I think I found the lack of proactive responses, honest updates (rather than boiler plate ones) and accountability for mistakes really difficult. The only reason this isn't a one is that I appreciate how complex my situation was. The things that need fixing here are basic communication and humanity. I would not choose to use this supplier again.

records.title: Your staff did not reply to my email…
records.text: Your staff did not reply to my email enquiries on 12/9/2024 and 13/9/2024 ! I had the feeling that your Co. Is holding my sales proceed for your own interest !

records.title: Nice interface, not great service
records.text: They got the transaction over the line (eventually, with the seller threatening to pull out in the last week before exchange due to the slow timelines), but then were quite negligent in their work to ensure that the retainer for service charge arrears was paid by the seller, even though clear proof of the arrears were given. I understand that they’re not in control of whether the seller pays, but the partnership employee on the case didn’t even notice that the initial transfer was insufficient and passed the funds onto me thinking nothing was wrong. Then they basically washed their hands of the issue and advised I contact another solicitor, despite their inadequacy being partly at fault for the situation. If they had pushed back initially before the retainer expired and before the funds were transferred to me, there would have been more time to resolve this. I am now > £400 out of pocket as a FTB. Would not use the partnership for future transactions and would not recommend.

records.title: Got there in the end but very…
records.text: Got there in the end but very unhelpful. Would definitely never use the Partnership again, have warned others against them and my estate agency also said they're no longer recommending the Partnership to clients. I'm a first time buyer and not from the UK so maybe my expectations for actually getting at least a decent service were too high. I definitely think they took thousands of pounds from me with very little to show for it. Very much 'check it yourself', 'we already sent that to you, check this document we have named really illogically' and 'computer says no' type of experience. I have 0 faith that if there was something alarming in the paperwork that Nicole would have highlighted it to me. I'm guessing they're understaffed as well or otherwise just don't provide any holiday/sick cover which I think led to at least 2 weeks delay on my exchange on what should have been a quick, no chain process. I felt really stupid when I asked any questions because the response tended to be se frosty so definitely not ideal for a first time buyer, and I did extensive research myself. I did however like the portal and at the beginning the staff was fairly engaged, I think I was just given a below average or potentially overworked solicitor.

description:
Equilaw is a market leading and award winning firm of solicitors specialising in Equity Release. 

Recognised by financial advisers nationwide for our niche work and experience in this specialist area of law, Equilaw is acknowledged as one of the market leaders in this sector. Every case is handled by our in-house team, made up of expert lawyers and legal professionals. We offer clients in-depth guidance on the equity release product which has been recommended to them.

In our experience, clients prefer to work with financial advisers who work closely with a leading solicitor in the field as it provides added confidence in the equity release process.

We have always been unique, in that we are the only law firm which deals solely with legal advice and conveyancing for homeowners taking equity release.

This enables us to give bespoke advice as to the details of the equity release plan and the legal obligations that attach to it. We do not tread on the toes of the adviser by recommending products or by discussing product suitability

Since 2008 we have been consistently winning awards for our Equity Release service. Our most recent award was the winner of best conveyancer 2020, awarded by The Equity Release Awards. We have won best conveyancer at the Equity Release awards 11 times now.

records.title: Equilaw (Gloucester office) are so helpful.
records.text: Equilaw (Gloucester) has just helped me navigate my way successfully through a complicated Equity Release Lifetime Mortgage process on my bungalow. This has released vital necessary funds. The whole team there were friendly, helpful and efficient. Particularly I want to 'mention' and thank Tiarna Crowther, my Case Manager, and Sam Gourley, Case Assistant, in light of their specific work, time and efforts on my situation. Nothing was too much trouble - and I'm the type who likes to clarify and understand every single detail as it comes along! So, my grateful thanks, and I've no hesitation in confirming from my own experience that Equilaw was just the right firm to help me.

records.title: Huge thanks to Eva and Paige.
records.text: Eva and Paige dealt with the sale of my parents property and will subsequently be dealing with the purchase of a new one. They were helpful, empathetic, diligent and informative all the way through. The sale was not an easy one due to outside factors but they both worked extremely hard to ensure a smooth completion. I can’t thank them enough for their efforts.

records.title: Explained everything from start to…
records.text: Explained everything from start to finish, kept us informed at every step of the process. Thank you Keeley McRoberts for all your help. Would recommend to anyone else who is thinking of equity release.

records.title: Many thanks to Olivia and Chloe for…
records.text: Many thanks to Olivia and Chloe for managing to push our case through before the end of the year. records.title: Spouse Settlement Visa
records.text: I found this service to be very helpfull. I did pay the full fee which I thought would give more help in compiling documents for the application but this is not the case.As a client you are responsible for putting the final package together and sending it to the UKVI (Home Office) within 10days after your partner has submitted biometric and health data. Prior to this period the client is asked to send all their supporting documents which they have compiled to Swift Immigration to be checked and if these are not sufficient Swift Immigration will advise that extra documents or more comprehensive documents are needed for the application package.After their final reveiw they will ask the client to collate the application giving a list of documents required and Swift Immigration sends a covering letter to attach to your application package plus the completed UKVI application forms. The service is very friendly and informative and they do fill in the actual application forms but all supporting documents have to be compiled by the client. I did find it very confusing as Swift Immigration did not have any system in place to advise the client on the procedural steps for obtaining a Visa and with my wife living outside the UK this made things considerably more difficult.

records.title: Ridiculous communication on their part
records.text: I am a Canadian citizen applying for a spousal visa to be able to stay with my husband in The UK. I reached out to Swift because they were recommended to me. I left an email inquiry and received a call back immediately. I gave Jonah all the information he asked for. On the initial call he kept asking the same questions repeatedly as though he was not taking down the information and I started to get a bit nervous because I felt that the details needed to be clear on my situation. He told me he would need to double check something with another solicitor and would call me back immediately. I didn’t hear from him for 2 days. I called the agency as I had not heard anything. They put me through to him - I stressed that this was very time sensitive so I needed to know next steps. He said he had confirmed information and would send me the package via email and confirmed my email address. Nothing was sent. Over the course of 2 weeks and over the holidays I left messages and sent emails to enquire why I hadn’t received anything. I didn’t overly expect to hear back during holidays although they still appeared to be open. The first week of January I decided to try again but ask for a different agent as Swift had good reviews - I called. The phone was answered and another gentleman offered to put me through to Jonah. I politely explained that I would prefer someone else as there was a severe breakdown in communication. He said not a problem, he would gather my information from what they had on file and someone would be in touch with me later that day. That was 2 weeks ago. Have heard nothing since. There also seems to be a clause within the agreement with swift in that you cannot leave a negative review after signing with them. I’m glad I didn’t sign on with them as they’re completely unreliable for such a serious situation as immigration: if I could rate them zero I would.

I'm not sure how they deal other cases but mine was done online exchanging emails and files. Looks like it could have been done from home with no issues. I finally received my visa (yesterday 11/12/2020 after almost 9 months after applying for it (April 2020). Not a single email from them to check on the process for this whole time and yesterday they literally just forwarded to me the email they received from home office. There is not a single shade of care for their customers. I know I will never look for their services again and will never recommend it.

records.title: Warmly recommended
records.text: Extremely professional, responsive, supportive and friendly. A big thank you to Emma and her team for successfully guiding us through a rollercoaster ride of a chain sale / purchase. If you’re looking for a stellar conveyancer, then you’ll find exactly that in Lets Move Conveyancing.

records.title: Excellent service from Lets Move…
records.text: Excellent service from Lets Move Conveyancing. Emma was Great. Purchase completed very quickly and with no fuss. The online portal is great for keeping up with what’s happening with the move.Response to all communications were was fast and efficient. Would recommend and we will definitely use them again.

records.title: Really efficient, great service throughout
records.text: Rebecca and Vicky worked really quickly on our house sale/purchase. Always answered any query efficiently on the phone or email and kept us informed throughout the process. The portal for the required documents was easy to navigate too. We felt in safe hands and their service out shone other solicitors in our chain. Thanks so much, we will definitely recommend to friends and family

records.title: Because I could not do the ID check
records.text: Because I could not do the ID check on line I had to visit the office. The address is Selby road but the entrance is on another road near the junction with Selby road. I got hopelessly lost and went past the entrance but did not realize it was there. I live in Hull so not familiar with the roads.Apart from that I found the all staff helpful and patient with me. I used Lets Move for buying a new build and then for selling.

records.title: Good but hard to justify the increased cost
records.text: Went with them as they were recommended by the mortgage broker but more expensive than other solicitors I looked at. No real issues with them, they completed the sale in a timely manner, could talk to them when I needed and ask questions and overall a good experience for first home purchase. But given that they were more expensive than every other solicitor I didn't see what I got for the extra cost.

records.title: Communication the only let down
records.text: Overall very good experience but communication on all fronts was the only reason it’s not a 5 star. Had communication been better between ourselves and the vendors solicitors it would have been better and less stressful. Rachel just needs to improve on that front. It shouldn’t be that hard and at times we felt we had to endlessly pester her for answers. Our buyers solicitors also stated that communication was very slow….

records.title: Helpful staff
records.text: Helpful staff. Quick to respond to my phone calls and emails. Kept me informed of position on day of completion and quick clear invoicing.   The only difficulty was finding the premises they work from to drop paperwork off. Either clear signage or mini map included in their sales pack would be useful.

records.title: Solid job in the end but really…
records.text: Solid job in the end but really difficult to get information out of them during the process, which made it incredibly stressful. Can be very difficult to speak to via a telephone call. (by this I mean getting through to someone) If this improved I’d have been incredibly happy with the service as it picked up on some key things during the purchase process and I’m pleased with the end product and price, but the communication front needs to improve!

records.title: It was my first time going through the…
records.text: It was my first time going through the house selling process.  When I needed information or explanation Let’s Go always took time to explain the process. I will certainly seek their help in the buying process.

records.title: Everything was handled quickly and it…
records.text: Everything was handled quickly and it was really straight forward. Our file was picked up quickly when our case handler was away. My only criticism was that the information provided in the emails was too brief and I had to probe for more information. As a first time buyer, I just felt I needed a little more information. I would instruct again!

records.title: Friendly service
records.text: Friendly service, quick to respond.Don’t bother downloading the app, it never updated as you progressed. Team responsive and helpful.

records.title: Recommended
records.text: App updates not do good Communication great and that is very important at a very stressful time of life .Thank you to the whole team

records.title: A great team of staff
records.text: A great team of staff, especially Fiona and Deborah. Kept me indate and were very informative and understanding. Great correspondence and quick to respond.

records.title: Overall very good service
records.text: Overall very good service. The only bad point was the confusion over stamp duty costs.

records.title: Focussed
records.text: Focussed, well organised and realistic advice given.  No delays, no drama.

records.title: Very efficient and good value for money.
records.text: Date of experience: 29 June 2023

records.title: First time buyer in the UK
records.text: This company came recommended by my mortgage broker as I was new to the country.  I found them efficient, thorough and helpful.I was involved in a particularly difficult chain and there seemed to be a lot of going back and forth and I have to admit that at times I felt that I would have liked a bit more contact from my solicitor, but in the end the job was done and I am pleased with the experience.

records.title: Keeping in touch on all developments
records.text: Date of experience: 27 July 2023

records.title: Adele and Janet were very helpful and…
records.text: Adele and Janet were very helpful and friendly throughout the process. We did have a few issues with the sale but Adele and Janer were so helpful and got the job done. Thanks for all your help.

records.title: Good service
records.text: I was dealing with Gary for a pre auction report. It was quite late and Gary did a quick turnover. I was very happy with his service. I will definitely use him in the future.

description:
The firm was established in 1999 by the current Managing Director from a single desk and has grown steadily since formation in all of its main practice areas.

We are happy to meet with you at any of our locations or you can work with us from anywhere without a face-to-face meeting via phone, videocall, email or our client portal.

records.title: Sale of property in Sevenoaks
records.text: Natalie Chan provided a very efficient service with regards the property we were selling in Sevenoaks. Email communications were clear and where there was a need for phone calls Natalie was always helpful in answering questions, which she did in a bright and cheerful way. I would definitely recommend. So, in conclusion, I am a happy customer. Thank you.

records.title: Fantastic Experience with Vaishnavi!
records.text: As a first-time buyer, I was really nervous about the whole process. Vaishnavi, my conveyancer, was absolutely amazing! She has such a lovely manner and was always there to answer any questions I had. She kept me informed every step of the way. From offer to completion, it took about 10 weeks, if not less. I'm really impressed and would definitely recommend her.

records.title: First Time buyer purchase
records.text: As a first-time buyer with lots of questions, I couldn’t have asked for better support than I received from Lawcomm Solicitors. Carolyn S. was absolutely amazing—quick to respond, patient, and incredibly efficient. She made the whole process smooth and stress-free, keeping me informed and reassured throughout. I highly recommend them for their professionalism and excellent service!

records.title: Natalie was fantastic
records.text: Natalie was fantastic, her and the team at Lawcomm kept us well informed on our sale and were very professional and nothing was too much trouble. I would definitely recommend them.

records.title: Highly recommend from a first time buyer
records.text: Highly recommend. As a first time buyer we weren’t too sure on the process but used Lawwcomm solicitors and they were fantastic. Especially Carolyn who worked on our case, she kept us updated with everything and was quick to respond to me. She did everything very fast and answered any questions we had. 10/10

records.title: Carolyn Shakespeare
records.text: Carolyn Shakespeare has made this a very easy process which was really appreciated as it was my mothers home, which needed to be sold due to her passing away. Thank you so much.

records.title: Natalie Chan
records.text: Read through the reviews and hoped Natalie would be available for our conveyancing as everyone was singing her praises.She was luckily and it was just as well as the whole process was beset with pitfalls and problems from the other parties.Natalie was always contactable or would phone straight back, diligent with informing the rest of the chain, reassuring with information and charming with a nice sense of humour.In contrast I described our buyer and her woeful virtue signalling solicitor efforts as a "catalogue of incompetence" so it was a challenge.Wards estate agents offered me the services of their in-house solicitor but I chose Natalie and saved £1500 on their fee.Win win situation, superb in every department thank you Natalie and a bottle of Moet is winging it's way to the office in appreciation.Jon and Anna Spreadbury

records.title: Negotiated a tricky sale
records.text: I can't praise Sanjib highly enough. He always responded quickly to requests and emails and made a stressful sale easier. We were losing hope on to our 3rd buyer through no fault of Lawcomm. Sanjib consistently worked quickly and efficiently throughout.  I also found the online Howla system useful for tracking the case.

records.title: Great support through arduous experience of buying new build property
records.text: As first time buyers we needed more guidance and support than usual maybe; and Natalie at Lawcomm was always helpful, kind, and prompt with her updates. Everything didn't go swiftly or smoothly (because it was a new build perhaps) but Natalie Chan was always ready to give us reassurance and great support throughout the process. Thanks so much!

records.title: As a first-time buyer
records.text: As a first-time buyer, I was initially overwhelmed by the property buying process, but I couldn’t have asked for better guidance than what I received from Pavan. He expertly guided me through each step, making sure I understood everything clearly. No matter how many questions I had, Pavan was always prompt and patient in answering them, providing reassurance every time I called.I’d also like to thank Donna, who was an incredible support, backing up Pavan seamlessly on his off days. Together, they made the entire experience smooth and stress-free.Thank you, Pavan and Donna, for your professionalism and dedication—I’m truly grateful for your help in making this process a success!

records.title: Recommended for conveyancing
records.text: Recommended for conveyancing. After the first month, I was switched to Sanjib who was the consummate professional and was always on hand to answer questions - very promptly and consistently and even late at night.I'd like to thank them for their guidance as a First Time Buyer.

records.title: Would use again
records.text: Natalie Chan was extremely helpful and professional. I have given 4 stars due to some initial struggles with a different individual, but once Natalie took over there was a lot of communication and updates given from Natalie, and a lot of hard work to get through some of the nitty gritty elements. Natalie persevered and got us to our desired outcome.

records.title: Good service
records.text: After a slow start at set up, the overall process went smoothly once assigned a clear contact Sanjib. He communicated clearly and in a timely manner. All queries answered efficiently, and explained well by email or phone. All in all a good experience.

records.title: Good experience with this law firm and conveyancer
records.text: Shirley Sherlock, our conveyancer, was most thorough,patient and diligent throughout the sale as it took a very long time to complete. She was fast to respond to e mail and kept us informed. My complaint is that as we live in Canada, Lawcomm should make the conveyancers able to callout of the UK…this was most inconvenient for both parties.

records.title: Saira Ibrahim was helpful.
records.text: Saira Ibrahim was helpful and polite when dealing with my 20% staircasing. Compliance was a big issue as I had to provide statements from three different institutions and 9 accounts over the last six months. I was unable to activate statements on an adhoc basis which meant telephone calls and branch visits. I felt that I was drip fed the instructions over 2 months rather than being instructed in one go which was time consuming. At one time, I thought I was going to miss the deadline of the valuation and it appeared from the conversation with Saira that she had a significant workload. However, when it mattered the effort was put in so that I met the deadline.

records.title: Josh Smith is my solicitor and all in…
records.text: Josh Smith is my solicitor and all in all I am happy with the service. He is thorough in his work and responsible. He has an eye to details and I feel safe and protected working with him. There has been a few hiccups along the line, especially regarding issues regarding Building Safety Act that I wish would have been flagged up earlier in the process. I also wish there is more timely responses/communication but I appreciate he must be very busy. Despite all that we got there in the end! I am thankful for all his help.

records.title: Lawcomm provided an excellent service…
records.text: Lawcomm provided an excellent service once our house move was handled by Joshua Smith. Josh himself deserves a 5* review, but Lawcomm a 4* as our initial solicitor wasn't up to the job and we had to request our file be handled by someone else. Thankfully, once our file was passed to Josh everything went perfectly. He was excellent throughout, supporting us all the way through the process. He was also always on hand when we had questions and always picked up the phone to call us where things had changed.I'd also like to thank Josh for his work in quickly rectifying a number of issues we had following our case being handled by his colleague. Josh took on the case, spotted a number of errors made by his colleague and rectified those following discussion with us, and did so within a matter of hours.

records.title: Good communication
records.text: Saira was very helpful. Always went through every bit of paperwork explaining it  in great detail. Seems very pleasant to speak to over phone. Professionally speaking over phone and email. Would go to again. Thank you for all your help and for speeding things up so I could get into my house

records.title: Sale of my parents home
records.text: We had to sell our parents home as they moved into care.Carolyn Shakespeare dealt with all the legal aspects of the sale and was very efficient and helpful.She dealt with all of our queries promptly and was always prompt and courteous.Vey many thanks

records.title: Rough start. Jasmeet saved the day
records.text: What started off as a rocky relationship with lawcomm they soon pulled our house completion off in uncertain times with covid. We were very unhappy initially with service provided  with the initial solicitor he was unresponsive and delayed the process by not submitting appropriate documents etc and he kept lying for dates and would not give us dates to aim for completion. Our luck changed when said person left the company what seems like a good move for lawcomm. Then came along jasmeet what an absolute god send for us she was lovely responsive to emails and gave goals and dates that were attainable if it was not for jasmeet we would not be in our property on time. She really was over the moon for us when we completed as you could hear it in her voice and restored faith in lawcomm for me as a solicitors from being close to walking away to saving our purchase. If it's possible whatever you do ask for jasmeet you will not be disappointed. As first time buyers it was a difficult journey and was not without its hurdles initially. I would of given 5 stars but the rough start we had outweighed this. Thankyou jasmeet for helping us achieve our life long dream at owing our own homeJamie and phoebe

records.title: Conveyancer Services from LawComm - Highly Recommend!
records.text: I recently sold my London flat and engaged the conveyancing services of LawComm Solicitors. Having previously utilised LawComm for the purchase of the same property, I returned as a client.Natalie Chan was my main point of contact at LawComm for this sale. I found Natalie to be proactive, clear in her communication, diligent in following up on action points, and always available to address any questions I had.My overall experience with this process was exceptionally smooth, without any hiccups. The pricing with LawComm was competitive, and I would confidently recommend their services for anyone looking to hire a conveyancer again.

records.title: I have had an excellent experience with…
records.text: I have had an excellent experience with Carolyn Shakespeare and would not hesitate to use her again

records.title: Disappointing
records.text: We were recommended Lawcomm by our estate agent and mistakenly thought it would speed up the process. We were initially assigned a solicitor who raised paperwork for a single seller when we are joint sellers, causing a delay. Then we were assigned different solicitor for reasons unknown to us. Our new solicitor was not easy to communicate with, not replying to emails and impossible to get hold of by phone and as this was our 1st time selling a property we had reasonable questions  that we would have liked answering. We had to contact the estate agent for them to constantly chase lawcomm and through this discovered that the buyers solicitor had raised questions for our response weeks before they were actually passed to us by our solicitor. The final disappointment was when we eventually completed we were told to expect our money by latest 5pm that day which was unfortunately a Friday. When this didn’t happen we spent a stressful weekend not being able to contact anybody, apart from our bank who confirmed that no payment was pending. When we eventually managed to contact someone on Monday morning, the excuse was that ‘accounts didn’t get round to it on Friday’ Poor show, wouldnt recommend

records.title: Short review as house sale still in progress
records.text: So far very slow and need chase up phone call to move on to the next step. Good app to follow the case. Very polite staff and available 7 days per week. Still ongoing and will complete a proper review once completed.

records.title: Terrible service and process full of mistakes
records.text: I have given two stars as our conveyancing process did go through but the entire process has been full of mistakes, incorrect advice and missing paperwork. I chose Lawcomms because they were on the panel for our mortgage company and were local. The reviews seemed good but this was not my experience. Our first issue was around using a Lifetime ISA, I had to argue with the conveyancer for months around being able to withdraw the money based on an estimated completion date. I did not want this to hold up the completion process. Eventually they withdrew the money but it was a drawn out process. Then we had issues with using a gifted deposit, the process was frustrating for my family and was drawn out. I understand there are checks which need to be completed but they were asking for a lot of unnecessary financial information which upset my family. Then our contracts were missing the plans for the house, I only noticed this because I went through the paperwork in great detail and had to go down to the office and ask for the paperwork, so as not to delay the exchange. As we were purchasing a shared ownership property we had to pay rent upfront before moving in, the amount asked for on our completion statement was wrong, this is very simple information that they had access to. Finally we had to pay all of the conveyancing fees upfront and not on completion. I dislike this as it is not common practice and meant I had no recourse for the terrible service I received. I would not recommend Lawcomms, yes their fees are lower than others but that is due to their lackluster service.

records.title: Absolutely dreadful experience…
records.text: Absolutely dreadful experience purchasing our house. Our solicitor Lorraine was rude, patronising and actually lied to us about the bank not providing her with the necessary information. It turned out she didn’t have legal authority, (and had never mentioned I needed to give that to her) but rather than tell me that she asked me to call them as “if we work together one of us will get the final settlement” she said this knowing she’d not be able to get the information, so she laid it on me 2 days before our move, despite knowing almost 2 weeks earlier that I’d need to either get this for her or provide legal authority. We were left with 1 day to transfer all the funds, or it would have fallen through. Never again, I wish I’d never had any contact with Lawcomm they made an already stressful experience unbearably challenging for us on so many more occasions.

records.title: Avoid at all costs
records.text: The worst experience. Just the worst. We were unlucky enough to have Josh assigned to our case initially. Didn't respond to emails, made some basic GDPR errors, and was quite happy to blame his team members for mistakes made. Sloppy, shoddy and unprofessional. For reasons never explained, our case was then assigned to Carolyn, who was much better. However, throughout the process we never felt we were in safe hands, and found Lawcomms to be reactive rather than proactive. They made an already stressful process much more stressful. I'd say avoid this lot and spend your money on a decent solicitor who knows what they are doing.

records.title: DO NOT USE
records.text: DO NOT USEAbsolutely shocking company. Shocking communication .Over worked.Totally incompetent.Does not know proceduresDoes not care how long it takesDO NOT USE

records.title: Lawcomm are extremely slow and progress…
records.text: Lawcomm are extremely slow and progress is minimal. Getting hold of someone via the phone is hard and emails are never responded to. We have had to change solicitors due to poor handling of our sale and purchase. Avoid

records.title: Don’t waste your money!
records.text: Don’t waste your money!I agreed to pay a little extra and instruct this solicitor as I was led to believe that using them would help speed up the house purchase process, I believe they have made it worse!Tried to urgently contact Carolyn Shakespeare for 4 working days, made 73 calls and 2 emails, phone is constantly engaged ( or off hook?) . Use an online solicitor, they are a lot cheaper and at least reply to emails.

records.title: Worse than bad
records.text: My house sale has been held up by the utter incompetence of Lawcomm who are acting for a purchaser in a short chain. The person at Lawcomm dealing with the case left the company without notice, and for over three weeks, nothing happened. They cannot be contacted by phone, and they do not respond to emails. The person in the chain has visited their offices several times and still has zero progress. We have been forced to put our house back on the market as we have no clue when Lawcomm will do its job. Never use this company. Like others who have posted, I will take this to the ombudsman. Their name should be changed to Law-con with the strapline “We are here to make your life difficult”.

records.title: Terrible

We gave you ample opportunity to come back to us with an update, all of our emails and complaints were ignored so therefore this comment will not be removed.

description: Admiral Law are specialists in personal injury claims. If you’ve suffered a personal injury or illness as a result of someone else’s negligence, then Admiral Law can help you get the compensation you are entitled to.

records.title: Really helpful - I didn't know what to do ... !!
records.text: I really didn't know what to do!! ... have not been in an accident before (despite 40 yrs driving) - claim was myself being rear-ended by a driver at around 30 mph, who admitted looking down (phone!!) and not at the road.Once I was able to get past the 'bot' to a person,, she was incredibly helpful and supportive.I was given options for future management via Admiral or Auxillis in a very balanced way.Only comment is of course to make access to the person / advisor easier for those who don't know how to progress.

However, she listened to how I was feeling and showed great sympathy/empathy to my situation.  Highly recommended. Thank you

records.title: Admiral law makes you feel at ease.
records.text: The level of professionalism at admiral law is outstanding. I got a chance to speak to a lovely lady regarding a claim, she listened and replied in a very professional manner, really put me at ease in such hard times, I will forever recommend admiral law. Thank you.

I’d like to thank Samantha and the team for being absolutely amazing.
