records.text: Good customer service, everyone I have spoken to has been very warm and helpful which has made a stressful experience much easier. I have had trouble with adding pictures and footage to the online portal though and have had to call and email them through instead.

records.title: Big thank you to Alex
records.text: My non fault accident happened in July 2021, took almost 3 years to claim to be settled. During that time I had several case handlers, I experienced lack of communication resulting lots of frustration. After two years of limited responses I started to chase them. After several phone calls and lots of attempts to get updated (mostly with no response) I got new case handler named Alex who was able to successfully sort everything out for me within a couple of weeks. Alex kept me informed, guided me through the whole process, gave me supportive and honest advice whether to proceed to court or consider offering of a settlement, he really tried to do his best. I would like to thank him for all his work.

records.title: Very Quick response after accident and…
records.text: Very Quick response after accident and very straight forward

records.title: I have now spoken with three of your…
records.text: I have now spoken with three of your staff, all have been extremely helpful and very polite. I’m not quite sure if it’s a fault of mine, however, I feel it would be more of a smooth experience if just the one person took my case. Also, the same questions were being asked along with the security questions, which I understand needs to be asked. With all said, a pleasant experience from the team that I have chatted with.

records.title: All online, but pretty straightforward.
records.text: Hassle free service but the fees outlined as "up to 25%" actually means 25% so this coulddo to be more transparent. If you like dealing with people, don't use Admiral Law, but if you're happy to process your whole case online then this is the legal firm for you.

records.title: Initial contact was great went downhill
records.text: Initial contact was great. Fortunately we didn't need a hire car, and they arranged a medical, from which I attended a chiropractor for a number of sessions.However, the 6 months deadline for recovery from physical injury arrived before my last appointment. I then felt pressured into agreeing to another medical, as there was no guarantee of pay out for that appointment.  I then recinded that as the process was taking too long, and asked for settlement. This was in August.No communication for ages until I found a phone number ( not right department but put me through) and I was told a reasonable settlement had been proposed!I was the innocent party! I should not be one penny out of pocket! I felt that my law firm was not working for me and just looking for fast resolution on a smallish claim.I stuck to my guns, silence. No one read any of my messages on the message system they use. it took me ringing in early January to discover that the other parties insurance had agreed full pay out.And even now it apparently takes 6 to 8 weeks for payout!!! My experience has added to the stress I already was experiencing from the crash, and I feel it was unnecessarily prolonged due to very poor communication systems with no escalation for the customer when they need to be updated. With the negotiations insurance companies seem to undertake I am so glad I only had compensation and medicals to settle. Goodness knows how anyone gets full cost for car hire if they take that option..we were lucky and didn't need it.I have given 3 stars instead of 2 only because when I did speak to staff they were very helpful and professional. My complaint is about timeliness of and difficulty in contacting someone.

records.title: Not the most proactive
records.text: A very slow process following an accident in January ‘22. It has only just been resolved although I must add I am pleased with the outcome. Had to prompt them several times, by phone,over the 2 years as the online process does not get quick replies.

records.title: Service with replacement car and amount…
records.text: Service with replacement car and amount been paid back after the car was written off

records.title: Consistency
records.text: My claim was opened in 2020 and has been settled in 2024. My experience towards the end has been amazing, and my final case handler has been clear and consistent with everything. Unfortunately, I had multiple case handlers prior to this who would call once, I would explain what happened, then would never speak to them again, meaning my claim was never making any progress. Since my final case handler started, the communication, the consistency and process had run a lot more smoothly.

records.title: I didn’t like the way you have set up…
records.text: I didn’t like the way you have set up the way of communication I can’t contact you directly

records.title: Good overall considering its Insurance
records.text: It was clear and concise but it took a while for them to reach out to me personally. One thing I would recommend they do is if you are needing physical help (such as physiotherapy), they mentioned it's all paid for by them upfront, rather than you paying and then they reimburse you later. Gareth was a lovely employee to work with!

records.title: To begin with I couldn’t fault their…
records.text: To begin with I couldn’t fault their service very attentive. However once I needed more treatment I ended up waiting over a year for an appointment to be rescheduled. This being due to the multiple case handlers my case went to.So just short of 3 years since my accident my case has been settled.

records.title: Good end result but took a long time
records.text: Everybody I spoke with at Admiral Law throughout the 15 months it took to resolve my case was excellent, kept me informed throughout and was clear on timelines and how long things would take. The only reason for not giving a higher score was the number of times my case switched 'handlers' which seemed to elongate an already lengthy process even further, to the point where even the defendants legal team ended up chasing what was happening. But a big thank you to those that were involved as they were courteous and helpful throughout.

records.title: my claim has taken over 2 years and…
records.text: my claim has taken over 2 years and still it is not complete, not a very happy bunny, customer service and response times leave a lot to be desired

records.title: Mixed experience, took time to settle claim
records.text: My claim took a long time to process, most likely due to frequent changes to case handler. Which stalled progress. At times communication was delayed and I needed to chase multiple times to get answers and updates. When I did get through updates were given but only with my most recent case handler did I ever get the follow up I was promised. It started well with good organisation and most recently service was good from my last case handler but I had long periods of time between these when service was below what I would expect.

records.title: Was hit by a car from behind just prior…
records.text: Was hit by a car from behind just prior to house move. Good service but the change of address due to the move seemed to not be taken note of, old address was written on all the documents , logistics issues collecting hire car and arranging damaged car collection. Service is good but could improve common sense

records.title: Not good enough
records.text: I like the quick response.I did not like the general messages/emails that we have received with my partner. The messages are irrelevant to us because they don’t specifically apply to our situation. Why do send to us such a message?.Example is :: why are we being asked to provide details of the other driver who hit us and we have indicated very clearly that the driver did not stop and we don’t have his/her details????

records.title: On filling in Customer Claim Form the…
records.text: On filling in Customer Claim Form the session timed out showing exclamation mark in red triangle icon on all the sections. It was not made clear that this happened b/c of time out nor that previously filled in fields had been blanked out. It should have been made clear that data needed to be "Saved". Or better yet, system should keep data as one clicks on down arrow for next section. Optimally, you shouldn't time out a session in the middle of activity such as typing in text and inputting information. It was a waste of my valuable time under employment which I lost in wages.

records.title: Great start but now frustratingly slow to get any update
records.text: After my accident Admiral Law were really quick to arrange medical assessment and physio. I really appreciated the physio. However, it has been 5 months since the physio ended, 7 months since medical assessment and I’ve had so few updates.  Seems to take over a month to get a reply to any question. From a great start, I am just finding Admiral Law and the lack of communication very frustrating.

records.title: Not the best service
records.text: Online service only is not very good Taking 25% of your uninsured losses is very unfair. This fee should be claimed from thd 3rd Party.There are not independent of Amiral insurance as led to believe.

records.title: 7 month delay
records.text: It took 7 months before my case was allocated to a case handler - so literally nothing happened during that time. Once allocated both the case worker and then the solicitor where really great at keeping in touch and explaining the process. If no delay would have been 5 star

records.title: The Actual Case Handler did a good job
records.text: The Actual Case Handler did a good job. My biggest criticism is that the whole procedure was too drawn out. The Handler was appointed months after the accident rather than days. Therefore, the medical was months after the physiotherapy course was completed.

records.title: It has taken numerous calls to get my…
records.text: It has taken numerous calls to get my claim started. Additionally,  I gave pointers as to who to chase to ascertain the third party insurance responsible as it was a subsidiary of the company I was given. This took 3 months where I was out of pocket to get my excess back. However, once I spoke to the case handler, he took my worries seriously and was able to expedite matters satisfactorily.

records.title: It’s taken… over 3 years to get our…
records.text: It’s taken… over 3 years to get our full settlement. Certainly wouldn’t recommend this Company. We were the innocent part in the incident involved…had to keep chasing for updates .

records.title: Dimitri was excellent
records.text: There is a lot of room for improvement. However, my review is to show my appreciation of the service I received from Dimitri. Dimitri is an asset to the company and completely turned around my view on the company as a whole. Dimitri always made sure to keep my up to date and was always quick at getting back to enquiries. Admittedly I did not have legal cover in my insurance policy and therefore I was not eligible for an individual case handler. But had I had the level of service that Dimitri offered the whole way through the claim, this would have been a 5 star review.

records.title: Finally 3.5 years following an…
records.text: Finally 3.5 years following an accident, having to chase Admiral Law continuously I am receiving my settlement. Considering I paid for this so called service I am appalled. I do not believe I would have received anything of if I had not continued to chase it. Despite recommendations from medical reports for further treatment this did not happen, case handler changed so many times, I had to re read and sign reports on numerous occasions. I will never go to Admiral for insurance again.

records.title: Constantly having to call them to get…
records.text: Constantly having to call them to get updates.Being asked the same questions over and over again.Given an update, called back 6 weeks later and same update given. They did not deal with request from other insurance company

records.title: The whole process was laborious
records.text: The whole process was laborious. Apart from my last agent (one of many), who without, this would have been a 1* review. The case proceeded at a snail's pace due to being passed from agent to agent without a proper handover or follow up. Taking ~4 months to even respond to me between case handler changes.One of my medical exams expired (!?) because it was over a year from the point of exam in which I was recommended a scan, and the actual booking of the scan. Minus the months waited for the medical report to come through which I acknowledge is out of their hands, the aforementioned handovers (or rather lack of) pushed this past the point of expiry.This discovery came at the same time I was informed of the very near DEADLINE for my entire case. I wasn't entirely sure we would meet it. Whilst we did achieve the deadline, it wasn't a comfortable experience. Allowing the expiry to pass due to lack of action very nearly impacted my case.. had it taken long to get the medical report back again (which wasn't unlikely!) this could have easily turned into a case of negligence.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Quick responses at first however didn’t last long which is disappointing. I feel like I’m the one constantly chasing for updates. The whole process is already stressful enough but the lack of communication and slow pace (3 years and counting) in dealing with the case has had a negative impact on my mental health and made an already stressful situation a hell of a lot worse.

records.title: Slow & Painful
records.text: Quick to pay my car out due to write off, minus the excess which was taken. Non-fault accident in August which was admitted back in January. Medical completed and now no response what so ever. portal is useless & no one replies. Admiral Law are quick to jump in when the accident occurred but are slow and awful when it comes to updates and processing. im sending constant reminders for updates. would avoid.

records.title: Poor communication from the off
records.text: Poor communication from the off. So many ‘accidental’ errors that pushed things further and further away from being closed. Constant changes in case handlers. Constantly had to call weekly for updates and complain about how long the process was taking. Hard work from start to finish and I’d never be with Admiral or Admiral Law again.

records.title: I have had 3 case handlers throughout…
records.text: I have had 3 case handlers throughout the time my case has taken to deal with. The first call handler was hard to communicate with and often she had not progressed the case, she was the call handler for nearly 2 years. I found her really poor. The second case handler I had no contact with really and again very little communication. The third case handler whom was asked to settle the case as it had been open for 3 years was amazing, he was very good at communication and very proactive in chasing everything up and settled the case within a number of months.

records.title: I am still awaiting a reply from…
records.text: I am still awaiting a reply from admiral law after a medical assessment two weeks ago, replies to messages go unanswered and accident happened in February, still no resolution. Tried getting in touch with my case handler using number I was given and can't get through, says call failed. I hope that this will be resolved ASAP.

records.title: Very long and tedious experience
records.text: The whole process was far longer than it should have been, 2 years from accident to payout (liability was admitted at the outset). Admiral Law were quick to contact me initially but then nothing seemed to happen. I felt like they were hoping I’d give up. Then my case handler left and I constantly had to chase the new one. After 16 months my case was finally forwarded to the litigation department and I found the solicitor to be very professional and a pleasure to deal with. This still took another 8 months, however for the case to be settled. Even once AL had received payment from the third party, they still took over a week from when they said they’d paid me for me to receive the money.

records.title: Takes to long to resolve the claim
records.text: Takes to long to resolve the claim Incident happened in may 2021. Uninsured driver hit me but didn’t send details to MIB till half way through this year. When questioned it, then documents were sent to me. very disappointed in how long it took to resolve

description:
Irwin Mitchell is unlike any other law firm. Nationally acclaimed, with a strong international capability, we offer a broad range of legal services to national and international organisations and institutions, small and medium-sized businesses and private individuals.


We make a donation to charity for every review we receive. Our chosen charity is Macmillan.

records.title: We have received a fantastic service…
records.text: We have received a fantastic service and support from Katy Daws.  She has always been very responsive to our emails, and helped answer all questions and worries we had.  She has been excellent at keeping us updated and ensured that the defendant was chased when needed. We really appreciate all your help Katy, and would recommend Irwin Mitchell.

records.title: A service that is difficult to put into words…. Just amazing
records.text: Emma created what is known as a very complicated world of legal jargon into an easy to understand process on what was going on, without being condescending. Emma and her team including the independent experts treated me with a high level of respect and compassion in a case that was extremely sensitive to me. I felt at every part of my journey they had my back.I had my whole world torn apart but Emma and her team have helped me and my family start to rebuild it. I will always be grateful to Emma.KRTony

records.title: Maxine Beckett (Support and Rehab…
records.text: Maxine Beckett (Support and Rehab Coordinator) is the best service I've had from IM.  She has been brilliant in every single way....from listening to me rant to responding to emails sent at night and providing links to articles that might answer my questions.  If you have to use IM for any reason (and I hope that you don't as that means something gone's pear shaped!) then ask for Maxine's help.  You won't regret it!

records.title: Kirsty and her team helped me through a…
records.text: Kirsty and her team helped me through a difficult time for almost 2 years! couldn't of done any more to help when dealing woth difficult opposition. Very fast responses and always thinking about the right things to do. Will always be thankful

records.title: Kady Howe was extremely helpful
records.text: Kady Howe was really patient with me and helped my case a lot and I really appreciate the time she waited for me as I was busy doing other things. She was helpful over the phone and explained things clearly, therefore i wouldn’t have been able to do this without her.

records.title: Amazing service received
records.text: We had the good fortune of being assigned with Emma Guy to help us with our Mesothelioma case, she was so understanding kind & helpful nothing was ever too much trouble for her, she came to visit us initially and we warmed to her straight away she has always been an absolute pleasure to deal with So a great big thank you to Irwin Mitchell & especially for all the amazing hard work we received from Emma Guy

records.title: Very happy
records.text: Very happy with the efficient, professional service received so far. Emma Frank has been excellent in helping me with my enquiry. I would defiantly recommend!

records.title: Great service
records.text: I have had excellent advice from the start of my claim and Ms Dawson who was assigned to my claim has been excellent throughout. I have been given regular updates on the claim and it has been settled to my satisfaction.

records.title: Irwin Mitchell is very efficient, and our Solicitor was very supportive.
records.text: This Company was excellent as it immediately stopped our son's Care Home from closing after only three months' notice for no specific reason.  Our Solicitor Kathryn Gooding sent the organisation Sanctuary Care a judicial review, which forced them to go about this legally, and employing a Surveying and a Consultation organisation.  This gave all the residents longer time to find suitable accommodation.  Kathryn went above and beyond her duty, and offered us tremendous support.  She was the only source of comfort to us throughout this appalling nightmare, and always made herself available to talk with us, right till 20th December 2024.  A wonderful young Lady.

records.title: I could not recommend Lewis, Danielle, Carol and the team enough
records.text: I could not recommend Lewis, Danielle, Carol and the team enough. They offered assurance and support at every turn during my case, always providing updates and thorough breakdown at each stage of my case and were always happy to answer any questions at any stage. I always felt we were in safe hands with the whole team throughout which was highly reassuring during a very stressful time for my family. Lewis is an absolute asset to the IM team due to the level of support and knowledge that he offers you. I would highly recommend the team for anyone seeking legal support

records.title: AFCS case support
records.text: I turned to Irwin Mitchell to help support me through my complex AFCS (Armed Forces Compensation Scheme). Having experienced Vets UK before and how they work. I chose to have legal support through this claim. Christie Fitzgerald has been great in communication and dealing with myself and my case thus far but we are only half way through to date and that has been 2 years. I highly value the work that Christie and her colleagues have done to date and highly recommend their services.

records.title: They care
records.text: Irviwn Mitchell are very thorough..i appreciate them wholeheartedly.. always keeping me up to date and informed regarding my claim

records.title: Ben Lyon representing Irwin Mitchell
records.text: Ben Lyon and his team have proven to be professional and caring. My late Wifes Inheritance claim had proven to be a challenge, due to a disruptive defendant intent on delaying and causing as many problems as his limited intelligence could muster. Ben Lyon, together with James Laycock and their team were both professional and patient whilst dealing with a belligerent and quite frankly unprofessional defendant.  I would happily ask Irwin Mitchell to represent my interests should the need arise.

records.title: Professional Service
records.text: Rabi was very detailed and professional in dealing with the preparation of my Will. She made me feel at ease and came across as very knowledgeable in her area of expertise.

records.title: Litigation claim
records.text: When I got in touch with irwin Mitchell, communication was good with Bethany Wale. She has done a fine job for me, even though I thought I would have received more compensation. In all honesty in 2 years of bethany being my handler I've found bethany easy to talk to and very pleasant telephone manner. I would have no hesitation in recommending irwin Mitchell and bethany wale to others.

records.title: Irwin Mitchel handled my compensation…
records.text: Irwin Mitchel handled my compensation claim for loosing my finger tips at work. Found them very informative and kept me informed throughout the process

records.title: My case is still ongoing but the…
records.text: My case is still ongoing but the service I’ve received so far has been very good & I’ve been kept updated as much as I can be & any questions I have get answered straight away. My solicitor is Jemma small (now till ) she is very confident at what she does & she is quick to get things moving, also she is a very nice lady to deal with & communicate with. My case is an upsetting case & Jemma is caring towards that & I put my whole trust in Jemma’s ability for her to win my son’s case.

records.title: Professional & friendly service
records.text: My experience with Irwin Mitchell was in the context of a ‘no win no fee’ claim. I received a very professional & friendly service where everything was explained fully & I was kept updated throughout the claim. A criticism I do have is that the whole process seemed to take a long time & my expectations of the outcome were not managed correctly by the person who initially handled my claim. However the person who subsequently took over my claim, after a review, brought matters swiftly to conclusion. She even replied to an email well out of her normal working hours. Even though the outcome wasn’t what I had initially been led to expect, I felt the reason for this had been explained fully in the end & appropriate advice given.

records.title: Very professional and organised
records.text: I have been with Irwin Mitchel since my accident 2022. Eleanor has been working on my case and regularly asked how I was and kept me updated as the case has progressed. If I had a worry and sent a email she always responded very quickly. I feel very lucky to have had her working on my behalf.

records.title: Settled claim succesfully
records.text: Settled claim successfully kept informed mainly email Would have liked a little more advice and guidance at certain stages of the claim as unsure at times whether to accept the offer made towards settlement  Informed to keep all expenses but had to request expense sheet which was poor on receipt lacking in space and detail.

records.title: Conveyance of House
records.text: We dealt with Laura Over of this company with property transactions over a period September 2022 to date. she was at all times prompt and efficient . The sale of our property took a long time and the conveyance was difficult . At all times Laura gave us good advice and support.We would continue to use this company for our family legal matters as we already have done over many years.

records.title: Thank you to Angela & Irwin Mitchell
records.text: Angela was fantastic throughout, she was consistant with my case for 3.5yr. Nothing was too much trouble, she was very honest and kept me updated at every stage, making things run as smoothly and swiftly as possible. Thank you Angela

records.title: Irwin Mitchell have been been very…
records.text: Irwin Mitchell have been been very professional in handling my claim for medical negligence. Kady Howe has been very helpful in keeping me informed of progress and I’m happy with the service received so far.

records.title: A successful conclusion
records.text: We have had a mixed experience with Irwin Mitchell. We initially put in a claim following sickness while on holiday back in 2017. In the 6 years it has taken to resolve the claim we have had 3, maybe 4, different people working on our case - with varying levels of service. Thankfully the most recent person to deal with our case has been very professional and the claim has finally reached a resolution. Thank you Dawn Banner for your help and guidance to bring what has been a long journey to an end.

records.title: We felt supported by Lucy and listened to.
records.text: We have been supported by Lucy through a very difficult family Will/beneficiary delegation. After losing someone special it’s unfortunate that you have to fight for what is right. Lucy was with us every step of the way and supporting by liaising with the appropriate people to get the best outcome possible. Happy to say the end is in sight for us.  Would have been a 5* it is only less due to cost but this is not anymore than other firms in this area of work and you get what you pay for.

records.title: My experience was very good
records.text: My experience was very good. IM were extremely quick to respond when I first rang after being hit my a car and sustaining a significant injury. They were exceptionally professional and replied to my emails quickly and talked me through the process at each stage. I was kept very well informed with what was happening and even after I settled they were still there to offer advice. I was completely satisfied with my solicitor. If there was one area I would improve it would be the thoroughness of the medical expert.

records.title: Would give a 4.5 if I could
records.text: Had a case started for a claim in 2021, that has just been completed, took some time but due to the other side of this case mainly i think! These people have been very good in communication and overall friendliness ect. I feel as if the first case handler I had wasn’t up to scratch, not sure! Took a long time for replies, had to chase a bit and seemingly took a while for anything, however I got switched to a different handler who got things done in a matter of months!! Special mention to Eleanor Buckley who handled my case in the end, such a fast replier and gets things done!

records.title: Katherine was really helpful and we had…
records.text: Katherine was really helpful and we had quite a tricky case with a very unresponsive third party. As soon as we instructed Katherine she made me feel completly at ease and that she would handle everything and took a lot of the pressure off. I will say that things seemed to get stuck being signed off from compliance for quite long periods of time which was annoying at the start but no other complaints. Was a great service and would highly recommend.

records.title: Great Support
records.text: Communication and availability of the team assigned to my case has been first class and I have felt that I can reach them easily if I needed to.  They explained relevant details and de-mystified some of the more complicated legal terms for me.The only issue has been the timeline of the process which I don't feel was Irwin Mitchell's fault - Premex seem to work very slowly and their communication is somewhat formulaic and sparse.

records.title: Review
records.text: I had an ongoing claim for four years, during which I was assigned multiple case handlers, especially in the first couple of years. The frequent changes in handlers were quite frustrating. However, a colleague of mine recommended Becky Copley, and I cannot recommend her enough. Becky demonstrated exceptional dedication and determination in handling my case. Her communication was consistently clear, and she was always willing to assist, showing immense patience in addressing my queries, and often took the time to speak with me directly. Becky was prompt in responding to emails and regularly provided updates without me needing to request them. Her professionalism and informative approach were truly commendable. Thank you, Becky, for your hard work and commitment – I am incredibly grateful.

records.title: Success Probability
records.text: Disappointed that we didn't achieve a more positive outcome. I would have appreciated an assessment at each stage on the probability of success (define success?). Note that within Australia (where I reside) any legal advice provided has to be accompanied with an assessment of likely cost and probability of success. Maybe this is something that Irwin Mitchell should investigate further. Costs increased above what was originally anticipated however this was expected and noted as we progressed.

records.title: Excellent outcome
records.text: I am really pleased with the outcome of my claim and grateful for the advice received from Jodi Whitworth. However it is over 4 years since my accident and although my treatment and the pandemic caused long delays I did have to chase up by phone and email, multiple times, to ask about progress on my claim as there were long periods when nothing had progressed, which was frustrating at the time.

records.title: Visa application [IM-Active.FID3290805]
records.text: Service from the lawyer very kind and good response time, significant delays on the visa even if fast track/priority service was payed, I assume the application centre in Italy is not the most efficient one, but the visa arrived almost 10 days later than expected even with priority.

records.title: Hit and miss
records.text: It's a huge hit and miss. Got a terrible lawyer at first. Lost document etc etcHowever once the case was switched to someone else it was completely different story! She sorted it within months. She was hearing what I was saying to her. She agreed it was very straightforward and she was confident about it. We worked together I finally felt supported with strong lawyer on my side. Excellent!

records.title: When I need help most no one cares
records.text: Thank you for replying to this review at this really difficult time for me and I do look forward from hearing from the team and maybe even if you cannot help, maybe certain questions should have been asked when I originally phoned so I was not given hope that I was going to get help as every week that goes by my husband is getting more ill,my first review reads as below Was very nervous about contacting a solicitor, when I plucked up courage to do so the first lady was very nice and reassuring, I had to wait almost a week for a call back, but when I explained about my situation I was asked if I had a diagnosis when I said no they said they could not help, my husband is very ill and because of the situation I don't think the doctors will give a diagnosis, but I told them that but I have some medical records that show he got worse after the tablets but they never asked about any of this, I told the person how worried I was and needed help but all they said was I could go back if I got a diagnosis, but surely this is why you need a solicitor in the first place, I never though when you need help most no one cares

records.title: Average
records.text: I have no prior experience with this type of legal team but at the start I felt I received a poor service and it actually made the process a lot harder to go through. I put most of these issues down to the medical company they use although after complaining. I had a new case handled I felt that the team listened to my issues and moved the case forward.

records.title: Car accident Experian
records.text: I had a car accident in November 2020, I was referred to Irwin Mitchell by a friend in which they spoke highly of. My experience with Irwin was that I feel that the communication are slightly poor and also I was being addressed as a Mr instead of a Miss a number of times even when I had reminded them of the mistake. I believe due to COVID-19 things didn’t move as fast as I expected and I had to keep chasing things up. However I would say when I did get in touch with someone they were helpful. I was able to finally have my claim completed a year later which am happy with.

records.title: I can't fault the service
records.text: I can't fault the service as I was successful in my claim.Communication could have been better, questions I had in terms of what the defendants were disputing went unanswered and asking me to chase down CCTV to prove I was involved in the accident before even taking my claim on, after I provided photos of my ticket, photos taken at the scene with GPS and screenshots of conversations with my manager to state why I was late for work, did leave me baffled.Overall a good service and I would recommend in future.

records.title: A good result, in the end...
records.text: My first two case handlers were useless and I had to chase them for progress reports every step of the way. When I complained, a more experienced and engaged case handler was assigned to my claim. The service I then received was first class, but I suspect nothing would have progressed had it not been for my persistence. My claim was settled and I was pleased with the final outcome.

records.title: Long time with plenty of chasing
records.text: Filled the form online , waited 3 weeks ,no one contacted me Did it again, nearly the same result, but I pesteredMine was a very straight forward case with no queries, but no contact with anyone . No concept of customer service, nearly graded it poor,but I got my will in the endWouldn’t use them for anything else, far too big to deal with little old me!

records.title: Dealing with the estate of my late father
records.text: Ruth Wallis and Laura Williams were unfailingly professional, courteous and pleasant and normally quick to respond to any questions.  However, the whole process took well over two years and although this included the  lockdown and a few minor complications along the way, this still seemed an excessively long time.   Also I couldn't help feeling there must be a clearer way of setting out the final accounts which, although transparent, were extremely difficult to understand in one area.   However, I am glad to now feel there has been closure of the process of dealing with my father's estate.

records.title: Very happy with the outcome but…
records.text: Very happy with the outcome but disappointed that it took in excess of three years to resolve ,particularly as the defendant admitted liability very early in the process . The hard working  solicitor acting was clearly directed from above to focus on other cases apparently initially due to Brexit and latterly apparently due to Covid-19.

records.title: Hindsight’s a wonderful thing ..
records.text: Irwin Mitchell were professional and communicated well.  However, I felt that the advice I was given could have been better.  I ended up receiving half of the original offer I was advised not to accept. The decision was entirely mine but when you have not been through this type of thing before you go with the advice given.  In hindsight I could have saved myself a lot of bother and received more compensation by just accepting the first offer.

records.title: Will-writing service
records.text: Will-writing serviceService provided was to a good standard and at a reasonable price.However, the firm was generally very slow to respond to email messages and failed to respond to telephone messages.There was also no point of partner contact and no attempt to remedy this.Given that the task involved updating wills last reviewed ten years previously, the instruction should not have taken so long to be finalised.

records.title: Achieved an outcome eventually
records.text: Achieved an outcome eventually, after almost 2 years. I suppose that is expected. It was difficult to get in touch with the case officer and their team. Calls were not always returned. I received numerous repeated and unnecessary mail from the solicitors. I had to resubmit documents and evidence as the solicitors claimed they did not have them. It was an exhausting experience.

records.title: My husband compensation was agreed on…
records.text: My husband compensation was agreed on the 26h November .and he was told he would most probably have it within 10 days .yet again poor communication .the person who is dealing with this case has never dealt with a case like this before ..this was from herself she said this .There has been delay after delay for my husband compensation to be paid out .And we have become . increasingly fraustrated with the whole procedure.We hope this can be resolved as quickly as possible .Claire Girard

records.title: Effective but slow
records.text: Ultimately achieved what was expected however, getting a response at certain points was difficult and my case was left untouched whilst handler went on leave (no contingency).Not terrible but could be slicker, more customer focused and treated with more urgency. It may not have been a huge case for Irwin Mitchell, but to me it could have been approached with more urgency.

records.title: Approached to use Irwin Michell after…
records.text: Approached to use Irwin Michell after an accident at work after having 2 case handlers and how ever many reports written im still sat at home depressed taking paid kills and .... antidepressants I would advise any one to actually shop around for a representative a claim is a long process so I have learnt but communication is key to that

records.title: Fencing sitting
records.text: I felt that my divorce was overshadowed by the large payout you had just made to someone else due to incorrect advice and that the team were led along by the machinations of my (ex)wife's team. Despite the fact the result was what I set out to achieve I do not feel that until the Barrister was bought in, the knowledge of divorce was sufficient to make me feel comfortable.

records.title: When I rang to register my claim
records.text: When I rang to register my claim, I had to make several phone calls ... was put through to various people, cut off, was spoken to by a robot, had to repeat the same information several times etc.  However, when all the details were in place, the claim ran smoothly.  I was on the verge of going elsewhere at the start of the process, but once that was sorted everything went very well.

records.title: Rubbish service and very very expensive.
records.text: I had a simple enquiry to ask for help re a property matter - there was no ring back after 4 days and then after another telephone enquiry I was told that before I could even speak to a lawyer to see if Irwin Mitchell can help that I would have to deposit £12,000 with them.   CrazyWhat upsets me most is it looked like Irwin Mitchell decided that for whatever reason they didn’t want my business so they ignored the initial enquiry.   This has cost me time - if Irwin Mitchell didn’t want to help they could have been upfront and not just delayed and hoped I’d  go away.  Then when I called again 4 days later  and after having explained the whole thing again I was asked to hold and was promptly cut off.   No call back so I rang back yet again “sorry we are having trouble with our phones” - really was it so much trouble Irwin Mitchell  couldn’t have called me back when they cut me off (I wasn’t sure I heard a snigger in the background)- then to ram home the point - no you can’t speak to a lawyer unless you have paid a deposit of £12,000.    I only wanted a quote for the work to issue a property notice that in extreme would take a few hours work. My family and I have  been using Thomas Eggar and lately Erwin Mitchell since the 2nd world war we have always paid our bills.  Christopher Doman and Tony Edwards would never have treated me or my father or even my grandfather that way - they respected their clients and their clients time and further they never asked for such a large deposit to do such a small amount of work - let alone to charge to quote or at least give me an idea as to how long it might be expected to take them.   Greedy, self serving and the client’s interests are not the priority - comes to mind - at no point did I feel looked after.

records.title: I would not trust this law firm
records.text: I have limited want to talk to people due to the diagnosis of moderately female conditions aka BPD hence I wanted to pursue a professional career but since I started this claim I have zero resolute desire to do so and was supported more my hospital staff members hence I accept liability.To be quite blunt the neurodivergence aspect of their experience is lacklustre and despite also going to a similar grammar to my solicitor we didn’t gell as we hoped to.

records.title: I have 2 children whom were both…
records.text: I have 2 children whom were both involved in the same car accident, one of which had more minor injuries and was apparently being dealt with by the 'Resolve' team.   No contact made despite chasing them on several occasions.   It seems they are only interested in the bigger claims which is disappoinitng

records.title: Inquired regarding consumer issue
records.text: Inquired regarding consumer issue, as they advertised on the website, took details asked how much the claim would be for. Given the complicated issue I wasn't sure and put a figure I thought it might be, but given its complication said i wasn't sure.I basically got told we charge a lot, and your case doesn't seem to be worth the bother. Here is the law society number, and do you want me to send you an email that says we can't help you. Fair play for honesty, but really that should be the website, as clearly a waste of time.Have not received any update or communication.

records.title: Rejected…. Next
records.text: I used chat to discuss my issue after calling and there being a technical problem with phone line.The chat ended abruptly, with no advice other than good bye try someone else.I was advised to call Irwin Mitchell.

records.title: It has taken 3 years for my personal…
records.text: It has taken 3 years for my personal injury claim to be completed, despite liability being admitted from the beginning. Within this time I have had 3 claim handlers of which I have had to chase all three for updates over this time through emails and calls, which was stressful. Sometimes it would be 7 days and more before a response would be given. I just feel that the customer care was lacking and what was a stressful time for me was made worse by having to chase information constantly.Irwin have requested further information but have not since been in touch. I have now almost been waiting 6 weeks for my claim to be paid and on top of this have been told if I want the payment to be made immediately once received by them (same day) I have to pay £30 for this.And once again, emails to chase it up. It’s a painful experience.

records.title: Unimpressed
records.text: I’m not impressed with the service. I requested a simple amendment to my will in early January. I paid the fee and there is still no sign on my amended will. Happily took my payment but as yet I have nothing for it. Told me I would have the draft by email at the end of this week. No email. No draft.

records.title: No communication, service received is nothing like the reviews!! Can’t recommend so far.
records.text: Haven’t made it to court or received an assessment yet and I am already leery about how well I will be represented. Communication is severely lacking, a mistake was made in a letter sent to me about factors in my case and I was shocked that a solicitor did that. He apologised but it didn’t give me the best confidence. I’m sending emails, leaving voicemails (direct number goes straight to voicemail) and there’s no communication whatsoever. I initially read the reviews thinking I would be in good hands but I’ve received a completely different service compared to what everyone else is describing. I’ve been completely in the dark and don’t feel supported or informed at all. My family and friends keep asking for updates and I never have anything to tell them.I haven’t heard from my solicitor in over a month, I don’t think it should take that long to do an assessment of my claim and even if it did, COMMUNICATION along the way (especially when I’m sending emails with more information or I’m asking for an update) should be maintained. If it wasn’t for my insurance, I would have just looked for another solicitors. To me it makes me wonder if I’m being avoided because my case hasn’t been touched yet and they don’t want to say. I don’t feel like my case is being given adequate attention. So far, I can’t say I could recommend Irwin Mitchell to anyone. Very sorry to say, not sure how they got their rankings if this is how they treat paying clients. Not impressed in the slightest. Update: I got my solicitor’s advice letter and it was clear he didn’t pay attention to all the information that was sent to him which I’m not surprised at all. His lack of attention to my case resulted in him provisionally advising that I didn’t have enough to win and that’s just simply unacceptable and hurtful to me. I’ve been in an abusive living situation for 4 YEARS and he didn’t care enough to read everything properly. I very much doubt I’d use Irwin Solictors again. If his department approve this letter after looking over his work that had so much left out and numerous mistakes, I may have to take it further. He said he couldn’t see my tenancy agreement (which I definitely sent) but didn’t ask me to send it since he couldn’t find it. He listed the incorrect rent amount. How is that okay?Don’t be fooled by the reviews!!!!

records.title: Not a good solicitors
records.text: Absolutely discusting that my mother was made to feel she was at fault for tripping over resulting in serious injury through no fault of her own but despite being offered to involve witnesses which my mother didn't get the chance to do due to her losing a percentage of use in her hand/wrist the case closed will not be using this company again they gave up to easily to get factual evidence from witnesses and lincolnshire county council some how wormed thier way out of being responsible! Not happy 😒

records.title: Absolutely terrible
records.text: Absolutely terrible. Personal injury wise do not go with them. A legal case still on going into it's 4th year they get back to you when they feel like it via email. If you phone them they will say the person you wish to speak to is busy on the phone or not in the office. All this added to my stress levels not been updated. It took two weeks for them to email me back. I put in a complaint to the complaints department they did nothing. They have to many cases.

description:
At Legacy Wills & Estate Planning, we’re all about taking care of our valued customers. We do this by offering a professionally tailored Estate Planning service, for all clients of all ages throughout England, Wales & Scotland.

Whether it’s your very first will or a complete property trust package, each of our clients are given the same dedication and professionalism throughout the process.

With a management team boasting decades of experience in the industry, and with over 75,000 Wills written, you can rest assured that you're in safe hands. 

Please do not hesitate to get in touch with us and find out why so many of our customers have rated us 5 Stars. 

We are ready and waiting to help you today.

records.title: Professional to the end
records.text: The whole operation of writing a will with this company was made so easy, they are very professional and explain everything in full and in an easy to follow arrangement Everything arrived on time and properly packaged Will definitely use again for other legal processes

records.title: I was unsure of what to do to register…
records.text: I was unsure of what to do to register my LPA and Jessica Green provided a quick response via email to clarify what I need to do. I am grateful for her prompt response and great customer service. Thank you Jessica

records.title: Legacy Wills was very easy to deal with
records.text: Legacy Wills was very easy to deal with and very helpful, the documents came well within the timescale quoted. I have recommended you to several family and friends.

records.title: Our documents professionally updated after our move
records.text: My wife and I had moved house and wanted our documents updated to reflect the move. The advisor who phoned sent us a link in which we were able to ask for the changes required. The person who called back was very good indeed, they took down the changes and even advised us on the products we had.

records.title: Will
records.text: They seem to be very professional and paper work is excel ant Pricy but you only get what you pay for Would highly recomend them

records.title: Very helpful from the first phone call…
records.text: Very helpful from the first phone call to completedWas nice to be able to have my Will done without having to leave the house. Everything was made easy for me by the staff explaining each step an to the whys & what’s. Very happy 😊

records.title: Very efficient…
records.text: The staff made the process very easy and were very professional every step of the way.Highly recommended

records.title: it was conducted on the phone and made…

records.title: Recommended for a simple will.
