records.title: SPEEDY REPLIES TO QUERIES.VERY PRECISE…
records.text: SPEEDY REPLIES TO QUERIES.VERY PRECISE ON GOING THROUGH INFORMATION FOR WIL.

records.title: The promptness and professionalism with…
records.text: The promptness and professionalism with which i was dealt with can only be positive. From the first inquiry to the time the final documents was produced.Well done!!! Keep it up

records.title: Very helpful in explaining most points…
records.text: Very helpful in explaining most points that were important to me and kept me updated with how things were going along easy to get in touch with if I had any problems would highly recommend.

records.title: Price jumps massively after second call
records.text: The service itself is pretty good and appears thorough. My only gripe is that it’s a bit like the bait and switch sales technique which was popular in the US until it was made illegal. You arrange for a £29.95 will service and end up with a quotation for over £1600. Apart from that it was seamless

records.title: Will review .
records.text: Polite. Patient. Clear and honest discussion. No pressure. I feel I can recommend them and will use them again.

records.title: Legacy Wills Feedback
records.text: The advice and support was first class and when I phoned with any queries my calls were answered promptly and the advice was very clear.I would recommend Legacy Wills to anyone needing to complete their wills.

records.title: A bit unhappy with hidden costs that…
records.text: A bit unhappy with hidden costs that you aren't made aware of when you start. Happy that my wishes have been adhered to. Well written and clear.

records.title: Like most people I felt anxious about…
records.text: Like most people I felt anxious about writing a will and contacting legacy wills. I needn't have worried as the gentleman I spoke to was helpful and efficient. I received my will back quickly and I'm very satisfied with it.

records.title: I thought the guy explained everything…
records.text: I thought the guy explained everything very well,& was good at explaining things!

records.title: Very helpful and friendly staff
records.text: Very helpful and friendly staff

records.title: Good explanation of the facts
records.text: Good explanation of the facts, quick to make changes to the will and a pleasantfriendly experience.

records.title: My experience was in general was good
records.text: My experience was in general was good. The lady I dealt with was very polite and friendly but the one thing I didn’t appreciate was how she dealt with my querying the cost of doing and LPA. Overall, I would recommend Legacy Wills for doing a will but not an LPA due to the cost.

records.title: My wife and I found the process of…
records.text: My wife and I found the process of making our wills fairly straightforward. We only required a basic will so we were surprised by the upselling of other services. Apart from that I would recommend Legacy Wills.

records.title: Very thorough.
records.text: Very thorough.Covered areas we had not thought of.A bit expensive if you go beyond a basic will.Took a long time to return our wills after returning them to Legacy Wills for signature checking.

records.title: Legacy wills phoned me and everything…
records.text: Legacy wills phoned me and everything was discussed over the phone, they also offered me other options along with what I was asking for. Though I would recommend that they learn Scottish law as things have changed.

records.title: Responded very quickly ,However I felt…
records.text: Responded very quickly ,However I felt I was reeled in by the £29.99 offer for a will,did not say basic,felt it was a salesman trying to sell me extras,the outcome was over a £1000,opted for the basic because once you get a call back you have no option but to pay £29.99.to me it wasn't personal it was all about selling you extras .

records.title: Good
records.text: The service is good but in this instance could you not wait until the service is complete.At moment I am having to meet witnesses and attorneys before sending the relevant papers back to you which will be soon.

records.title: The legacy will staff I found to be…
records.text: The legacy will staff I found to be professional, caring and dedicated. They explained to me about my will ,health and financial LPA's in a convenient way with great ease and satisfaction. They are the best.

records.title: Excellent provider.
records.text: The company explained everything we needed to do in very simple terms. Paperwork came on time with places for signatures clearly labelled. The one mistake made was naming a trustee incorrectly  with a completely different name to the one we had said. Nobody could explain how that happened,  but was quickly reprinted and posted back to us correctly. So, important to read everything thoroughly. In all an excellent service provider.

records.title: Excellent help & guidance on doing a…
records.text: Excellent help & guidance on doing a new will , from start to finish it only took 3 weeks. Thank you very much for an excellent service .

records.title: Positive Feedback - trust
records.text: Hi, at times like the current; trust becomes very valuable; I liked your simple handling of the set-up of the will and when I asked to have the printed copy send with delay as I was on holiday then; you responded by sending it at the right time for me.Depending on size of company these relatively little attendances to detail are sadly overlooked.That is why I gave you a positive rating.Thank you very much.I feel assured that I can come to you with any future questions I may have and I thank you for that too.Best wishesMiss M Westermann

records.title: Don’t sign up before looking at all the reviews
records.text: I was expecting just to sort out the details of the will for 19.99 but felt was offered other add ons  that I don’t feel I need,   service that u keep hold my will at 20 pounds a year  need to have  power  attorney which was another payment at 47.00 month for a year I am elderly woman just wanted a will for my wishers to be met I would like 19.99 that u took also 50.00 power of attorney deposit followed. 12 monthly payments you can cancel any will service refund me my money please

records.title: Get quotes
records.text: We saw the advert for will writing service discount price under £30.00. This went up to nearly £50.00 after the initial phone call. The guy we spoke to really new his stuff and was very professional.  He told us what we needed was wills with trusts and came back with everything we needed in mirror wills for my wife and I. Cost to do was£1800.00 , more than I thought but as I've been saying I'd do this for 20 years and never got round to it I went ahead. I've now learned I could get the same service from many places like the co-op for less than half this. I'm happy with my wills but I should have got a few quotes first.

records.title: 5 DAYS on still no refund from legacy…
records.text: 5 DAYS on still no refund from legacy wills - still awaiting refund , taken further legal advice to resolve this - not aligned to what the operative stated - cancelled monday within the cooling off period as stated - no call back , we have had to chase legacy . finally resolved and money returned 11 days on .

records.title: Quick, but uncomfortably rude.
records.text: The service is quick and straightforward, absolutely no complaints. When it comes to payments it feels odd leaving the card number over the phone (I had to request a bank transfer instead) so it would be good to have a payment link option to do that. Another thing I found very uncomfortable it’s how rude they can be when you call back/email back to ask for more information or details. I am afraid you might have to work on that as you are dealing with sensitive documents and some delicate moments a person can go through. Down to 3 stars due to lack of human and customer service skills.

records.title: Watch out for hidden costs
records.text: Feeling left a little dissapointed at our experience, finally got round to making a will and despite questioning at initial contact with Legacy Wills to the price being lower than expected, was assured as a simple will, that would be the set price. Follow on comms suggested some added extras if you wanted will stores or legal executors, but this all changed during the will making call. Where the price went up to £1400. Just felt not at all transparent from the start and the tone of the will making call definitely changed when we said no to enhancements to the will from the basic package. We now feel worried as to what we do have! Maybe naive on my part but maybe should have stuck to the old fashioned way of seeing a solicitor in person.

records.title: It's not easy getting you people on the…
records.text: It's not easy getting you people on the phone. Another thing is I have asked about my deposit for Power of attorney  ( I decided against it) but nobody is responding to my email.

records.title: They did a pretty good job
records.text: They did the job efficiently, returning my initial call promptly. Subseqently the documents came through the post in reasonable time too.You certainly can't complain at the price either BUT beware the hard sell add‐ons which of course is where they make their money. Unless you decide you do want the extras, decline; as Mrs Malaprop might have said, 'Put your foot down with a firm hand'!

records.title: Lack of transparency …
records.text: Professional service with good communication throughout however we were not informed of ‘living trusts’ until our final call where we were expected to pay over £2500.  I was appalled by this as it was not mentioned at our earlier consultation.  This lack of transparency is tarnishing this company.Please be transparent regarding all fees upfront and this will help with company integrity!

records.title: good for a basic will
records.text: If you want a basic will this is fine, but i felt i was also being sold a trust i didn't really need, and it was more expensive than other providers. i decided not to go ahead and I was refunded.

records.title: After receiving the paperwork,I found…
records.text: After receiving the paperwork,I found it all clear to understand. A guide is sent to explan who signs what which all have coloured stickers. I find everyone I have dealt with able to deliver great customer service. The only issue I have is that I feel the Power of Attorney fees were not explanned to me properly. I was aware of the fees for each one taken but was not happy to find that there was going to be another fee to register them at a cost of £84 each,which I am unable to pay for in this moment in time. Reason for 3 stars.

records.title: Felt slightly misled with the…
records.text: Felt slightly misled with the advertising of your prices. The guy we originally didn't say the cost depends on circumstances.  Although our situation is quite straight forward. All we wanted to do was be able to read through  documents and have a think but told we need to pay the amount he quoted. So we declined. Disappointed

records.title: Sales Targets???
records.text: Good information and communication and very helpful staff but very much a Sales pitch which cost us a further £1,000. We were then asked to attend a video call to ‘firm up our details’ but after a further 1 hour ‘SALES’ call it was clear the aim was to sell us further plans at a cost of £3,000!

records.title: Not for me
records.text: My experience wasn't good. I wanted a simple, straight forward will for £19.99 as advertised. After telephone consultation it was made far more complicated and was told it was £900+ so I declined. Took 2 weeks to get refund. My partner had a previous good experience with Legacy Wills and only paid £19.99 and his is a mirror situation. I used another company the following day and they provided exactly what I wanted.

records.title: Every now and again things don’t go…
records.text: Every now and again things don’t go according to plan. It took Legacy Wills three attempts to produce my Will. On the first occasion they left out an important statement and funeral arrangements. Second time inserted a wrong word. Third attempt they got it right. Persistence pays off in the end. Would I recommend them? Yes I think I would. Make sure you read what they send.

records.title: Continuing power of attorney Scotland
records.text: I contacted legacy wills to get my will written, this was very easy and went well, however if you live in Scotland do not get them to do a continuing power of attorney. When I was offered this service I thought it was a gòd idea and paid £100 deposit. When I received the document I tried 3 GPs and 6 solicitors but couldn't get one to sign it for less than £300, almost as much as it cost to draw it up. I can't get my £100 deposit back. If you live in Scotland don't let legacy wills do your continuing power of attorney without checking to see if your GP surgery will sign it first.

records.title: I must be a bit thick as I asked I…
records.text: I must be a bit thick as I enquired about the £29.99 double will and finished up paying nearly £4,000 and the part that really gets to me is the fact that you go from one person to another and not at any time do they tell you it will be this amount, I am not saying that they have not done a good job but if I had know it was going to finish up at that amount I would have gone to a local solicitor. Alan Crunden

records.title: Be sure you don’t buy what you don’t need
records.text: I was contacted by phone on promised date and answered questions regarding making a will, I was a little surprised to be asked about my bank accounts and how much money in each account. On completing the business of making a will, i was offered ( pitched as duty of care) the services of power of attorney, trusts etc all at extra cost disclosed at the end of the sales pitch in total £1639. It seemed to suggest the reason for asking about bank details was to it ensure enough in bank account to cover duty of care extras before the sales pitch. It would be more up front if Legacy Wills pointed out at the start of the duty of care the extra costs involved. There was a noticeable change in the agents tone when I declined the extra services and costs. On the plus side we have received our wills 5 star

records.title: Lack of Communication
records.text: I originally wrote my Will in 2021 (for which I paid £600) and due to an ongoing divorce/settlement - omitted to return the signed forms. Whilst I appreciate this was my fault, I think a reminder from the company to return them would have been in order. Had anything happened to me, my son would not have been protected. Thankfully, I have now contacted them and the situation has been rectified.

records.title: It is all about upselling.
records.text: It is all about upselling.The price of a basic Will was advertised as £19.99 but, for me, I was advised that there was an optional cost of £996.00 and given four choices of how I wanted to pay this 'option' without which I couldn't have the basic Will.Covered in the Options are Lasting Powers of Attorney for Finance and Care (available elsewhere online for £ 200.00 and creation of a discretionary trust because I want to gift my property to a charity when my wife dies (on the assumption that I will die first). Discretionary Trusts are not covered in their basic Will package.Edited:The explanation given is understandable, but the "all-in-one" oncost is a little steep given that there are other providers that can do the LPoAs for 20% of this oncost

records.title: Will writing is okay but cost of added documents like power of attorney is mentioned after a lengthy questioning
records.text: Will writing is okay but cost additional items they suggest is mentioned after a lengthy talk from advisor. Poor transparency Phone calls- ask for a call back and it does even ring. The person leaves a voice message.

records.title: Happy with the service
records.text: Happy with the service. Received my will today and all in order.The only thing is they were very professional on the phone, but spent quite a long time advising me to have a power of attorney costing £1,000 and one of of my family members have their share in trust. I adjusted my Will accordingly and took the necessary actions. This didn’t alarm me but their advice may alarm some people. But I suppose they have to do their job and give advice. All in all a good service and I’m happy with the outcome of my will. Thank you Loraine Denison

records.title: I received a phone call to help me put…
records.text: I received a phone call to help me put right a problem I had encountered. That bit was good, however I really resented the dogged attempt to sell me insurance that had nothing to do with the problem. This really tanked your score.

records.title: Unfortunately this service felt more…
records.text: Unfortunately this service felt more like a sales call than helping. Trying to make us buy services of up to £2000. There was some real scare munger tactics used & the basic will I paid £50 for is something anyone could have done at home for free. So disappointing.

records.title: Frustrating
records.text: The initial interview was a bit too jargoned, and we didn't understand everything. There were certain things we had to research afterwards. The power s of attorney were expensive. We took these to our solicitor to have signed. The witness put the wrong date, which was amended in the correct manner. We sent the docs back but they were returned saying this amendment was not done correctly, so we had to get them signed again and send them back. These docs will now take up to 6 weeks to be reviewed and returned again. This whole process has taken months which is so unneccessary as we could have died before completion, so it would have all bee a waste of time. If we could get our money back and go elsewhere, we would.

records.title: Not what I expected
records.text: When I approached LW I received a good response. About the same time our children made us a gift of a Which? Wills package. LW returned my call and I informed them I did not wish to continue.  Some days later I received a profane, disgusting call from a male person who seemed aggrieved at my cancellation. On 26 July LW again made contact with a reduced offer asking I call them on 01165020774. I have not responded.  I am minded to furnish the offending number to Police. LW contacted me later this day requesting additional information to trace my experience.  It's unfortunate their records are so poor as they were able to contact me on 26 inst. Seems pointless continuing this charade.

records.title: Received a call to take out a will and…
records.text: Received a call to take out a will and the person on the phone was rude and hung up before I’d even finished talking. Very rude

records.title: I paid the start up fee went through…
records.text: I paid the start up fee went through all details, realized there were mistakes, never heard back from them.. eventually received a call after chasing up with an apology then was told I’d receive another call the next day to confirm the changes. Missed the call so called back 3 times was told someone would return my call & never heard again.. not a great experience or service & didn’t receive a refund from the initial start up fee.

records.title: I contacted legacy Wills
records.text: I contacted legacy Wills. The early details were good and I explained what I wanted on the phone. It was very professional. Afterwards I was told there were problems and it would cost me just umder1000 pounds. There were various ways to pay. They took the advertised price straight away but I never got a will....Will have to go somewhere else.

records.title: Terrible experience
records.text: I have never come across such utter incompetence! I don’t know if I’ve just been very unlucky but they seem unable to complete my simple Will! This process has been going on for months. They keep sending me a copy of my Will that doesn’t match the one I signed. Trying to check that the correct version is in storage is proving impossible. Today I have received a new copy of my Will to sign, with no explanation as to why, after more than three months, I am back to square one. I would never use this company again, or recommend that anyone else does.Update on 22nd August. I finally spoke to someone who was able to sort this for me and I have now received a copy of the correct version of my Will. He was very apologetic about the difficulties I had.

records.title: Easy simple
records.text: Easy simple, wished they'd say what the actual cost of it would be 19.99 for the phone call then they say £600+ for the making of the will then £80.00 per document.I would of never paid it if I didn't just get a 0% credit card! Not transparent but a great service for the rest of it.

description: Switalskis Solicitors - award winning lawyers with offices in Wakefield, Leeds, Bradford, Sheffield, Doncaster, Huddersfield, Honley, Dewsbury, Pontefract, York, Boston Spa, Knaresborough and Goldthorpe. We advise individuals and businesses in many dif...

records.title: Outstanding service
records.text: I have used them twice. Once to buy a new build house and then to sell my old house. From beginning to completion, their service was professional, overt and friendly. Richard Wisnia was outstanding in his communication, kindness and alacrity.I thoroughly recommend them.

records.title: I had the pleasure of working with…
records.text: I had the pleasure of working with Switalskis Solicitors for the purchase of my new flat, and I couldn't be happier with the outcome. From start to finish, they demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to making the process as smooth as possible. Every step was clearly explained, and any questions I had were answered promptly, putting my mind at ease throughout what could have been a stressful experience.A special mention also goes to Melanie, who was an absolute star. She provided invaluable support throughout the process, always approachable and willing to go the extra mile to ensure everything was in order. I highly recommend their services to anyone looking for top-notch legal assistance.

records.title: Highly recommended
records.text: We used Switalskis for the conveyancing of our parents' property following probate. All of the initial paperwork was completed online via the portal. The sale presented a number of challenges along the way from the buyers, but I always felt that Switalskis gave us good advice so we could make an informed decision when needed. They kept us updated by email or phone contact, and clearly had a good working relationship with our Estate Agent (Haus). Thank you to Liz, Alison and Andy in particular. We would definitely recommend Switalskis Solicitors to others.

records.title: They were very helpful and extremely…
records.text: They were very helpful and extremely good at explaining everything i needed to know would definitely recommend them

records.title: Great experience!
records.text: Our experience with Switalskis was brilliant from start to finish. We dealt with Richard from the new build team and nothing was too much trouble. He kept us updated regularly, was easy to get in touch with and he was happy to answer any questions that we had. Richard also pushed the process along for us so that we could complete before Christmas. I’d definitely use Switalskis again if they’re all as efficient as Richard and the new build team.

records.title: I would definitely recommend Switalskis…
records.text: I would definitely recommend Switalskis solicitors. They have been very supportive and understanding of our needs in selling .y father's house.Thank you again

records.title: Switalskis have been great from start…
records.text: Switalskis have been great from start to finish. The portal to start off the legal process and fill out documents is so easy and convenient to use. The team are friendly and we would definitely recommend to others.

records.title: Highly recommend
records.text: We have used a few solicitors in our time, when moving house, however Switalskis are by far the best. They were always easy to get hold of, didn’t sit on things or unnecessarily complicate anything and were all very pleasant. They were also very competitively priced. We are now living in, what we hope, will be our forever home but if we did ever need to utilise the services of a solicitor for this purpose, we wouldn’t hesitate to use them again. Big thanks go to them all.

records.title: Friendly and reliable!
records.text: When we sold our flat, our agent recommended Switalskis to do the conveyancing. I was impressed by the reviews, the reasonable quote, and also that they were local to Sheffield, and I'm really glad we went with them.The whole process took about 12 weeks which was much quicker than I expected, and I got the feeling that the team was pushing things forward at every opportunity without us having to chase them all the time! All our emails were answered quickly and the service was very friendly and helpful. After the initial paperwork it was all very hands-off which was exactly what we wanted. Definitely recommended!

records.title: Liam was very informative and explained…
records.text: Liam was very informative and explained everything very clearly to us. Very polite and friendly young man. The whole process of updating our wills was made easy for us thankyou

records.title: Alot of time delays
records.text: Apart from time delays was good experience

records.title: Pleasant personnel staff.…
records.text: We were made aware of each part of the process, when given a timeline it was kept.Always telephone communications were pleasantly answered.   Not having moved home for 37 years, sometimes I had to ask a question twice, given the impression I wasn't being a pain.

records.title: House sale
records.text: Ellie and Wendy gave us good service. They explained the processes well, communicated effectively. They were friendly, professional snd approachable.

records.title: Pleasant personnel.
records.text: Felt that our home sale was important, questions were answered with patience and understanding.     Overall, as good an experience as the situation could have been.Thank you.

records.title: A little slow to make appropriate…
records.text: A little slow to make appropriate contact - and still find it hard to understand why I needed a new Will, rather than an update.But communication and contacts with Steph Potter very straightforward and reassuring.

records.title: The whole process took far too long
records.text: The whole process took far too long. Whose fault that was I am not entirely sure. We agreed the deal in June and completed 4th November! It was not complex as we had the funds, there was no mortgage to organise, so why did it take so long?

records.title: Moving house is never great
records.text: Moving house is never great - after an initial crawl Sarah explained the reason for the delay clearly to me -pressing the seller side to sort the hitch - after this things went ahead very speedily. Sarah and Lisa are very easy to deal with and understood I find modern systems tricky to deal with. I was confident they were acting in my best interest.

records.title: Good service
records.text: Good service, prompt and responded when asked for an update. Knocked a star off as only updated when chased and never volunteered information if any unexpected delays.

records.title: Rahul was astute
records.text: Rahul was calm, polite and very astute throughout my sale and purchase.

records.title: We feel fortunate to have worked with…
records.text: We feel fortunate to have worked with Laura Farrow on the sale and purchase of our properties. She has consistently been supportive and, most importantly, readily available to address all our questions.Initially, we were apprehensive and uncertain about handling both the sale and purchase simultaneously, but Laura made the process smooth and straightforward. Thank you for all your kind support. We wish you all the best!

records.title: Got there
records.text: We got regular updates and it did take longer than we expected but through delays which weren't either of our faults we got there so thank you all

records.title: Very good
records.text: Very good, kept me informed most of the time and was a generally stress free process. Would recommend using them for the sale of property.Would have been a 5 star if there were regular (weekly updates) without prompting. But overall very good service.

records.title: Prompt to reply to queries via email
records.text: Prompt to reply to queries via email. Friendly. Generally made house sale straightforward. Price is comparable to other local agencies. Could be clearer on details of documents required or reasons for delays. As I was overseas, communicating via email was ok, but a WhatsApp option would have been even more useful. Would happily recommend.

records.title: Incredibly thorough
records.text: My solicitor was very thorough and although that sometimes meant the timeline increased it was worth it in the end because nothing was overlooked. Communication was clear and direct and when I needed things explaining further I could 9 times out of 10 reach them to do so. I am very grateful for the time put in by my solicitor Briony. The only thing I wish had been done differently is keeping me abreast of new costs when they came up.

records.title: A thorough, professional and knowledgeable Company.
records.text: The final outcome and completion of the house purchase was certainly the highlight of the experience! Although the procedure felt, to us, a lengthy one, Briony proved professional and efficient in handling our affairs and keeping us in the loop! We are pleased and grateful for all her help!

records.title: Switalskis Solicitors supported me with…
records.text: Switalskis Solicitors supported me with the purchase of  my first property.  The whole process took longer than we had all anticipated. Many thanks to Melanie Hirst for her patience and hard work.

records.title: Laura kept us in the loop
records.text: Laura kept us informed at every stage of the process and was relatively easy to get hold of if we had any questions

records.title: Smooth and seamless
records.text: My solicitor was clear on communications, extended access to speak and clarify any questions during working days, and stayed on top of things . Thanks much Brinoy, it was fabulous working with you!

records.title: Kept is in the loop…
records.text: Laura kept us informed at every stage of the process and was relatively easy to get hold of if we had questions

records.title: Very helpful and thorough.
records.text: Overall our house sale took 6 months. Due to a combination of issues with deeds and contacting other companies and back and forth with other solicitors. Gulshan was professional throughout the process and always kept us in the loop with quick responses. Thanks again.

records.title: Just ok
records.text: Just ok. I can count a few times that I called and left messages and very rarely got a call back. I found myself chasing up and much of the time got more out of the estate agent than the solicitors. I think a call back is pretty basic in any organisation.I suppose we got the end result and sold our house in the end but it was just ok.

records.title: The cost
records.text: The cost , misleading on initial appointments , only reviewed when gone over estimate then increased and not before. Although you get detail of what has created the cost - these items are confusing and misleading. Service was generally good but not good value.

records.title: Over all the experience was good
records.text: Over all the experience was good.I did feel at times a bit lacking with communication.When emailing in it felt like my email went to the bottom of the pile and was hard to get quick responses to questions often.I feel it would be better to get assigned 1 conveyancing assistance to deal with as then you could build a better relationship and understanding of the process. Rather than having to explain on each call as you were dealing with a different person each time.Just a few small things but over all was fine.

records.title: I do feel like we had to keep chasing…
records.text: I do feel like we had to keep chasing rather than getting info from our solicitor, im not disputing they were helpful but i did do a lot of the leg work.

records.title: On the whole the service was as expected
records.text: On the whole the service was as expected.  Only negatives were the buyer asking the same questions on numerous occasions.  These questions were passed onto us to respond to many times, as if they had not been checked first.Also phone calls were not always returned.

records.title: Cost
records.text: the cost only got reviewed when you had gone over the amount that was set so this was very misleading yes you got it explained why it had gone over  but only unpon request yes the solicitor I had was good and she explained it all when she could so thia was very misleading

records.title: Laura Farrow was professional and…
records.text: Laura Farrow was professional and efficient and I would give her 5 stars however we had 3 solicitors in a month one only for a week. Buying a house is stressful enough without that.

records.title: Power of attorney review
records.text: The solicitor was very pleasant but it was a very long drawn out process, not helped due to the fact that the solicitor had forgotten to forward paperwork to our son in Australia, until  brought to her attention by us. Also, the number of copies of paperwork were incorrect.

records.title: Could have been better
records.text: Could have been better. As we were previous Clients of Atherton Godfrey Solicitors there were answers to questions from buyers solicitor that could, with some research, have been answered more readily without necessitating us having to pay for a building protection policy!!!!

records.title: Divorce
records.text: Was referred to them via a women’s support group for dv. Initially they were supportive. They supported me through the court process. I did feel at times that they struggled to understand the situation I was in emotionally and felt that sometimes they were questioning my decisions and made me feel that useless because i felt so hopeless and depressed and frustrated. The main event which left me very frustrated was the discrepancy between my house valuations for the marital home, which he lived in, and his valuations. Mine were nearly 50k higher than his, so they suggested we got an independent valuation from someone that they used frequently. Even though I sent in numerous property’s that was for sale on the same street with a valuation around my figure, their valued agreed more or less with my ex husbands valuation. The solicitor then said there was no where else we could go with it and I needed to accept it. Which was not supporting ne and a little dismissive. So I lost in effect £25k. A year later my ex husband has put the house up for sale for the valuation I have given and no property in that area has sold so low as the solicitor valued gave. Not even a 2 bed property and mine was a 3 including a large conservatory. Feel like I have been totally let down by this and as I left with nothing other that a few clothes I desperately needed this money to try and start again. I do feel very let down but I’ve got to try and ignore it and move on. Not how you should feel when you’re paying solicitors a huge amount of money to fight for you. Also my solicitor bill ended up being several thousand pounds higher than his even though I qualified for legal aid. Also not sure how that can be possible. All in all no I wouldn’t use them again.

records.title: Had to do a number of things more than…
records.text: Had to do a number of things more than once which should not have been necessary

records.title: I like the Switalskis  solicitors for…
records.text: I like the Switalskis  solicitors for the quick response they made to my matter.... thank you.

records.title: Best on quotation
records.text: Benchmark before selection and price are one of best although there is a slight cost raised at the end, it matches the initial quote.  Overall the process is smooth at the end but it required several backs and forth to provide the same data/information it seems to me there is an internal communication issue.  Last minute request was raised after documents were submitted for 2 months which almost impact the completion and luckily the last min request document catch up at the end.

records.title: They were available to speak to and…
records.text: They were available to speak to and were a fair price.Wasn’t happy that my stamp duty based on my extras and fittings was calculated at a guess. Had I not queried this, I would have paid more than I needed to.

records.title: Multiple contacts in reality.
records.text: Multiple contacts in reality.After exchange questions.Not as efficient as previous barratt advised solicitors

records.title: Initial support was great
records.text: Initial support was great. But when it came to wanting things in letters to ex partner regarding her conduct with our child she wasn't prepared to put it in letter. And after she had spoken to my ex partner and the excuses she started siding with ex partner. Even though I had evidence to the contrary. And I think the fee for a c100 form was disgusting when it only cost £215. And you was charging £2000

records.title: I felt that for £1200.00 there was a…
records.text: I felt that for £1200.00 there was a communication breakdown between Switalskis and Cafcass and lack of empathy considering the current circumstances, a lot of money that my late Uncle did not have was spent and the situation caused my late uncle and myself undue stress as well as having to attend court twice, in the end I had to represent myself as no way I expected my Uncle to pay an additional £600 for a 5 minute call, I did feel very disappointed to be honest, I don't usually moan about such things.I am however glad that the outcome in court was positive in the end, but felt did not receive value for money, apologies.

records.title: When speaking to people on the phone an…
records.text: When speaking to people on the phone an asking for advice it seemed as they couldn't wait to get you off the phone an didt seem intrested in speaking to you or helping you

records.title: First time buyer - left in the dark
records.text: If my experience had solely been with Melanie Hirst I would have given this company 5 stars for a quick and efficient process. However, from October 2023 to April 2024 I was with Mark Thornton (who has now left the company) and the experience was shocking. I was waiting weeks, sometimes a month for a reply regarding the sale of the property I was buying. The replies I would get were along the lines of “just waiting for answers on a couple things from the sellers solicitor”. I never got clarification on what we were waiting for, and this went on from January to April leaving me increasingly frustrated. Mid April Mark emailed on a Tuesday asking me to come into the office that week, his work hours were the same as mine and I was unable to do so, I emailed him several times about this, stating I could call if necessary but never received a reply. On the following Monday I got a call from Switalksi’s asking if I still wanted to proceed with the sale as nothing had been done on my case since January and Mark Thornton had left the company on the Friday. I was given no notice that he was leaving, and whilst the company sorted me out to be with Melanie Hirst one would think the leaving solicitor should have prepared where his clients were going, and notified them of his departure. As a first time buyer this was a horrible experience, and if you choose to go with Switalkski’s I would be cautious which solicitor you use. I fully recommend Melanie as she completed the sale quickly and kept me well informed. The two stars are for her.

records.title: Important Paper work was lost many…
records.text: Important Paper work was lost many times. We sent documents in and then received emails days later asking for the same documents despite already giving them in. We were advised wrong several times by different people. The solicitor dealing with the sale was on annual leave when the house completed and there wasn’t a single person designated for the sale so lots of miss communication and messages.

records.title: Not the best at communicating and…
records.text: Not the best at communicating and ignore your calls.They seem to forget they are getting paid to do you a service, like politicians yiu never get a true answer and when answering your questions it’s in riddles.

records.title: I engaged Switalskis for the purpose of…house sale
records.text: I engaged Switalskis for the purpose of a house sale. Overall it was not a good experience. I identified several mistakes that were simply as a result of not checking what had been written. These include a spelling mistake of my name, a miscalculation on a form to be submitted (£10,000 out) and conflicting information on a form to be submitted. I pointed each of these out and there was no apology at all. There were times when I felt they did try to help but I didn't expect to find so many basis mistakes when I was paying for a professional service.

records.title: The lawyer you wish your wife chosen...
records.text: Switalski's is the law firm you wished your wife found first and chose to represent her. In fact, I would have paid her to have chosen them!Terrible advice and very, very costly in the end.EDIT: Standard, 'we take all feedback seriously' reply. Tell's you all you need to know about this firm. I only left this review after they cold called me trying to sell more services post-divorce. All they care about is invoicing. I don't actually know if I'm divorced or not months later. I never heard anything from them after their last invoice was paid.

records.title: Poor client service
records.text: Poor client service. Lack of communication within the team resulting in multiple misunderstandings, which were acknowledged by a barrage of excuses. Would not use again. Would not recommend

records.title: Due to Covid
records.text: Due to Covid, dealt with 3 different people, never informed of this change, in the week prior to completion, my person went on holiday! It was transferred to someone new  but I informed prior to discovery. Didn’t want to help me fight for my sale of this house, didn’t want to get involved.

records.title: You kept a will immediately after it…
records.text: You kept a will immediately after it had been written,and signed withought requesting or asking if you could do so.I needed to take the will into my immediate possesstion

records.title: Full of hope but don't finish what they started.
records.text: They are full of great ideas but don't finish what they started.My advise is Run. Find a smaller Solicitor group but not these as so expensive it's worse than buying a house. Wouldn't recommend to anyone.

records.title: How not to have an estate/will handled.
records.text: This organisation is trying to process the properties from my later father’s estate. My feedback:- poor communication- poor feedback - slow/no progress- I always have to chase them - have had to provide the same information multiple times- tried to complain, no feedback/success - many changes in people looking after my case I could not recommend.

description:
TT2 Ltd. operates the Tyne Tunnels as a toll road.

They are managed by the North East Combined Authority (NECA). The Bylaws, which are approved by the Department for Transport, regulate the Tunnels.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: I have renewed my tunnel pass on line, but couldn't send required documents as they wouldn't go through. Spoke to customer service and the talked me through my problem and stayed on phone till they had what they needed. Got my renewal confirmed the next day.

records.title: Super TT2 service
records.text: I had made my first journey through the tunnel on Jan 1 and had tried to use my Blue Badge but could find no-one to check it. I made a phone call this morning and Jacqueline sorted everything including my registration very quickly. Great service and a very capable agent. Thanks

records.title: Customer service Excelled
records.text: My renewal was simplified by the excellent staff with whom I spoke to who answered all my queries and helped me find my way. Thank you for your customer service, greatly appreciated.

records.title: Had problem l did not have my v5c
records.text: Had problem l did not have my v5c when doing my blue badge on line but rang them up and a lovely polite young lady sorted it all out for me thank you so much

records.title: I'm impressed with this process.
records.text: After initial difficulties trying to complete the application on a very old laptop, I changed to using my mobile phone and it only took about five minutes,My application was approved in a couple of days.

records.title: Just renewed my Blue Badge…
records.text: Just renewed my Blue Badge successfully.Thanks for help with this and letting me know everything in order now. Well  done Tyne Tunnels.

records.title: Spot on
records.text: These guys emailed me to remind me to renew my exemption account.Submission was straight forward and I received my renewal confirmation within a couple of days.Great stuff.

records.title: A top class service
records.text: A top class service.  As the T&C’s state when applying for a blue badge exemption for the Tyne Tunnel I renewed online just before the 12 months was up.  Very easy process and sorted within a few days.  I always diarise for the next time so won’t get caught out and end up with a fine allowing it to run out.

records.title: I filled the online form wrongly
records.text: I filled the online form wrongly, and was promptly notified which helped greatly. Everything was sorted in just one day

records.title: Simple process applying for my sons…
records.text: Simple process applying for my sons Blue Badge exemption, we only use the Tyne Tunnel for his trips to hospital at Newcastle RVI but it makes life a little easier. Thanks.

records.title: Fast and prompt response to application
records.text: Fast and prompt response to application

records.title: Photo size and GDPR
records.text: Normal size photos are too big and need to be cropped; no big deal just annoyingly faffy.  Documents were sent at previous renewals so should be held on system until account closed.  Appreciate there'll be some GDPR shenanigans but if customers agree for you to hold them there would be no need to upload and send again.The assistant I spoke to for help was fantastic though.

records.title: Easy to log on
records.text: Easy to log on, but found it more complicated to download the documents, but overall very easy and help at hand if needed.

records.title: Helpful …
records.text: The frequent messages and ongoing updates. The only reason I didn’t give five stars is because when we started the two and a half hour journey the message said I wasn’t allowed access through the tunnel but by the end of it the application had been activated. I had nagged to start sooner; maybe this will encourage my poor husband! Thanks for acting quicker than two weeks.

records.title: JUST A BLIP
records.text: OBVIOUSLY,-DUE TO A SLIGHT OVERSIGHT, I POSTED MY RENEWAL FOR EXCEMPTION TO TT2.GOT THE OK CONFIRMATION,--THEN--RECEIVED  IN BOX THAT I NEEDED TO APPLY AGAIN, I THEN GOT IN TOUCH  TO TT2  ON 21/1/2024.--WHICH THE VERYHELPFULL PERSON ON THE PHONE ,SAID GIVE A FEW MINUTES,-THEN-ALL WAS RECTIFIED .MANY THANKS, RER.

records.title: TT2 Communications.
records.text: Teleohone staff (Shannon) are extremely helpful....once you get through. Note: It's worth the waiting time :-)Having opened an account I applied vis the link for a BlueBadge exemption. The form for application is incomplete in that it doesn't request all the necessary detail - eg photo proof of Blue Badge.1 call and all was sorted.

records.title: Everything is fine,although slow at…
records.text: Everything is fine,although slow at peak times.This comment refers to traffic approaching the northbound tunnel from the A19. May I suggest you introduce some measures to control traffic which is abusing the recently introduced left hand lane to jump the queue and then cutting in when approaching the tunnel. Possibly bollards to separate lanes for a distance and force traffic using the left hand lane to turn left

records.title: Improvements to System
records.text: The speed of the renewal process when the application was received. Dealing with the system requirements to get to this stage was a challenge. System improvements could be achieved using "pop-ups" to describe what was required at each step of the process so that inputs were valid. This would prevent missteps along the way.

records.title: Given conflicting information about the…
records.text: Given conflicting information about the blue badge expiry.   I was sent an e mail stating my blue badge application for my vehicle has been renewed and then a few minutes later (although told originally it would be two weeks) a message stating the blue badge exemption had now expired and I will be required to pay from now on.  Very confusing.  But still I am grateful for the service.

records.title: Renewal system for Blue Badge holders so much easier
records.text: Since TT2 became computerised for Blue Badge exemption applications things have become so much easier. I must admit the first few times I was confused but this time no problems at all. Thank you.

records.title: No payment issues but …
records.text: As a prepaid customer I never had any payment problems when travelling through the Tyne tunnel.  However I do wish that they would do something about those users who overtake, speed and use their phones whilst travelling through the tunnel.  There are cameras so surely these violations can be seen.

records.title: Great phone call staff. Got it sorted no bother.
records.text: Applied on line for blue badge exemption. Should have had an e-mail of acknowledgement to tell me that you had received my application.Phoned up to enquire & got it all complete there & then. Call operator was very efficient, nice & polite.

records.title: i had problems with my computer and…
records.text: i had problems with my computer and could not apply on line I phoned up and was given great advice sent application in and was sorted in a few days

records.title: IT blue badge registration
records.text: I had issues adding my files in the choose file as I have an android phone and I wasnt given the option to choose from my picture gallery. I called and spoke to Jamie who was gery helpful and asked me to try sending in from my daughters smart phone or try sending through the online enquiry service and he would watch for the application coming in. Jamie you are a star my application was actioned the same day as submitted. Thank you.

records.title: Tyne Tunnel Exemption The instructions provided allowed for…
records.text: The instructions provided allowed for the process to be completed easily as long as you read them carefully.The only annoying part was the fact that the date started when you received the email instead of from the last day of the exemption.The emails from Tyne Tunnel were quick and informative.

records.title: Appalling but redeemed by subsequent action
records.text: Appalling . All my details have been wiped and when I try to re enter them the app will not let me , nor will the app give me a financial statement. I have tried to make contact through the given mechanism and no one has yet contacted me. After complaining via trust pilot the company contacted me and sorted out their IT problem. I have consequently changed my review to 4 stars for the prompt way they dealt with it.

records.title: Slightly confusing to receive 2 Emails…
records.text: Slightly confusing to receive 2 Emails at the same time saying account is cancelled and the second Email stating I have an account. Contacted them by phone and everything explained that I do have a renewal, but as you cannot have 2 at the same time, they send you a  cancellation of the listing one! Got there in the end.

records.title: Good but confusing
records.text: I found it easy to renew my blue badge but they confused me by sending me to many emails, 2 said that my application had been successful and the other one saying that my application was invalid and I had to stop using my blue badge to go through the tunnel. These 3 emails came within a minute of each other 12-33 and 12-32.      Otherwise no problems and I am happy to use my badge for another year, my advice is carefully check your emails TT send you.

records.title: First Toll Experience
records.text: It was the first time requiring a toll cost for me. The information was simple to follow and understand, cost wise it wasn't too bad either, although with road tax charges my personal opinion is there should be no toll roads!

records.title: Problem was that it's a motability…
records.text: Problem was that it's a motability vehicle, so was waiting an age for them to provide a copy of V5 paperwork. Once received and applied for exemption was done quickly and efficiently. Many thanks.

records.title: I didn’t like the repeated emails…
records.text: I didn’t like the repeated emails requesting the same information even after exemption certificate had been granted.

records.title: The web site doesn’t work..it continues…
records.text: The web site doesn’t work..it continues to buffer…I tried for days but could not submit my Tunnel renewal despite all relevant documents being attached.Exactly the same happens every year..it’s is nit my computer as can send everything else without a glitch.However, sorted by a fabulous customer service guy via telephone and email the next day.

records.title: The profits of this company are…
records.text: The profits of this company are exhorbident. The toll is high. To many a necessary expense but it just adds to he cost of living.This company has an ideal opportunity to leave a legacy for the community that it serves. Not fashionable green washing nor a  gluttonous charity. Can l suggest a Construction training college?Providing futures in the locality.What a great PR coupe!

records.title: Due care and attention- Television…
records.text: Due care and attention- Television screens should be removed as they are a distraction, could cause an accident. 50% of the tunnel north to south on an evening is empty, due to backed up traffic at the last slip road down to the tunnel. Should be bollards to prevent inside lane switching to outside lane until further along straight. I’ve noticed this choking traffic at this point. Should also show that speed limit is 40 inside the tunnel as some drivers are doing 25-30 again not utilising the tunnel space to flow more vehicles through.

records.title: Staff aren't disability aware
records.text: Fast response this time, unlike all the other ones. However there is no need for it to be 12 months, when the blue badge clearly states 3 years. Customers having to go to and re-apply ever year who have difficulties already clearly shows the heads of TT2 limited aren't disability aware.

records.title: Computerised payment system needs to be…
records.text: Computerised payment system needs to be looked at. I went through the procedure for payment and entered the requested information. I was not informed that the payment had gone through. This needs to be improved otherwise unnecessary fines will result. I also added money to my account and again wasn't informed that the payment had gone through. I emailed my dilemma to TT2 and was very impressed by their response which sorted out my dilemma and undoubtedly saved me from a fine.

records.title: Losing money without going through TT2.
records.text: I’ve avoided using the TT2 as earlier on this year I had 2 accounts with different balances and now I cannot even find these accounts so lost out about £15 between both accounts. I sent a message on Facebook book but got nowhere. I cannot afford to top up an account and lose the money if I haven’t been through the TT2 for a couple of months or longer.

records.title: It is illogical that when I am disabled…
records.text: It is illogical that when I am disabled it is the vehicle which is registered. I appreciate that you have to read a number plate, however I do travel in a number of different cars. Have you considered issuing a small transponder which travels with me so I am what counts not the vehicle in which I’m being transported?

records.title: Great staff but confusing website
records.text: The staff are great, helpful when asked but the site and procedures must have been developed by someone with zero customer service skills. It's very confusing.

records.title: Signage
records.text: I use this tunnel most weeks.  I feel sorry for the people who have their first experience using it.  The entrance going North is very confusing with the traffic lights and extra lanes to the left.The speed limit should be reduced so they are both 30 miles/hour.The information sign is not big enough or the size of lettering on it.

records.title: Really easy to complete the online form…
records.text: Really easy to complete the online form but the process faltered when the vehicle is in another person's name. My mum is the blue badge holder but my vehicle is nominated. I completed the forms on behalf of my mum and uploaded the relevant documents but received a mail initially advising my email could not be linked. I provided my mum's then received a second mail advising the account could not be processed. I called TT2 to ask what else was required and was advised my mum needed to authorise this. I found this unhelpful as I complete all the relevant documents for my elderly mum. I had to arrange for my mum to call TT2 and she was advised she needed to write a letter for me to upload to TT2 authorising the processing of the form. An absolute waste of time and added stress that was not required.

records.title: Low score due to need to reapply again in 4/12
records.text: Low score, for knowing have to renew again in 4 months when I renew Blue Badge (have indefinite PIP higher mobility award, so no issue getting it renewed) then again, when my Motability lease runs out on current car in Dec. Surely they could have made last application last to expiry of Blue Badge? Why can’t they use DVLA Disability tax exempt Vehicle data, for those who qualify, instead, asked to submit exemptions form, Motability lease holders don’t have. Or PIP award letter which has very personal medical information on it, unlike old DLA award letters.

records.title: Renewal of blue Badge
records.text: I received my renewal Blue Badge on Friday 15th February and immediately applied for a permit on line as I was going through the tunnel next day. When I stopped at the booth to explain I was told I could not use the blue badge until the account was set up so had to pay £4.40 and then at 10.00 a.m. on Monday 19th February, I received an email confirming that my account was set up. I paid when in reality I had an account waiting for me. If that had been midweek it would have my account set up in time. There must be a way to accept the blue badge. If I was travelling through from a distance, the blue badge would have let the driver through. Why not a resident??

records.title: Unnecessarily Complicated
records.text: This is the 2nd pass renewal,(3rd year) also the 2nd complete repeat exercise including ratification of address AND change thereof!If TT2 records the details to check against,why is the renewal application so complicated?If it has to be an annual process why treat it as a fresh application every yearClassic !

I'VE ALREADY APPLIED ANDRECEIVED MY RENEWAL BADGE [EXPIRES28/2/2026]OF WHICH I HAVE APPLIED FOR FREE  PERMIT TO TT2.EMAILS FROM TT2 HAVE CONFUSED ME.PLEASE ENLIGHTEN ME IF ICAN USE TT2MANY THANKS R E RAMSAY

records.title: Renewal procedure confusion
records.text: Was originally advised exemption was to expire 11/10/23. Completed on line renewal procedure easily & efficiently on 19/9/23. But then received an email on 20/9/23 saying that it had expired. This was followed by another advising it had been renewed for 12 months from 20/9/23. I find this confusing & mistrustful that the exemption has indeed been renewed.

records.title: Confusing and frustrated
records.text: Confusing and frustrated.  Documents were uploaded to the online application but received email to say they weren't and request to forward docs.  Despite applying for exemption I received email to say account was set up and car details and funds must be added before use, only to receive further email to say exemption had been applied to the car I'd added to the original application (so you had the details all along).  Then received an email about password reset following my request which I didn't make.  Anywho, process was complete in the stated timescales so all's well that ends well!

records.title: No ANPR for Motability vehicles
records.text: I pay for my travel,even though. I am disabled and drive a Motability car. Other crossings recognise my vehicle, why don’t you ?  It should be automatic. I shouldn’t have to prove my disability

records.title: The process to renew online was frustrating
records.text: The process to renew online was frustrating. You couldn't attach photos to a renewal so had to go through and treat it as a new application. Much easier to go to an office and renew in person.

records.title: Took a long time to get form…
records.text: Took a long time to get form completed,had to send different proofs- and I’m computer illiterate. Once completed,it went ahead fairly speedily.

records.title: Too complicated.
records.text: Too complicated.Difficult to find the correct procedure.Pass should run in line with Blue Bagde, i.e. valid until badge expires.Thanks

records.title: Instructions to change blue badge…
records.text: Instructions to change blue badge vehicle are WRONG! That's NOT how to do it.They say:- Log into your account using your email address and new password - Add new vehicle registration - Click on permits PLEASE look at your system and put it right. It's ALWAYS hard work trying to do anything on your site.

records.title: Exempt or not?
records.text: I received an expired email, then another stating the following Tyne TunnelsTyne Tunnels ExemptionA Blue Badge Holder with the label Blue Badge has been created for your account.It has been applied to your vehicle, NE245EE.Please rate your Blue Badge application experience by leaving us a review This is an automated email. Please do not respond directly to this message.It’s confusing because it states my postcode not my licence plate for my car, so unsure if I’m exempt

records.title: Just had to renew my Blue Badge…
records.text: Just had to renew my Blue Badge exemption 3/12 after previously renewing it as  my Blue Badge had to be renewed, will have to renew again in Dec/Jan when the lease on my Motability car ends / new one starts with new car. Pity that they can’t automatically exempt Cars whose tax status with DVLA is Disabled. as well as the Blue Badge exemption. Would make life much easier than having to reapply 3 times in one year.

records.title: Ridiculous queues
records.text: For years there has been no traffic whatsoever going through the tunnel southbound. Now there are only 2 lanes to the tunnel, the traffic is backed up towards silverlink roundabout. Nothing but inconvenience and delays caused to all drivers. Very poor "improvement"!

records.title: Absolute shambles during the system…
records.text: Absolute shambles during the system changeover, didn’t advise of low balance which resulted in several unpaid toll notices, which I paid grudgingly after my appeals were rejected and I was blamed for not having the low balance reminder ticked. This was rubbish as I had it ticked from opening my account. Received numerous requests to download the App. But I have zero trust in this company now, so no thanks.

records.title: Can you PLEASE change the ‘exclusivity’…
records.text: Can you PLEASE change the ‘exclusivity’ arrangements?!I am a long time pre-paid user of the Tyne Tunnel. In addition to using the tunnel regularly, I look forward to the updates, and, in particular, the special offers. HOWEVER, it seems that, unless I subscribe to the various social media platforms (e.g. Facebook), I am not able to access the special offers. NOT EVERYONE chooses to use these platforms, and it seems discriminatory that not all who subscribe to the Tyne Tunnel are eligible to take advantage of such offers. PLEASE consider opening them up to ALL who subscribe, and not just a selection.

records.title: Contact with TT2 could not be easier
records.text: Contact with TT2 could not be easier. They provided the help I required, were direct, listened and made my approach easy. Nothing seemed to be a problem.A refreshing experience.his of course was preceded by very informative and useful email messages.

records.title: Blue Badge Exemption is not Straightforward
records.text: Setting up a blue badge exemption account was a bit tortuous. I received 3 e-mails relating to this, the first one of which saying I was almost there and gave me loads of instructions to follow. And then at the bottom of the e-mail it said this did not apply to a blue badge exemption account! My partner was expecting his existing account (which has a balance on it) would become an exempt account because of the vehicle registration number. This was not so and his vehicle is now registered under my new account. Despite ringing the customer helpline we are still not clear how is balance will be applied to a journey made without me in the car. I suppose we will have to wait to see what happens when such a journey is made.

records.title: Unnecessary repeat  paperwork
records.text: It was just by chance that I was told to renew my blue badge exemption .I have my disability for life so why not an exemption for life. On my original application it did not indicate that a yearly renewal was required. The copy of my blue badge that you have is valid till 2025 . So why not my exemption !!!!!!!!!!!!!

description:
Express Solicitors is an award winning Top 70 UK law firm that specialise in personal injury claims.

The firm prides itself on pursuing a huge range of ‘no win, no fee’ personal injury claims – helping you to claim compensation for any accident you may have experienced.

Express Solicitors cover every area of personal injury including; employer’s liability, road traffic accidents, serious injuries, clinical negligence, occupier’s and public liability, and industrial disease.

Our accident claim solicitors are supported by a team of dedicated support specialists, cutting edge technology, and an on-going training programme that ensures they are fully up-to-date with any advances in personal injury law.
